title: Floor Manager - (Operations Coach) - Croydon
description:
In our NIKE Retail Stores we use special job names for our positions: a Store Manager is called "Head Coach", an Assistant Store Manager is called "Assistant Head Coach", a department manager is called "Coach", a team leader is called “Lead“ and a Sales Associates is called "Athlete".


As a Coach you are:

  • Using your expertise in the field of exceptional consumer service to serve and deliver a premium brand experience to our consumers
  • Leading, coaching and motivating the employees in your department and ensuring an excellent work atmosphere
  • Managing the daily business in your department to reach sales targets (incl. digital services, visual merchandising, salesfloor)
  • Identifying and improving areas based on feedback given by consumers
  • Being a brand ambassador for NIKE’s initiatives including training your team
  • Ensuring that the store complies with all NIKE standards and guidelines
  • Cooperating with your business partners across stores and HQ

More specifically, our store structure consists of the 3 Coach roles below:


COMMERCIAL

  • Leading a team who can deliver efficient receiving of product, inventory accuracy to visual presentation standards
  • Ensuring the smooth process of all inventories warranting our sales floor is always full, presentable and achieve brand standards
  • Working alongside departments leads who will oversee the individual components (product receiving and visual presentation) whilst you will be responsible for the overall product journey in store.
  • Being responsible for monthly initiative launches
  • Using our reporting tools to make the best commercial decisions
  • Achieving accurate inventory to fulfill digital orders

ATHLETE EXPERIENCE

  • Ensuring the team is equipped to deliver the highest quality athlete experience (Purpose)
  • Leading team Engagement on NIKE Community Ambassador activities
  • Partnering with senior store leadership, you will oversee the hiring processes including onboarding
  • Being responsible for store scheduling
  • Working collaboratively with store team to implement & maintain a positive NIKE culture

CONSUMER EXPERIENCE

  • Leading by example and the delivery of our sales floor service and bring the consumer journey to life
  • Ensuring the team is equipped with brand knowledge regarding all aspects consumer service including digital service enablers
  • Completing specific training and share completion with athlete services
  • Using data and analytics to provide insights and partner to achieve continuous improvement with senior store leadership

What you get:

  • Attractive salary that evolves with the market and experience
  • Opportunity on receiving monthly bonus payments
  • Attractive online and in-store employee discounts
  • Attractive Benefits Package, Pension & Share scheme
  • Exciting development and career opportunities
  • Regular training on leadership, sales and products
  • A dynamic and motivating environment which values Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DE&I)
  • Staff dress to represent NIKE and foster our team spirit
  • Access to sports activities
  • Opportunities to participate in unique NIKE moments

What you bring:

  • A passion for NIKE and/or love of sport
  • Experience in retail and/or leadership positions
  • Very good command of English language (written and spoken)
  • Experience and competency in serving exceptional consumer service
  • Ability to coach and develop a strong team
  • Strong focus on communication
  • Flexibility to work in shifts and on weekends

Watch this video to find out about the atmosphere in our stores and learn more about our store traditions.


Did we arouse your interest and do you want to support us on our mission “To bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete in the world.”? Apply now, easy way online. We are waiting for you!

title: Program Director, Philippines PEARL Program
description:
About TechnoServe:

At TechnoServe, we believe that everyone deserves the opportunity to build a better life. For over 50 years, we have given smallholder farmers and entrepreneurs the skills, connections, and confidence to lift themselves out of poverty. We leverage the power of markets and the private sector to create sustainable economic growth to benefit people and the planet. Our unique mix of business solutions, deep knowledge of local contexts, and data-driven insights is helping to fight poverty across Africa, Asia, and Latin America.

TechnoServe staff are local–95% are from the countries in which they work. We put a high premium on collaboration and entrepreneurship. We hold ourselves and each other to the highest standards of integrity and transparency. And we focus on delivering lasting impact for our mission.

Job Summary:

The Program Director leads TechnoServe’s technical support unit for PEARL, a five-year, USD 19 million program that works with the Philippine Coconut Authority (PCA) to raise the incomes of 250,000 smallholder coconut households and help the Philippines supply quality copra and premium coconut oil to global buyers.

The Program Director is accountable for strategy, delivery, quality, budget and relationships across PCA, cooperatives, oil processors, government agencies and funders, and builds the systems that let local institutions sustain results after the program ends.

The Program Director leads a dedicated program team of approximately 17 staff based in Manila and across five program regions.

Program Overview:

The Philippines is the world’s largest coconut oil producer, yet about 3 million coconut farmers earn on average PHP 35,000 a year. Aging palms, smoke-dried copra that fails EU food-safety limits, and a trader-dominated supply chain keep farm incomes low and mills under-supplied.

PEARL is a market systems development program designed with and for PCA and aligned with the Coconut Farmers and Industry Development Plan (CFIDP) 2024–2028. By 2030 it aims to reach 250,000 farming households, raise net farm incomes by at least 30% for 80% of participating farmers, and ensure 80% of coconut oil produced by participating processors meets premium and export quality standards. PCA is the lead partner and convener; cooperatives are the implementing partners that own Farm Service Crews and Copra Processing Hubs; anchor oil processors provide quality-based offtake; and TechnoServe acts as the technical support unit, facilitating, training and monitoring rather than implementing directly. The program runs in phases, beginning with a six-month planning phase.

Primary Functions & Responsibilities:

Strategy and Partnership with PCA (20%)

  • Set program strategy and direction with PCA; lead Task Force and governance engagements.
  • Keep PEARL aligned with CFIDP and secure commitments from implementing agencies.
  • Partnership identification & management. Work with program partners to ensure the program aligns with respective partners’ social strategy objectives

Program Delivery and Results (25%)

  • Deliver the results framework on time and on budget: cooperative cohorts, Farm Service Crews, Copra Processing Hubs, quality copra volumes and farmer income gains.
  • Adapt the approach as evidence emerges from each phase.
  • Set strategy and lead strategy planning and monitoring activities with the program team
  • Maintain a culture of executing the program at the highest quality possible, using learnings from the TNS global community and creating, or continuing to use, tools or systems to support this standard
  • Direct responsibility for recruitment and management of various consultants for various aspects of the program

Market Linkages (15%)

  • Build and sustain relationships with oil processors, buyers and market-access partners.
  • Structure quality-based offtake between cooperatives and processors and link processors to premium markets.

Cooperative and Institutional Capacity (15%)

  • Oversee training of trainers and technical support for cooperative managers, crews and PCA field teams on quality, drying, aggregation, finance and governance.
  • Ensure women and youth participate meaningfully.

Financial and Operational Management (10%)

  • Own the budget, forecasting, compliance with TechnoServe and funder rules, procurement and risk management.
  • Manage subawards or agreements with partners.
  • Manage and plan expenditures to deliver program within program budget
  • Approve expenses, adhering to TNS procurement policies

Results Measurement and Reporting (10%)

  • Lead the MEL system, including TechnoServe’s impact platform.
  • Report to PCA, funders and TechnoServe leadership; manage evaluations and publish learning.
  • Ensure program has a clear theory of change which is outlined in a monitoring and evaluation framework and log frame, and that established program systems and procedures are followed in order to meet those targets
  • Incorporate the use of M&E data into program implementation to inform adaptations of the model such that TechnoServe activities are as impactful as possible
  • Conduct annual impact assessments, working with consultants and internal TechnoServe resources

Leadership of People (5%)

  • Recruit, coach and manage the program team; model TechnoServe values and safeguarding, safety and inclusion standards.
  • Manage the program team including building an office culture focused on the TechnoServe values

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree (with 12 years of relevant experience), or Master’s degree (with eight years of relevant experience) in agriculture, economics, business administration or another relevant area
  • At least five years leading a multi-stakeholder agribusiness or market systems program with significant budgets and teams, preferably in Asia
  • Demonstrated experience working with government agencies and private-sector buyers or processors
  • Experience managing donor- or investor-funded programs, budgets and compliance

Required Languages: Excellent oral, written and interpersonal skills, including professional fluency in English.

Travel: Travel up to 30–40%, mainly domestic to coconut-producing regions and partner sites; occasional international travel.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in coconut, tree-crop or other agricultural commodity value chains in the Philippines or Southeast Asia
  • Experience with cooperative strengthening, aggregation or farm-service models, and with agricultural finance or blended financing
  • Knowledge of food-safety and quality requirements in edible-oil export markets (for example EU contaminant limits)
  • Working knowledge of Filipino or another Philippine language
  • Advanced degree in agriculture, economics, business or a related field

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strategic and systems thinking: designs and adapts interventions that change how markets work rather than delivering services directly
  • Strong leadership: builds high-performing, diverse teams and manages through partners and influence
  • Stakeholder management: credible with senior government officials, cooperative leaders, executives and funders
  • Commercial acumen: understands supply chains, offtake structures, unit economics and financing
  • Analytical and results orientation: uses data to make decisions and report with rigor
  • Strong written and spoken communication, including presentations to senior audiences
  • Integrity and commitment to gender equality, social inclusion and safeguarding

Supervisory Responsibilities: Leads a dedicated TechnoServe program team of approximately 17 staff: an Associate Director, Program; three Technical Managers and three Program Associates; two MEL Managers and four Data Coordinators; and Communications and Finance/HR support. Directly supervises the Associate Director, Technical Managers, MEL Managers and operations leads, and works with the Technical Advisors and the Steering Committee, who provide expertise and oversight. Team size and structure are subject to the approved budget.

Candidates must have valid, unrestricted work authorization in the Philippines. TechnoServe will not provide sponsorship for this position. The position is contingent upon program award.

We encourage all qualified individuals who share TechnoServe's vision of improving the lives of others through proven business solutions to apply.

With our commitment to diversity, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and affirmative action employer and do not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, color, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, HIV/AIDS status, protected veteran status, disability and all other protected classes.

We are also proud of our commitment to protecting staff, partners, and beneficiaries from abuse and exploitation and thoroughly vet all final candidates through rigorous background and reference checks.

If you have a disability that affects your ability to use our online system to apply for a position at TechnoServe please contact the Human Resources at recruitment@tns.org or call +1 202 785 4515.

title: Tenure-track Assistant and Associate Professorships in Algorithms at SDU Vejle
description:
We seek candidates to join the Algorithms Section at the Department of Mathematics and Computer Science and contribute to the development of the new SDU Centre for Computer Science and AI in Vejle.

The starting time is negotiable with a preference for Summer 2027.

The academic environment
Hired candidates will join the Algorithms Section, which spans SDU’s campuses in Odense and Vejle, and become part of the new SDU Centre for Computer Science and AI. Based at the new campus in Vejle, in the heart of Denmark’s Triangle Region and its strong and developing IT ecosystem, the centre offers an inclusive, international and collaborative environment for research and education in Computer Science and AI. It connects research, teaching and innovation through collaboration across research groups and with companies, public organizations and international partners.

The Centre for Computer Science and AI at SDU Vejle connects fundamental computer science with AI, data and advanced digital systems. Its shared focus is how architectures, AI, data and advanced algorithms can transform the specification, design, development, validation, deployment and operation of digital systems. The research environment is also home to SustainAI, an international research group advancing the design, development, evolution, testing and operation of sustainable, high-quality and AI-enabled software systems.

We encourage applications from researchers who can complement or strengthen the Algorithms Section while building links to the centre’s wider scientific environment in areas such as data analytics, data science and machine learning; optimization and computational efficiency; programming languages; software engineering and DevOps; AI-driven development and software evolution; and software architectures, cloud-edge computing, and autonomous and agentic systems.

At SDU Vejle, the department is responsible for international BSc and MSc programmes in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence. The programmes provide a strong setting for research-based teaching, supervision, and student collaboration with researchers and external partners.

Research profile
We seek candidates with a strong research record in efficient algorithms, broadly understood as spanning algorithm design, analysis and implementation as well as complexity theory. Relevant areas include, but are not limited to, approximation algorithms, combinatorial optimization, cryptology, data structures, fine-grained complexity, experimental algorithmics, and algorithmic research bridging to machine learning and AI.

Scientific excellence is the primary requirement. We particularly welcome candidates in algorithms engineering, optimization, or computational efficiency, whose work combines strong algorithmic foundations with the design, implementation and rigorous evaluation of algorithms for real-world problems.

Each appointment should help create a clear and distinctive identity for the Vejle environment by building critical mass, adding a missing capability, or creating a strong bridge between research areas. Candidates must strengthen at least one core area and connect meaningfully with other parts of the centre through research, education or external collaboration.

Industrial collaboration
Industrial collaboration is a defining theme of the centre. Successful candidates are expected to demonstrate an interest in engaging with companies and public organizations and the potential to contribute to the digital transformation of industry at local, national and international levels. Relevant activities may include collaborative research, industrial PhDs, student collaborations, and experimentation with industrial data and systems.

Qualifications
Successful candidates for a tenure-track assistant professorship must demonstrate a promising research record within the area of the call and some experience with teaching and supervision at BSc or MSc level. They are expected to contribute to research-based teaching, student projects and thesis supervision, including activities that connect students, researchers and external partners.

The Danish tenure-track system provides a focused pathway toward a permanent academic position. Before the end of the sixth year of employment, and contingent upon a positive academic assessment, the Assistant Professor will transition to a tenured Associate Professor position. Read more about SDU’s tenure-track program here.

The evaluation is based on an overall assessment of the candidate's academic achievements and potential. Emphasis will be placed on the ability to develop an independent and internationally recognized research profile, deliver high-quality teaching and supervision, contribute actively to the academic community, and demonstrate the potential to secure competitive external research funding and build an ambitious research programme.

As part of the tenure-track programme, the Assistant Professor is expected to complete SDU's Lecturer Training Programme before the tenure evaluation, unless an equivalent university-level programme has already been completed at another institution.

The evaluation will also consider the candidate's contributions to the strategic and organizational development of the department, including a willingness to engage in academic leadership and administrative responsibilities.

Successful candidates for an associate professorship must have an international profile, a distinguished research record within the area of the call, and a proven ability to attract third-party funding. Demonstrated success in building and leading research teams, and a strong record of developing and leading research, innovation or industry-engaged activities, will be an advantage. Extensive teaching and supervision experience across BSc and MSc levels is expected.

Application
In addition to the documentation required under SDU’s appointment procedures, applicants should describe:

  • Possible existing collaboration with industry or public organizations and plans for developing future external partnerships.
  • How they would collaborate with existing groups in Vejle, supported by concrete examples of potential research, educational or practical collaboration.

Further information
More information can be found on:

  • Algorithms Section:
  • SustainAI:
  • Department of Mathematics and Computer Science:
  • SDU Vejle Campus: https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/sdu-campusser/vejle

Contact
If you are curious about the positions and the research environment at SDU Vejle and would like to hear more, please contact:
Davide Taibi, LEGO Chair and leader for the SDU Centre for Computer Science and AI; Email: taibi@imada.sdu.dk
Kim Skak Larsen, Head of the Algorithms Section; Email: kslarsen@imada.sdu.dk
Martin Svensson, Head of the Department of Mathematics and Computer Science Email: svensson@imada.sdu.dk

We recommend that as an international applicant, you take the time to visit Work in Denmark where you will find information and facts about moving to, working and living in Denmark, as well as the International Staff Office at SDU.

Conditions of employment
Appointment as a Tenure Track Assistant Professor is temporary and for an initial up to 6 years period.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme.

The Danish tenure track employment
The Danish tenure-track employment is a focused assistant professorship with a guaranteed assessment for a permanent position as an associate professor within the tenure-track assistant professor’s field of study.

The head of department will host annual performance- and development reviews, to ensure the progress of the assistant professor’s development towards meeting the qualifications of an associate professorship. A formal midterm evaluation will be conducted by a committee, consisting of the head of the department and two external researchers with relevant qualifications, with the purpose of ensuring the focus of the assistant professor’s activities, as well as to create the basis for the planning of the remaining period.

To qualify for the position as Tenure Track Assistant Professor you must have obtained a PhD degree by the employment date.

The transition from assistant professor to associate professor
Within the last year of employment, the tenure-track assistant professor is expected to transition into a position as an associate professor position, based on a positive assessment conducted by a formally approved assessment committee, consisting of a chairman appointed by SDU and minimum one external committee member approved by the dean and the academic council.

Successful applicants to tenure-track assistant professor positions must be scholars with an internationally competitive research profile, whose potential is at the forefront of their discipline. The applicants for tenure-track assistant professorships are assessed based on the criteria of the applicant’s potential to reach an international level of scholarly excellence during the tenure-track period. The candidate will only be promoted to associate professor when the assessment committee confirms that the candidate has scholarly merits at a level of international excellence beyond what can normally be expected for associate professors, with reference to the qualification policy of the research group in which the position is announced.

Indicators of relevant scholarly merits could be documented through scholarly output independent of the PhD supervisor, ground-breaking publications, achievement of excellence grants, and international research network.

The assessment and evaluation process
Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee and the shortlisted applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. The committee may request additional information, and if so, it is the responsibility of the applicants to provide the necessary material.

Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Application, salary etc.
Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the salary agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please check links for more information on salary (only available in Danish) and taxation.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.
As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.
SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Applications will be assessed by an expert committee. When the expert committee issues its assessment, the applicants will be sent the portion of the assessment pertaining to them personally.

The application must include:

  • A curriculum vitae, including information on previous employment with start and end dates
  • A full list of publications
  • Copy of PhD diploma
  • Copies of all publications on which the applicant wishes to be evaluated
  • A brief survey of the applicant's most important research results and research plans for the next three years
  • A teaching portfolio (not applicable for the assistant professor position)

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated.
If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk

An interview may be included as a part of the overall assessment of the applicant’s qualifications.

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Since not all members of the appointment committee are Danish-speaking, it is recommended that your application is submitted in English.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark.

About SDU
The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

title: QA Associate Quality Engineer

title: Software Engineer
description:
At Franklin Templeton, we believe success is built through powerful partnerships. As a forward thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique.


From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success.

About the department


Our direct team is based in the USA. The team supports batch systems for FADB, our funds accounting database, and for GPW, the downstream system that reports product performance. The immediate team is currently three full-time employees.

We are seeking an experienced and adaptable Software Engineer to design and deliver resilient, secure, well-observed software for Franklin Templeton's Technology & Operations organization, and to raise engineering standards on the team. This is a senior-level individual contributor role with a stronger emphasis on design and system quality.

You will own the design and delivery of services and applications from idea to production and beyond, make sound architecture decisions, build for security and reliability, and help teammates through code review and shared tooling.

Your work gives the business secure, reliable and well-observed platforms.



How you will add value


Core Responsibilities


  • You will design and build scalable back-end services, batch processes and APIs in Python (Django and FastAPI) and Oracle PL/SQL, developing new code and configuration for complete features.
  • You will define service health metrics, and use logging, metrics and tracing to find and fix production problems safely, including failures in batch processes.
  • You will build security into design: authentication, authorization, API protection and secrets management.

Strategic Responsibilities


  • You will make and document architecture decisions on distributed systems, scalability, high availability and event-driven design, and propose high-level solutions.
  • You will design GitLab CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployments on AWS (Lambda, ECS Fargate, EC2) that release database, API and application changes together safely, and establish test strategy and automation.
  • You will design and build AI-enabled features where they add value, and evaluate their quality and safety.

Team & Collaboration


  • You will review source code and effort estimates of more junior engineers, and build shared libraries and developer tooling.
  • You will plan and coordinate cutover and implementation activities, build effective working relationships with other technical teams, and resolve ownership questions between teams with evidence.



What will help you be successful in this role


Experience, Education & Certifications


1-4 years of experience


  • Uses AI assistants as a natural part of their development workflow: for writing code, debugging, writing tests, generating documentation, and exploring unfamiliar domains.
  • Decomposes a task into parts, translates those parts into effective prompts, and iterates on those prompts until the task is complete.
  • Treats AI-generated outputs as drafts, not final, and refines them before incorporating.
  • Actively explores new AI tools, techniques, and capabilities.

4+ years of experience


  • Approaches system design, architecture, or technical decisions, considering where AI can meaningfully improve the solution, not just the development process.
  • Evaluates trade-offs between AI-assisted and traditional approaches with practical judgement.
  • Identifies repetitive, manual, or error-prone processes in their team's work and introduces AI-powered improvements, including but not limited to code reviews, AI-assisted testing, intelligent alerting, or document generation.
  • Applies advanced prompting techniques to tackle ambiguous, multi-step or domain specific problems.

Technical Environment


  • Core stack: Python and Oracle PL/SQL, with a Django web application (using Django REST) and FastAPI REST APIs, both running on ECS Fargate.
  • Operating environment: AWS cloud, with some workloads on Linux EC2 and some container-based (ECS Fargate).
  • Workflow: Git and GitLab CI/CD, AWS Lambda workflows and S3.
  • Quality and reliability: service health metrics, logging, tracing, production debugging, automated testing.

Technical and Soft Skills


  • Strong programming skills in Python, including Django (with Django REST) for web applications and FastAPI for REST APIs.
  • Solid grounding in system design: distributed systems, scalability, high availability and event-driven patterns.
  • Strong Oracle SQL and PL/SQL development experience, including performance tuning.
  • Working knowledge of authentication and authorization, API security and secrets management.
  • Experience with GitLab CI/CD (or similar), containers and AWS deployment (for example Lambda, S3, ECS Fargate and EC2), and with production monitoring and troubleshooting.
  • Strong testing discipline, including automation.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and delivering production systems end to end.
  • Clear communication, effective teamwork, and the ability to influence peers across teams.
  • Experience building LLM applications, including retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, and evaluation of AI output would be a plus.
  • Experience with Linux on AWS EC2 and with event-driven workflows on AWS Lambda and S3 would be a plus.
  • Experience mentoring other engineers would be a plus.
  • Experience in financial services or other regulated environments would be a plus.

Franklin Templeton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and existing employees, and we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to ancestry, age, color, disability, genetic information, gender, gender identity, or gender expression, marital status, medical condition, military or veteran status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, and any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law, ordinance, or regulation.

title: Front Office Agent
description:
Intro

The William Vale aims to blend the authenticity of the Williamsburg neighborhood with a forward-thinking approach to the hospitality experience. The William Vale offers a comfortable contemporary atmosphere combined with intuitive design and modern comfort – we pride ourselves on offering warm hospitality to all.

We understand that for our colleagues to give their best work, we must meet (and exceed!) their expectations as an employer. We promote a culture of respect, diversity, career growth and fun. Success awaits motivated individuals who join our team.

Overview

An enthusiastic people-person to serve as the first and last impression for guests during their stay. A team-minded and solution-orientated professional with expert communication skills who will serve as an expert on our property and the neighborhood.

Responsibilities

As a Front Desk Agent, you will be the first point of contact for our guests, entrusted with delivering unparalleled service and crafting unforgettable experiences.

Your role will involve a variety of key responsibilities, including but not limited to the following:

  • Organize, confirm, process, and conduct all guest check-ins and check-outs. Handle room reservations, requests, changes, and cancellations efficiently and accurately.
  • Greet guests both over the phone and in person with a warm, friendly, and sincere welcome, ensuring each guest feels valued and appreciated.
  • Promptly answer guest inquiries over the phone using a positive and clear tone. Effectively handle a high volume of calls and requests, directing inquiries to the appropriate departments as needed.
  • Review all guest arrivals and departures. Retrieve, input, verify, and update important guest information in the Property Management System (PMS).
  • Listen to and resolve guest problems or concerns with professionalism and empathy. Stay calm, confident, and solution-oriented during difficult conversations, emergencies, or busy hotel periods.
  • Record and track all guest requests and complaints in the guest profile, ensuring follow-up on any outstanding issues from previous shifts.
  • Establish and maintain close working relationships with other hotel departments (such as Housekeeping, and F&B) to ensure smooth and cohesive operations.
  • Assist guests with making reservations at hotel dining outlets and provide information about the hotel’s dining options as well as take in-room dining orders.
  • Provide guests with detailed information about hotel services, facilities, events, and local attractions, ensuring a seamless guest experience.
  • Use hotel systems to send information to guests according to service standards, maintaining clear and timely communication at all times.
  • Adhere to company policies, ensuring that your uniform and personal appearance is clean, neat, and professional at all times.
  • Assist with additional guest services, such as transportation arrangements, package deliveries, and special requests.
  • Perform other reasonable duties as assigned.

Skills

  • Proactive approach to problem resolution, including: anticipating, preventing, identifying, and solving issues as needed. Contribute to short term and long term problem solving.
  • Outstanding communication skills and ability to effectively communicate with others.
  • Maintain a high level of professionalism in all interactions/situations.
  • Maintain confidentiality of guest information.
  • Understanding of: Outlook Office (Excel, Word, Email) – experience with Opera Cloud, Hot SOS is a plus.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in customer service required.
  • Hotel experience is a plus.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays as needed is a must.
  • Ability to lift and transport up to 10 pounds.
  • Comply with Standards and regulations to encourage safe and efficient hotel operations.
  • Capacity to work varied shifts, including weekends and holidays.

title: Full Stack Software Developer
description:
• Compensation: USD 30,000 - USD 50,000 - yearly

Company Description

About the Role

We're looking for a software developer who enjoys building things that solve real business problems — and who cares about how those things run once they're live.

This is a broad role in a small engineering organization. You'll build internal and customer-facing applications, prototype new ideas, and work close to the infrastructure those applications run on. If you like moving between product work and the systems side rather than staying in one lane, this role is designed for you.

Our stack is deliberately pragmatic rather than uniform: TypeScript and React on the frontend, with Scala, Python, Node.js, and Go across various services, all running on AWS. We care more about your engineering fundamentals than the specific languages on your resume — strong developers pick up a new stack quickly, and we'll give you the time to do it.

This will be an on site position with some hybrid work from home flexibility. Must be available to have some overlap with our US based team.

The gross annual salary for this role is $30,000 - $50,000 USD

Job Description

What You'll Do

Product & Application Development

Build and maintain modern web applications, from UI through to API and data layer.

Develop new product features and improve existing applications.

Integrate third-party APIs and external services.

Build internal tools and automations that remove manual work from business processes.

Translate business requirements into reliable, maintainable software.

Troubleshoot issues and improve application performance and reliability.

Participate in code reviews and help raise the bar on engineering practices.

Infrastructure & Operations

Infrastructure work is shared across a small team rather than siloed, so we're looking for someone who can contribute here credibly. How much of it lands with you will depend on your strengths and where the team needs help — but you should be comfortable with all of it.

Work with AWS infrastructure across production and non-production environments (EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, RDS, S3, VPC, IAM, CloudFront, Route 53).

Contribute to infrastructure defined as code using Terraform or CloudFormation.

Help maintain CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments, and improve the workflows around environments, releases, and debugging.

Contribute to monitoring, alerting, logging, and tracing — including dashboards and alerts that are actually actionable.

Take part in investigating production issues, root-cause analysis, and the follow-up fixes that prevent repeats.

Apply sound security practices: least-privilege IAM, network security, encryption, secrets management, and secure configuration.

Keep an eye on AWS spend — right-sizing, autoscaling, and retiring what isn't being used.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Several years building and shipping production web applications end to end.

Strong programming fundamentals in a modern typed or backend language, and the ability to become productive in a new one quickly.

Hands-on experience running applications on AWS or a comparable cloud platform.

Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and infrastructure as code.

Comfort operating what you build — debugging production issues, reading logs and metrics, and improving reliability over time.

Experience with SQL and relational databases.

Experience integrating REST APIs and third-party services.

Git and pull-request-based collaboration.

Strong analytical skills and clear written and verbal communication.

Nice to Have

TypeScript.

Scala, Python, Go, or Node.js.

Terraform specifically, and container orchestration (ECS, EKS, or Kubernetes).

Observability tooling — metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting platforms.

Experience building applications on top of AI services or LLM APIs.

Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code.

Exposure to SOC 2 or similar compliance work.

Experience building automation or workflow tooling.

Additional Information

How You Work

You take initiative, take ownership, and follow work through to completion without needing to be chased.

You're resourceful and enjoy practical technical problems, including the unglamorous ones.

You pick up new technologies quickly and apply them sensibly.

You communicate clearly — progress, blockers, and technical decisions — and collaborate well.

You ship high-quality, practical solutions rather than over-engineering.

You have a product mindset and care whether the software actually creates impact.

What We Offer:

Direct impact: the products and systems you build are the ones the business runs on.

End-to-end ownership of meaningful projects, from idea through release and operation.

Unusual breadth for one role — product engineering and the infrastructure underneath it.

A collaborative environment focused on learning and continuous improvement.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Platform Solution Architect - AWS
description:
Join Kainos and Shape the Future

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.


We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.


Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.

Main purpose of the role & responsibilities in the business:


As a Platform Solution Architect (Manager) in Kainos, you'll be responsible for leading multi-skilled agile teams to design and deliver high-quality solutions on public cloud which delight our customers. As a technical leader in Kainos, you'll work with customer architects and talented colleagues to design, automate, build and support modern digital service platforms. You'll estimate effort and advise on the impact of technical decisions surrounding technology choices.

You work AI-Augmented as standard and lead its adoption across projects and accounts. You use AI tooling responsibly throughout the delivery lifecycle to increase automation, accelerate delivery, and improve outcomes while maintaining accountability for quality, governance and risk. You embed effective AI-Augmented practices into ways of working, coach teams and senior engineers, and contribute to the continuous evolution of Kainos's AI delivery capability.

All employees are expected to continuously develop their understanding of AI capabilities relevant to their role and actively seek opportunities to improve customer, business, and delivery outcomes through responsible application of AI, while operating within appropriate security, regulatory, commercial, and governance constraints.


Your Key Responsibilities

  • Championing a DevOps culture: You'll lead colleagues in engineering, testing, consulting, product management and security to design solutions of the highest quality which meet all non-functional requirements.
  • Championing technology for positive impact: You'll keep appraised of the latest technologies and tools and champion their use within and outside of Kainos.
  • Developing Kainos as a business: You contribute to technology strategy and help Kainos to identify, qualify and win new opportunities.
  • Providing Leadership: You'll provide technical leadership, typically across projects, and take the difficult but necessary decisions when required.
  • Being opinionated: As a respected leader, you'll offer your opinions and critique with a view to improving the quality of our solutions.
  • Being a role model: You'll support your colleagues and reconcile the needs of the individual with the needs of the team, embodying the Kainos values.
  • Putting people first & developing others: You'll manage, coach and develop a small number of senior staff, with a focus on managing employee performance and assisting in their career development.
  • Working AI-Augmented: You'll maintain an open and curious mindset towards AI, continually exploring how evolving capabilities can improve the way work is performed. You'll challenge existing practices, experiment responsibly with new approaches, and apply sound judgement to determine where AI delivers meaningful value, and where it does not. You'll balance innovation with pragmatism as you remain accountable for the results delivered.

​

Minimum (Essential) Requirements

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to simply and clearly communicate technical concepts to a non-technical audience.
  • Excellent prioritisation and time management skills, with the ability to work across a number of major projects simultaneously.
  • Proven team leadership skills across teams and fostering a DevOps culture.
  • Demonstrated ability in managing, coaching and developing senior members of your team and wider community.
  • Demonstrable personal ownership of: delivering all aspects of modern digital service platforms in production environments; prioritising non-functional concerns and incorporating them into the platform design; making effective decisions within fast-moving delivery environments and owning the outcomes.
  • Significant expertise in: using multiple public cloud platforms (AWS and Azure) to build solutions across a variety of problem domains; whole-solution architecture concepts; the latest Continuous Delivery techniques.
  • Demonstrable experience in: latest container orchestration platforms including Kubernetes; applying cloud-native tooling and approaches; pro-actively developing business within an account; accountability for all sizes of technology delivery challenges; developing and contributing to business cases promoting public cloud adoption.
  • Demonstrable experience of successfully applying AI to improve outcomes, evolve ways of working and solve complex business or delivery challenges. Evidence of translating experimentation and learning into sustainable improvements, shaping the adoption of effective practices and adapting approaches as technology capabilities evolve.

​

Desirable

  • Third level (or equivalent) qualification in a related discipline.
  • Obtained certification with a public cloud provider (AWS/Azure).
  • Obtained certification with another respected professional body (CNCF).
  • Actively shares thoughts and views on technology both internally and externally.
  • Use of automation tooling and proficient in one of the following: Powershell, Bash, Python, Ruby, Go, Groovy.
  • Experience shaping or evolving delivery approaches, operating models, or platform capabilities that improve developer experience, productivity, and delivery outcomes across projects and accounts.
  • An active interest in emerging trends shaping the future of software delivery and platform engineering, such as agentic delivery patterns.

Embracing our differences

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive. We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are. We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out.

We understand that everyone's journey is different, and by having a private conversation we can ensure that our recruitment process is tailored to your needs.

title: Starbucks Manager
description:
Why choose us?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career? Join us for an exciting opportunity at Albertsons Companies, where innovation and customer service go hand-in-hand!

At Albertsons Companies, we are looking for someone who’s not just seeking a job, but someone who wants to make an impact. Starbucks Manager

This position ensures the department consistently delivers the Starbucks Experience while maintaining company and Starbucks brand standards. title: Shelter Technician (Full-time)

title: Barback
company: Kimpton Seafire Resort & Spa | Hotel Indigo Grand Cayman
description:
The Barback assists bartenders with essential support in maintaining a well-stocked, clean, and efficient bar environment. The role is key in ensuring a positive guest experience by preparing and restocking supplies, maintaining bar cleanliness, and providing prompt support to bartenders during busy service times.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Stocking & Restocking: Maintain a fully stocked bar by ensuring supplies like glassware, ice, garnishes, mixers, and alcohol are readily available throughout service. Restock items quickly as they deplete.
  • Preparation & Setup: Assist in setting up the bar at the start of the shift, including organizing equipment, arranging supplies, and preparing garnishes and other essentials.
  • Cleaning & Maintenance: Keep the bar area, equipment, and storage areas clean, sanitized, and organized throughout the shift. This includes wiping down surfaces, washing and drying glassware, and sweeping/mopping floors as needed.
  • Assisting Bartenders: Support bartenders by fetching and delivering drinks, ingredients, and supplies quickly. Help with simple drink preparation tasks as directed by the bartender.
  • Inventory Management: Monitor and manage inventory levels, reporting shortages to bartenders or the bar manager to prevent service interruptions.
  • Customer Service Support: Engage with customers courteously and professionally if approached, helping create a welcoming environment while directing any specific orders or requests to the bartender.
  • Adherence to Health and Safety Standards: Follow health, safety, and sanitation regulations to maintain a clean and safe work environment, including proper handling and storage of all bar equipment and ingredients.
  • End-of-Shift Responsibilities: Assist with closing duties by cleaning, organizing, and restocking the bar for the next day’s service.

Experience:

  • Previous experience in a bar or restaurant setting is preferred but not required; on-the-job training provided.
  • Strong multitasking abilities and quick problem-solving.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
  • Basic knowledge of bar equipment, alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages is a plus.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs, stand for long periods, and handle physically demanding tasks.
  • Flexible schedule and are able to work weekends, nights, and holidays when needed.

Please note: management reserves the right to change, modify, and/or alter any of the duties listed above to meet business demands.

Salary range: $8.00 USD - $10.00 USD per hour, plus gratuities

title: AI/ML Architect
description:
Overview of 66degrees

66degrees is an end-to-end AI transformation partner that guides enterprises from complex business challenges to clear, quantifiable outcomes. Our company is the culmination of several successful firms, each a leader in its own right in cloud, artificial intelligence, and data. This convergence of talent and expertise is how we help businesses reach their own "inflection point," where chaotic data becomes a strategic asset, complexity becomes clarity, and AI becomes an engine for growth. Our ultimate vision is to be the catalyst for a future where every business operates as an intelligent enterprise, with autonomous systems unlocking human potential.

At 66degrees, we believe in thriving through challenges and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.

AI/ML Architect, India — Job Description

Overview of Role

An AI/ML Architect at 66degrees designs and ships production AI systems for enterprise clients and leads the engineers who build them. The Architect is the senior technical person on an engagement: the primary technical point of contact for the client, the owner of the architecture, and the person the team takes direction from.

The role is hands-on and client-facing in equal measure. Architects take a business problem, define the solution and the value it delivers, and then build and deploy it. They write and review code, make the architectural decisions, and stay with the system through production. They also run discovery, present to client executives, and are the face of 66degrees on the engagement.

This role is based in India and works daily with US-based colleagues and clients. Engagements typically run 12 to 16 weeks and are delivered by a Delivery Manager, one or more Architects, and a team of engineers.

Why this role

  • 2026 Google Cloud AI Partner of the Year. This team's work won the Artificial Intelligence category this year, one of four Partner of the Year awards 66degrees has earned. You're joining the top of the Google Cloud AI ecosystem

  • About 60% of the work is generative and agentic AI, in production, for clients up to the Fortune 10. The rest is classical ML and MLOps, so you build real agents without losing the rest of the craft.

  • New problem, new client, every 12 to 16 weeks. You build range fast and never spend three years on one system

  • The whole stack. Architects span infrastructure, software, data, ML, AI, and analytics. The role is built to make you a well-rounded technologist, not to keep you in one lane

  • Player-coach all the way up. Growth here doesn't mean giving up the craft. Leaders still build, and the management track is open because the team keeps growing, not because someone has to leave

  • No up-or-out, no partner-track politics. Nobody is competing to differentiate themselves; everyone is trying to be the best technologist in the room, which is why people share what they know

  • The team has grown roughly tenfold in three years and people stay. The few who've left went on to top tech firms and AI startups

Responsibilities

Build

  • Design the architecture for each engagement: data pipelines, classical ML, agentic and generative AI, and the production path on Google Cloud, with the trade-offs written down

  • Write and review the code that matters: core logic, orchestration, evaluation, the parts an engineer shouldn't be guessing at

  • Take systems to production and own them through handoff: deployment, monitoring, drift, retraining, incident response, and a client who can run it after we leave

  • Choose the right approach for the problem, and defend it on cost, explainability, and fit rather than on what's fashionable

Lead the team

  • Direct a team of engineers: write the brief with the reasoning, not only the tasks; confirm it landed before code is written; review the work

  • Run a team where engineers raise problems early and are heard when they do

  • Develop engineers: pairing, giving them the client call, making them present the design review, and telling the Delivery Manager who is ready for more

  • Delegate real work and still own the hard parts. Not a solo builder; not a delegator who only checks in

Own the client relationship

  • Run discovery: turn an ambiguous ask into a scoped plan with success criteria the client agrees to

  • Hold the solution to what the client actually needs, and when scope and need diverge, raise it early with options and what each costs

  • Raise risk the day you see it, up and across, in business terms, with options. Report "on track" only when it is

  • Present to client executives: the design, the trade-offs, the status, and the recommendation, answer first

  • Spot expansion: where the client's next problem is, and tell sales

Qualifications

Technical (required)

  • Has personally designed and shipped production ML or AI systems, more than once, and owned them after launch. This is a hard requirement: an Architect who cannot point to systems they built and ran is not an Architect, whatever else is on the resume

  • A data science foundation with range: several technique families (classification, forecasting, NLP, deep learning, recommendation, anomaly detection) each tied to a real business outcome. Depth in a few, breadth across the rest

  • Has built a generative or agentic AI system that real users depended on: the architecture end to end, where the tools ran, how cost and latency were handled, and how quality was measured. A serious RAG system or single-agent workflow with real evaluation discipline qualifies; a chatbot demo does not

  • Production fluency on a hyperscaler: Google Cloud preferred (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run or GKE); deep AWS or Azure experience with a credible translation is acceptable

  • Strong software engineering: expert Python and SQL, containers, CI/CD, and the habits that make code someone else can run

  • Currently hands-on, with recent, specific examples of code written and architectural decisions made

Leadership and delivery (required)

  • Currently leads a team of engineers or data scientists, delegating real work while owning the architecture and core logic

  • A repeatable method for taking an engagement from discovery through handoff: phases, milestones, who does what, validation before anything ships

  • A track record of reshaping scope when the original ask wasn't the right solution, and of making the business case for the change

Communication and judgment (required)

  • Answers the question asked, first, then the detail. Adjusts depth for the audience: can explain a system to an engineer and to a CFO in the same hour

  • Executive presence: speaks with conviction, holds a position under challenge, and is someone we would put in front of a client executive next week without coaching

  • Raises risk before it becomes a problem, to the person who can act on it, with a proposed fix. Comfortable disagreeing with senior people when the work calls for it

  • Comfortable operating with autonomy across a significant time-zone gap with US colleagues and clients

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience

Preferred

  • Consulting or professional services background, with fluency in SoWs, scope, and billable delivery

  • Google Cloud certifications, or delivery alongside Google teams

  • Experience with agentic frameworks and patterns in production: tool calling, state management, MCP, multi-step orchestration, policy-guarded loops

  • Regulated-industry delivery (financial services, healthcare) where explainability and audit are requirements, not features

  • Daily use of AI coding assistants and agents in your own work, with a view on where they help and where they get in the way

  • Experience working with a US-based team from India, and a point of view on how to make it work

What the job demands

We write this down so nobody is surprised in month two.

  • The client sees you. You present the design, you deliver the bad news, you defend the recommendation. The strength of the 66degrees brand on an engagement is the Architect leading it

  • The plan will be wrong sometimes. Client problems rarely arrive fully defined, and scope moves. Working out what's really needed and saying so is the job, not an exception to it

  • Your engineers learn from you. If you raise risks, they will. If you don't, they won't. You set the standard for how the India team works

  • The US is asleep for half your day. You will make decisions with incomplete direction and own them. This role works a shifted schedule: online through 2:00 PM US Eastern (11:30 PM IST), so that most of the US working day overlaps with yours

  • It's hands-on. If your week has become meetings and status calls, this is not the role

About 66degrees and the AI/ML practice

66degrees is a leading consulting and professional services company specializing in developing AI-focused, data-led solutions leveraging the latest advancements in cloud technology. With our unmatched engineering capabilities and vast industry experience, we help the world's leading brands transform their business challenges into opportunities and shape the future of work.

At 66degrees, we believe in embracing the challenge and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.

The AI/ML practice spans roughly 100 specialists across the U.S., Canada, the UK, France, and India, working across three pillars: agentic and generative AI; classical ML; and MLOps and AgentOps. The India team is being built to own engagements end to end, with a path from Engineer to Architect that runs through India.

Please note, we cannot sponsor or transfer any visas, of any kind, at this time.

66degrees is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status or other legally protected class.

AI Transparency & Disclosure

As an AI transformation partner, 66degrees leverages intelligent solutions to enhance our recruitment experience. We utilize AI tools—including LinkedIn Recruiter’s Hiring Assistant and interview transcription technologies—to assist with sourcing, role analysis, and capturing interview highlights.

These tools augment our process, but we "Commit to Our Craft" by ensuring all final hiring decisions are made by our human Talent Team. By applying, you acknowledge the use of these technologies to help us "Win Together" in finding the best fit for our team.

title: Junior Creative Designer

  • Develop a design analytical approach: Adopt an overall analytical approach to design by testing and validating your designs either through user test or A/B testing online
  • Cross-team & cross-country collaborations: Work and learn from experienced designers, analysts and business stakeholders internationally (the Netherlands, Germany & France)
  • Trend research & knowledge sharing: Research retail trends and conduct competitor reviews to keep the team up to date

Your superpowers

  • BSc. or MSc. degree in visual, media, digital or communication design, or similar
  • 0-2 years of working experience in visual design, preferably in a commercial and/or agency environment
  • Solid online portfolio showing a keen eye for detail paired with lots of creative flair
  • Expert with Adobe Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator) and Figma
  • Self-starter with a “roll up your sleeves” attitude
  • Eager to learn in a fast-paced environment
  • Affinity for illustration and experience with animation are a plus but not a must
  • English skills on point

Picnic Perks

🥗Fresh Lunch, coffee, and snacks

Our offices are equipped with fully-fledged coffee bars and a kitchen and chefs. They prepare delicious fresh and warm lunches every day so you can keep your energy up.

🚴🏼‍♂️Health insurance discount & bike plan

We have a partnership with CZ (a health insurance provider). Picnic employees get a discount on CZ insurance packages between 5% and 15%. Furthermore, through our partnership with Lease a Bike, you can rent-to-own a new (e)bike at a discounted rate

🏠 Relocation

At Picnic you get 25 holidays, we cover your travel expenses and offer a pension plan. And your phone and laptop are on us, as well.
