Functional Title: Senior PMO Tooling & Automation Analyst

Department: PMO (Portfolio Management Office)

Employment Type: Permanent

About Apex

Apex Group Ltd., established in Bermuda in 2003, is a global financial services provider. With fifty offices worldwide and 12,000 employees upon the close of announced acquisitions, Apex delivers an extensive range of services to asset managers, capital markets, private clients, and family offices. The Group has continually improved and evolved its capabilities to offer a single-source solution through establishing the broadest range of services in the industry including fund services, digital onboarding and bank accounts, depositary, custody and super ManCo services, business services including HR and Payroll and a pioneering ESG Ratings and Advisory service for private companies.

We look to recruit bright, articulate, and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge. You are prepared to work hard, love what they do and be prepared to innovate.

Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today and the more that we grow, the more important that becomes. Whatever your career path or specialism Apex provides a global platform to allow you to thrive.

About the Role

The Senior PMO Tooling & Automation Analyst will partner with PMO leadership, Portfolio Leads, Project Managers, Technology teams and business stakeholders to design, build and optimise tooling and automation that strengthens PMO control, improves portfolio visibility and reduces manual effort. The role will combine practical PMO experience with deep technical capability across Azure DevOps (ADO), Power BI, ServiceNow and the Microsoft Power Platform.

The role will own the design and continuous improvement of integrated PMO tooling solutions, including workflow automation, data integration, executive dashboards, governance controls and self-service reporting. The role holder will translate PMO requirements into scalable tools, establish technical standards and deliver reliable management information for portfolio decision-making.

The successful candidate will be a hands-on tooling and automation expert who can independently configure platforms, develop data models and dashboards, automate workflows, troubleshoot solutions and guide users. They will bring relevant experience delivering PMO technology solutions in a complex enterprise environment and will balance rapid improvement with appropriate data governance, security and change control.






Key duties and responsibilities

This role will sit within the central Enterprise PMO and support the wider PMO community. The role holder will lead the design, build, administration and adoption of PMO tools and automated solutions across Azure DevOps, Power BI, ServiceNow, Power Automate, SharePoint, Excel and related Microsoft technologies. Responsibilities include solution design, integration, reporting, data governance, documentation, training and continuous improvement.

The role will also provide expertise across the Microsoft ecosystem, train users, generate reports, analyse captured data to provide insight, strengthen data governance, leverage AI and other tools to drive efficiency and automation, and maintain key portfolio management information.

Data, Reporting & Insights

Portfolio Reporting, Dashboards & Executive MI

  • Design, build and maintain portfolio, programme and project dashboards for operational and executive audiences.
  • Develop decision-focused management information for governance forums and senior stakeholders.
  • Define standard KPI measures, reporting logic, drill-through views and reusable dashboard templates.
  • Provide actionable insight on portfolio health, delivery confidence, risks, issues, milestones, demand, capacity and dependencies.
  • Automate enterprise reporting cycles and implement controls that improve accuracy, consistency and timeliness.
  • Develop and maintain portfolio, programme and project reporting dashboards.
  • Produce high-quality management information for governance forums and senior stakeholders.
  • Implement standard reporting frameworks and KPI measures.
  • Provide insights on portfolio health, risks, issues, milestones and delivery performance.
  • Support enterprise reporting cycles, ensuring data accuracy and consistency. Governance & Process Implementation

PMO Tooling Solution Design & Administration

  • Act as the PMO subject-matter expert for Azure DevOps (ADO), Power BI and ServiceNow, with working knowledge of Power Automate, SharePoint, Excel and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.
  • Translate PMO and portfolio requirements into practical tool designs, workflows, data structures, dashboards and automated controls.
  • Configure and enhance Azure DevOps boards, work-item types, fields, states, queries, dashboards, permissions and portfolio reporting structures.
  • Configure or support ServiceNow workflows, forms, queues, approvals, notifications and reporting relevant to demand, project, change and governance processes.
  • Build semantic models, measures and interactive reports in Power BI using Power Query and DAX.
  • Establish tooling standards, release controls, user guidance and support arrangements.
  • Train and coach PMO and delivery users to improve adoption, data quality and self-service capability.
  • Administer and optimise the use of PMO tools (e.g. Azure DevOps/ADO, MS Project, Excel, Power BI, Power Automate, Sharepoint, CoPilot etc)

  • Lead on the generation of required PMO reports/insight required.
  • Develop automated dashboards and reporting solutions.
  • Support continuous improvement of PMO systems and processes.
  • Train new users of the various applications and tools as adopted by the PMO
  • Drive adoption of reporting best practices and tooling standards.
  • Maintain user guidelines and drive adoption

Data Quality, Controls & Governance

  • Monitor and improve data quality across Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Power BI and connected PMO data sources.
  • Design automated validation rules, exception reports, reconciliation checks and data completeness controls.
  • Identify data gaps, duplicates, inconsistencies and reporting anomalies, and drive corrective action with accountable owners.
  • Define portfolio data standards, field definitions, ownership, access controls and governance processes.
  • Maintain reporting definitions, metric logic, lineage documentation and data dictionaries.
  • Monitor and improve data quality across Azure DevOps and PMO reporting platforms.
  • Establish data validation and control mechanisms.
  • Identify inconsistencies, gaps and reporting anomalies and drive corrective actions.
  • Support the development of portfolio data standards and governance processes.
  • Maintain reporting definitions, metrics and data dictionaries.

Analytics, Planning & Decision Support

  • Perform trend and variance analysis to identify emerging portfolio risks, bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.
  • Support capacity planning, utilisation analysis, demand forecasting and resource decision-making.
  • Develop forward-looking reporting and scenario analysis to improve planning and delivery outcomes.
  • Analyse schedule, milestone, resource, financial, demand and delivery data from multiple systems.
  • Present clear, evidence-based recommendations to PMO leadership and portfolio stakeholders.
  • Perform trend analysis and identify emerging portfolio risks and opportunities.
  • Support capacity planning and resource forecasting through data analysis.
  • Develop predictive reporting models to improve planning and delivery outcomes.
  • Analyse schedule, milestone, resource and financial data to support decision making.
  • Provide insight-driven recommendations to stakeholders.

Integration & Workflow Automation

  • Design, document and maintain automated data extraction, transformation and refresh processes.
  • Integrate or orchestrate data across Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Power BI, SharePoint, Excel and other approved enterprise platforms.
  • Create robust Power Automate workflows, alerts, approvals and scheduled reporting processes that reduce manual intervention.
  • Automate governance, assurance, status reporting, demand intake, action tracking and exception-management activities.
  • Develop maintainable data models and reusable components, with appropriate error handling, logging and support documentation.

  • Design, document and maintain automated data extraction and transformation processes.
  • Integrate data from multiple project and portfolio management systems.
  • Reduce manual reporting effort through workflow automation.
  • Support automation of reporting, governance and assurance activities.
  • Develop and maintain data models to improve reporting efficiency.

Collaboration, Adoption & Service Management

  • Partner with PMO, Technology, Data, ServiceNow and delivery teams to prioritise and deliver tooling enhancements.
  • Manage a clear backlog of tooling improvements, defects, automation opportunities and technical debt.
  • Maintain solution documentation, process maps, operating procedures, repositories and knowledge articles.
  • Provide practical support, root-cause analysis and resolution for PMO tooling and reporting issues.
  • Build cross-functional capability through training, demonstrations, office hours and reusable guidance.
  • Support reporting and information management processes across the PMO community.
  • Ensure reporting outputs are accessible, accurate and aligned across stakeholder groups.
  • Maintain reporting repositories, libraries and supporting documentation.
  • Work collaboratively with delivery teams to continuously improve data capture and reporting quality.
  • Train PMO Team to enable a cross functional service

AI & Intelligent Automation

Automation and AI-Enabled Reporting

  • Develop and maintain automated reporting solutions using Power Automate, Power BI and other approved technologies.
  • Identify and prototype responsible AI-assisted use cases for reporting, summarisation, forecasting and risk identification.
  • Reduce manual effort through intelligent workflows while maintaining human oversight and auditable controls.
  • Support the implementation of AI-assisted reporting capabilities.
  • Reduce manual effort through process automation and intelligent workflows.

Scalable Portfolio Insights

  • Design solutions that enable consistent drill-down from enterprise portfolio views to programme and project detail.
  • Improve data readiness and metadata quality to support advanced analytics and future AI capabilities.
  • Apply appropriate security, data access, change control and responsible-use standards to automation solutions.
  • Measure solution adoption, reliability, cycle-time reduction and realised efficiency benefits.
  • Explore opportunities for AI-assisted forecasting, planning and risk identification.
  • Support the adoption of AI-enabled portfolio management practices.
  • Contribute to AI governance, controls and responsible usage frameworks.
  • Ensure portfolio data readiness to support future AI initiatives.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

  • Proactively identify and deliver improvements to PMO reporting, controls, user experience and operational efficiency.
  • Evaluate emerging platform capabilities and recommend practical, supportable applications.
  • Contribute to PMO transformation, tooling roadmaps and portfolio data-maturity improvements.
  • Act as a hands-on champion for automation, standardisation and data-driven decision-making.
  • Identify opportunities to improve PMO reporting, analytics and operational efficiency.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend practical applications.
  • Contribute to PMO transformation initiatives and data maturity improvements.
  • Act as a champion for innovation and data-driven decision making.

Experience & Skills Required

  • Minimum 7 years of relevant experience across PMO, portfolio reporting, project controls, data analytics, tooling or automation roles, including at least 4 years building or administering PMO technology solutions.
  • Demonstrable experience designing and delivering portfolio and executive reporting solutions in a complex enterprise environment.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel capability, including Power Query, PivotTables, Power Pivot and complex formulas.
  • Advanced Power BI experience, including data modelling, Power Query, DAX, dashboard design, row-level security, publishing and refresh management.
  • Strong hands-on Azure DevOps experience, including Boards configuration, work-item customisation, queries, dashboards, permissions, process templates and reporting integration.
  • Hands-on ServiceNow experience configuring or supporting workflows, forms, approvals, notifications, queues and reports; experience with demand, project portfolio or strategic portfolio processes is strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of PMO disciplines, including governance, demand intake, stage gates, milestones, RAID, dependencies, resource planning and portfolio reporting.
  • Proven experience automating reporting and governance processes using Power Automate or comparable workflow technologies.
  • Experience integrating data across ADO, ServiceNow, Power BI and Microsoft 365 sources using APIs, connectors, OData, dataflows or controlled extracts.
  • Ability to convert ambiguous business requirements into maintainable technical solutions and clear user stories.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, documentation and communication skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving capability, with rigorous attention to data accuracy and solution reliability.
  • Ability to work independently, manage a tooling backlog and deliver multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

Nice to have:

  • Experience within Financial Services or another regulated, data-sensitive industry.
  • Experience working within an Enterprise PMO, Portfolio Management Office or transformation function.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, Python, REST APIs, JSON, OData or advanced analytics techniques.
  • Microsoft certifications relevant to Power BI, Power Platform, Azure DevOps or data analytics; ServiceNow certification is advantageous.
  • Experience implementing AI-assisted reporting, Copilot-enabled workflows or intelligent automation with responsible-use controls.
  • Exposure to portfolio financial management, resource forecasting, demand management and benefits tracking.
  • Relevant qualifications in Data Analytics, Information Systems, PMO, Project Management, Business Analysis or a related discipline.

title: Operational Resilience Manager
description:
Imagine being able to see exactly what Heathrow needs to keep operating: which processes depend on which systems and assets, what happens when something fails and what the exact recovery sequence is. Resilience at Heathrow has been evolving; technology has created new risks but also new opportunities to understand and manage disruption differently. Adapting to this change, we’ve shifted our focus from a traditional document-based contingency planning approach towards structured data, digital workflows and decision-supporting tools. The goal is resilience plans that react dynamically to the needs of the operation. Blending analogue ways of working (who doesn’t love a whiteboard) with a digital capability that enhances our understanding of critical decision points and paths. We want resilience plans to leverage available operational data, be integrated alongside existing operational systems and ultimately help Heathrow to anticipate disruption, make better decisions and recover faster.

  • Be part of the team that leads on the development and maintenance of Heathrow's operational resilience framework, mapping critical processes, systems, assets, dependencies, and recovery pathways across the airport.
  • Take ownership of our operational IT contingency plan portfolio.
  • Develop and embed data-driven resilience and contingency planning approaches, transforming traditional plans into dynamic tools that support operational decision-making and recovery.
  • Analyse operational data, disruption scenarios, and business impacts to identify vulnerabilities, assess resilience risks, and support evidence-based planning and prioritisation.
  • Collaborate with operational, engineering, technology, and business stakeholders to maintain an accurate understanding of critical dependencies and ensure resilience requirements are integrated into operational planning.
  • Design, maintain, and improve resilience dashboards, digital workflows, and decision-support tools that enhance situational awareness, incident response, and operational recovery.
  • Drive continuous improvement in resilience capability by using data insights, exercises, testing, and lessons learned to strengthen Heathrow's ability to anticipate disruption, minimise operational impact, and recover effectively.
  • Experience in operational resilience, business continuity, operational planning, risk management, or a related discipline within a complex operational environment.
  • Experience analysing operational processes, systems, dependencies, and data to identify risks, vulnerabilities, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build effective relationships and collaborate across multiple business functions.
  • Experience delivering projects, operational improvement initiatives, or resilience-related programmes from concept through to implementation.
  • Ability to facilitate discussions, challenge constructively, and drive accountability to achieve resilience and operational planning outcomes.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex information clearly to a range of audiences.

Ideally you`ll also have:

  • Experience within aviation, transport, infrastructure, utilities, emergency services, or other operationally critical and regulated environments.
  • Knowledge of resilience frameworks, business continuity principles, incident management, or contingency planning methodologies.
  • Experience using data visualisation, process mapping, workflow management, or decision-support tools to support operational planning and resilience activities.
  • Experience conducting exercises, scenario testing, operational readiness reviews, or lessons-learned activities.
  • Knowledge of Heathrow's operational environment, key dependencies, and stakeholders.
  • Experience applying data and insights to support decision-making, operational recovery, or continuous improvement initiatives.

title: Electrical Systems Designer (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

As an Electrical Systems Designer, you will join the Vehicle Systems team and contribute to the development and certification of the VÆRIDION Microliners’ Low-Voltage (LV) electrical and avionics systems. Your primary responsibility will be to mature the physical installation of the aircraft’s LV electrical and avionics systems, including LV EWIS routing and installation for all vehicle systems, guiding the design from concept through detailed design and release. You will translate system, interface and certification requirements into practical design solutions and take ownership of the associated 3D models, installation assemblies, wiring diagrams, and manufacturing drawings.

You will work closely with the Propulsion, Systems, and Structures teams, as well as external development partners, to resolve integration challenges and deliver practical design solutions throughout the aircraft development cycle.

The role will have a strong focus on hands-on CAD design, complemented by engineering analysis and certification activities. You will have the opportunity to define and mature the installation of LV electric systems currently being developed. Every day will bring new challenges, and you will be given a healthy amount of responsibility and autonomy, always supported by the team.

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Mature the LV electrical and avionics systems installation from concept through detailed design and release, integrating it into the aircraft digital mock-up (DMU).

  • Design and detail mechanical components for equipment and LV EWIS installation, such as, brackets, supports, interfaces and assemblies in accordance with applicable aerospace design standards and manufacturing methods.

  • Create and maintain complex 3D parts, assemblies, electrical diagrams and installation models using CATIA V6 within the 3DEXPERIENCE platform.

  • Prepare and release electrical schematics, electrical diagrams, detailed single part and assembly drawings, ensuring accuracy and compliance with industry standards.

  • Oversee the documentation process to ensure all drawings are up-to-date and correctly integrated within the PLM system.

  • Develop installation solutions that account for structural integrity, environmental conditions, separation, accessibility, installation sequence, removal envelopes, inspection and maintainability.

  • Perform technical assessments and trade studies to support design decisions and system maturation.

  • Collaborate directly with external development partners and suppliers, providing technical direction, reviewing deliverables and ensuring consistency with aircraft-level requirements.

  • Support the resolution of installation, manufacturing and assembly issues arising during prototype assembly and aircraft integration

  • Ensure adherence to all engineering processes and standards and participate in design reviews to meet development and certification goals.

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field.

  • At least 5 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in a design role on an EASA/FAA Part 23/25 aircraft development program.

  • Experience working within an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation or international equivalent.

  • Practical experience with the design and integration of aircraft electrical systems. Experience with electric aviation is an asset.

  • Strong proficiency in CAD software, preferably CATIA V5/V6, including experience in part design, generative shape design, sheet metal design, assembly design, diagramming and drafting.

  • Sound knowledge of aircraft electrical installations, aerospace materials, standard hardware and manufacturing methods, assembly and inspection requirements.

  • Understanding of design-for-manufacture and design-for-assembly principles.

  • Ability to develop and assess installation designs while balancing manufacturing and maintainability considerations.

  • Experience collaborating with external development partners, engineering service providers or aerospace suppliers.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a methodical approach, attention to detail, and the ability to present clear rationale for solution proposals.

  • A high degree of self-motivation, resilience, reliability and precision, combined with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Collaborative team player with a positive attitude and the ability to work effectively in a multicultural team.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; proficiency in another European language is an asset.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of the aviation industry.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: Statistical Programmer II
description:
FSP Statistical Programming Opportunities | EMEA | Remote

At ICON Strategic Solutions, you will work in a sponsor-dedicated model, supported by ICON’s global expertise.


As the world’s largest FSP organisation, with over 90 sponsor partnerships, we offer stability, career development and a collaborative environment where your work contributes to the development of treatments that benefit patients worldwide.

title: Quality Analyst - Contact Centre
description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Why Deliveroo?

Our mission is to be the definitive food company. We are transforming the way the world eats by making food more convenient and accessible. We give people the opportunity to eat what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world.

The Role

A Care agent provides support for our Customer’s, Riders and Partners, and if things don’t go as expected we want to make sure they are taken care of if there is a need to contact us. The Quality team is instrumental in ensuring those contacts are handled correctly and in line with our policies and expectations. The primary goal of the Quality team is to set a standard of excellence within the team in order to deliver a consistently high experience to our customers, supporting managers to maintain these standards at all times.

As a Quality Analyst you will:

  • Be responsible for evaluating and ensuring contacts and tasks handled by agents are completed correctly and in line with our policies and expectations.
  • Review customer survey feedback and identify agent coaching opportunities.
  • Perform targeted deep dives on low performing areas and support with improvement plans.
  • Join calibration sessions with relevant internal and external stakeholders globally to ensure alignment on quality and performance.
  • Set a standard of excellence in the team while ensuring fair and consistent marking against the predefined quality scorecard.
  • Routinely perform root cause analysis and share actionable insights with stakeholders.
  • Hold agents and vendors to account, whilst ensuring fair and consistent marking against the predefined quality scorecard.
  • Support Operations with agent coaching and feedback to continuously drive improvement.
  • Ensure feedback is always relevant, realistic and up to date by regularly handling front line contacts to fully understand the agent experience.
  • Identify improvement opportunities in policy, content and training through Quality and CSAT feedback.
  • Serve as an advisor to our Operations teams and management by building strong relationships focused on positive feedback and coaching closed-loop processes.
  • Perform qualitative analysis to drive continuous improvement; produce development plans by identifying pain points and areas for optimisation within the customer journey.
  • This is a Hybrid role - you will work 3 days a week in our Manchester office with 2 optional work-from-home days.

Requirements

  • Demonstrates a strong commitment to thoroughness and precision
  • Outstanding communication skills in English
  • Capable of inspiring others and fostering change
  • Exceptional collaborative abilities within a team
  • Skilled in self-managing tasks and responsibilities
  • Proficient in providing and receiving constructive feedback
  • Can navigate in an ambiguous environment
  • Seasoned in a dynamic and high-pressure role, specifically in Operations or Customer Services, showcasing strong critical thinking skills

Preferred but not required

  • Experience using Zendesk
  • Intermediate excel skills
  • Working proficiency in a second language (Italian, French or Arabic)

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

description:
• You have hands-on experience with several programming languages and platforms, and you understand most of the moving parts in the applications you work on. Java, Go, Rust - you name it. We think that, in a world of ever-changing languages and technologies, the most valuable and transferable assets are experience and competence, not tools. Can you tell us why and when your stack is great?
  • You can work on distributed applications with high-availability/high-performance/high-security requirements.

  • You have strong, experience-based opinions and are not afraid of having them challenged.
  • You are passionate about crafting and delivering value through software.
  • You LOVE learning.

What we offer

  • A first-class team where both mutual learning and teaching are welcome.
  • Diverse and technically challenging projects to work on. Our portfolio goes from IoT to enterprise systems, from the shiny new startup to the secretive niche project which will twist your mind with unpredictable requirements and technical challenges.
  • A collaborative organization where every team member has autonomy, purpose and a direct influence in shaping our Company.
  • Many chances to shape your growth. At OptionFactory, we think you know best what, when and how you want and need to learn and improve. We don’t have fixed career paths or plans, just talented peers, interesting projects and autonomy.
  • An open, informal environment that welcomes research, experiments and failures.

title: Mechanical Technology Engineer
description:
Mechanical Technology Engineer

Arclin Mechanical Technology Engineers serve as a vital resource for Operations by applying technical skills to optimize plant operations, resolve plant problems, and enable safe and efficient production of low cost, quality products. Mechanical Technology Engineers generate tremendous value to Arclin through their knowledge, skills and abilities. Understand customer needs and drive high levels of quality, responsiveness and reliability for the customer. Identify metrics and management systems to drive optimization of plant value/EBITDA by all of operations (operators, Technical Advisors, maintenance, etc.). Responsible for Key Performance Indicators and trends to ensure optimal performance. Responds urgently to emergencies and issues. Works with Production Coordinator to determine production capabilities.

Qualifications:

  • BS engineering discipline required
  • 0-5 years of manufacturing or related experience required
  • Line of business (Kevlar®/Tyvek®/Nomex®) experience preferred
  • Process Safety Management (High Hazard Process/Low Hazard Operation) experience preferred

Responsibilities:

  • Possess strong sense of ownership and are accountable for the success and failure of their assigned unit.
  • Show courageous leadership by coaching, asking questions, and intervening when needed. Challenge status quo and past norms to make the operation more effective and safer.
  • Role model the professionalism and behaviors expected in the plant because their actions or lack of actions affect the culture.
  • Learn and apply continuous improvement, value creation, and financial acumen skills to accelerate profitability and low-cost service of the facility.
  • Understand customer needs and drive high levels of quality, responsiveness and reliability for the customer.
  • Know how much money the plant makes per day, the margins generated from the plant’s production slate, and actively work to maximize total margin.
  • Know the total cost (raw material, conversion cost, etc.) of production for the plant(s) he/she operates and continuously works to improve the cost position and EBITDA generation.
  • Set up metrics and management systems to drive optimization of plant value/EBITDA by all of operations (operators, Technical Advisors, maintenance, etc.).
  • Earn respect and trust of operations team because of their great problem-solving skills and technical expertise.
  • Elevate and appropriately apply knowledge of their plant and technology – study historical data, convene with other Subject Mater Experts (SMEs), etc.
  • Ensure Manufacturing Technology is utilized, and that process automation is used as a tool to optimize plant performance.
  • Partner with the experts to perform advanced troubleshooting and improve operating discipline. Diagnose and document root causes of asset utilization losses in the facility.
  • Understand why specific procedure steps and precautions are needed and keep a strong field presence to reinforce the importance.
  • Conduct daily review of logbook and alarm history to better understand the plant operation and stay engaged with daily activities. Maintain, own, and review daily Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)/trends to ensure optimum performance.
  • Works with Production Coordinator to determine production capabilities.
  • Works with Supply Chain and Production Planning to optimize production schedule.
  • Convert business plan into daily operating plan.
  • Respond urgently to plant issues and emergencies. Act as a unit technical expert during unplanned events and drive implementation of effective corrective and preventative actions.
  • Provide leadership, expertise, diagnosis, and optimization in plant Raw Material Efficiency, which may include yield or waste generation.
  • Ensure compliance with plant operating permits.
  • Understand site integration and provide input to optimize the overall system

Capabilities Required for this Role (Knowledge Skills & Abilities)

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree
  • Discipline: Engineering
  • Lean/Six Sigma experience beneficial
  • Continuous Improvement beneficial

Behaviors Required for this Role

  • Learning agility - A personal drive to learn, pivot when necessary, and adapt to the ever-changing needs of our company in the face of a changing world and customer base
  • Intellectual curiosity - Proactively investing time and energy into learning more and personally developing, in the interest of improving yourself and delivering better results
  • Functional skills - The specific skills and experiences needed to deliver and accelerate in your current role and throughout your career
  • Actively listening - Knows what she/he doesn’t know; welcomes input from others; takes time to clearly understand and respond; allows people the time to express their point; open to influence
  • Self-driven - “Sense of purpose”; driven by a higher agenda; demonstrates the ability to elevate and remain objective; able and willing to take risks and do difficult things
  • Collaborating with others - Empowers purposeful engagement; “servant leader”; keeps things simple; engages individuals/team to achieve superior results; creates an atmosphere of value-driven outcomes
  • Accountable - Takes responsibility for actions; communicates with transparency; recovers from mistakes; owns their impact

title: Safety & Training Coordinator
description:
The Role:

We are seeking an experienced Safety & Training Coordinator to join the team at our Ernest Henry - BERT Project in Cloncurry, Queensland.

Reporting to the Safety & Training Superintendent, you will be responsible for coordinating, monitoring and implementing all Health, Safety and Training requirements across the project. Working closely with operational leaders and site personnel, you will help ensure compliance with Redpath, client and legislative requirements while supporting a strong safety culture and workforce capability.

This is a hands-on site-based FIFO 2/2 role suited to a proactive safety professional who enjoys balancing safety leadership, training coordination, incident management and workforce development within an underground mining environment.

About Us

Redpath is a global, full-service underground mining contractor, bringing more than 60 years of experience to mining projects around the world. Our capabilities span areas including mine development and construction, contract mining, shaft sinking, raiseboring and specialist mining services.

At Redpath, our people and the way we deliver matter. Our philosophy is built around Safety - First, Last and Always, Our People are our Greatest Resource, and a Spirit of Continuous Improvement.

We combine global experience with practical mining expertise to solve complex underground challenges and deliver safe, reliable outcomes for our clients.

For our Safety & Training Coordinator, that means working alongside experienced operational leaders while helping develop the safety culture, systems and workforce capability that underpin successful project delivery.

Ready to Join Redpath?

If you're an experienced safety professional who enjoys working with people, developing workforce capability and driving positive safety outcomes in a mining environment, we'd like to hear from you.

  • $3,000 in hand at 5 years' service, $10,000 at 10 years, $15,000 at 15 years and $20,000 at 20 years.
  • Exclusive access to Redzone, Redpath's employee rewards program, offering discounts and cashback at hundreds of retailers.
  • Competitive salary package.
  • Salary continuance and life insurance.
  • Discounted health insurance through BUPA.
  • Opportunities to grow within the Redpath Group across Australia and internationally.
  • Novated car leasing options.
  • Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.

Safety & Compliance

  • Coordinate and participate in workplace inspections and safety initiatives across site.
  • Conduct risk assessments and facilitate JSA training.
  • Prepare and deliver toolbox talks and safety meetings.
  • Support operational teams with site risk management processes.
  • Ensure compliance with Redpath, client and legislative requirements.
  • Review Safety Data Sheets and manage approvals for new substances introduced to site.
  • Provide guidance and advice on workplace health and safety obligations and best practices.

Training & Workforce Development

  • Coordinate site training requirements and maintain training compliance records.
  • Develop and implement training modules and workforce development programs.
  • Support employee competency management and verification processes.
  • Ensure personnel are trained, competent and authorised to perform their duties safely.
  • Promote continuous learning and workforce development across the project.

Incident Management & Rehabilitation

  • Investigate incidents, hazards and near misses.
  • Complete incident reporting and corrective action tracking within required timeframes.
  • Coordinate workplace rehabilitation and return-to-work programs.
  • Liaise with injured workers, supervisors and health professionals to support successful recovery outcomes.
  • Assist with continuous improvement initiatives arising from incident investigations and audits.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Work closely with operational teams to achieve safety and training objectives.
  • Build strong working relationships across all levels of the workforce.
  • Lead by example and promote Redpath's safety values.
  • Support the ongoing improvement of site safety and training systems.
  • Foster a positive team culture focused on accountability, professionalism and continuous improvement.

About You

You're a passionate safety professional who enjoys working closely with operational teams and understands the important role that training, leadership and engagement play in creating a safe and productive workplace.

You may currently be working as a Safety Coordinator, Safety & Training Advisor, HSE Advisor, WHS Advisor, Safety Officer, Training Coordinator or HSET Coordinator within mining, mining services, construction or heavy industry.

You will bring:

  • Experience in a safety-focused role within mining, construction or heavy industry.
  • Certificate IV in Work Health & Safety (or equivalent).
  • Certificate IV in Training & Assessment (TAE).
  • Current First Aid & CPR qualifications.
  • ICAM investigation training or experience.
  • Strong knowledge of workplace health and safety legislation and risk management practices.
  • Experience coordinating workforce training and competency systems.
  • Strong interpersonal and conflict resolution skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong planning, organisation and administration capability.
  • A proactive approach to problem solving and continuous improvement.
  • A valid driver's licence.
  • The ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a site-based team environment.
  • A practical, hands-on leadership style with a genuine commitment to safety.

title: Retail Media Trader - Personal Health Care
description:
Job Location

MASON BUS AND INNOVATION CTR

Job Description

As a Retail Media Trader you are responsible for the day-to-day execution, optimization, and stewardship of retail media campaigns for the Personal Health Care portfolio. This role translates brand and customer plans into high-quality campaign activation across retailer platforms, helping ensure investments reach the right shoppers, deliver against objectives, and remain on budget and on schedule.

The Retail Media Trader will serve as a hands-on execution lead for Personal Health Care retail media campaigns. Working from approved strategies and plans, this individual will build, launch, monitor, optimize, and reconcile campaigns across retailer media networks. The role requires strong attention to detail, comfort working in media platforms and spreadsheets, and proactive communication to keep campaigns accurate, efficient, and aligned with brand and customer priorities.

  • Monitor campaign delivery and performance, making timely optimizations to improve pacing, efficiency, and progress against campaign objectives.

  • Support reporting by validating platform data, identifying performance trends, and surfacing risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
  • Coordinate with brand, sales, agency, retailer, finance, and analytics partners to resolve executional issues and keep deliverables on track.
  • Support campaign closeout, reconciliation, billing inputs, and delivery of final performance results and learnings.
  • Follow established processes and governance standards while identifying opportunities to improve executional efficiency and consistency.

Job Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of experience executing or trading retail media, digital media, or performance media campaigns; consumer packaged goods or Personal Health Care experience is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of retailer media platforms, campaign trafficking, budget pacing, optimization, and performance reporting.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple campaigns, timelines, and deliverables accurately.
  • Proficiency with spreadsheets and comfort analyzing campaign data to identify issues and next actions.
  • Clear, proactive communicator who collaborates effectively across internal teams, agencies, retailers, and other partners.
  • Ability to work within established processes, escalate risks early, and apply feedback quickly.
  • Curiosity and willingness to build expertise across retail media platforms, Personal Health Care brands, and retailer-specific best practices.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Electric vehicles are one of the fastest-growing distributed energy resources on our platform. Through integrations with major automakers and charger manufacturers, EnergyHub ingests telematics and charging data from a large and rapidly expanding fleet of EVs enrolled in utility managed charging programs. EnergyHub's EV team is hiring a Data Analyst to turn that data into insight: understanding how drivers charge, how programs perform, where our data falls short, and where the next product opportunities lie. Your work will shape how utilities, automakers, and EnergyHub itself understand EV load, and will directly inform the products we build next. The ideal candidate is passionate about data analytics, curious about how people actually use their EVs, and motivated to apply their skills to solving the climate crisis.

Main Responsibilities

  • Analyze large-scale EV telematics and charging data from multiple OEM and charger integrations to surface insights into driver charging behavior, program enrollment and retention, event participation, and load shifting outcomes.
  • Define, monitor, and improve data quality for EV OEM data feeds: identify gaps, latency, duplicates, and anomalies across sources, build automated checks, and work with engineering and OEM partners to resolve root causes.
  • Track and report on trends across the EV fleet, including vehicle and charger mix, charging patterns by time of day and season, home vs. public charging, and shifts in behavior as programs and incentives change.
  • Build clear documentation and training materials to enable others to use the assets and insights you create independently.
  • Identify and quantify opportunities for new EV products and program designs, such as smarter charging optimization, new incentive structures, and new OEM or utility offerings, and partner with product managers to validate them with data.
  • Build and maintain data models, dashboards, and automated reporting in EnergyHub's BI stack so that product, client success, and utility clients have timely, accurate, and actionable views of EV program performance.
  • Collaborate with engineering, data science, product management, client success, and OEM partnership teams to develop business logic, detailed requirements, and research questions of interest to the company and our clients.
  • Other duties as assigned

Key Skills and Experience

  • You are passionate about finding valuable insights in large, complex datasets, and you are curious about electric vehicles and how people use them
  • 3+ years of experience as a data analyst
  • When you can't find the data you need, you are creative enough to infer and/or generate it from other information that is available, and you can clearly articulate the limitations of that inference
  • You have experience developing analytics dashboards that are useful and visually compelling
  • You have experience developing automated reporting systems with business intelligence tools
  • You have experience assessing and improving data quality, and you are comfortable working with messy, high-volume, time-series data from third-party sources
  • You can translate an analytical finding into a product or business recommendation and communicate it clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
  • You enjoy communicating with others and developing real relationships with colleagues, clients, and external partners
  • You are excited about the opportunities of working with very large datasets from disparate sources
  • You have the ability to describe your ideal analytics schema to data engineering team members and work with them to improve a data warehouse
  • You share our vision of a carbon-free distributed energy future
  • You are passionate about empowering users through timely, accurate, and actionable data
  • You have experience with one or more BI tools (e.g. Tableau, Sigma, Looker), cloud data warehouses (e.g. Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery), data transformation frameworks (e.g. dbt), and data science tools (e.g. Python/Jupyter, Julia, R)
  • You have experience with data warehouse architecture

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Extensive experience with dbt / Snowflake / SQL
  • Experience with EV, telematics, connected-vehicle, charging, or other IoT device data, or with the energy or utility industry
  • Experience working with third-party API data and partner-delivered data feeds, including defining data contracts and quality standards
  • A strong background in mathematics and statistics in order to provide support to clients who need to understand complex statistics and to collaborate with data scientists who will use the analytics platform for statistical analysis
  • Experience supporting product discovery or go-to-market decisions with quantitative analysis

Please note that sponsorship of new applicants for employment authorization, or any other immigration-related support, is not available for this position at this time.

Why work for EnergyHub?

  • Collaborate with outstanding people: Our employees work hard, do great work, and enjoy collaborating and learning from each other.
  • Make an immediate impact: New employees can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. You are empowered to perform as soon as you join the team!
  • Gain well rounded experience: EnergyHub offers a diverse and dynamic environment where you will get the chance to work directly with executives and develop expertise across multiple areas of the business.
  • Work with the latest technologies: You'll gain exposure to a broad spectrum of IoT, SaaS and machine learning obstacles, including distributed fault-tolerance, device control optimization, and process modeling to support scalable interaction with disparate downstream APIs.
  • Be part of something important: Help create the future of how energy is produced and consumed. Make a positive impact on our climate.

About EnergyHub

EnergyHub empowers utilities and their customers to create a clean, distributed energy future. We help consumers turn their smart thermostats, EVs, batteries, and other products into virtual power plants that keep the grid stable and enable higher penetration of solar and wind power.

To learn more, visit energyhub.com.

title: Software Development Engineer 3, Samvaad
description:
About Sarvam

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India's full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.

About the Role

We are looking for a skilled Backend Engineer to join our Conversational Agents team, building Samvaad — our voice and AI-driven dialogue platform. A day at Samvaad means tackling hard problems, fast feedback, and real impact, all while working with a team that loves tinkering and shipping. You'll design and develop the server-side logic, APIs, and platform orchestration that powers AI conversations for millions of Indians.

What You'll Do

• Build and maintain backend services — scalable APIs (REST/gRPC), fault-tolerant systems, and clean, testable code.

• Design schemas, tune queries (Postgres/NoSQL), manage unstructured data, and apply caching and indexing strategies for performance.

• Deliver reliable releases with full observability — metrics, logs, traces — and ensure backward compatibility.

• Contribute to architecture discussions, resolve scaling and latency bottlenecks, and drive improvements in performance and reliability.

• Champion best practices — enforce coding standards, mentor peers, and stay current with backend and Generative AI technologies.

• Build enterprise-grade software with strong security practices in adherence to privacy and compliance policies.

• Collaborate across teams — integrate models into production, define data contracts with frontend and product, and partner with DevOps for smooth deployments.

What We're Looking For

• 5-8 years of backend development experience, with exposure to distributed systems and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).

• Demonstrated expertise in Python and Go & Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

• Strong knowledge of SQL (Postgres/MySQL) and NoSQL (Cassandra/ScyllaDB), including schema design, query optimisation, and scaling.

• Experience with message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ) or streaming systems.

• Proficiency in algorithms, data structures, and asynchronous programming patterns.

• Experience building and scaling WebSocket/gRPC/WebRTC/REST APIs.

• Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and tracing tools (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry).

• Strong debugging skills with a focus on performance, scalability, and reliability.

• Proven ability to own features end-to-end, review code, and drive process or architecture improvements.

Bonus Points

• End-to-end ownership of the full stack, including frontend technologies such as React, TypeScript, and Next.js.

• Experience setting up CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment.

• Contributions to open-source projects or a strong GitHub portfolio showcasing backend work.

Why Sarvam?

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact.

• Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar

• High ownership and high impact, from day one

• Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems

• You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates

If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

description:

  • Strong project management and delivery planning skills — able to plan, sequence, and track multi-workstream delivery.

  • Hands-on with data — comfortable working in Excel/Power BI or similar tools to build reports, dashboards, and drive data-based decisions.

  • Systems thinking — able to see how processes, tools, and teams interact, and design for scale and resilience.

  • Experience designing, developing, and deploying processes and SOPs that ensure error-free delivery.

  • Proven ability to work with and present to senior leadership and client stakeholders.

  • Experience working with cross-functional, matrixed, or global teams across time zones.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to manage client conversations confidently.

  • Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills across functions and geographies.

  • Structured, analytical problem-solver who is comfortable with ambiguity.

  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to operate independently under deadline pressure.

  • Calm and solution-oriented in escalation and high-pressure situations.

title: ART 1514 - DevOps Engineer

title: Assistant Manager

title: Manager
description:
Job Description

Just imagine helping to protect one of the world's most trusted and loved brands by delivering assurance and data-driven insights across a global organisation.

About the role

As our Corporate Risk and Internal Audit Manager, you'll plan and deliver audits and assurance projects across multiple business areas and processes. You'll evaluate risks and controls, recommend practical improvements and monitor actions through remediation. You'll also use data analytics, modelling and transformation, particularly Power BI, to turn data into actionable insights, reports and dashboards that strengthen audit approaches and quantify risk.

Required Qualifications

  • Delivered internal audit and other assurance activities, including identifying risks and assessing design and effectiveness of mitigating actions.
  • Collaborated with business stakeholders to understand processes and to identify and obtain relevant information to deliver data-driven solutions and actionable insights.
  • Demonstrated technical expertise in Power Platform with particular depth in Power BI, including data quality assessment, Power Query (M) transformation, star-schema dimensional modelling, and complex DAX analytics.
  • Applied strong interpersonal and communication skills to enable meaningful collaboration that values diverse viewpoints and cultures while being able to influence results; ability to interpret and explain highly technical information in simple terms
  • Ability to travel globally and collaborate across multiple time zones

Preferred Qualifications

  • Understanding of SAP S/4HANA configurations or functionality in your work.
  • Experience in using Databricks platform
  • Project management skills
  • Ability to navigate a complex organisation with dispersed stakeholders

What you'll build

  • Plan and execute assurance work across varied business areas, processes and compliance frameworks.
  • Data models and analytics dashboards using multiple data sources to identify patterns, anomalies, control deviations and wider risks.
  • Clear reports and presentations that recommend practical improvements and monitor corrective actions through implementation.

If you've worked in a role where you used data to uncover meaningful patterns, identified risks and assessed controls, you'll feel at home here. What matters most is combining sound assurance judgement with practical, data-informed thinking and clear communication.

Life on the team

You'll join Corporate Risk and Internal Audit within the CFO area. We provide independent assurance over governance, enterprise risks and internal controls. It's a global team working across projects and business functions, following a hybrid model of spending an average of three days a week together in the office. You'll bring critical thinking, analytical problem-solving skills and build constructive relationships while maintaining independence and confidentiality.

What success looks like

You’ll gain broad organisational exposure and the opportunity to support the business in managing risks and opportunities, improving controls, and protecting employees, the brand and the company. You’ll develop enhanced data analytics to identify patterns and anomalies that drive action and support more real-time risk-based prioritisation.

title: Complaints Management Specialist, Vinted Pay
description:
Brief info about Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information about the position

As a Complaint Management Specialist at Vinted Pay, you will play a key role in protecting user trust and ensuring strong regulatory compliance within a fast-growing financial services environment. You will investigate and resolve complex, escalated payment-related complaints, prepare formal responses, and help turn challenging user situations into fair, well-managed outcomes. This role sits within the Vinted Pay Customer Support organisation, part of Vinted Pay - Vinted’s expanding regulated financial services entity.

In this position, you’ll

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for high-priority, complex, or escalated payment-related complaints requiring specialist handling.
  • Investigate complaints thoroughly and make fair, evidence-based decisions, balancing customer outcomes, company policies, regulatory requirements, and operational risk.
  • Prepare clear, accurate, and well-reasoned complaint responses in line with applicable UK and Lithuanian regulatory expectations, including FCA DISP, Consumer Duty, GDPR, FOS, and Bank of Lithuania standards.
  • Work closely with internal and external stakeholders, including Product, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations, senior management, and external partners, to resolve complex customer issues.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by translating complaint themes and pain points into actionable insights for Product, Policy, Risk, and Operations teams.
  • Use complaint data and root-cause analysis to identify recurring issues, emerging risks, and opportunities for service improvement.
  • Support the maintenance of complaint controls, procedures, and documentation to ensure they remain current, effective, and audit-ready.
  • Identify opportunities to responsibly use automation across complaint triage, handling, quality assurance, and reporting.
  • Communicate complaint trends, systemic issues, and relevant regulatory developments to senior stakeholders in a clear and actionable way.

About you

  • Experience handling complaints in a financial institution, PSP, EMI, fintech, banking, or regulated financial services environment.
  • Strong understanding of regulated complaint handling, including fair outcomes, evidence-based decisions, and documentation standards.
  • Ability to triage complaints, determine ownership and resolution path, and distinguish Vinted Pay regulated complaints from non-regulated issues.
  • Strong analytical skills to assess complex cases, identify root causes, and propose practical solutions.
  • Confident managing complex or escalated complaints with sound judgement and attention to customer, regulatory, and business impact.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to stay clear and calm in challenging situations.
  • Customer-centric, empathetic, resilient, and objective when handling sensitive cases.
  • Strong planning and prioritisation skills.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English.

Work perks

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 working days of holiday
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Comprehensive Medical Insurance
  • Group Life and Income Protection Insurance
  • A matched pension scheme up to a set limit
  • Access to a discounted gym membership plan
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • Frequent team-building events
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted

Working at Vinted

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

£31,600—£42,800 GBP

title: Business Systems Manager, Financial Applications
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

Business Systems Manager – Financial Applications

Role Overview

As a Business Systems Manager – Financial Applications (Workday), you will serve as a key technical execution lead and hands-on domain specialist for enterprise financial systems. Partnering closely with Finance Applications Leadership, you will drive the end-to-end delivery of complex Workday Financials projects, module enhancements, and ecosystem integrations.

Operating in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, you will balance rigorous system governance with agile delivery—translating strategic priorities into scalable configurations, mentoring system analysts, and maintaining seamless financial operations across global entities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Program Delivery & Execution:
  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of high-impact Workday Financials initiatives (major upgrades, new module rollouts, entity expansions, and process redesigns).
  • Translate roadmap objectives set by leadership into clear project plans, milestones, technical specifications, and sprint deliverables.
  • Hands-on Domain Expertise:
  • Serve as a technical and functional specialist on Workday Financials, performing complex configurations, troubleshooting escalation issues, and evaluating system capabilities.
  • Partner with Finance, Accounting, and Tax teams to analyze operational pain points and build robust, automated system solutions.
  • Agility & Change Management:
  • Rapidly adapt to shifting business priorities, market expansions, and statutory changes while maintaining project momentum.
  • Facilitate smooth transitions for end-users through structured user acceptance testing (UAT), release management, and clear enablement documentation.
  • Cross-System Integrations:
  • Coordinate and oversee data flows between Workday Financials and connected platforms (P2P, Payroll, Banking/Treasury, Travel, Tax, and Billing).
  • Support the technical design and optimization of end-to-end Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) pipelines, subscription/usage billing workflows, and revenue accounting operations.
  • Partner with integration engineers and vendors to ensure reliable, auditable integrations (EIBs, APIs, SFTP pipelines).
  • Governance, Compliance & Data Security:
  • Enforce strict change management, SOX compliance, and internal ticketing standards for all system modifications.
  • Maintain data integrity and security across financial data models and business processes.
  • Advanced Reporting & Analytics:
  • Design and maintain advanced reports, custom dashboards, and complex calculated fields to empower financial reporting and operational decision-making.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of progressive experience in financial systems analysis, enterprise ERP implementations, and technical project/program delivery.
  • Workday Mastery: Deep hands-on proficiency in Workday Financials (Core Financial Accounting, Business Processes, Expenses, Business Assets, Revenue and Advanced Reporting / Calculated Fields).
  • Adaptability & High-Pace Delivery: Proven track record of thriving in high-growth, rapidly evolving environments with the ability to manage ambiguity, reprioritize quickly, and deliver under tight timelines.
  • Finance & Accounting Knowledge: Strong understanding of core accounting principles, General Ledger (GL) structures, US GAAP/IFRS, internal controls, and SOX frameworks.
  • Project Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-level implementation cycles, upgrades, and structured testing phases (Unit, E2E, UAT).
  • Collaboration & Influence: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to bridge technical requirements with business stakeholder expectations.

title: Service Delivery Officer Level 3 - RTB
description:

Working Hours: 37 hours per week

Worker Type: Hybrid Worker

We’ve got an exciting opportunity available for talented individuals to join our workforce - perhaps this is the opportunity you’ve been looking for? Read on to find out more…

Working for Nottingham City Council has great benefits. As well as competitive pay, great leave entitlement and access to a generous pension scheme, we strive to create an innovative, inclusive and progressive work culture where everyone is supported to do and be their very best.

In return, we are looking for people like you - people who are innovative, driven and committed to serving and improving Nottingham. So, if you are passionate about making a difference to the lives of those who live and work in our city, we want to hear from you.

About the Role

Why Join the Right to Buy Team?

The Right to Buy (RTB) team delivers an important statutory service, supporting eligible council tenants through the process of purchasing their home. The service manages applications through key stages of the RTB process, working within statutory requirements and timescales while providing clear and effective support to residents.

As a Service Delivery Officer Level 3, you will provide comprehensive business and administrative support to the RTB service. You will manage your own workstreams, respond to customer enquiries, maintain accurate records and management information, and provide advice and guidance to customers, colleagues and partners. You will also support performance monitoring, project activity and improvements to systems and processes.
You’ll develop your understanding of the legislation, policies and procedures that underpin the service and use this knowledge to help resolve queries and ensure work is progressed accurately and within required timescales.

Why Apply?

  • Join a specialist statutory service that has a direct impact on Nottingham residents.
  • Develop knowledge and experience of Right to Buy legislation and housing services.
  • Manage varied workstreams and support residents through an important process.
  • Build your skills in customer service, administration, performance reporting and case management.
  • Contribute ideas and help improve processes, systems and ways of working.
  • Work collaboratively with colleagues and other services while developing your own knowledge and experience.

If you’re organised, customer-focused and looking for an opportunity where you can develop specialist knowledge while making a positive difference to Nottingham residents, we’d love to hear from you.

About You

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Service awareness and ability to understand and begins to apply knowledge of statutory requirements and legislation in daily tasks.
  • Undertakes structured research and analysis to support the resolution of moderately complex problems, using established procedures and guidance.
  • Demonstrates drive and motivation and the ability to deliver against objectives whilst working under pressure.
  • Solid working knowledge of Microsoft Office suite, capable of handling more complex tasks and supporting team activities with these tools. Experience and use of service specific IT software packages including case and document management systems.
  • Experience of documenting processes and procedures with a commitment to the application of new technology & relevant new ways of working.
  • Engages in cross-functional teamwork, fostering strong relationships and effective communication with others.

To support shortlisting, please demonstrate how you meet each of the essential criteria in your application, providing clear examples that highlight your relevant skills, knowledge and experience. Candidates who best evidence the essential criteria will be shortlisted for interview.

title: Cloud Engineer (All genders)
description:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Our cloud engineering team builds and maintains the foundational infrastructure supporting next-generation defence technology. We collaborate closely with software, autonomy, and security engineers to deliver high-availability systems across air, land, and sea domains. We foster an agile, fast-paced environment where IaC, automation, and operational excellence drive our core engineering practices.

YOUR MISSION

As a Cloud Engineer (All genders), you will focus on transforming service requests into production-ready, scalable environments. By utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC), you ensure every deployment is executed with precision, security, and thorough documentation. Your work will directly impact the reliability and scalability of our embedded autonomy infrastructure deployed across air, land, and sea systems.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Act as the primary contact for infrastructure service requests.
  • Build and maintain Terraform modules to ensure consistent state management and streamlined deployments.
  • Configure and install services with a strong emphasis on security protocols.
  • Monitor cloud provider activities to ensure cost-efficiency and compliance with security standards.
  • Produce detailed "How-to" guides for new services to enable developer self-service.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • 2 to 4 years of professional Cloud Engineering experience.
  • Strong practical knowledge of GCP is preferred; AWS or Azure experts willing to transition are welcome.
  • Advanced proficiency in Terraform.
  • Skilled in Kubernetes (k8s / GKE) and GitOps frameworks like Flux or Kustomize.
  • A commitment to supporting technical teams through well-architected infrastructure.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with hybrid or on-prem systems.

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!
