title: Blockchain Software Engineer
description:
About the Role

Our client, a rapidly expanding fintech company specializing in blockchain solutions, is seeking a talented Blockchain Software Engineer to join their dedicated team in Queenstown, Eastern Cape, ZA . This role is essential for the development and enhancement of our client's core blockchain platform and decentralized applications. You will be involved in the full software development lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing and deployment. The ideal candidate possesses strong programming skills, a solid understanding of blockchain principles, and a passion for building innovative, secure, and scalable systems. This is a unique opportunity to make a significant impact within the growing blockchain ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement robust software solutions leveraging blockchain technology.
  • Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code in relevant programming languages (e.g., Go, Rust, Python, Solidity).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, and other engineers.
  • Develop and integrate smart contracts for various applications.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging to ensure software quality and performance.
  • Contribute to the architecture and design of new blockchain features and functionalities.
  • Research and stay updated on emerging blockchain technologies and industry best practices.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve software defects and technical issues.
  • Ensure the security and integrity of all developed solutions.
  • Contribute to the documentation of software designs and processes.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of professional software development experience.
  • Proven experience with blockchain technologies and distributed ledger systems.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language commonly used in blockchain development (e.g., Go, Rust, Python, JavaScript).
  • Understanding of smart contract development (e.g., Solidity) and common patterns.
  • Familiarity with blockchain concepts such as consensus mechanisms, cryptography, and distributed consensus.
  • Experience with version control systems like Git.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Good communication and teamwork abilities.
  • Eagerness to learn and adapt to new technologies in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and skill development.
  • Engaging work environment contributing to innovative blockchain projects.
  • Located in Queenstown, Eastern Cape, ZA .
  • Generous paid time off and company holidays.
  • Access to industry conferences and training resources.
  • Potential for career advancement within a growing company.

title: Analysis Lead
description:
Who we’re looking for

We are seeking a high-calibre, hands-on Analysis Lead to support the definition of our strategic roadmap, shape our change book of work, design strategic solutions, set out and oversee design governance and lead other senior Analysts across our Client Group change portfolio

This role is pivotal in ensuring that enterprise strategy, operating models, and cross-domain business capabilities are clearly defined, aligned, and translated into scalable platform outcomes.

You will operate at the intersection of business strategy, operating model design, and platform enablement, ensuring coherence across Investment, Client, Group Operations, Data, and Finance business aligned domains.

As a senior leader, you will embed a strong analysis and design discipline within a platform-centric operating model, driving clarity, standardisation, and measurable business value across the organisation.

About Schroders

Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.

Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.

The team

The Asset Management Platform (AMP) is a global technology change and delivery organisation responsible for the platforms that underpin Schroders’ investment, client and operational capabilities across public and private markets.

AMP brings together a set of business-aligned technology platforms—including Client, Investment, Group Operations, Data and Finance—into a single, integrated asset management capability, enabling consistent, scalable and value-driven outcomes across the firm.

Operating within a platform-centric model, teams are aligned to business outcomes while leveraging shared enterprise capabilities across architecture, data, engineering and delivery to drive standardisation, reuse, and speed of execution.

This role provides a great opportunity to work across a wide range of interconnected initiatives gaining exposure across the whole remit of Asset Management Platforms

Asset Management Platform – Analysis & Design

The Analysis & Design function is a core enterprise level capability within the Asset Management Platform, accountable for shaping the future direction of the firm's technology and business capabilities.

Operating across all business aligned domains, the team provides leadership in business analysis, architecture, operating model design, strategic analysis and product management, ensuring investment is aligned to business priorities and enterprise outcomes.

Through the definition of common standards, reusable design patterns and platform-wide governance, the function drives consistency, simplification and scalability, enabling the organisation to accelerate change, optimise cost, and realise the full potential of data, AI and platform-based operating models.

Analysis & Design plays a central role in achieving this by:

  • Defining enterprise-wide capability models and value streams
  • Ensuring alignment across platforms and business domains
  • Driving standardisation, simplification, and convergence
  • Enabling data - and AI-driven transformation at scale

The team provide the structural backbone linking strategy to execution, ensuring that business intent is consistently realised across the platform ecosystem.

What you’ll do

  • Define and lead solution design and Analysis standards across various initiatives across Asset Management Platforms
  • Establish and maintain document templates, programme wide design governance
  • Ensure traceability and accountability from design to production
  • Present design recommendations to Senior sponsors and stakeholders
  • Translate business and corporate strategy into clear, structured outputs.
  • Enable enterprise-wide coherence and alignment across platform initiatives.
  • Define and evolve target operating models across front-to-back functions.
  • Support programme mobilisation activities including feasibility studies, RFI/RFP and vendor selection activities, produce business cases and TCO assessments.
  • Establish design principles, assumptions, programme scope and oversee programme BA’s to ensure the delivery adheres to the strategic design
  • Ensure alignment of business architecture across multiple platforms and domains.
  • Partner with programme managers, platform architects, domain architects, and engineering leads to ensure the solution design meets architectural standards as well as the functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Act as a bridge between business strategy and platform design/delivery.
  • Embed data and AI considerations into solution design.
  • Align with enterprise data strategy, governance, and platform capabilities.
  • Establish and enforce business architecture governance, standards, and best practices.
  • Promote consistency and quality in artefacts (capabilities, value streams, process maps, etc.)

The knowledge, experience and qualifications you need

  • Proven experience in a senior Business Analysis leadership role in a complex, global organisation
  • Strong understanding of asset management business models across front, middle, and back office
  • Experience operating within platform-led or product-based operating models.
  • Deep expertise in: Business capability modelling, Value stream mapping, Operating model design, End-to-end process architecture
  • Experience aligning business architecture with technology and data platforms.
  • Strong ability to translate complex strategy into structured, actionable frameworks.
  • Experience supporting large-scale, cross-domain transformation programmes.
  • Focus on value delivery, outcomes, and measurable impact.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders across business and technology.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to simplify complex concepts.
  • Experience working across global, matrixed environments.
  • Strong appreciation of modern technology concepts including Platform architectures, Data ecosystems, API and integration models
  • Ability to ensure business intent is effectively realised in platform design and delivery.

  • Experience of Salesforce & CRM (preferred)

What you’ll be like

The successful candidate will be a strategic and outcome‑driven senior Analyst, able to connect business priorities with clear, scalable technology direction. They will combine strong vision with pragmatism—defining long‑term platform strategy while making practical decisions that enable delivery at pace. With deep analytical credibility, they will engage confidently across analysis, architecture, engineering and delivery teams, shaping solutions that are robust, aligned to enterprise standards and focused on delivering tangible business value.

They will operate as a collaborative and influential leader within a complex, global environment, driving alignment across business and technology stakeholders. A strong advocate of simplification, standardisation and reuse, they will actively reduce complexity and drive convergence across the platform. Clear in their communication and accountable in their approach, they will take ownership for the platform’s evolution, contribute to the wider analysis and design community, and continuously apply emerging technologies—particularly data and AI—to enhance investment capabilities and outcomes.

We Recognise Potential, Whoever You Are

Our purpose is to deliver excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We believe diverse perspectives and an inclusive culture help us make better decisions and achieve better outcomes for our clients. That's why inclusion is a strategic priority for us, and we are an equal opportunities employer. You are welcome here, regardless of your age, disability, gender identity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, socio-economic background, or any other protected characteristic.

We will consider flexible working arrangements for all roles and provide reasonable accommodations to support applicants and employees, including those with neurodiversity, disability, or physical and mental health needs. For more information, please visit our FAQs.

title: Storage Presales Technical Architect - UKI Defence

Storage Presales Technical Architect - UKI Defence

We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

We are looking for our next Storage Presales Architect to join the growing Data Solutions team, supporting HPE's UK Public Sector Defence business. This is a highly visible role focused on helping defence organisations, government agencies, and strategic technology partners unlock the value of their data and infrastructure investments.


Working across a broad spectrum of defence and national security customers, you will engage with business and technology leaders to shape strategy, solve complex challenges, and deliver mission critical outcomes.


This is an exciting time to join the team. As defence investment continues to grow, with significant funding being directed towards digital transformation, cyber resilience, and modern data capabilities, Defence remains HPE UK's largest Public Sector sub-vertical and represents a major growth opportunity for the business.


We are looking for a proactive, high energy individual who thrives in a dynamic environment and enjoys influencing across customers, partners, and internal teams. You will help drive opportunities from early discovery through to successful adoption, creating meaningful impact across some of the UK's most strategically important organisations.


The ideal candidate will bring expertise across:

  • Enterprise storage and data management
  • Private and hybrid cloud architectures
  • Virtualisation and modern workloads
  • Structured and unstructured data platforms
  • Data protection, cyber resilience, and disaster recovery
  • Software-defined and hyperconverged infrastructure

Combining strong technical knowledge with business acumen, the successful candidate will translate complex requirements into secure, outcome focused solutions, acting as a trusted advisor to customers and partners while helping accelerate growth across HPE's Defence business.

Job Family Definition:

Responsible for architecting solutions that will achieve customer business outcomes either within a specific technical domain, or across the broader company portfolio (hardware, software, services, and as a service offerings) in combination with all necessary third-party components (e.g. software and integration). Develops and articulates compelling, accurate, and relevant proposals and ensures customer's business and technical requirements are met. Can be aligned to a specific area of technical expertise (e.g., products, solutions, services). Provides technical expertise to sales teams and customers (through sales presentations, product/solution demonstrations, etc.) aimed at gaining the customer mindshare within their domain. These jobs focus on technical selling to customers/partners. May be aligned to specific accounts based on business priority.


Management Level Definition:

Contributions impact technical components of HPE products, solutions, or services regularly and sustainable. Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. Provides expertise and partnership to functional and technical project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for achieving objectives. May provide team leadership and mentoring to others.


Responsibilities:

  • Demonstrates in-depth knowledge in one or more solution domains, company products, services, and solutions as well as the customer’s technical and business environment.
  • Develops compelling customer proposals and critically reviews them, manages the expectations of internal stakeholders and customers, ensuring the meeting of customer’s business and technical requirements are met.
  • Quantifies the impact of the business problem(s), positions business value, identifies the strengths and weaknesses of the overall proposed solution to achieve long-term business objectives.
  • Provides input to all global business units to address IT trends, requirements, gaps, or unmet needs.
  • Translates outcome-based solutions into a functional solution design that aligns to the customers business needs, and then translates that functional design into a technical design and architecture that can be scaled to accommodate growth.
  • Communicates how the solution value propositions addresses customer business needs.
  • Tracks leading-edge and emerging technologies.
  • Contributes to industry development for one or more domains through conferences (content support/presentations, demos, booth support) and industry events, while also monitoring social media.
  • Incorporates an understanding of technology trends within the IT industry, as well as the customer’s industry.
  • Actively gathers and applies competitive intelligence as a critical component of account support.
  • Drives the Account Business Planning process, leveraging knowledge of industry trends and the customer’s technical environment.

  • Produces in-depth comparative analysis of alternative approaches to meet solution requirements.

title: Airbus Account Director
location: UK Wide Role (HMRC Guidelines apply), England
description:
Better places, thriving communities.


Lead one of the UK's most prestigious security and business-critical partnerships.

At Mitie, we protect some of the world's most recognised organisations. We're now looking for an exceptional Account Director to lead our strategic partnership with Airbus UK, overseeing a complex, multi-site operation across a nationally significant aerospace, manufacturing and defence environment.

This is a high-impact leadership role with full accountability for operational excellence, client satisfaction, commercial performance, people leadership and future growth. You will be the senior point of contact for Airbus, building trusted executive-level relationships while ensuring the successful delivery of contractual obligations, continuous improvement initiatives and transformational programmes across the account.

  • Lead one of Mitie's most strategic and high-profile accounts
  • Build relationships with senior Airbus stakeholders and influence long-term account direction
  • Drive operational excellence across a complex, multi-site environment
  • Lead large-scale security, risk, resilience and transformation programmes
  • Shape culture, colleague engagement and customer experience
  • Play a key role in future growth opportunities and innovation across the contract
  • Work within a business that invests heavily in leadership development and progression

Opportunity

As Account Director, you will have end-to-end responsibility for the Airbus contract, ensuring exceptional service delivery whilst maintaining strong commercial performance and customer satisfaction.

You will provide strategic leadership across operational, financial and people performance, ensuring Mitie remains a trusted partner to Airbus while identifying opportunities to continuously improve service, efficiency, resilience and value.

Working closely with the wider leadership team, you will create an environment where safety, compliance, innovation and customer focus sit at the heart of everything we do.

Responsibilities

Client & Stakeholder Leadership

  • Act as the senior strategic relationship owner for Airbus UK
  • Develop trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders across multiple functions
  • Ensure contractual commitments, KPIs and service standards are consistently achieved
  • Deliver governance, performance reviews and business updates
  • Identify opportunities for contract enhancement and future growth

Operational Excellence

  • Lead all operational delivery activities across the account
  • Drive service performance, compliance and risk management
  • Ensure robust business continuity and resilience arrangements are maintained
  • Oversee mobilisation, transformation and continuous improvement programmes
  • Champion innovation, technology adoption and operational efficiencies

Commercial & Financial Accountability

  • Own account profitability and budget performance
  • Monitor commercial risks and opportunities
  • Deliver agreed productivity and efficiency targets
  • Support forecasting, workforce planning and strategic investment decisions
  • Ensure accurate reporting and strong financial governance

People Leadership

  • Lead, inspire and develop a high-performing leadership team
  • Create a culture centred around engagement, accountability and inclusion
  • Build succession plans and strengthen leadership capability across the account
  • Drive colleague wellbeing, retention and development initiatives
  • Ensure talent pipelines support current and future operational requirements

Safety, Risk & Compliance

  • Maintain the highest standards of health, safety, security and compliance
  • Ensure all statutory, contractual and regulatory obligations are met
  • Lead risk mitigation and resilience planning activities
  • Promote a strong culture of security awareness and operational assurance

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • Significant experience leading large-scale operational contracts or strategic customer accounts
  • Proven success in managing senior client relationships
  • Strong commercial and financial management capability
  • Experience leading multi-disciplinary teams across multiple locations
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and influencing skills
  • Demonstrable experience delivering transformational change
  • Strong understanding of governance, compliance and risk management

Desirable

  • Security, facilities management, critical infrastructure, aerospace, defence or manufacturing sector experience
  • Experience working within highly regulated environments
  • Degree-level qualification or equivalent leadership experience
  • Professional security, operational or business management qualifications

About Airbus

Airbus is a global leader in aerospace, defence and space technologies, operating some of the most advanced and business-critical environments in the UK. This role provides a unique opportunity to influence security, resilience and operational excellence across a nationally important account.

What Success Looks Like

  • Exceptional client satisfaction and stakeholder confidence
  • Delivery of contractual KPIs and service excellence
  • Strong financial performance and sustainable growth
  • High-performing, engaged and well-developed teams
  • Continuous improvement and innovation across the account
  • Safe, compliant and resilient operations

If you're a strategic leader who thrives on building partnerships, delivering operational excellence and leading large-scale teams, we'd love to hear from you.

Join Mitie and help shape the future of high-performing, secure environments for Airbus UK.

Our market-leading offering provides you with benefits that suit your lifestyle.

We have a virtual GP on hand for you and members of your household. So you can get expert advice by video or phone without having to leave your home. We offer financial wellbeing assistance through our Salary Finance scheme. For example, you could access 50% of your earned pay before payday for a small fee. Salary Finance also offers competitive loans.

When you join us, we'll give you a link to our flexible lifestyle benefits platform, Choices. You might choose to purchase up to five extra days' holiday each year. You might buy critical illness insurance, seek dental treatment or buy technology products at an affordable cost. There are many choices!

We give you access to high street discounts from thousands of well-known retailers, gyms and more through our MiDeals platform. And we have a cycle-to-work scheme. Life cover of up to four times your salary is available. We also offer enhanced pension contributions, a save-as-you-earn scheme, and a Mitie Matching Share Plan (you could even be awarded free shares in Mitie).

We award our employees with Mitie Stars as recognition for their hard work. There are cash prizes up for grabs each month and at the end of the year there's a chance to scoop a top prize of £10,000!

Our success is a direct result of the experience and quality of our people. Progressing your career is therefore a top priority for us. We offer a diverse variety of training and development avenues via a wide selection of learning resources to suit you.

Since 1987, Mitie’s 84,000 employees have been maintaining companies globally. We are the UK’s leading facilities management and professional services company, and our clients range from household names in banking, critical government sites as well as hospitals and schools.

Join our Mitie Team.

Together our diversity makes us stronger.

title: Plastmager til KOM Change Over, Aftenhold
description:
Job Description

Plastmager Til KOM Change Over – Aftenhold

Vil du være en del af en succesfuld virksomhed, hvor du er med til at forsyne vores kunder med LEGO® produkter og arbejde i en afdeling, der vægter sammenhold, kvalitet og sikkerhed højt.


Du er med til at sikre god kvalitet af omstillinger.

Som medarbejder i Change Over er du med til at sikre den rigtige omstilling af høj kvalitet.


Dine primære opgaver er at lave omstillinger i den rigtige kvalitet.


Specifikke kompetence behov

  • Du er plastmager uddannet.
  • Du er god til at have mange bolde i luften
  • Du kan bruge en pc
  • Du er indstillet på at lære de opgaver, rutiner og spilleregler, der er i afdelingen
  • Du er god til at samarbejde, og udviser fleksibilitet og forandringsvilje
  • Du har stor fokus på kvalitet
  • Du kan arbejde selvstændigt
  • Du er forberedt på at der er gang i den hele dagen


Det gode match

Har du faglig ballast, er kvalitetsbevidst og en teamplayer? Vi er på udkig efter dig, der tager et ansvar og yder en fleksibel indsats i et miljø, hvor sammenhold og sikkerhed betyder alt. Du har et godt overblik, er hjælpsom og du er i stand til at håndtere forskellige opgaver uden at gå på kompromis med sikkerheden og kvaliteten.

Ansøg & kontakt

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Senior manager Henrik Jespersen på telefon nr. 29228679

For at søge stillingen skal du klikke på APPLY/ANSØG knappen foroven. Husk at vedhæfte dine dokumenter.

Bliv en del af det globale LEGO® team

Hvad får du ud af det? Her er noget af dét, du kan forvente:

• Familieplejeorlov - Vi tilbyder betalte orlovsmuligheder i de vigtige tider.

• Forsikringer – Alle kolleger er dækket af vores livs- og invalideforsikring, som giver beskyttelse og ro i sindet.

• Kollegarabat – Vi ved, at du vil elske at bygge, så du bliver en del af vores generøse kollegarabat.

• Bonus – Vi gør vores bedste for at få succes sammen. Når målene er nået, vil du blive belønnet gennem vores globale bonusordning.

Børn er vores rollemodeller. Deres nysgerrighed, kreativitet og fantasi inspirerer alt, hvad vi gør. Vi stræber efter at skabe en mangfoldig, dynamisk og inkluderende legekultur i LEGO Koncernen, hvor alle føler sig trygge, værdsatte og at de hører til.


LEGO Koncernen er stolt af at være en arbejdsgiver med lige muligheder. Vi er forpligtet til lige beskæftigelsesmuligheder og lige løn uanset f.eks. race, farve, religion, køn, national oprindelse, seksuel orientering, handicap eller kønsidentitet.


LEGO Koncernen er fuldt engageret i børns rettigheder og børns trivsel over hele kloden. Kandidater, der tilbydes stillinger med højt engagement med børn, skal deltage i Child Safeguarding Background Screening som en betingelse for tilbuddet. Tak, fordi du deler vores globale engagement i børns rettigheder.


Byg din karriere klods for klods i LEGO Koncernen.



Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.



What’s in it for you?


Here is what you can expect:


Family Care Leave - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.


Insurances – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.


Wellbeing - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.


Colleague Discount – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.


Bonus - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.


Your workplace: Your workplace will be the office, store or factory specified in this advert.


Hybrid Working: Our hybrid work model, Best of Both offers you the option of flexibility to work from home up to two days per week. Your People Leader will discuss the principles of the model, including how this option applies to your role and team.

Learn more about our benefits, culture and workplace experience here


Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong.


The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team.


The LEGO Group is fully committed to Children’s Rights and Child Wellbeing across the globe. Candidates offered positions with high engagement with children are required to take part in Child Safeguarding Background Screening, as a condition of the offer.


Thank you for sharing our global commitment to Children’s Rights.


Just imagine building your dream career.

Then make it real.

Join the LEGO® team today.

title: Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

À propos du rôle

Anthropic construit l’équipe Applied AI pour aider les organisations les plus ambitieuses du monde à adopter Claude de manière transformatrice, sûre et durable. Nos Forward Deployed Engineers s’intègrent directement auprès de clients stratégiques pour déployer des applications d’IA en production qui résolvent de véritables problèmes métier. À mesure que cette pratique se développe, nous avons besoin d’une personne leader pour construire et développer cette équipe.

En tant que premier Forward Deployed Manager en Europe du Sud, vous piloterez l’équipe qui se situe à la frontière du déploiement d’IA en entreprise. Vous recruterez et développerez une équipe performante de Forward Deployed Engineers, fixerez le standard technique et opérationnel pour les engagements clients, et construirez les playbooks qui transforment les succès ponctuels en modèles reproductibles. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les Engagement Managers qui gèrent la logistique de livraison et les relations avec les parties prenantes, tout en veillant à ce que votre équipe livre du code de qualité, se développe techniquement, et représente Anthropic au plus haut niveau dans les environnements clients.

Ce rôle est un rôle de meneur-contributeur avec une forte orientation leadership. Vous resterez assez impliqué dans le travail technique pour examiner les architectures, déboguer les problèmes en production, et vous associer à votre équipe quand cela compte — mais votre impact principal viendra des personnes que vous recruterez, des standards que vous fixerez, et de la culture que vous créerez. Vous collaborerez de manière transversale avec les équipes Ventes, Produit et Ingénierie pour façonner la manière dont Anthropic sert ses clients les plus stratégiques, et les insights de terrain de votre équipe influenceront directement la direction produit.

Ce rôle nécessite quelqu’un qui s’épanouit dans l’ambiguïté et qui est énergisé par la création à partir de zéro. Vous définirez ce que l’excellence ressemble pour la gestion d’une équipe FDE chez Anthropic — il n’existe pas de playbook existant à suivre.

Responsabilités

  • Recruter, développer et fidéliser une équipe de classe mondiale de Forward Deployed Engineers. Fixer un haut standard pour le talent technique et l’instinct client.
  • Mener des entretiens individuels réguliers, fournir du mentorat technique, et investir dans la progression de carrière de chaque membre de l’équipe. Créer un environnement où les Forward Deployed Engineers accomplissent leur meilleur travail.
  • Staffier et superviser les engagements clients dans le portefeuille de votre équipe, en prenant des décisions d’allocation des ressources qui équilibrent les besoins clients, le développement de l’équipe, et les priorités métier.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes de compte et les Engagement Managers pendant le processus de pré-vente pour qualifier les engagements, définir le périmètre du travail, et informer les demandes de travail.
  • Examiner les architectures techniques et le code produit par vos Forward Deployed Engineers, en veillant à ce que l’équipe livre des solutions production de haute qualité qui résolvent de véritables problèmes clients.
  • Rester assez impliqué pour diriger des sessions de découverte technique, prototyper des solutions, et déboguer des problèmes complexes aux côtés de votre équipe quand cela est nécessaire.
  • Construire des playbooks reproductibles, des dépôts de démarrage, des modèles d’intégration, et une base de connaissances interne qui capture ce que votre équipe apprend sur le terrain.
  • Définir les OKRs de l’équipe liés aux résultats de succès client et aux objectifs d’adoption produit. Créer des cadences opérationnelles — standups, rétros, revues d’engagement — qui maintiennent l’équipe alignée.
  • Collaborer avec Produit et Ingénierie pour traduire les insights de terrain en améliorations produit. Servir comme voix du client dans la planification interne.
  • Voyager sur les sites des clients selon les besoins (25-50%), particulièrement lors des lancements d’engagement et pour les comptes prioritaires de votre équipe.

Vous pourriez être un bon fit si vous avez

  • 10+ ans d’expérience en ingénierie logicielle, architecture de solutions, ou dans un rôle technique orienté client comme l’ingénierie forward deployed ou le conseil.
  • 2+ ans d’expérience en gestion de personnes au sein d’une organisation de services/post-vente/FDE avec un palmarès de recrutement, développement et fidélisation d’ingénieurs performants.
  • De l’expérience dans la construction d’organisations de zéro à un, pas seulement l’héritage d’une organisation existante.
  • De l’expérience de travail direct avec des clients d’entreprise sur des mises en œuvre techniques, y compris l’aisance à naviguer dans les dynamiques organisationnelles complexes.
  • Une présence de cadre avec la capacité à naviguer fluidement entre les conversations stratégiques avec les parties prenantes senior et les sessions de débogage pratiques avec les ingénieurs.
  • Des compétences fortes en communication écrite et verbale. Vous pouvez traduire la complexité technique en narratifs clairs pour des audiences diverses.
  • Un enthousiasme sincère pour la construction de quelque chose de nouveau et la définition de l’excellence pour une équipe qui n’existe pas encore.

Pourquoi ce rôle compte

Vous serez une personne leader fondatrice d’une équipe qui définit comment les entreprises adoptent et déploient l’IA. Votre travail influencera directement la direction produit d’Anthropic, créera des modèles réutilisables pour la base clients plus large, et établira Anthropic comme le partenaire de confiance pour la transformation de l’IA — tout en promouvant le développement responsable des systèmes d’IA de pointe.

About the role

Anthropic is building the Applied AI team to help the world's most ambitious organizations adopt Claude in ways that are transformative, safe, and lasting. Our Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with strategic customers to ship production AI applications that solve real business problems. As this practice grows, we need a founding leader to build and scale it.


As the first FDE Manager in Southern Europe, you'll own the team that sits at the frontier of enterprise AI deployment. You'll hire and develop a high-performing team of FDEs, set the technical and operational bar for customer engagements, and build the playbooks that turn one-off successes into repeatable patterns. You'll work hand-in-hand with Engagement Managers who own delivery logistics and stakeholder management, while you ensure your team is shipping quality code, growing technically, and representing Anthropic at the highest level in customer environments.

This is a player-coach role with a strong bias toward leadership. You'll stay close enough to the technical work to review architectures, debug production issues, and pair with your team when it matters — but your primary impact will come from the people you hire, the standards you set, and the culture you create. You'll partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Engineering to shape how Anthropic serves its most strategic customers, and your team's field insights will directly influence product direction.

This role requires someone who thrives in ambiguity and is energized by building from zero to one. You'll be defining what good looks like for FDE management at Anthropic — there is no existing playbook to follow.

Responsibilities

  • Hire, develop, and retain a world-class team of Forward Deployed Engineers. Set a high bar for technical talent and customer instincts.

  • Conduct regular 1:1s, provide technical mentorship, and invest in the career growth of each team member. Create an environment where FDEs do the best work of their careers.

  • Staff and oversee customer engagements across your team's portfolio, making resource allocation decisions that balance customer needs, team development, and business priorities.

  • Collaborate with account teams and Engagement Managers during the pre-sales process to qualify engagements, scope work, and inform statements of work.

  • Review technical architectures and code produced by your FDEs, ensuring the team ships high-quality, production-ready solutions that solve real customer problems.

  • Stay hands-on enough to lead technical discovery sessions, prototype solutions, and debug complex issues alongside your team when needed.

  • Build repeatable playbooks, starter repositories, integration templates, and an internal knowledge base that captures what your team learns in the field.

  • Define team OKRs that tie to customer success outcomes and product adoption goals. Create operational cadences — standups, retros, engagement reviews — that keep the team aligned.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to translate field insights into product improvements. Serve as the voice of the customer in internal planning.

  • Travel to customer sites as needed (25-50%), particularly during engagement kickoffs and for your team's highest-priority accounts.

You may be a good fit if you have

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, or a technical customer-facing role such as forward deployed engineering or consulting.

  • 2+ years of people management experience within a services/post-sales/FDE organization with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.

  • Experience building organizations from 0->1, not just inheriting an existing one.

  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers on technical implementations, including comfort navigating complex organizational dynamics.

  • Executive presence with the ability to move fluidly between strategic conversations with senior stakeholders and hands-on debugging sessions with engineers.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. You can translate technical complexity into clear narratives for diverse audiences.

  • Genuine excitement about building something new and defining what great looks like for a team that doesn't yet exist.

Why this role matters

You'll be a founding leader of a team that defines how enterprises adopt and scale AI. Your work will directly influence Anthropic's product direction, create reusable patterns for the broader customer base, and establish Anthropic as the trusted partner for AI transformation — all while advancing the responsible development of frontier AI systems.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
€235.000—€295.000 EUR

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

description:
Job Title:

Senior Engineer, ARM Platform Security – RICOCHET – Central Technology

Job Description:

Your Mission

Call of Duty is one of the most iconic and successful video game franchises in the world, delivering unforgettable experiences to millions of players. At the heart of that experience is fair play—and that’s where the Ricochet team comes in. We’re on a mission to detect and eliminate cheaters swiftly, ensuring every player enjoys a level playing field.

In this role as a Senior Engineer, your experience working with Windows on the Arm Platform will be critical as you help port some of our key security features to Windows on Arm. Your work will directly protect the integrity of one of the most beloved franchises in gaming as we bring it to more PC platforms.


What you bring to the table

The Game Security team’s priorities can change quickly based on the threat landscape. The following areas of ownership will act as a baseline. Therefore, this role includes, but is not limited to, the following responsibilities:


Innovate and Evolve: Design and implement advanced anti-cheat technologies to stay ahead of emerging threats.

Strengthen Core Systems: Analyze, update, and enhance existing protection frameworks to maintain top-tier security.

Detect and Defend: Investigate, develop, and deploy cheat detection mechanisms that keep gameplay fair and fun.

Collaborate Across Studios: Work closely with engineers across multiple teams to ensure seamless integration and performance.

Why This Role Matters: Your contributions will help millions of players experience Call of Duty as it’s meant to be played - competitive, fair, and thrilling. You’ll tackle complex technical challenges, influence the future of anti-cheat technology, and make a real impact on one of the world’s largest gaming communities.

Player Profile

Minimum Requirements

Experience

  • 8+ years of relevant professional software development experience
  • 5+ years of experience with Windows Platform on ARM
  • Proven experience working on large-scale complex systems
  • Experience with C++ codebases and refactoring
  • Experience working in an engineering organization with a focus on CI/CD, scalability, and automation
  • Expertise in debugging, optimization and performance tuning

Knowledge & Skills

  • Advanced knowledge of algorithms and data structures

Key Attributes

  • Strong passion for delivering high-quality products
  • Curiosity and drive to understand how systems work under the hood, break them down, analyze their behavior, and improve them
  • Passion for low-level systems work, including comfort reading and debugging compiled code at the assembly level
  • Clear and effective communication skills, both written and verbal

Extra Points

Experience

  • Experience with Windows Internals Experience with Windows Security
  • Experience working on the internals of a multi-player game engine
  • Experience in reverse engineering software analysis

Knowledge & Skills

  • Background in Mathematics and/or cryptography
  • Deep understanding of C++ compilation, linking, and toolchains, including diagnosing compiler and linker failures and optimizing build performance
  • Deep understanding or hands-on experience in the anti-cheat domain


Your Platform

Activision Central Tech works to support our development studios and their titles. Comprised of seven main teams, we have many specialties including big data, privacy and security, motion capture and animation pipeline technologies, graphics, build and infrastructure for studio development and data centers, optimization, systems programming and online services including matchmaking and networking. Central Tech is distributed globally with offices across the U.S., and in Canada, England, Ireland and Japan.

Most of our teams are comprised of both engineering and research talent, allowing us to always have an eye on the future. Our talented engineers help with title development and provide valuable knowledge sharing between studios while our researchers are action-oriented and keep a strong connection with the needs of the game studios.

Central Tech is part of Activision. To learn more about us and our research, please visit us at .

Our World

At Activision, we strive to create the most iconic brands in gaming and entertainment. We’re driven by our mission to deliver unrivaled gaming experiences for the world to enjoy, together. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, Crash Bandicoot™, Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™, and Guitar Hero®. As a leading worldwide developer, publisher and distributor of interactive entertainment and products, our “press start” is simple: delight hundreds of millions of players around the world with innovative, fun, thrilling, and engaging entertainment experiences.

We’re not just looking back at our decades-long legacy; we’re forging ahead to keep advancing gameplay with some of the most popular titles and sophisticated technology in the world. We have bold ambitions to create the most inclusive company as we know our success comes from the passionate, creative, and diverse teams within our organization.

We’re in the business of delivering fun and unforgettable entertainment for our player community to enjoy. And our future opportunities have never been greater — this could be your opportunity to level up.

Ready to Activate Your Future?

We love hearing from anyone who is enthusiastic about changing the games industry. Not sure you meet all qualifications? Let us decide! description:

5:00 PM - 3:30 AM

Department: Specimen Processing 232

*Hourly rate is an estimate only which includes shift differential for nights, evenings or weekend shifts. Overall hourly rates will vary based on schedule

Primary Purpose:

Works under direct supervision to learn the proper handling of all specimens received at ARUP's central facility and/or University Division and prepares specimens for laboratory testing. The position includes such functions as matching patient information, data entry, aliquoting, and scanning documents.

About ARUP:

ARUP Laboratories is a national clinical and anatomic pathology reference laboratory and an enterprise of the University of Utah and its Department of Pathology. Based in Salt Lake City, Utah.

ARUP proudly hires top talent to create a work environment of diversity, professional growth and continuous development. Our workforce is committed to the important service we provide to over one million patients each month. We always strive for excellence and have a strong desire to have involvement with the advances in medicine and the role laboratory services plays within each patient’s life. We never forget that there is a patient behind every specimen we receive.

We are looking for individuals who want to contribute to ARUP's culture of accountability, integrity, service, and excellence. Consider joining our dynamic team.

Essential Functions:

Reads and signs all department specific Sop's and Safety Manual.

Attends Specimen Processing team and staff meetings.

Immediately processes specimens as they become available.

Enter patient demographics and process specimens/orders using the appropriate applications.

Order all tests indicated on the requisition.

Process all manual and electronically transmitted tests on submitted paperwork.

Properly comments any additional information on the requisition/packing list.

Follow department process to resolve issues when problems are identified e.g. order EXCEPT TT, EPIC follow up task, etc.

Handles and labels all specimens and paperwork appropriately.

Able to recognize and appropriate handle all specimen types per corporate and departmental procedure.

Properly documents all specimen receipt information as outlined in departmental procedures.

Properly documents the appropriate client provided information on specimen labels.

Ensures all appropriate identifiers are checked on all received specimens/paperwork and electronically. Must ensure all match and all specimens are labelled correctly.

Properly handles specimens requiring a reroute or to be shared.

Places processed specimens on the automated track, or at the appropriate temperature for manual sorting, or delivers to the testing laboratory at the proper temperature if automated delivery systems are not available.

Able to process specimens at all three temperatures and follow the appropriate procedures for all manual and electronically transmitted orders.

Properly operates the biological safety cabinet.

University Hospital Clinical Lab only: Properly operates the centrifuge.

Proficient in the Internal Test Directory (ITD) or applicable test information catalog as related to accessioning and client submissions/inquiries.

Proficient in all current departmental LIS applications and functions.

Aliquots specimens according to procedure using the proper safety equipment.

Knows ARUP and University Division laboratories and able to determine their locations, hours of operations, and general functions (or able to find such information using departmental information on Nucleus).

Ability to make sound judgement decisions or checks with Supervisor, Lead, or Workflow Coordinator when needed, before making such decisions.

Assists the management team in handling more complex processing needs including specimen searches and processing compromised shipments when needed.

Observes principles of data security and patient confidentiality. Maintains ethical standards in the performance of testing and in interactions with patients, co-workers and other health care professionals.

Adheres to all safety policies and regulations including, but not limited to, proper dress code and using proper protective clothing and other equipment.

Remains informed of all procedures pertaining to department.

Performs cleaning duties as assigned.

Assists with departmental projects.

Central Processing: Proficient in the following ARUP applications: Accessioning and Shipment Tracking.

University Division: Properly operates the centrifuge and ensures specimen acceptability and integrity per department protocol.

University Division: Correctly prepares specimens for delivery between ARUP testing facilities by creating packing list according to specimen handling requirements.

Other duties as assigned.

Physical and Other Requirements:

Stooping: Bending body downward and forward by bending spine at the waist.

Reaching: Extending hand(s) and arm(s) in any direction.

Mobility: The person in this position needs to move between work sites and inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.

PPE: Biohazard laboratory environment that requires use of personal protective equipment in accordance with CDC and OSHA regulations and company/departmental policies.

ARUP Policies and Procedures: To conduct self in compliance with all ARUP Policies and Procedures.

Abide by the Code of Conduct as outlined in the ARUP employee handbook.

Medium Work: Exerting up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 30 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects.

Fine Motor Control: Picking, pinching, typing or otherwise working, primarily with fingers rather than with the whole hand as in handling.

Vision: Having close, far, and peripheral visual acuity to perform a variety of tasks such as make general observations of depth and distance.

Color Vision: Perception of and ability to distinguish colors

Performance Expectations: Regular and reliable attendance. Reliable and dependable performance. Ability to work well with others. Ability to work all required overtime.

title: Communication Representative - OH Communications
description:
FirstEnergy at a Glance

We are a forward-thinking electric utility powered by a diverse team of employees committed to making customers’ lives brighter, the environment better and our communities stronger.

FirstEnergy (NYSE: FE) is dedicated to safety, reliability, and operational excellence. Headquartered in Akron, Ohio, FirstEnergy includes one of the nation's largest investor-owned electric systems, more than 24,500 miles of transmission lines that connect the Midwest and Mid-Atlantic regions, and a regulated generating fleet with a total capacity of 3,780 megawatts.

About the Opportunity

This is an open position with FirstEnergy Service Co., a subsidiary of FirstEnergy Corp. [SC00]

Position Summary:

The State Communications Representative is an individual contributor who delivers high‑quality internal, external and customer communications that support business objectives at the state level. The Representative partners closely with the Head of State Communications and collaborates with corporate and state teams – including Operations, External Affairs, Regulatory, Customer Accounts & Local Engagement, Safety and Corporate Communications – to ensure employees, customers and other stakeholders receive consistent, accurate and compelling information.

In this role, the ideal candidate will possess a strong ability to work collaboratively with business leadership and team members to provide strategic advice on communications issues. The Representative must be a strong communicator with experience telling stories through high-quality written content and speaking publicly on key issues. The Representative must also have a general understanding of current media trends and video, digital and social channels. The individual should be self-driven while adept at working with others to strategize, identify pitfalls and develop solutions that result in clear, concise messaging on specific and sometimes tight deadlines.

Key Responsibilities:

Employee & Internal Communications

  • Develop and execute internal communications that inform, engage and align state employees with strategic business priorities.
  • Draft employee‑focused messaging for employee portal articles, leadership updates, safety campaigns, transformation initiatives and operational activities.
  • Translate complex or technical concepts into accessible internal content that supports understanding and builds employee confidence.
  • Support executive communications including presentations, talking points, town hall content and internal videos.
  • Coordinate with HR, Operations, Safety and Corporate Communications partners to ensure timely internal messaging.

External Communications & Media Relations

  • Draft news releases, media statements, talking points and external briefings.
  • Identify and support pitching of story opportunities that strengthen FirstEnergy’s reputation.
  • Build and maintain relationships with local reporters and news outlets.
  • Serve as media spokesperson, delivering key messages and maintaining a positive public image.
  • Monitor issues and support responses related to outages, community events and emerging topics.
  • Participate in after‑hours media on‑call rotation and outage/emergency communications.

Customer & Community Communications

  • Produce customer‑focused content supporting programs such as energy efficiency, smart meters, safety and operational updates.
  • Break down complex topics into clear messaging for customers and stakeholders.
  • Support community engagement through materials for events, public meetings and sponsorship initiatives.
  • Ensure consistency with FirstEnergy’s brand and service commitments.

Digital, Social Media & Multimedia Support

  • Create digital content for web, social media, video scripts and visual displays tailored to state audiences.
  • Leverage emerging communications technologies – including AI‑enabled tools, digital platforms and new multimedia formats – to enhance content creation, distribution and audience engagement.
  • Conduct social and media listening to identify insights that inform messaging.
  • Support management of content calendars for internal, external and customer communications.
  • Assist with development of videos, graphics and other multimedia assets.

Regulatory, Stakeholder & Operational Support

  • Support communications related to regulatory filings, public open houses, legislative engagement and stakeholder issues.
  • Collaborate across departments to maintain alignment in messaging.
  • Attend community or public meetings as needed.

Team Collaboration & Culture

  • Collaborate with Corporate Communications colleagues to ensure consistency.
  • Promote a positive, inclusive, high‑performing team culture.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, Public Relations or related field.
  • 3–7 years of communications experience spanning employee/internal communications, media relations, digital content or customer engagement.
  • Strong writing and editing skills with ability to tailor content to diverse audiences.
  • Experience with emerging communications technologies, including AI‑driven content tools, digital communication platforms and evolving multimedia formats.
  • Strategic storyteller skilled at crafting relatable business narratives.
  • Ability to translate complex subjects into clear messaging.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
  • Familiarity with social media platforms, CMS tools and multimedia.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with ability to build trust across functions.
  • Willingness to support after‑hours and emergency communications.

Benefits, Compensation & Workforce Diversity

At FirstEnergy, employees are key to our success. We depend on their talents to meet the challenges of our changing business environment. We are committed to rewarding individual and team efforts through our total rewards philosophy which includes competitive pay plus incentive compensation, a company-sponsored pension plan, 401(k) savings plan with matching employer contribution, a choice of medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, and life insurance programs, as well as skills development training with tuition reimbursement. Please visit our website at www.firstenergycorp.com to learn more about all of our employee rewards programs. FirstEnergy proudly supports workforce diversity. title: Freelance Data Science Engineer (Python & SQL)
description:
This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About The Role

GenAI models are improving very quickly, and one of our goals is to make them capable of addressing specialized questions and achieving complex reasoning skills. If you join the platform as a Data Science AI Trainer, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate on these projects.

Although every project is unique, you might typically:

  • Design original computational data science problems that simulate real-world analytical workflows across industries (telecom, finance, government, e-commerce, healthcare)
  • Create problems requiring Python programming to solve (using pandas, numpy, scipy, sklearn, statsmodels, matplotlib, seaborn)
  • Ensure problems are computationally intensive and cannot be solved manually within reasonable timeframes (days/weeks)
  • Develop problems requiring non-trivial reasoning chains in data processing, statistical analysis, feature engineering, predictive modeling, and insight extraction
  • Create deterministic problems with reproducible answers: avoid stochastic elements or require fixed random seeds for exact reproducibility
  • Base problems on real business challenges: customer analytics, risk assessment, fraud detection, forecasting, optimization, and operational efficiency
  • Design end-to-end problems spanning the complete data science pipeline (data ingestion → cleaning → EDA → modeling → validation → deployment considerations)
  • Incorporate big data processing scenarios requiring scalable computational approaches
  • Verify solutions using Python with standard data science libraries and statistical methods
  • Document problem statements clearly with realistic business contexts and provide verified correct answers.

How To Get Started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

Requirements

  • You hold a Master's or PhD Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related quantitative field.
  • You have at least 5 years of hands-on data science experience with proven business impact
  • You have portfolio of completed projects and publications showcasing real-world problem-solving.
  • You are proficient in python programming for data science (pandas, numpy, scipy, scikit-learn, statsmodels).
  • You are an expert in statistical analysis and machine learning with deep understanding of algorithms, methods, and their practical applications.
  • You are proficient in SQL and database operations for data manipulation and analysis
  • You have experience with GenAI technologies (LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, vector databases)
  • You have good understanding of MLOps practices and model deployment workflows
  • You possess knowledge of modern frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, LangChain)
  • Your level of English is advanced (C1) or above
  • You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines
  • Our freelance role is fully remote so, you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge

Benefits

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $34/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs
  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise

title: Building Monitor
description:
SUMMARY:

This position supports the work of the Y, a leading nonprofit, charitable organization committed to strengthening community through youth development, healthy living and social responsibility. The Building Monitor has primary management control over all aspects of Tri-Cities Family YMCA operations, with a special focus on building safety/security functions and building maintenance/custodial functions during open building hours. Active involvement in building oversight is required.


OUR CULTURE:

Our mission and core values are brought to life by our culture. In the Y, we strive to live our cause of strengthening communities with purpose and intentionality every day. We are welcoming: we are open to all. We are a place where you can belong and become. We are genuine: we value you and embrace your individuality. We are hopeful: we believe in you and your potential to become a catalyst in the world. We are nurturing: we support you in your journey to develop your full potential. We are determined: above all else, we are on a relentless quest to make our community stronger beginning with you.


ESSENTIAL OVERALL FUNCTIONS

  1. Risk Management – Patrols building and grounds to prevent fires, theft, vandalism, and other behavior disruptive to the peace and orderly operation of the YMCA. Documents all occurrences of personal injury, property damage or theft, anti-social behavior or other unusual situations by completing an Incident Report form for each occurrence. Employees are advised on OSHA Standards through required signage and administrative updates as compliant by federal law.
  2. Building Maintenance – Coordinates and assists in light maintenance tasks such as replenishing bathroom/locker room supplies, sweeping floors, mopping, etc. Responsible for cleaning, removing and sanitizing areas exposed to potential bio-hazardous waste (body fluids).
  3. Enforcement of Rules and Policies – Interprets and sensibly enforces YMCA rules, regulations and operational policies. Observes behavior of YMCA members and guests. Cautions and/or takes appropriate enforcement action against violators. Monitors program and activity areas to insure compliance with the YMCA’s policies. Remains visible and readily available to patrons and staff.
  4. Emergency Situations – Renders CPR and First Aid care to injured guests, members and employees. When appropriate, telephones “911” to insure that seriously injured receive necessary medical attention. Maintains a working relationship with the Grand Haven City Police and Fire Departments. Becomes knowledgeable about the YMCA’s Emergency Action Plan and able to fully implement the Plan’s provisions.
  5. Public Relations – Maintains a friendly and visible presence in the building. Get to know names of guests & members. Assists guests, members and the general public in gaining the information they desire related to the YMCA’s facilities, programs and services. Becomes and remains knowledgeable of the YMCA’s programs, practices and policies. Resolves complaints. Strives to maintain an orderly and pleasant building atmosphere for the benefit of guests and members and the YMCA’s organizational image.
  6. Building Tours – Provide scheduled or upon demand guided tours of the YMCA to groups or individuals.
  7. Personnel – Insures that employees are present, alert and performing their duties in the expected manner.
  8. Program Support – Coordinates and assists in room rental and program equipment set-ups. Works to resolve room rental/usage conflicts. Is responsible for crowd control and security during major program events and when large numbers of people are present in the building.
  9. Front Desk – Able to fill in and perform all front desk responsibilities, including but not limited to; answering the phone, taking money from customers, answering customer’s questions, and assisting with laundering of towels.
  10. Inspections - Performs daily and periodic inspections of the building and updates Building Supervisor Checklist at the end of each shift. Makes contact with all departmental employees during shift. Make sure the building is cleared and properly locked before leaving. Completes required written reports. (SEE CHECKLIST)
  11. Other Duties – Performs other duties, as assigned by the Senior Program Director.

London, United Kingdom - Deliveroo

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drive everything we do. Our Global Safety and Security team protects our people, property, operations, and reputation across more than 40 countries.

We're looking for a Protective Services Agent to join our team. This is an office-based role in London, with up to 25% travel, mainly across the UK and Western Europe. You'll deliver protective operations for the people we protect in the UK and our international markets, working to established standards with direction from the Senior Protective Services Agent and the Protective Services Manager.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll join the Protective Services function within Global Safety and Security, running daily movements in London and supporting advances and international operations as part of the detail. Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Run protective movements, independently in London and as a member of the detail on advances and international trips, from planning through to recovery.
  • Put intelligence to work by taking Protective Intelligence briefings into every movement, applying the changes they call for, and escalating new information quickly.
  • Support risk and vulnerability assessments with site surveys, photos, and field notes for residences, venues, and travel programmes.
  • Work with our in-country network of vetted security providers, drivers, venues, and local partners, and report performance issues.
  • Support crisis response, carrying out emergency action plans, taking part in drills, and capturing lessons in after-action reports.
  • Earn trust and keep friction low by building relationships with the people we protect and their teams, so protection is something they rely on rather than tolerate.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Two to four years in protective, security, military, police, or other high-trust service operations, ideally including protective movements.
  • Sound judgement when the plan changes, with the discipline to follow procedure and the sense to know when to adapt or escalate.
  • Reliable delivery and discretion, with clear handovers, follow-through without chasing, and absolute care with sensitive information.
  • Coachability, taking direction and correction in the field and turning feedback into better performance.
  • A current SIA Close Protection licence, first-aid certificate (FREC 3 or equivalent), and full UK driving licence with a clean record. Existing right to work in the UK is required; we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.
  • Availability to travel up to 25% of the time, sometimes at short notice, and to work extended and after-hours during active operations.

Nice to Have

  • International operations experience, hostile environment awareness training (HEAT), and medical evacuation familiarity.
  • Working knowledge of surveillance, access control, alarm monitoring, and residential security technology.
  • A degree or equivalent professional experience.

What the Work Involves

This role is active and operational. It includes extended time on your feet and in vehicles, carrying equipment, driving in busy or poor conditions, working outdoors in varied weather, and irregular hours including nights, weekends, and travel across time zones. We are happy to discuss reasonable adjustments with any candidate at any stage of the process.

description:

As a Senior Technical Support Engineer for our Platinum Support team, you will provide advanced, post-sales technical solutions to our most valued customers. This role requires addressing complex issues where in-depth evaluation of multiple factors is essential. You will be a critical thinker, adept at using sophisticated methods and techniques to achieve results, and skilled at communicating intricate technical details to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide advanced post-sales technical support, including configuration and troubleshooting, to Platinum customers via phone, email, and web.
  • Meet or exceed enhanced response time SLAs for mission-critical systems covered under the Platinum Support offering.
  • Manage and own customer support cases from initial report to final resolution, ensuring timely follow-ups and comprehensive documentation.
  • Apply expert fault isolation and root cause analysis methodologies to diagnose and resolve complex technical challenges in customer environments.
  • Systematically reproduce customer issues and collaborate directly with Engineering and ETAC teams to qualify and resolve critical product bugs.
  • Conduct multi-vendor troubleshooting to resolve issues in complex, integrated network and security environments.
  • Author and publish Technical Support Bulletins and other technical documentation to the company's knowledge base.
  • Proactively collaborate with Development, Sales, and Quality Assurance teams to enhance the customer experience and improve product documentation.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications


  • 9+ years of experience in a technical support or systems engineering role, with at least 4 years focused on SASE or Cloud Security.
  • Deep hands-on experience with SASE platforms, specifically Prisma Access (Mobile User & Retail/Remote Office).
  • Mastery of networking protocols including TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, and IPsec VPNs.
  • Strong understanding of security concepts such as NGFW, ZTNA, SWG, and CASB.
  • Proficiency in network and API troubleshooting tools (e.g., Wireshark, MTR, Curl).

AI & Automation Familiarity: Experience or a strong interest in leveraging AI utilities and workflow automation platforms (such as coding assistants, low-code integration tools, or orchestration systems) to build helper scripts, streamline diagnostics, or automate repetitive support tasks.

Future-Ready Mindset: A basic conceptual understanding of AI workflows (such as LLMs or automated task flows) with an interest in identifying how these technologies can be applied to optimize customer communication or accelerate knowledge sharing (like automated KB drafting)


Preferred Qualifications


  • Palo Alto Networks certifications (PCNSA, PCNSE, or PCSAE).

  • Experience with identity provider integrations (e.g., SAML 2.0, Okta, Azure AD).
  • Basic scripting skills in Python or PowerShell to automate repetitive diagnostic tasks.

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Casualty Evaluator - Remote

Handles claims in multiple states including licensed states and statutory states (OK license required). Handles Homeowner liability low complexity property damage claims.   • Adjuster to manage productivity by seeking claim assignments through designated queues in the claim system.
