title: Identity Management Engineer
description:
Company Description

About Grab and Our Workplace

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

Job Description

Get to Know the Team

Grabber Technology Solutions (GTS) aims to be a technology leader that provides predictive and seamless experiences to all Grab employees (Grabbers). We are a diverse team of technology practitioners looking to out-serve Grabbers with positive, personalised IT experiences. We are looking for individuals with similar customer-centric and innovative values to join our growing team

The Identity Management team is responsible for managing identities and privileged access across Grab's enterprise infrastructure. The team maintains core identity and access solutions, helping to secure Grab's privileged access landscape.

Get to Know the Role

In this position, you'll be supporting Grab's enterprise infrastructure with an emphasis on Identity and Privileged Access Management. The Identity Management team at Grab is committed to overseeing access to Grab's enterprise applications and safeguarding access to vital systems and sensitive data. Our mission is “Empowering Grabbers with secure, seamless access to systems and data; simplifying productivity and creating time for what matters”.

Our responsibilities include ongoing monitoring, auditing, and regular reviews to uphold a robust access control environment. A mindset geared towards optimisation and automation is essential, along with the ability to work independently and foster relationships with stakeholders throughout Grab. If you believe you have what it takes, we'd love to hear from you!

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

Privileged Access Management & Engineering

  • Implement and operate CyberArk solutions including Privilege Cloud, Secure Web Sessions (SWS), Remote Access, Conjur and Secure Cloud Access.
  • Configure safes, platforms, credential rotation, session monitoring and access workflows to enforce least privilege and secure privileged access.
  • Onboard applications, infrastructure and cloud environments into CyberArk, ensuring alignment with PAM standards.

Integration, Automation & Governance

  • Develop automation - scripts or integrations to improve onboarding, credential management and overall PAM efficiency.
  • Support audits and compliance by providing access evidence, logs and ensuring controls are operating effectively.
  • Proactively identify gaps in privileged access coverage and drive improvements across the environment.
  • Identity Operations
    • Manage incidents and service requests related to Identity services, ensuring timely resolution and minimal disruption to operations.
    • Configure, support, and maintain the CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform, ensuring stability, performance, and security.
    • Provision and deprovision privileged access in accordance with the principles of least privilege, segregation of identities, and separation of duties.
    • Drive periodic access reviews for privileged accounts within CyberArk, ensuring ongoing compliance and appropriate access levels.
    • Develop custom plugins and integrations within CyberArk to extend functionality and enable interoperability with other enterprise systems and platforms.
    • Support audits and forensic investigations by supplying compliance evidence, access logs, and other relevant data.
    • Manage and monitor ticket queues, develop and track KPIs/KRIs to provide insights, and identify opportunities for operational improvements.
    • Develop and maintain documentation, including best practices, technical guides, and standard operating procedures.
Qualifications

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • 4–6 years of strong hands-on experience in Identity & Access Management (IAM/PAM), with a primary focus on Privileged Access Management.
  • Proven, deep hands-on experience with CyberArk (not just familiarity or exposure), including:
    • Privilege Cloud
    • Secure Web Sessions (SWS)
    • Remote Access
    • Conjur (Secrets Management)
    • Experience configuring safes, platforms, policies, credential rotation and session monitoring
    • Use of CyberArk APIs for plugins, automations and integrations.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing, onboarding and operating CyberArk across applications, infrastructure and cloud environments.
  • Hands-on experience with a leading Identity platform such as JumpCloud (preferred), Okta, Azure AD or similar.
  • Strong understanding of PAM principles (least privilege, just-in-time access, credential vaulting, session monitoring, segregation of duties).
  • Solid foundation in IAM concepts including identity lifecycle management, authentication, authorisation, SSO and access governance.
  • Experience working with security, risk and compliance teams, including supporting audits and interactions with auditors.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to automate and troubleshoot using scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell or similar).
  • Experience contributing to IAM/PAM implementations or transformation initiatives, from design through execution.
  • Strong ownership mindset — proactive, self-driven, and willing to take responsibility end-to-end.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working with globally distributed, cross-functional teams, and the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
Additional Information

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

  • We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
  • Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
  • We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
  • Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For At Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

The Facility Maintenance Technician is responsible for maintaining and repairing building systems, equipment, and facilities to ensure a safe, efficient, and productive work environment. This position performs preventive maintenance, responds to repair requests, and supports facility operations across our manufacturing, warehouse, and office spaces. The ideal candidate is a skilled tradesperson with broad maintenance experience who can work independently and as part of a team to keep our facilities operating at peak performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on building systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, mechanical equipment, conveyor systems, and dock equipment
  • Maintain building infrastructure including doors, windows, walls, floors, ceilings, roofing, lighting systems, electrical panels, and power distribution equipment
  • Service critical building systems including boilers, cooling systems, compressed air systems, fire protection systems (sprinklers, alarms), and overhead doors/dock levelers
  • Conduct plumbing and HVAC repairs including pipes, fixtures, drains, water systems, air handlers, ductwork, thermostats, and climate controls
  • Execute preventive maintenance program following scheduled tasks, inspecting equipment to identify potential failures, lubricating machinery, changing filters, and tracking performance in CMMS
  • Ensure safety and regulatory compliance by conducting regular inspections, following OSHA standards and building codes, maintaining lockout/tagout procedures, and identifying/correcting safety hazards
  • Maintain accurate documentation of all maintenance activities, repairs, inspections, and work orders; coordinate with contractors and vendors for specialized repairs
  • Perform exterior and grounds maintenance including parking lots, sidewalks, snow removal, exterior lighting, drainage management, and perimeter security features
  • Monitor energy efficiency by identifying improvement opportunities, adjusting building systems for optimal performance, and replacing inefficient equipment
  • Respond to emergency maintenance requests promptly, participate in on-call rotation for after-hours emergencies, and provide backup support to other maintenance staff

Qualifications

Required

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • 3+ years of experience in facility maintenance, building maintenance, or industrial maintenance
  • Strong knowledge of electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and mechanical systems
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, schematics, and technical manuals
  • Proficiency with hand tools, power tools, and diagnostic equipment
  • Valid driver's license required
  • Ability to lift heavy objects (up to 75 lbs) and work at heights using ladders and lifts
  • Strong problem-solving skills and mechanical aptitude
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Preferred

  • Technical school training or apprenticeship in electrical, HVAC, or industrial maintenance
  • EPA certification for HVAC refrigerant handling
  • Forklift and aerial lift certification
  • Welding certification or demonstrated welding skills
  • Experience with computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS)
  • Boiler operator license
  • OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification

title: Vault Infrastructure Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Vault Infrastructure Engineer to develop institutional-grade Web3 vault asset management infrastructure. The project will use smart contract-based pooled vaults and multi-party computation (MPC) custody technology to automate yield generation, tokenized asset pooling, and treasury security. It is a new 3-year R&D project, funded under the Innovation and Technology Fund (ITF) Research Talent Hub (RTH-SPC).

Key Responsibilities

  • Research vault architectures for pooled asset management and related yield-generation strategies.
  • Design smart contracts for vault share issuance, deposits and redemptions, rebalancing, fee mechanics, and strategy allocation.
  • Develop APIs to integrate vault workflows with custody, accounting, and reporting systems.
  • Implement MPC-based treasury infrastructure: threshold-signature signing, quorum policies, address whitelists, withdrawal limits, and transaction-monitoring mechanisms.
  • Build prototypes and test cases covering depeg events, oracle failures, emergency withdrawals, circuit breakers, and exceptions.
  • Evaluate alternative blockchain architectures, vault standards (e.g., ERC-4626), and settlement mechanisms.
  • Document research findings, technical specifications, risks, limitations, and test results.
  • Present prototypes and findings to management and business stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Financial Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Understanding of blockchain, digital assets, distributed ledger technology, and smart contracts.
  • Programming experience in Solidity, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Rust, or Go.
  • Knowledge of token and vault standards, APIs, wallet integration, and smart-contract security.
  • Exposure to MPC/threshold-signature custody or institutional wallet infrastructure is an advantage.
  • Experience in DeFi, asset management, treasury operations, or financial services is an advantage.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
  • Hong Kong permanent resident or holder of a valid visa permitting full-time employment in Hong Kong.

Engagement Terms

Position: Vault Infrastructure Engineer
Salary: HK$20,000 – 25,000 per month
Work Mode: Full-time

How to Apply

Please send your CV and a short cover letter to rex.tsang@finbot.hk with the subject line "Application — Vault Infrastructure Engineer".

title: Young Professional Program - Dynamics 365 Supply Chain (Dutch Required)
description:
Afgestudeerd? What’s next? Stap in bij het HSO Young Professional Program! Kickstart je IT-carrière ! Klaar voor de reis? Join the journey to explore!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Young Professional (Trainee Consultant) start je reis met de Masterclass van 6 weken, een intensief trainingsprogramma. We garanderen je dat deze weken een ijzersterke start zijn van jouw carrière in IT Consulting. Naast de hard skills, zetten wij ons ook volledig in op de soft skills. Zo leer je alles over de Microsoft Technologie, hoe je dit optimaal inzet bij de klant én hoe je dit met overtuigingskracht presenteert. Dit is pas het begin! Je krijgt ook inzicht in onze HSO-projectmethodologie en je sluit af met een volledige Microsoft-certificering.

En hoe dan verder?

Na de ‘Masterclass’ ga je meteen door! Als Young Professional werk je in een innovatieve, internationale omgeving. HSO is uitgegroeid tot één van de leading Microsoft-partners wereldwijd. En hier speel jij een sleutelrol in!

Je wordt onderdeel van een ervaren projectteam, bij toonaangevende klanten. Je wordt betrokken bij diverse fases van het project, zoals het digitaliseren en automatiseren van processen. Je adviseert hen over Microsoft-based applicaties (Dynamics 365 ERP) en helpt hen daarna om deze daadwerkelijk te implementeren. Je houdt ervan om processen in kaart te brengen en zoekt naar mogelijkheden om deze te optimaliseren. Daarom start je aan het begin van het project met het achterhalen van de behoeften en verwachtingen van de klant. Je bouwt aan de relatie met de klant en investeert in verwachtingsmanagement. Op basis van de opgehaalde informatie zorg jij voor een passend advies en implementeert de software die de optimalisatie ondersteunt.

Maar, ondanks dat je zelfstandig veel bereikt, hoef je dit niet alleen te doen. Een Senior Consultant is zowel je buddy als je mentor die je volledig ondersteunt, terwijl je je carrière ontwikkelt van Trainee Consultant tot Medior en Lead Consultant. Door intensieve training en begeleiding leer je alle ins en outs van het consultancyvak. Na jaar één ben je een volwaardige Junior Consultant. We vinden het belangrijk dat je groeit als Consultant, maar ook als mens. Daarom krijg je alle tools en begeleiding om het beste uit jezelf én je werk te halen!

HSO werkt onder andere voor mooie merken als: Rituals, Royal BAM, Heineken en Intergamma. Je krijgt de kans om bij veel verschillende bedrijven, branche-en mensenkennis te doen, op verschillende organisatieniveaus mee te denken en te adviseren. Je kunt trainingen volgen via de HSO Academy. Jij komt met een plan en je manager helpt je bij de uitvoering daarvan.

Wat zoeken we?

  • Een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding, bij voorkeur in de richting van bedrijfseconomie, engineering, (technische) bedrijfskunde, ICT, bedrijfskundige informatica of een vergelijkbare studie;
  • Analytisch sterk en communicatief vaardig;
  • Affiniteit met IT en technologie;
  • Ambitieuze en onbedwingbare nieuwsgierige houding;
  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal;
  • Beschikbaar vanaf maart? Top, dan begint het Young Professional Program!

Wat bieden we?

  • Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, dus daar zetten we graag een goede beloning tegenover (2895 – 3061 euro brutoloon, excl. 8% vakantiegeld);
  • De basis is geregeld. Leaseauto (of mobiliteitsvergoeding van 675 euro), laptop en mobiele telefoon? Zeker weten!
  • Hybride werken, vanuit huis, op kantoor (Rotterdam, Veenendaal) of zelfs tijdens je Workation;
  • Vitaliteitsbudget: € 65,- netto, dit kun je inzetten voor je sportabonnement of voor een goede thuiswerkplek. We vinden het belangrijk dat jij fit en gezond blijft. Op kantoor of remote;
  • Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan;
  • Vakantie: 25 vakantiedagen. Wil je meer vrije tijd? Koop tot 10 dagen bij. Natuurlijk behoort een Workation tot de mogelijkheden;
  • Pensioen van BeFrank;
  • En vooral een leven lang leren. Op dag één start jouw onboardingsprogramma en daarna heeft onze HSO-Academy een leerreis voor je gedefinieerd;
  • Je ontvangt ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Vrijheid, flexibiliteit en fun

Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met professionals met verschillende nationaliteiten. HSO heeft professionals in dienst die plezier hebben in hun werk en klaar staan voor elkaar. Om het plezier in ons werk nog groter te maken, organiseren we uiteraard teamuitjes en bedrijfsfeesten, maar ook wekelijkse zomerborrels op ons dakterras, allerlei sportactiviteiten en is er de mogelijkheid bij te dragen aan onze Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen-werkzaamheden.

Ben jij klaar voor de reis of heb je nog vragen?

Neem contact op met Sheling Goh via sgoh@hso.com.

title: Counter Fraud Specialist
description:
This is a great opportunity to work in the Sopra Steria (SSL) Counter Fraud Service (CFS), specifically within Sopra Steria Financial Services Limited (SSFSL), to provide a service to all SSFSL business areas, external clients and stakeholders.

The SSFSL Counter Fraud Specialist supports the Head of Counter Fraud in delivery of the Counter Fraud strategy. The individual will respond to the challenge of developing and implementing new ways of working as well as maintaining existing processes across the business to ensure SSFSL protect its financial assets and those of its clients.

The SSFSL Counter Fraud Specialist is responsible for ensuring that SSFSL delivers an effective Counter Fraud programme, including conducting investigations, providing a robust fraud prevention approach across the whole business and developing and delivering a programme of Fraud Risk Assessments.


This is a hybrid variable role requiring limited presence in either our Blackpool, Durham, Newcastle, Glasgow or London offices.

What you will be doing:

  • Manage the investigation of any reported suspected incidents of Fraud, maintaining an accurate, comprehensive, factual record of the actions taken at each stage of the investigation and conclusions reached.
  • Working with business unit’s specific customer fraud teams as required, providing advice and guidance.
  • Being a main point of contact for advice and guidance relating to Fraud and associated areas such as Money Laundering and Bribery & Corruption.
  • Implementing Government Counter Fraud standards (GovS 013).
  • Delivery and maintenance of Fraud prevention frameworks in line with the pillars from the Economic Crime & Corporate Transparency Act guidance notes.
  • Work with SSFSL business areas to facilitate and maintain Fraud Risk Assessments (FRA).
  • Identification and management of Fraud related risks, ensuring that the appropriate controls are being managed to mitigate the risks.
  • Support 1st and 2nd line activities relating to fraud. Identify areas where a pro-active approach, to identify potential Fraud, can be undertaken, and deliver this work.
  • Review and maintain all relevant SSFSL and SSL Fraud, Whistleblowing and other relevant policies and procedures.

What you’ll bring:

  • Experience of conducting a Fraud Investigation and of delivering and reviewing Fraud Risk Assessments
  • Ideally knowledge of financial services within a Financial Conducted Authority regulated sector, if not then experience of working withing a regulated industry.
  • Experience of evidence gathering, including maintaining chain of custody and integrity of information evidence and intelligence.
  • Experience of conducting interviews with witnesses, third parties and those suspected of being involved in Fraud or other financial crime.
  • Understanding of the three lines of defence model including separation of duties.
  • Knowledge of GovS 013 standards and the Home Office guidance requirements under the Economic Crime & Corporate Transparency Act.
  • Excellent communication skills – both verbal and written – including writing of detailed reports explaining findings.

If you are interested in this role but not sure if your skills and experience are exactly what we’re looking for, please do apply, we’d love to hear from you!


Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
Location: Hybrid variable role requiring limited presence in either our Blackpool, Durham, Newcastle, Glasgow or London offices.
Security Clearance Level: DV
Internal Recruiter: Adrian
Salary: Up to circa £45k depending on experience
Benefits: 25 days annual leave with the option to buy additional days, life assurance, pension and health cash plan scheme

Although this role is advertised as full-time, we believe that flexibility at work can promote work/life balance, increase your motivation, reduce stress and improves performance and productivity. We support different ways of working and can offer a range of flexible working arrangements. So, if you’re interested and need to work flexibly, we encourage you to apply and talk to us about what might be possible.

Loved reading about this job and want to know more about us?

We are a purpose driven digital transformation provider, creating innovative digital solutions to help clients drive their digital transformation projects and secure tangible and sustainable benefits. We harness the power of innovation to drive positive change in both business and society, delivering sustainable growth and services which make life better, from effective frontline citizen services, to digitising financial services, utilities, and delivering smarter roads.

We place people at the heart of everything we do and are committed to working with our customers, partners and suppliers to shape a better world and add real and lasting social value to the communities in which we work.

Together we are building a better future by delivering real and lasting value.

We are just at the start of what we can achieve together. Come and join us!

The personal information we have collected from you will be shared with Cifas who will use it to prevent fraud, other unlawful or dishonest conduct, malpractice, and other seriously improper conduct. If any of these are detected, you could be refused certain services or employment. Your personal information will also be used to verify your identity. Further details of how your information will be used by us and Cifas, and your data protection rights, can be found by [https://www.cifas.org.uk/fpn].

title: Tech Lead, Asic Design
description:
Astera Labs (NASDAQ: ALAB) provides rack-scale AI infrastructure through purpose-built connectivity solutions. The company’s custom connectivity solutions business complements its standards-based portfolio, enabling customers to deploy tailored architectures to meet their unique infrastructure requirements. Discover more at .

Astera Labs is hiring a Tech Lead Design Engineer to help architect and deliver the connectivity silicon powering the world's largest AI clusters. You'll own design execution on complex blocks across our purpose-built products, working at the cutting edge of PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, and emerging rack-scale interconnect technologies.

This is a high-impact technical role at a hyper-growth company. You'll partner closely with architecture, verification, DFT, and physical design teams to take features from spec to silicon, while contributing to the design methodology that scales with our roadmap. If you want to ship silicon that defines AI infrastructure, this is the team.

    • Own RTL design for assigned blocks from microarchitecture through synthesis sign-off
    • Develop high-quality, synthesizable Verilog/SystemVerilog with strong attention to PPA

    • Drive structured, data-driven design decisions in support of aggressive tapeout schedules

Basic Qualifications

  • Strong proficiency in Verilog/SystemVerilog, RTL coding, and synthesis flows

Preferred Qualifications

  • MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering
  • Experience with PCIe Gen5/Gen6, CXL, UALink, UCIe, or Ethernet MAC/PCS designs
  • Familiarity with formal verification, emulation, or assertion-based methodologies
  • Background in advanced process nodes (7nm, 5nm, or below)
  • Strong debug skills across pre-silicon and post-silicon environments

title: HIS - Professional Coding Integrity Auditor & Educator - 40 hrs/wk
description:
PURPOSE OF THIS POSITION

The primary purpose of the HIS Professional Coding Integrity Auditor & Educator is to support the integrity of the coding integrity program which is a key driver of accurate reimbursement, quality scores, benchmark data and statistical reporting. The primary scope of responsibility includes claims derived from the HIS coding y team; however, may provide support in an advisory capacity to other divisions within BVHS, as appropriate. Implements educational opportunities in relation to current and upcoming coding guidelines and practices. Collaborates with HIS Coding Auditor and Educator as well as leadership to ensure consistency within the HIS coding program, as applicable.

JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Duty 1: Participates along with coding leadership to develop and maintain coding-related policies and procedures to promote compliant and consistent coding practices, inclusive of ICD/DRG, ROM/SOI/APR-DRG, CPT/APC code assignments which are reflective and supported by clinical documentation. Collaborates with Coding Integrity Auditor and Educator and coding leadership to ensure consistency between facility and professional coding policies and procedures, as applicable. Monitors and implements educational guidance in anticipation of changing organizational needs (e.g. implement a new service line) and/or in response to revised regulatory requirements (e.g. IPPS and OPPS annual updates, CPT Assistant, Coding Clinic, etc.). Ensures appropriate dissemination of information and education to ensure coding team and/or any other pertinent individuals or departments remain current on coding policies and procedures.
  • Duty 2: Regularly performs or coordinates the completion of coding quality reviews for accounts submitted by the HIS professional coding team. Documents results, analyze data, identify issues and report findings to leadership of impacted areas. Provides education in a peer-to-peer environment on audit findings and areas of opportunity to the Coding Integrity associate(s). The Professional Coding Integrity Auditor & Educator helps facilitate ongoing follow-up auditing and education as a result of action plans.
  • Duty 3: Assists in identifying clinical documentation opportunities that may impact the diagnosis and or CPT code assignments, including query appropriateness or opportunity. Provides feedback to Clinical Documentation Integrity (CDIS) Specialist or clinical area, as appropriate.
  • Duty 4: Partners with Revenue Integrity, Patient Financial Services (PFS), and other areas, as appropriate, to conduct internal audits, as needed, of claims to ensure the accuracy and completeness of code capture (reconcile “hard” and “soft” coding); which is supported by clinical documentation.
  • Duty 5: Reviews and responds to third party payer audits related to code assignments. Resolves identified issues; documents relevant decisions related to coding practice in policies or procedures to promote ongoing standardization and consistency. Provides feedback to the coding team of identified coding opportunities through third party payer audits.
  • Duty 6: Provides support and guidance to Corporate Compliance Department in audits or initiatives related to professional coding. This may include participating in coding audits in response to an investigation or potential compliance risk, conducting coding research, offering advisory guidance to other BVHS entities, or interacting with third party consultants conducting a compliance review.
  • Duty 7: Lends support to other departments, such as Quality, PMO, Case Management, or other organizational initiatives or projects where the coded data is a key driver in outcomes, benchmarking, or evaluation of the data being reported or utilized. Serves as a member on committees, task force or projects as the coding representative, as necessary.
  • Duty 8: Develops and provides education to HIS Professional Coding Integrity Specialists other departments/associates, as necessary and medical staff (in collaboration with the CDI Specialists, Coding Integrity Auditor and Educator, as appropriate) regarding general coding education, regulatory updates, etc. Tracks attendance and demonstrates competency of the participants of the course content.
  • Duty 9: Participates in regular and active coding of various work types and works coding related edits, as time permits, to support the HIS coding team as needed.
  • Duty 10: Performs second-level reviews prior to final coding when prompted by HIS Professional Coding Integrity Specialists, and acts as an organizational resource for coding-related questions. Utilize internal and external credible resources to investigate complex coding issues (e.g. conflicting coding guidelines, differing interpretation of guidelines, etc.) to provide guidance or recommendations to leadership to establish compliant coding practices.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • College degree in a related field including, but not limited to health information management, a clinical profession, or 5+ years of experience from which comparable knowledge and abilities have been acquired.
  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC) or Certified Coding Specialist – Physician Based (CCS-P) certification
  • 5+ professional coding (hospital-based and non-hospital based clinic) experience (ICD and CPT)
  • Proficient knowledge of professional charge and reimbursement methodologies
  • General understanding of revenue cycle and reimbursement methodologies
  • Proficient knowledge of regulatory requirements and compliance required; proficiency in researching coding issues (e.g. Coding Clinic, CPT Assistant, CMS website, etc.) required.
  • Ability to provide education individually or to a group in a clear, concise and effective manner
  • Must possess positive service-oriented and interpersonal skills; strong communication, including written and verbal presentation skills
  • Ability to compile, analyze and effectively present data and complex information in an informative and meaningful way to a variety of audiences, including leadership.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks/projects. Excellent organizational, time management and prioritization skills required. Self-directed.
  • Proven competence in utilization of computer applications, including Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and health-care related applications, including an Encoder

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Certified Professional Medical Auditor (CPMA) certification
  • RHIA, RHIT certification
  • Facility coding experience
  • Facility and/or professional billing knowledge
  • Previous auditing experience
  • Experience providing education in a peer-to-peer environment

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

This position requires a full range of body motion with intermittent activities in sitting, walking, lifting, bending, squatting, climbing, kneeling, twisting and standing. The associate must be able to lift 50 pounds or more and reach work above the shoulders. The individual must have excellent eye/hand coordination with the ability to grasp, push and pull, fine finger dexterity and manipulation. This position requires corrected vision and hearing in the normal range. The associate must have excellent verbal skills to communicate with patients, physicians, and co-workers.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer – Fullstack AI (Data Focus)

Location: Pune (M.H)

Experience: 4+ years in software engineering, including 1+ year building data-intensive or LLM-powered systems in production

About the role

You'll build the data and retrieval foundation that makes Clearwater's AI agents accurate, grounded, and measurable. This is a hands-on software engineering role, not a research role: you'll write production pipelines and services, build retrieval and evaluation systems, and ship the product surfaces that expose them. You'll work across security and threat data at scale.

What you'll do

  • Build and operate data pipelines (batch and streaming) that ingest, normalize, and enrich large volumes of security and telemetry data
  • Design retrieval systems for agents: chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, vector and graph stores, and freshness and access control
  • Build evaluation harnesses and datasets to measure agent and retrieval quality, regressions, and cost
  • Build backend APIs and services in Python, and the full-stack features that surface data and AI insights to users
  • Design data models and manage relational, analytical, and vector stores for performance and cost
  • Add data quality checks, lineage, observability, and governance, including PII and sensitive-data handling
  • Use AI agents to automate data engineering work such as pipeline generation, data validation, and documentation
  • Containerize and deploy on Kubernetes and cloud with CI/CD, and mentor engineers on data and AI practices

Must have

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering with strong data-engineering exposure and sound testing and CI/CD practice
  • 1+ year building production systems involving LLMs, retrieval (RAG), or large-scale data pipelines
  • Strong Python and SQL, including query optimization and data modeling
  • Hands-on with pipeline or stream-processing tooling such as Airflow, Dagster, Spark, or Kafka, or an equivalent
  • Experience with vector stores and retrieval design (pgvector, OpenSearch, or similar), and with evaluating retrieval quality
  • Docker, working Kubernetes knowledge, and experience on AWS, Azure, or GCP

Nice to have

  • Working JavaScript/TypeScript, enough to build and ship full-stack features
  • Experience with security, threat intelligence, or SIEM/telemetry data
  • Healthcare or compliance-driven data experience (HIPAA, SOC 2, HITRUST)
  • Knowledge graphs or graph databases
  • LLMOps and evaluation tooling experience
  • Experience with a lakehouse or warehouse such as Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery
  • Open-source contributions or public data or retrieval projects

First 12 months

  • Ship production pipelines and retrieval services with clear quality and reliability targets
  • Deliver a retrieval and evaluation framework that measurably improves agent accuracy
  • Establish the team's patterns for data quality, grounding, and sensitive-data handling

Why join

You'll have high ownership at an early-stage engineering site, direct exposure to leadership, and the chance to build the data foundation behind AI-driven security products that protect healthcare organizations.

description:

Full rental fees, peak-time availability and contract terms will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Ready to help our members develop their game while growing your own coaching business? We’d love to hear from you.

title: IT Business Analyst
description:
Job Summary

The IT Business Analyst role involves understanding, analyzing, and documenting business requirements, translating them into functional specifications for IT development teams, and supporting the project throughout the entire lifecycle. The IT Business Analyst will work closely with stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.

Job Responsibilities

Requirements Analysis & Documentation

  • Conduct workshops, interviews, and document analysis to gather and analyze business requirements from stakeholders across different departments. Translate these requirements into clear, concise, and testable user stories, use cases, and functional specifications.

  • Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation, including business requirements documents (BRD), functional specifications documents (FSD), process flow diagrams, user manuals, and training materials.

Business Process Mapping & Improvement

  • Document As‑Is and design To‑Be workflows, identifying gaps and improvement opportunities.

  • Ensure process designs comply with governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Project Delivery & Solution Support

  • Collaborate with PMs, architects, developers, QA, and vendors to ensure accurate interpretation of requirements.

  • Participate in project planning, deliverables refinement, and solution design discussions.

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Develop test cases, scripts and acceptance criteria for functional and user acceptance testing.

  • Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT), ensuring that the delivered solution meets the business requirements.

  • Validate defects, ensure resolution, and confirm solutions meet business expectations.

Change Management & User Enablement

  • Prepare user guides, training materials, and communication plans for system rollouts.

  • Conduct user training and support adoption activities during and after implementation.

  • Effectively communicate and collaborate with diverse stakeholders, including business users, IT teams, vendors, and management, to ensure alignment on project goals and requirements. Manage stakeholder expectations and address any concerns.

Job Qualifcations

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Management, Industrial Engineering or related field.

  • Certifications such as CBAP, CCBA, Agile BA, ITIL, or Scrum Master are an advantage.

  • 3–5 years experience as a Business Analyst in IT or technology‑driven environments.

  • Proficiency in requirements elicitation techniques (e.g. interviews, workshops, document analysis)

  • Experience in creating and maintain project documentation (e.g. BRD, FSD, use cases)

  • Requirements engineering and documentation (BRD, FSD, user stories, use cases).

  • Business process modeling using tools such as Visio, Draw.io, or BPMN‑based platforms.

  • Familiarity with SDLC, Agile/Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies.

  • Basic understanding of system architecture, APIs, databases, and integrations.

  • Proficiency in data analysis, reporting, and visualization (Excel, Power BI, SQL basics).

  • Experience with UAT planning, test case creation, and defect management tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, etc.).

  • Knowledge of IT governance, security, and compliance principles (ISO 27001, ITIL, NIST preferred).

description:
Job Description

Plastmager Til KOM Change Over – Daghold

Vil du være en del af en succesfuld virksomhed, hvor du er med til at forsyne vores kunder med LEGO® produkter og arbejde i en afdeling, der vægter sammenhold, kvalitet og sikkerhed højt.


Du er med til at sikre god kvalitet af omstillinger.

Som medarbejder i Change Over er du med til at sikre den rigtige omstilling af høj kvalitet.


Dine primære opgaver er at lave omstillinger i den rigtige kvalitet.


Specifikke kompetence behov

  • Du er plastmager uddannet.
  • Du er god til at have mange bolde i luften
  • Du kan bruge en pc
  • Du er indstillet på at lære de opgaver, rutiner og spilleregler, der er i afdelingen
  • Du er god til at samarbejde, og udviser fleksibilitet og forandringsvilje
  • Du har stor fokus på kvalitet
  • Du kan arbejde selvstændigt
  • Du er forberedt på at der er gang i den hele dagen

Det gode match

Har du faglig ballast, er kvalitetsbevidst og en teamplayer? Vi er på udkig efter dig, der tager et ansvar og yder en fleksibel indsats i et miljø, hvor sammenhold og sikkerhed betyder alt. Du har et godt overblik, er hjælpsom og du er i stand til at håndtere forskellige opgaver uden at gå på kompromis med sikkerheden og kvaliteten.

Ansøg & kontakt

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Senior manager Henrik Jespersen på telefon nr. 29228679

For at søge stillingen skal du klikke på APPLY/ANSØG knappen foroven. Husk at vedhæfte dine dokumenter.

Bliv en del af det globale LEGO® team

Hvad får du ud af det? Her er noget af dét, du kan forvente:

• Familieplejeorlov - Vi tilbyder betalte orlovsmuligheder i de vigtige tider.

• Forsikringer – Alle kolleger er dækket af vores livs- og invalideforsikring, som giver beskyttelse og ro i sindet.

• Kollegarabat – Vi ved, at du vil elske at bygge, så du bliver en del af vores generøse kollegarabat.

• Bonus – Vi gør vores bedste for at få succes sammen. Når målene er nået, vil du blive belønnet gennem vores globale bonusordning.

Børn er vores rollemodeller. Deres nysgerrighed, kreativitet og fantasi inspirerer alt, hvad vi gør. Vi stræber efter at skabe en mangfoldig, dynamisk og inkluderende legekultur i LEGO Koncernen, hvor alle føler sig trygge, værdsatte og at de hører til.


LEGO Koncernen er stolt af at være en arbejdsgiver med lige muligheder. Vi er forpligtet til lige beskæftigelsesmuligheder og lige løn uanset f.eks. race, farve, religion, køn, national oprindelse, seksuel orientering, handicap eller kønsidentitet.


LEGO Koncernen er fuldt engageret i børns rettigheder og børns trivsel over hele kloden. Kandidater, der tilbydes stillinger med højt engagement med børn, skal deltage i Child Safeguarding Background Screening som en betingelse for tilbuddet. Tak, fordi du deler vores globale engagement i børns rettigheder.


Byg din karriere klods for klods i LEGO Koncernen.


Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.



What’s in it for you?


Here is what you can expect:


Family Care Leave - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.


Insurances – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.


Wellbeing - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.


Colleague Discount – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.


Bonus - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.


Your workplace: Your workplace will be the office, store or factory specified in this advert.


Hybrid Working: Our hybrid work model, Best of Both offers you the option of flexibility to work from home up to two days per week. Your People Leader will discuss the principles of the model, including how this option applies to your role and team.

Learn more about our benefits, culture and workplace experience here


Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong.


The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team.


The LEGO Group is fully committed to Children’s Rights and Child Wellbeing across the globe. Candidates offered positions with high engagement with children are required to take part in Child Safeguarding Background Screening, as a condition of the offer.


Thank you for sharing our global commitment to Children’s Rights.


Just imagine building your dream career.

Then make it real.

Join the LEGO® team today.

title: Control Room Analyst
description:
With 85 years of experience in the construction and management of natural gas infrastructure, Snam is a leading European operator in three main business areas: transportation, where it ranks first with a network extending for approximately 38,000 km in Italy and abroad;storage, with one-sixth of the entire capacity of the European Union; and regasification, where it is currently the thirdlargest European player, with an annual managed (or co-managed) capacity of 28 billion cubic meters.


One of the leading Italian listed companies by market capitalization, Snam ensures Italy's security of supply through its infrastructure system, enables energy integration between different sources, and promotes decarbonization projects that support competitiveness and development of businesses and communities.


Why should you consider joining us?


🚀 Challenge: Work directly with business managers and key decision-makers.


📈 Growth: Gain the opportunity to develop your career by contributing to challenging projects in a dynamic environment.


🌐 Company Culture: We are a passionate team that has always valued talent and fostered a positive work environment. Would you like to be part of our growth journey?


⚙️ A Growing Industry: The energy sector is constantly evolving, and you will have the opportunity to be at the heart of the dynamics shaping this transformative industry.


Control Room Analyst


Vuoi trasformare le tue passioni in un percorso di sviluppo continuo?

Come Control Room Analyst, sarai una figura chiave nel nostro impegno quotidiano per l’ottimizzazione del servizio di trasporto e stoccaggio del gas. Farai parte della nostra Direzione Dispacciamento & Misura, nello specifico nell'area Controllo Gas e avrai la responsabilità di relazionarti sia con i Line Manager che con le funzioni specialistiche, occupandoti di effettuare il controllo operativo della situazione della rete di metanodotti e dei relativi impianti.

Cosa farai in particolare:

  • Effettuare il controllo sistematico della situazione della rete di metanodotti e dei relativi impianti, tramite i dati forniti dal sistema informatico e/o mantenendosi in contatto con le Unità operative;
  • Effettuare, su indicazione del superiore, le manovre di telecomando al fine di mantenere gli assetti distributivi definiti dalla programmazione e/o dovuti agli interventi sulla rete, in accordo con le Unità operative Territoriali, come intercettazioni, scarichi, alimentazioni di emergenza, rimessa in esercizio di tronchi di condotte ecc.
  • Rispondere alle richieste telefoniche di assistenza, da parte di terzi o delle Unità operative, supportandole nella risoluzione delle problematiche espresse;
  • riportare sul diario di sala tutte le operazioni eseguite;
  • effettuare le attività in turno h24, 7 giorni su 7, assicurando il passaggio di consegne ad ogni cambio turno.

Cosa serve per unirti al nostro team?

  • Problem solving, organizzazione
  • Capacità di lavorare sia in autonomia che in team
  • Flessibilità sul ciclo dei turni e proattività
  • Volontà di mettersi in gioco

Sei tu la persona che stiamo cercando?

Sei una persona fortemente orientata al risultato, efficace sia nel lavoro in team che nella comunicazione a tutti i livelli organizzativi.

Lavori in autonomia sapendo individuare e gestire le priorità con flessibilità, dinamismo e proattività.

Pianifichi le attività e gestisci le scadenze in modo puntuale, grazie a buone doti di organizzazione, pianificazione e problem solving.

Cosa offriamo

CCNL applicato: Energia e Petrolio

Tipologia contrattuale: Apprendistato/Indeterminato

La retribuzione offerta sarà commisurata all’esperienza maturata e alle competenze specifiche.

La Retribuzione Annua Lorda minima per il ruolo è indicativamente pari a €38.500.

In caso di contratto di apprendistato professionalizzante, alla retribuzione sarà applicata la percentualizzazione prevista dal CCNL di riferimento per la specifica tipologia contrattuale.

La posizione è inoltre destinataria di un sistema incentivante annuale, secondo le policy aziendali.

Benefit:

Nel nostro impegno per il benessere dei dipendenti e per favorire l’equilibrio tra lavoro e vita privata, offriamo un pacchetto completo di benefit tra cui:

  • Assicurazione Sanitaria: copertura completa per te e la tua famiglia
  • Previdenza complementare: risparmio pensionistico sostenuto dal datore di lavoro
  • Welfare e Wellbeing: accesso a un ampio programma di iniziative e convenzioni dedicate al benessere, allo sport, alla salute e alla qualità della vita
  • Offerta formativa: sosteniamo la crescita delle persone attraverso programmi di formazione continua e sviluppo professionale
  • Piano di Azionariato Diffuso: opportunità di aderire al piano di azionariato diffuso godendo di tutti i benefici riservati ai dipendenti del Gruppo

In conformità agli obblighi definiti dalla Direttiva UE 2023/970 e dalla normativa nazionale di recepimento, e coerentemente con procedure interne dedicate, Snam non richiede né raccoglie informazioni sulla retribuzione o sull’inquadramento pregressi dei/delle candidati/e: tali informazioni non vengono richieste durante i colloqui, né via e-mail, né tramite società di selezione, head hunter o altri soggetti terzi coinvolti nel processo.


L’azienda si riserva, al termine del processo di selezione, in presenza di esperienza professionale e competenze tecniche e trasversali diverse dal profilo ricercato, di formulare una offerta retributiva differente rispetto a quanto riportato nel presente annuncio, nel rispetto degli obblighi di trasparenze definiti nel decreto rif. D. Lgs 96/26. A tal fine si è dotata di procedure interne volte ad assicurare l’adozione di fattori oggettivi e non discriminatori che possano motivare retribuzioni diverse nell’ambito di una medesima categoria di lavoratori.


Tutti gli annunci di lavoro da noi pubblicati si intendono rivolti ad ambo i sessi, a persone di tutte l’età e nazionalità (ex L.903/77, D.Lgs 215/03 e 216/03 s.m.i.). Informativa sul trattamento dati (GDPR: Reg. UE 2016/679).


Our Culture


At Snam, we believe that diversity is the key to innovation and long-term success. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where every voice is heard, respected and valued.

We actively promote fairness in hiring, professional development and career progression, while fostering a culture of open dialogue, collaboration, and continuous feedback.


We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates, making our hiring decisions based solely on objective criteria and alignment with the requirements of the role.


Candidates whose profiles best match the position will be contacted and invited to participate in the selection process.


If you are ready to take on a new challenge and see yourself reflected in the profile described above, we encourage you to submit your application through the Snam Careers Portal. For further information, please contact carriere@snam.it.

We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. title: Mechanical Systems Engineer - Landing Gear (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

We are looking for a Mechanical Systems Engineer to help us develop and integrate the Landing Gear System of our fully battery-electric aircraft (CS-23). You will take a leading role in defining, integrating and certifying the retractable landing gear system of a clean-sheet battery-electric aircraft, including extension/retraction actuation, wheels & brakes, tires, steering, anti-skid functions and associated indication sub-systems. Your work will span the full system development lifecycle, from system-level requirements, architecture and functional analysis through preliminary and detailed design, supplier involvement, prototype assembly support, ground & flight testing and certification. You will work closely with overall aircraft design, structures, flight physics, avionics, and other engineering teams to ensure optimal system integration and will play a key role in the detailed definition of the overall aircraft.

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Define and derive system-level requirements for the landing gear system based on CONOPS, aircraft-level requirements and applicable regulations.

  • Perform system-level functional analysis, including functional decomposition and identification of system interfaces.

  • Contribute to the definition and development of the landing gear system to achieve the required level of maturity at each aircraft design phase.

  • Define and manage functional and physical interfaces between the landing gear system and other aircraft systems and structures.

  • Define system-level verification and validation strategies, including support for ground and flight test campaigns and qualification testing of landing gear equipment and assemblies.

  • Collaborate with partners and suppliers as a technical interface for landing gear system integration.

  • Support Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA) and system safety activities in accordance with ARP4754A, ARP4761A and applicable certification requirements.

  • Support system integration, verification, testing and certification activities.

Your Profile:

  • Engineering degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.

  • 5+ years of aerospace experience, with a focus on aircraft retractable landing gear systems.

  • Experience with systems engineering, including requirements definition, functional analysis and system integration.

  • Experience across the aircraft development lifecycle, including EASA/FAA Part 23 or 25 certification.

  • Experience working in an EASA Part 21J organization, or international equivalent.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; another European language is a plus.

  • Proactive, solution-oriented and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of flight.

  • Experience with electric or hybrid-electric aircraft and strong understanding of aircraft systems is a plus.

  • Experience working in an aerospace startup or new aircraft development programme would be beneficial.

  • Previous CVE or equivalent technical authority responsibility for landing gear systems on CS-23 aircraft program is a plus.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: Software Engineer Intern

title: Contracts Specialist
description:
We are seeking an experienced Contracts Specialist to provide commercial, contractual and functional support for post-award contract management activities associated with a major EPCC project.

Location: Qatar
Industry: Oil & Gas
Project: EPCC Project

The successful candidate will manage contractual obligations, commercial correspondence, variations and contractual risks, ensuring effective contract execution and supporting the safe delivery of the project within approved budgets and schedules.
Key Responsibilities
- Manage day-to-day commercial and contractual activities related to post-award EPCC contract management.
- Support the implementation of value protection plans and ensure contractual changes and correspondence are managed in accordance with approved procedures.
- Identify contractual and commercial risks and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
- Prepare regular commercial and contract performance reports for project management and leadership.
- Coordinate with Project Management Teams (PMT), Functional Managers, Legal and Risk Management teams on contractual matters.
- Manage contractual obligations, notices, deliverables and key milestones, ensuring timely compliance and accurate documentation.
- Handle contractual correspondence, change orders, variations and provide timely contractual advice to project management teams.
- Support contract evaluations and end-of-contract close-out activities in accordance with company procedures.
- Monitor contractor performance and ensure compliance with contractual terms and conditions.
- Support effective project execution by managing commercial issues and contractual risks within a high-value project environment.

Qualifications & Experience
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Accounting, Commercial, Marketing, Science, Engineering, Project Management, Supply Chain Management, Law, Communications, Technology, Mathematics or Statistics.
- Minimum 8 years of experience in a business-related function or discipline.
- At least 4 years of experience in the Oil & Gas industry.
- Experience working with Oil & Gas companies, EPC contractors, subcontractors, vendors or service providers.
- Hands-on experience in post-award contract management, including:
- Drafting contractual and commercial correspondence.
- Managing change orders and variations.
- Contract administration and monitoring contractual obligations.
- Providing contractual advice to project management teams.

Technical & Business Skills
- Strong commercial, contractual and business acumen.
- Good understanding of contractual risks and risk mitigation strategies.
- Strong influencing, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to prepare clear and well-documented commercial correspondence.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Excellent interpersonal and coordination skills, with leadership capabilities.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a high-pressure project environment.
- Knowledge of legal matters and dispute/claims resolution would be an advantage.
- Ability to drive continuous improvement and support strategic business objectives.

title: CRA2
description:
Clinical Research Associate, China

At ICON Strategic Solutions, you will work in a sponsor-dedicated model, supported by ICON’s global expertise.


As the world’s largest FSP organisation, with over 90 sponsor partnerships, we offer stability, career development and a collaborative environment where your work contributes to the development of treatments that benefit patients worldwide.


As a CRA II at ICON, you will design and analyse clinical trials, interpreting complex medical data, and contribute to the advancement of innovative treatments and therapies.


What You Will Do:

You will contribute to clinical trial monitoring activities, taking responsibility for your deliverables and working collaboratively.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Conducting site qualification, initiation, monitoring, and close-out visits for clinical trials.
  • Ensuring protocol compliance, data integrity, and patient safety throughout the trial process.
  • Collaborating with investigators and site staff to facilitate smooth study conduct.
  • Performing data review and resolution of queries to maintain high-quality clinical data.
  • Contributing to the preparation and review of study documentation, including protocols and clinical study reports

You will bring relevant clinical trial monitoring experience, along with the following qualifications and skills.

Required qualifications and experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in a scientific or healthcare-related field.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience as a Clinical Research Associate.
  • In-depth knowledge of clinical trial processes, regulations, and ICH-GCP guidelines.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills, with attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Employment with ICON is contingent upon having the legal right to work in the country where the role is based.

title: Senior Expert ARM Kernel Developer – RICOCHET - Central Technology
description:
Job Title:

Senior Expert ARM Kernel Developer – RICOCHET - Central Technology

Requisition ID:

R028287

Job Description:

Your Mission

Your contributions will help millions of players experience Call of Duty as it's meant to be played: competitive, fair, and thrilling. You'll solve complex challenges involving Windows kernel development, driver security, platform architecture, and low-level system behavior while helping shape the future of anti-cheat technology on both traditional PC and Windows on Arm devices. Your work will directly influence the security, reliability, and effectiveness of the RICOCHET platform and help protect one of the world's largest gaming communities.


What you bring to the table

The Game Security team's priorities can change quickly based on the threat landscape. The following areas of ownership will act as a baseline. Therefore, this role includes, but is not limited to, the following responsibilities:


Build and Evolve Platform Protections: Design, develop, and maintain kernel-mode driver capabilities that provide a strong foundation for anti-cheat protections across x64 and Windows on Arm platforms.

Strengthen Core Driver Systems: Analyze, port, debug, and enhance production driver functionality while ensuring stability, performance, and compatibility across a wide range of hardware and Windows configurations.

Investigate and Counter Advanced Threats: Research cheat techniques and evasion methods, leveraging expertise in Windows internals, reverse engineering, and kernel architecture to develop resilient detection and protection mechanisms.

Collaborate Across Studios and Platforms: Partner with security engineers, platform teams, and external partners to validate hardware compatibility, improve development and testing infrastructure, and successfully ship and operate driver technology in live products.

Why This Role Matters

Your contributions will help millions of players experience Call of Duty as it's meant to be played: competitive, fair, and thrilling. You'll solve complex challenges involving Windows kernel development, driver security, platform architecture, and low-level system behavior while helping shape the future of anti-cheat technology on both traditional PC and Windows on Arm devices. Your work will directly influence the security, reliability, and effectiveness of the RICOCHET platform and help protect one of the world's largest gaming communities.



Player Profile

Minimum Requirements

Experience

  • 10+ years of professional software development experience with deep expertise in C/C++
  • 5+ years developing, debugging, and maintaining Windows kernel-mode drivers
  • Proven experience building and supporting production-quality system software
  • Windows on Arm, ARM64, or ARM64EC development experience
  • Experience diagnosing and resolving complex driver, platform, and OS compatibility issues
  • Experience with automated build, test, and validation environments

Knowledge & Skills

  • Deep understanding of the Windows on Arm, Windows kernel, driver model, and operating system internals
  • Strong proficiency in C/C++ and Arm, x86/x64 assembly
  • Expert-level debugging skills using WinDbg and related tooling
  • Strong understanding of Windows Internals, process, memory, and executable image internals
  • Solid understanding of algorithms and data structures

Key Attributes

  • Passion for building reliable, high-quality low-level software
  • Curiosity to understand how systems work internally and solve complex technical problems
  • Comfortable analyzing and debugging code at the assembly level
  • Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills
  • Clear and effective communication skills

Extra Points

Experience

  • Windows security or security software development experience
  • Reverse engineering experience
  • Experience developing anti-cheat, endpoint security, anti-malware, or EDR solutions
  • Experience working with multiplayer game technology

Knowledge & Skills

  • Understanding of advanced cheat-evasion techniques, rootkits, bootkits, including hypervisors, DKOM, EPT manipulation, and vulnerable-driver abuse
  • Deep understanding of C++ build systems, compilation, linking, and toolchains

Your Platform

Activision Central Tech works to support our development studios and their titles. Comprised of seven main teams, we have many specialties including big data, privacy and security, motion capture and animation pipeline technologies, graphics, build and infrastructure for studio development and data centers, optimization, systems programming and online services including matchmaking and networking. Central Tech is distributed globally with offices across the U.S., and in Canada, England, Ireland and Japan.

Most of our teams are comprised of both engineering and research talent, allowing us to always have an eye on the future. Our talented engineers help with title development and provide valuable knowledge sharing between studios while our researchers are action-oriented and keep a strong connection with the needs of the game studios.

Central Tech is part of Activision. To learn more about us and our research, please visit us at .

Our World

At Activision, we strive to create the most iconic brands in gaming and entertainment. We’re driven by our mission to deliver unrivaled gaming experiences for the world to enjoy, together. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, Crash Bandicoot™, Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™, and Guitar Hero®. As a leading worldwide developer, publisher and distributor of interactive entertainment and products, our “press start” is simple: delight hundreds of millions of players around the world with innovative, fun, thrilling, and engaging entertainment experiences.

We’re not just looking back at our decades-long legacy; we’re forging ahead to keep advancing gameplay with some of the most popular titles and sophisticated technology in the world. We have bold ambitions to create the most inclusive company as we know our success comes from the passionate, creative, and diverse teams within our organization.

We’re in the business of delivering fun and unforgettable entertainment for our player community to enjoy. And our future opportunities have never been greater — this could be your opportunity to level up.

Ready to Activate Your Future?

We love hearing from anyone who is enthusiastic about changing the games industry. Not sure you meet all qualifications? Let us decide! Research shows that women and members of other under-represented groups tend to not apply to jobs when they think they may not meet every qualification, when, in fact, they often do! We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and strongly encourage you to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, among other characteristics.

We are committed to working with and providing reasonable assistance to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are a disabled individual requiring an accommodation to apply for an open position, please email your request to accommodationrequests@activisionblizzard.com. General employment questions cannot be accepted or processed here. Thank you for your interest.

Rewards

We provide a suite of benefits that promote physical, emotional and financial well-being for ‘Every World’ - we’ve got our employees covered! Subject to eligibility requirements, the Company offers comprehensive benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, vision, health savings account or health reimbursement account, healthcare spending accounts, dependent care spending accounts, life and AD&D insurance, disability insurance;
  • 401(k) with Company match, tuition reimbursement, charitable donation matching;
  • Paid holidays and vacation, paid sick time, floating holidays, compassion and bereavement leaves, parental leave;
  • Mental health & wellbeing programs, fitness programs, free and discounted games, and a variety of other voluntary benefit programs like supplemental life & disability, legal service, ID protection, rental insurance, and others;
  • If the Company requires that you move geographic locations for the job, then you may also be eligible for relocation assistance.

Eligibility to participate in these benefits may vary for part time and temporary full-time employees and interns with the Company. You can learn more by visiting .

title: Senior Software Development Engineer - Code Signing
description:
Senior Software Development Engineer - Code Signing

This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

About the role

As a Senior Software Development Engineer in HPE's Product Security Office, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise code signing and certificate-based security solutions that support secure software delivery across the organization. You will apply strong software engineering expertise and practical knowledge of public key infrastructure (PKI), digital certificates, key management, and signing automation to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions.

This hands-on role combines software engineering, security engineering, and automation. You will work across engineering and security teams to improve signing workflows, strengthen software supply chain security, advance cryptographic capabilities, and establish standards and practices that scale across the enterprise. You will also provide technical leadership and contribute to engineering excellence through mentoring, collaboration, and knowledge sharing.

About you

You are an experienced software engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building security capabilities that are broadly adopted. You bring expertise in software development, code signing technologies, certificate lifecycle management, and secure software delivery practices.

You are comfortable leading technical initiatives, evaluating architecture decisions, balancing security and usability requirements, and guiding engineers through design and implementation challenges. You communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders and contribute to engineering excellence through collaboration, mentoring, and continuous improvement.


What you’ll do:

  • Lead the design, development, testing, integration, and deployment of enterprise code signing solutions and certificate-based security services.
  • Review software designs, architectures, and development activities to ensure alignment with secure software development, PKI, key management, and code signing standards while improving quality and reducing security and operational risk.
  • Provide technical leadership and domain expertise for cross-functional initiatives involving code signing, digital certificates, cryptographic controls, and software supply chain security.
  • Drive the adoption and integration of technologies that improve signing automation, cryptographic agility, certificate lifecycle management, and readiness for post-quantum cryptography.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable and reliable code signing capabilities that support enterprise software delivery objectives.
  • Mentor engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, knowledge sharing, and hands-on collaboration.

What you need to bring:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Typically 6-10 years of experience designing, developing, and deploying enterprise software applications and services.
  • Experience building secure applications, APIs, services, and automation using modern programming languages and application frameworks.
  • Experience integrating code signing and certificate management workflows into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitOps, Docker, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar technologies.
  • Experience designing secure software systems and services, including certificate integration, policy enforcement, auditability, and high-availability architectures.
  • Experience designing and integrating software solutions across Windows, Linux, macOS, cloud, containerized, and hybrid environments.
  • Experience with software testing methodologies, test planning, debugging complex issues, and developing testing tools and automation.

Experience and expertise

  • Experience with code signing architectures, public key infrastructure (PKI), certificate lifecycle management, hardware-backed key protection, and signing automation.
  • Understanding of applied cryptography, digital certificates, certificate authorities, trust models, key management, and associated governance frameworks.
  • Understanding of software supply chain security, OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, secure coding practices, and protection of signing credentials and cryptographic keys.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML and agentic AI concepts.
  • Experience with software design tools, frameworks, and programming languages used to build enterprise-scale applications and services.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical architectures, design proposals, and implementation options to technical and leadership audiences.
