Role Overview:

We are seeking a Senior .NET Backend Developer to design, build, and maintain enterprise-grade backend services on the Microsoft Azure cloud platform. The role covers API services, Azure Functions, orchestrators, and partner connectors that power digital products, with growing exposure to AI/GenAI integration, Agentic AI, and Skills-based AI architectures. The candidate is also expected to engage directly with external partners (banks, distribution partners, third-party API providers) and present technical solutions through structured refinement sessions.

Position Details:

Job Title: Senior .Net Backend Developer

Function/Department: Technology

Experience: 5–8 Years

Location: Hyderabad

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop backend services and RESTful APIs using .NET 6 / .NET 8 (C#) and ASP.NET Core (multitargeted codebase).

  • Build and maintain Azure Functions (HTTP, queue, timer, service bus triggers) and microservices following our Orchestrator + Connector pattern. • Develop and consume internal NuGet SDKs to enforce shared standards across services.

  • Build, deploy, and operate workloads on Azure App Services, Azure Functions, AKS, API Management (APIM), Service Bus, Event Hubs, Event Grid, Cosmos DB, Azure Table Storage, Blob Storage, and Key Vault.

  • Implement resilient HTTP integrations using Polly (retry/circuit-breaker), Flurl/HTTP Client, and well-defined contracts.

  • Author and maintain OpenAPI/APIM specs for new and existing APIs.

  • Implement structured logging and observability with Serilog (Console, AZURE EventHub, Periodic Batching sinks) and Application Insights.

  • Build partner integration layers for banks, brokers, payment gateways, and distribution partners.

  • Integrate AI/GenAI capabilities into backend workflows. • Contribute to AI Agents and Skill-based AI components that orchestrate tools, APIs, and business workflows autonomously.

  • Engage with external partners and integration vendors — gather integration requirements, walk through API contracts, troubleshoot connectivity, and drive joint technical alignment.

  • Present technical solutions to business and technology stakeholders — produce solution decks, sequence diagrams, API specs, and lead solution-refinement sessions to converge on the final design.

  • Ensure security, observability, and compliance (OAuth2/OIDC, Key Vault, Managed Identity, App Insights, Log Analytics).

  • Collaborate with architects, BE Leads, frontend, QA, and DevOps teams in an Agile/Scrum environment. • Conduct code reviews, mentor junior developers, and uphold engineering best practices.

Technical Skills:

• 5–10 years of backend development experience with C# / .NET Core / .NET 6 / .NET 8.

• Strong expertise in ASP.NET Core Web API, Azure Functions (in-process and isolated worker), LINQ, async programming.

• Proven hands-on experience on Microsoft Azure — App Services, Functions, AKS, API Management (APIM), Service Bus, Event Hubs, Event Grid, Storage (Blob/Table), Key Vault.

• Strong working knowledge of NoSQL databases used in our stack:

• Azure Cosmos DB — data modelling, partitioning, indexing, RU optimization, change feed.

• Azure Table Storage — partition/row key design, query patterns, scalability.

• MongoDB — schema design, aggregation pipelines, indexing, replica sets.

title: Field Sales Engineer
description:
Salary: $4,000 – $5,000 per month

ABOUT STYL SOLUTIONS

Ride on the wave of Industry 4.0! Join STYL Solutions in the forefront of using Fintech and IoT technologies for smart city/nation transformation. Headquartered in Singapore with R&D center in Vietnam, STYL Solutions designs, develops, and supplies hardware, software and integrated solutions for applications in payment, loyalty management, location tracking, self-service operation, telemetry.

Our market segment coverage extends from financial services, retail, mass transit, education to social services markets in Singapore and South Asia Pacific.

Our vision is to use Fintech and IoT to create smart and efficient cities that enhance Quality of Life through convenience and healthier living.

JOB DESCRIPTION

We are looking for a reliable, highly motivated, and self-driven Field Sales Engineer to proactively develop and expand our Self-Service business pipelines. In this role, you will be responsible for driving end-to-end sales growth by winning new business from self-service machine operators and merchants—ranging from large fleets to independent owners—across key segments including vending, laundromats, car washes, game machines etc..

You will promote and sell STYL’s integrated solutions, specifically our unattended payment terminals and the Vend-in-STYL (VIS) remote sales and inventory SaaS telemetry platform. Beyond business development and CRM management, you will take hands-on ownership of technical pre-sales and integration testing. You will independently conduct on-site terminal integration and protocol testing (e.g., MDB and VCCS) directly with vending machines and self-service hardware, ensuring seamless pilot rollouts and eliminating engineering bottlenecks so that no deal is delayed.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Business development

  • Build and maintain a target list of self-service machine operators and merchants, from large fleets to small owners.

  • Approach them through visits, calls, trade events and referrals. Run the full sales cycle: first meeting, demo, quotation, negotiation and closing.

  • Keep the CRM and the sales pipeline current. Report pipeline and forecast to the Senior Sales Manager every week.

  • Gather market and competitor information and share it with the team.

Technical pre-sales

  • Explain the STYL payment terminal and the VIS platform to operators in clear business terms.

  • Study each operator’s machine models, interfaces and payment needs. Recommend the correct terminal setup.

  • Work with STYL Sales team on quotations, with STYL Service team on installation and servicing.

Integration testing

  • Test the payment terminal with customer machines in Singapore, using the MDB and VCCS protocols.

  • Find and record faults, such as communication errors, wrong vend signals and failed refunds. Report them to the technical team with clear test notes.

  • Support pilot installations on site. Confirm that cashless payments and VIS reporting work end to end before handover.

Customer success after the sale

  • Stay the main contact for the newly developed accounts after first roll-out as well as for assigned existing accounts. Follow up regularly for repeat orders and referrals. Provide product and solution updates.

Hardware inventory and forecast

  • Ensure the hardware inventory in STYL warehouse is accounted for monthly at the minimum.

  • Provide inputs for self-service hardware forecast

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Here at STYL Solutions, we value proactive ownership and require independence and hands-on involvement in our daily responsibilities. We seek entrepreneurial candidates with the following:

Education & Experience

  • Diploma or degree. Engineering, electronics, or a related technical field is preferred.

  • 2 to 4 years of sales or technical work with vending machine operators, vending machine makers or vending machine suppliers. Experience in unattended payment terminals for self-service machines is also accepted.

  • A record of winning new customers or of delivering machines or payment integrations, shown by clear examples.

Technical knowledge (Must Have)

  • Good knowledge of vending machine specifications and how the machines work. This includes the controller, the coin and note devices, the vend and refund flow, and the error codes.

  • Hands-on knowledge of the MDB protocol (master and peripheral roles, and the cashless device role).

  • Hands-on knowledge of the VCCS/JVMA protocol is a plus.

  • Able to do integration tests alone: connect the terminal to a machine, read signals, find the cause of a fault, and write a clear test report.

  • Able to use basic test tools, such as a multimeter and a protocol analyser or logger.

Sales skills

  • Able to explain a technical product to both an owner and an engineer.

  • Self-driven. Can build his own pipeline without close supervision.

  • Clear written and spoken English.

Work conditions

  • Willing to travel in Singapore and to Malaysia and other Southeast Asian markets as needed.

  • Willing to work on site, and outside office hours when required.

Aptitudes & Personal Attributes

  • Honest and reliable. Follow through on promises to customers.

  • Curious. Learn a new machine model quickly.

  • Patient and careful in testing. Writes clear notes for the technical team.

  • Collaborative and work well with the Sales Manager, Sales Enablement Specialist and with other teams.

Nice to have

  • An existing list of contacts at vending, laundromat or amusement machine operators in Singapore or Malaysia.

  • Knowledge of cashless payments: QR and e-wallet payments, card payments, and how acquirers and settlement work.

  • Knowledge of other interfaces, such as Pulse and DEX/telemetry.

  • Experience with SaaS or IoT products for remote sales and stock management.

  • Experience with a hardware demo, a pilot or a proof of concept.

What measures the success of the role:

  • New Operator Account Acquisition: Total number of signed operators or merchants submitting their initial orders.

  • Terminal & Machine Deployment: Timely deployment and go-live execution of payment terminals across customer machines.

  • Revenue Generation & SaaS Subscriptions: Attainment of target terminal hardware sales along with growth in active VIS platform subscriptions.

description:
Production Team Leader

Position Summary

The primary responsibility of this position is to provide leadership and direction for the team members in the Production department. This position will be the go to person for all issues involving materials, quality and production runs.

Duties & Essential Job Functions

Verify correct setup of machines for production runs by using documented setup procedures
Verify the correct quantity of resin bags have been added to mixing tanks to produce gel substance
Verify all materials have been located to produce daily orders
Basic troubleshooting of machines and palletizers when they malfunction
Complete all necessary paperwork and submit to supervisor
Correctly enter all data into computer system for reports, ensuring accuracy of data
Collaborate with Maintenance on machine functions and troubleshooting processes
Participate in Daily Management meetings

Performs other duties as assigned by leadership including assisting other departments when instructed

Qualifications

High school diploma or G.E.D.
Ability to effectively communicate in English, both written and oral
Technical background – Preferred
Leadership experience

Company Overview
Founded in Elkhart, Indiana in 1954, EFP is strategically located to serve the central United States with two of the largest EPS molding plants in the U.S. Headquartered in Elkhart, Indiana, the company also has locations in Decatur, Alabama, Nashville, Tennessee, and Evansville, Indiana.

EFP can design, mold, fabricate and provide fulfillment capabilities, kitting, assembly, custom systems, and inventory management. Nashville is also home to the company’s Temperature Solutions Center of Excellence.

For more than 30 years, EFP, LLC has been owned by J.B. Poindexter & Co., Inc., a privately held, diversified manufacturing company with operating subsidiaries throughout North America. description:

Working under the Art Director, this person will review image submissions, provide clear, actionable feedback and assess revisions throughout the creative approval process.   • Review hero and alternate images for consistency and recommend selects to the Art Director
  • Re-review revised assets to confirm feedback has been addressed and flag unresolved creative or product-accuracy concerns before approval
  • Maintain clear review notes and feedback history within designated asset review platforms, keeping the Art Director and production partners informed of outstanding revisions
  • Prioritize assigned reviews to meet daily, weekly and seasonal deadlines while maintaining quality across product categories

  • Experience with e-commerce imagery; fashion or in-house brand experience is a plus
  • Familiarity with digital imaging and retouching methods, including AI-assisted workflows, is a plus
  • Experience using digital asset review and approval platforms preferred
  • Strong visual judgment and attention to product detail, garment fit and brand consistency
  • Understanding of photography, lighting, composition, color and texture
  • Ability to recognize subtle visual inconsistencies and translate them into clear image markups and revision instructions
  • Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite, Capture One, Figma and Excel

title: Senior Sales Engineer (ROA)
description:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

About the role

Amplitude helps companies understand how people use their digital products, and act on what they learn. As a Senior Sales Engineer based in Singapore, you'll be the technical lead in our sales conversations across Singapore and the Rest of Asia region.

You'll partner with Account Executives to win new customers and grow existing ones. Day to day, that means running discovery with product, data and engineering teams, building demos that show Amplitude working in a customer's world, and explaining to technical buyers how it fits into their stack and what it will be worth to them.

This is a hands-on role. More and more of our customer conversations are about how Amplitude connects to a data warehouse, how it fits into the way engineering teams build and ship software, and how teams run A/B tests and feature flags. We're looking for someone who has worked with this kind of technology directly, not just alongside it, and who is as comfortable leading a customer meeting as they are working through a technical problem.

What you'll do

  • Run technical and business discovery. Understand a prospect's goals, data, tech stack and decision criteria, and shape the solution around them.

  • Build and deliver demos, presentations and prototypes tailored to each customer, for audiences from engineers to executives.

  • Lead proofs of concept hands-on, working with the customer's engineers and data teams to get Amplitude running on their own data and use cases.

  • Explain Amplitude's value to technical buyers and executives: architecture, data flows, warehouse integration, experimentation, and where it sits in a modern data stack.

  • Stay involved as customers implement. Keep the plan on track, keep technical stakeholders aligned, and make sure what we proposed gets delivered.

  • Be proactive. Follow up quickly, build relationships across the customer's technical team, and keep deals moving without waiting to be asked.

  • Act as the voice of the market inside Amplitude: bring customer feedback and requirements back to Product, and help AEs, Customer Success and newer teammates with the technical side.

  • Travel within the region to meet customers when needed.

What you'll bring

  • 6-8+ years of Senior-level experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as solutions engineering, sales engineering, solutions architecture or technical consulting.

  • Hands-on technical and data skills. You can build a sample app for a demo, instrument SDKs and feature flags, and troubleshoot customer questions.

  • Hands-on technical experience with two or more of the following:

    • Experimentation: designing and running A/B tests, feature flags and controlled rollouts.

    • Software development lifecycle: how engineering teams plan, build, test and release software, and where analytics, gates and experimentation fit in.

    • Data warehousing: working with cloud data warehouses, including connecting, modelling and activating data. Experience at a data warehouse or data platform company is especially relevant.

    • Modern data stack architecture: designing how collection, storage, transformation and analytics tools fit together.

    • AI: harnesses, evals, governance

  • Strong demo building. You create demos and presentations that make a product real for a specific audience.

  • Solid discovery skills. You ask the questions that uncover what a customer needs and how they'll make their decision.

  • The ability to explain value clearly to technical buyers, from engineering and data leaders to the business stakeholders they work with.

  • You're based in Singapore and comfortable covering customers across Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia and Taiwan.

Nice to have

  • A background in developer tooling.

  • Implementation, post-sales or consulting experience where you owned multi-month customer projects and managed technical stakeholders.

  • A second language used across the region.

Our values:

At Amplitude, our values guide how we show up for one another and for our customers:

  • Humility: We operate from a place of empathy and openness, seeking to understand many points of view.

  • Ownership: We take the initiative to solve problems that drive our shared company success.

  • Growth Mindset: We’re tenacious in the face of challenges and seek feedback in order to grow ourselves and others.

  • Customer Centricity: We put the customer at the center of everything we do and are deeply committed to their success.

We care about the well-being of our team: We offer competitive pay and benefits packages that reflect our commitment to the health and well-being of our Ampliteers.

Some of our benefit programs include:

  • Excellent ​M​edical, ​D​ental and ​V​ision insurance coverages, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employee Medical, ​Dental,​ ​​​​​​​​Vision on select plans

  • 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 1% of your eligible pay each pay period up to $2,000 annually

  • Flexible time off, ​p​aid holidays, and more

  • Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), new hire home office equipment, and much more

  • Excellent Parental benefits including​:​ 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back-up Child Care support

  • Mental health and wellness benefits including no cost employee access to Modern Health coaching & therapy sessions

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program​ (ESPP)

Other fun facts about Amplitude:

  • Our customers love us! They've said we're the #1 product analytics solution for 23 quarters in a row on G2.

  • We care a lot about product innovation. We've made significant investments in talent and infrastructure to build the most powerful AI analytics platform on the market.

  • We invest in our people. We offer mentorship programs, management training, and wellness initiatives.

  • We give back to our communities. We give every Ampliteer a charitable giving grant and paid volunteer time off.

  • We were founded in 2012, went public via a direct listing in September 2021, and are now trading under the ticker $AMPL.

title: Senior Professional Services Consultant- AMS
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Professional Services Consultant to join our Professional Services team. This is a Hybrid, Mohali role , reporting to the Manager, Professional Services. In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical authority for our enterprise customers — architecting, deploying, and optimizing solutions across the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform. As organizations navigate AI-accelerated threats, cloud-first transformation, and increasingly complex hybrid environments, you will be the expert who turns that complexity into clarity. You bring deep technical depth, a strategic consulting mindset, and the ability to engage equally well with hands-on engineering teams and senior business stakeholders — delivering outcomes that are secure, scalable, and built to last. Work Shift: 5:00 PM – 2:00 AM IST (aligned with US/American enterprise customers)

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Own the full technical engagement lifecycle for enterprise customers — from discovery and solution design through deployment, adoption, and continuous optimization
  • Architect and integrate ZIA, ZPA, ZDX, and the broader Zero Trust Exchange across complex, multi-cloud and hybrid enterprise environments including AI-driven workload scenarios
  • Lead Zero Trust maturity assessments, technical discovery workshops, and migration planning sessions with customer and partner stakeholders at all levels
  • Guide customers on securing modern identity frameworks, SaaS ecosystems, and AI-powered workflows — translating evolving threat landscapes into actionable, platform-led security outcomes
  • Partner with sales, channel partners, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact consultancy and deployment services that accelerate customer time-to-value

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 8+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles — Professional Services, Security or Network Consulting, Technical Account Management, Escalation Engineering, or SOC operations
  • Hands-on experience deploying and operating Zscaler solutions — ZIA, ZPA, and ZDX — across large-scale, complex enterprise environments
  • Strong command of modern identity and access frameworks — SAML, SSO/IdP integrations, MFA, conditional access, and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) principles
  • Solid foundation across networking and security fundamentals — TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, SSL/TLS, PAC files, GRE/IPSec tunnels, proxies, and next-generation firewalls
  • Working knowledge of AI/ML security concepts — including shadow AI risk, data loss prevention in AI-powered environments, and securing LLM and API-driven workloads

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Hands-on experience securing cloud-native architectures on Azure, AWS, or GCP — including AI/ML pipelines — with practical exposure to SASE, SSE, and converged security frameworks
  • Understanding of AI governance, data security posture management (DSPM), and the security implications of enterprise GenAI adoption
  • Industry certifications: ZDTA / ZDTE, CISSP, CCSP, or equivalent cloud and security credentials

#LI-Hybrid #LI-VV3

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.

title: Health Safety and Wellness Manager
description:
Position Summary

The Health, Safety & Wellness Manager provides strategic leadership and oversight for the organization's Health & Safety Management System, regulatory compliance, WSIB and disability management programs, wellness initiatives, security operations, and emergency preparedness across two facilities employing approximately 1,450 team members operating on three shifts.

The position is accountable for ensuring legislative compliance, driving continuous improvement, managing organizational risk, and fostering a strong culture of safety and wellbeing. The incumbent leads the Health, Safety & Wellness team and partners with departmental leadership to achieve organizational health and safety objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Strategy

Develop and execute health, safety, wellness, and security strategies aligned with organizational goals.

Provide leadership, development and performance management for the Health, Safety & Wellness team.

Advise senior leadership on health, safety, regulatory, security, and organizational risk matters.

Lead initiatives that strengthen employee engagement, hazard awareness, reporting culture, and management accountability.

Drive continuous improvement in safety culture through visible leadership, performance measurement, and organizational development initiatives.

Develop and manage departmental budgets and business cases to support health, safety, wellness, security and risk reduction initiatives.

Develop and execute the departmental business plan and budget, including recommendations for investments that support health, safety, wellness, security and risk reduction priorities.

Health & Safety Governance & Compliance

Provide strategic oversight of the Health & Safety Management System, ensuring compliance with legislative, regulatory, customer, and organizational requirements.

Lead the development and maintenance of health and safety policies, programs and standards to ensure regulatory compliance and effective risk management.

Provide technical oversight of health and safety training requirements to ensure employees and leaders are appropriately trained for workplace hazards and regulatory requirements.

Act as the organization’s subject matter expert for ergonomics, hazard identification, risk assessment and physical demands analysis.

Oversee ergonomic and injury prevention programs, risk assessment processes and hazard control strategies.

Represent the organization with regulatory agencies, customers, and industry stakeholders on health and safety matters.

WSIB, Disability Management & Wellness

Provide strategic oversight of WSIB, return-to-work, disability management, and accommodation programs.

Monitor claim performance, costs, and return-to-work outcomes and drive improvement initiatives.

Lead development and evaluation of employee wellness programs that support workforce wellbeing, attendance, engagement, and retention.

Security & Emergency Preparedness

Oversee facility security programs, contractor safety governance, and access control processes.

Ensure effective emergency preparedness, crisis management, and business continuity planning.

Review significant security and emergency events and direct corrective actions as required.

Operational Partnership & Project Support

Partner with operational leaders to integrate health and safety requirements into business operations.

Ensure health, safety, ergonomic, and regulatory considerations are incorporated into project planning and execution.

Provide health and safety leadership for capital projects, facility modifications, equipment installations and operational changes.

Oversee contractor safety requirements and performance for construction, maintenance and other contracted services.

Qualifications

Degree or Diploma in Occupational Health & Safety, Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

CRSP designation preferred.

Minimum 10 years of progressive health and safety experience, including 5 years in a management role within a manufacturing, food processing, or industrial environment.

Demonstrated experience leading Health & Safety Management Systems, regulatory compliance, WSIB and disability management programs, audits, and organizational risk management.

Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence all levels of the organization.

Proven ability to drive change, foster a positive safety culture, and lead continuous improvement initiatives.

Strong analytical, decision-making, project management, and problem-solving abilities.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced, multi-site, environment.

Direct Reports

Health, Safety & Wellness Coordinator (3)

Health, Safety & Wellness Compliance Auditor (1)

Key Competencies

Accountability and Initiative

Enabling Change

People are Our Foundation

Working Conditions

Occasional weekend, after-hours, and multi-shift support as required to meet operational needs.

Regular presence in a food-processing environment with exposure to cold temperatures, elevated noise levels, moving equipment, and production hazards.

Frequent interaction with manufacturing operations, including high-traffic production and material handling areas.

Periodic work in outdoor environments and active processing areas requiring adherence to all safety and personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements.

Physical Requirements

May be required to lift up to 50 pounds on an occasional basis while performing ergonomic assessments

May be required to stand for extended periods of time

Key Performance Indicators

Total Recordable Injury Frequency Rate (TRIFR)

Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR)

WSIB Claim Costs and Duration

Return-to-Work Performance

Audit Compliance Scores

Corrective Action Closure Rates

Ministry of Labour Compliance Results

Wellness Program Participation and Engagement

Security Incident Performance

Department Budget Performance

title: ICT Risk Officer (m/w/d)
description:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

ICT Risk Officer (m/w/d)

Überblick

Als ICT Risk Officer (m/w/d) gestalten Sie die Weiterentwicklung unseres ICT-Risikomanagements aktiv mit und tragen dazu bei, unsere digitale Resilienz nachhaltig zu stärken. Sie bewerten und überwachen ICT-Risiken, hinterfragen bestehende Kontrollen und arbeiten eng mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen und Stakeholdern zusammen. Dabei verbinden Sie regulatorische Anforderungen mit einem pragmatischen Blick auf unser Geschäft und unterstützen uns insbesondere bei der Umsetzung von DORA.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Weiterentwicklung und Pflege des ICT-Risikomanagement-Frameworks sowie der dazugehörigen Richtlinien, Methoden und Standards
  • Identifikation, Bewertung und Überwachung von Risiken in den Bereichen Informationssicherheit, Cybersecurity, IT-Betrieb und ICT-Drittdienstleister
  • Durchführung von ICT-Risikoanalysen und Unterstützung bei der Integration von ICT-Risiken in das unternehmensweite Risikomanagement
  • Pflege des ICT-Risikoregisters sowie Überwachung von Maßnahmen, Risikoakzeptanzen und relevanten Kontrollaktivitäten
  • Unabhängige Bewertung und Challenge der First Line of Defense hinsichtlich wesentlicher ICT-Risiken und Kontrollen
  • Bewertung der Angemessenheit und Wirksamkeit von Sicherheits- und Kontrollmaßnahmen
  • Begleitung wesentlicher ICT-Incidents sowie relevanter Maßnahmen zur Stärkung der operationalen Resilienz
  • Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung regulatorischer Anforderungen, insbesondere im Zusammenhang mit DORA, Resilienztests und ICT-Drittparteienrisiken
  • Entwicklung und Überwachung relevanter Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) und Key Control Indicators (KCIs)
  • Erstellung aussagekräftiger ICT-Risiko-Reports für Management und relevante Governance-Gremien
  • Unterstützung bei internen und externen Prüfungen sowie regulatorischen Anfragen
  • Beratung von Management und Fachbereichen zu ICT-Risiken und regulatorischen Fragestellungen
  • Förderung einer starken Risiko- und Sicherheitskultur sowie Mitwirkung an Schulungs- und Awareness-Maßnahmen

Was Sie mitbringen

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium, beispielsweise in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in ICT Risk Management, IT Risk Management, Informationssicherheit, Operational Risk oder Internal Controls
  • Gute Kenntnisse regulatorischer Anforderungen an ICT-Risikomanagement und digitale operationale Resilienz, insbesondere DORA
  • Erfahrung mit ICT-Risikoanalysen, Kontrollbewertungen und dem Umgang mit regulatorischen Anforderungen
  • Verständnis für Informationssicherheits-, Cyber-, Auslagerungs- bzw. ICT-Drittparteienrisiken
  • Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Risikothemen verständlich gegenüber unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern zu vermitteln
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Das wäre ein Plus

  • Erfahrung im regulierten Finanzdienstleistungs-, Banken-, Fintech- oder Zahlungsverkehrsumfeld
  • Kenntnisse etablierter Frameworks wie ISO 27001, NIST oder COBIT
  • Erfahrung mit regulatorischen Prüfungen oder im Austausch mit Aufsichtsbehörden
  • Kenntnisse weiterer relevanter regulatorischer Anforderungen, beispielsweise MaRisk oder ZAG

Was wir bieten

  • Eine verantwortungsvolle Rolle im ICT-Risikomanagement mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und großem Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Die Möglichkeit, unser ICT-Risikomanagement und die digitale operationale Resilienz aktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln
  • Ein spannendes regulatorisches Umfeld mit besonderem Fokus auf DORA, Informationssicherheit, Cybersecurity und ICT-Drittparteienrisiken
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten im Rahmen einer Gleitzeitregelung
  • Die Möglichkeit, bis zu 15 Arbeitstage pro Jahr aus zahlreichen Ländern im Ausland zu arbeiten
  • 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr
  • Attraktive Zusatzleistungen wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Aktienbeteiligungsprogramme und Mobilitätsangebote
  • Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Corporate Benefits und vieles mehr

Thank you for considering employment with Fiserv. Please:

  • Apply using your legal name
  • Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).

title: Systems Engr II
description:

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

The Staff Software Engineer will provide organization-wide technical leadership for large-scale distributed systems and platform architectures, driving long-term scalability, reliability, modernization, and engineering excellence. This role will shape technical strategy across teams, lead high-impact cross-functional initiatives, advance AI-assisted development and developer productivity, and influence architecture and operational maturity without relying on direct authority.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and evolution of large-scale distributed systems and platform architectures for long-term scalability and reliability across organizations.
  • Define long-term technical strategy and architecture across organizational boundaries, aligning engineering direction with business goals.
  • Lead adoption of AI-assisted development and connect AI initiatives to engineering effectiveness and measurable business outcomes.
  • Identify high-impact technical opportunities, prioritize complex problems, and drive cross-team initiatives spanning multiple systems and domains.
  • Partner with engineering, product, and business leadership on technical priorities, roadmaps, architecture decisions, and strategic initiatives.
  • Drive observability, performance, reliability, operational maturity, and systemic risk mitigation across production systems.
  • Define technical debt reduction and modernization strategies, including re-platforming roadmaps, while advancing platform capabilities and developer productivity tooling.
  • Mentor senior and staff engineers, establish high standards for design, code, operations, and continuous improvement, and contribute to technical due diligence for strategic initiatives and partnerships.

Required Qualifications

  • B.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience driving technical strategy across multiple teams or organizations.
  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and design patterns.
  • Deep experience designing large-scale distributed systems or platform architectures, with strong understanding of scalability, reliability, performance, and cost trade-offs.
  • Hands-on production experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, including cloud-native services and security best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven ability to operate in ambiguity and drive execution without direct authority, while aligning senior/staff engineers and leadership across teams.
  • Deep observability and reliability engineering experience across logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, incident response, and post-mortem improvements.
  • Experience improving engineering productivity through platforms, tooling, processes, and modern delivery practices.
  • Forward-looking experience with AI-assisted development and organizational AI strategy, including adoption and measurable engineering outcomes.
  • Experience with full-stack/API development and proficiency in one or more of Rust, C#, or JavaScript; familiarity with OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and SAML.
  • Strong experience with distributed systems, microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, cloud-native infrastructure, serverless services, managed Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Pulumi, or Bicep.
  • Experience with secure coding, threat modeling, vulnerability remediation, CI/CD, progressive deployment, relational and non-relational data stores at scale, and technical due diligence for strategic initiatives.

Additional information
Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Quality Assurance Quality Control Manager
description:
RPM Utilities, LLC is a growing underground utility construction company specializing in water, sanitary sewer, storm drainage, and infrastructure projects throughout North Texas. We are committed to delivering high-quality construction services while maintaining the highest standards of safety, efficiency, and workmanship.

We are seeking an experienced Quality Assurance / Quality Control (QA/QC) Manager to oversee quality standards, ensure compliance with project specifications, and support successful project execution across our underground utility construction operations.

Position Summary

The QA/QC Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing quality assurance and quality control processes across multiple construction projects. This position works closely with Project Managers, Superintendents, Foremen, subcontractors, and field personnel to ensure construction activities meet company standards, engineering specifications, regulatory requirements, and contractual obligations.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in underground utilities, civil construction, quality inspections, and construction compliance, with strong leadership and problem-solving abilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and maintain company-wide QA/QC policies, procedures, and inspection standards.

  • Conduct regular jobsite inspections to verify compliance with approved plans, specifications, and quality requirements.

  • Oversee quality control for underground water, sanitary sewer, storm drainage, and related utility installations.

  • Ensure construction activities comply with applicable municipal, state, and federal regulations, project specifications, and industry standards.

  • Review construction drawings, engineering plans, project specifications, and inspection requirements.

  • Coordinate with Project Managers, Superintendents, Foremen, engineers, and municipal inspectors to resolve quality concerns.

  • Identify construction deficiencies, document nonconforming work, and oversee corrective actions.

  • Monitor testing and inspection requirements, including compaction testing, pressure testing, leakage testing, and other project-specific quality measures.

  • Maintain accurate inspection reports, quality documentation, testing records, and corrective action logs.

  • Assist with project closeout documentation, punch lists, and final inspections.

  • Conduct quality training and provide guidance to field personnel regarding company standards and best practices.

  • Identify opportunities to improve construction quality, reduce rework, and increase operational efficiency.

  • Provide regular quality performance updates and reports to management.

  • Promote accountability and continuous improvement throughout field operations.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in underground utility construction, civil construction, or construction quality management.

  • Previous experience in a QA/QC leadership, construction inspection, or field management role.

  • Strong knowledge of underground water, sewer, and storm drainage construction practices.

  • Ability to interpret construction plans, blueprints, engineering specifications, and technical documents.

  • Familiarity with municipal construction standards, inspection requirements, and quality control procedures.

  • Experience documenting inspections, identifying deficiencies, and implementing corrective actions.

  • Strong organizational, communication, and leadership skills.

  • Ability to manage quality control activities across multiple active construction projects.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and construction reporting software.

  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel to jobsites throughout the DFW area.

Preferred:

  • Experience working with municipalities, general contractors, and civil engineering firms.

  • Knowledge of North Texas municipal utility construction specifications and standards.

  • Relevant construction inspection, quality management, or industry certifications.

  • Experience developing and implementing QA/QC programs.

  • Familiarity with underground utility testing, inspection, and project closeout procedures.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation based on experience.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Paid vacation and holidays.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and advancement.

  • A collaborative, team-oriented work environment.

  • The opportunity to play a key leadership role in maintaining and improving construction quality standards.

title: Supervisor Distribution System Operations - PA Distribution Operations - Greensburg Corporate Center
description:
FirstEnergy at a Glance

We are a forward-thinking electric utility powered by a diverse team of employees committed to making customers’ lives brighter, the environment better and our communities stronger.

FirstEnergy (NYSE: FE) is dedicated to integrity, safety, reliability, and operational excellence. Headquartered in Akron, Ohio, FirstEnergy includes one of the nation's largest investor-owned electric systems, more than 24,000 miles of transmission lines that connect the Midwest and Mid-Atlantic regions, and a regulated generating fleet with a total capacity of more than 3,500 megawatts.

About the Opportunity

This is an open position with the FirstEnergy Service Company, a subsidiary of FirstEnergy Corp.

All employees who apply for a posted position must notify their supervisors that they have applied. Employees who have not been in their current position for at least one year or who are in a position with specific requirements beyond one year, must obtain approval from their supervisor before applying.

This position directly oversees, mentors, and supports Distribution System Operations personnel involved in the daily real-time activities at the Distribution Control Center located in Greensburg, PA.

Responsibilities include:

  • Maintaining a high level of safety commitment throughout day-to-day functions.
  • Supervising activities including the direction of field crews in the operation and maintenance of the electrical distribution system.
  • Ensuring compliance with appropriate policies and procedures for real-time dispatch operations.
  • Supervising real-time utilization of Advanced Distribution Management System (ADMS), Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA), Distribution Management System (DMS), contingency analysis and system analysis resources for assessing system conditions.
  • Conducting mid-year and year-end performance reviews with employees.
  • Executing the performance management process by providing feedback and coaching on an ongoing basis throughout the year and discussing development opportunities, performance issues, and changes that are occurring.
  • Initiating, conducting, and providing expert and timely assistance to investigate reliability, safety conditions, and incidents; this involves interacting with other areas in Energy Delivery, FirstEnergy regional operations, transmission operations, and neighboring utility regions.
  • Developing contingency plans for prioritizing the restoration of service.
  • Assisting in or developing emergency plans for storm-related interruptions, equipment failures, or labor unrest.
  • Supervising the maintenance of operating documentation, record keeping, and operator shift schedule.
  • Participating in operational and other meetings at the General Office.
  • Will be required to work weekends or extended days.
  • Must be available for storm work during severe weather conditions.
  • Responsibility for supervision of review and approval of outage data.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor or Associate of Engineering degree (Electrical Engineering preferred), with at least 3 years of related work experience, or a high school diploma with 5 years of relevant work experience. Related work experience includes line or substation field work, engineering experience, and military related or leadership experience.
  • Demonstrated past leadership in operational supervision or dispatching job duties.
  • Demonstrated interpersonal skills and ability to process information in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Ability to accurately perform analytical calculations such as voltage drops, transformer, and circuit loadings.
  • Knowledge of the equipment and principles involved in the operation of all components of the electrical system required.
  • Knowledge of FirstEnergy's information systems related to dispatching activities.
  • Knowledge of clearance and switching (lockout/tagout) procedures to remove and restore lines and electrical equipment while maintaining safety to employees (Manual of Operations).
  • Experience in the safe operation of electrical equipment and maintaining reliable and quality service to customers.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to conduct and present himself/herself in a professional manner.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of computer applications such as Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel.
  • Must reside within an acceptable proximity of the reporting location due to job related requirements.

Benefits, Compensation & Workforce Diversity

At FirstEnergy, employees are key to our success. We depend on their talents to meet the challenges of our changing business environment. We are committed to rewarding individual and team efforts through our total rewards philosophy which includes competitive pay plus incentive compensation, a company-sponsored pension plan, 401(k) savings plan with matching employer contribution, a choice of medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, and life insurance programs, as well as skills development training with tuition reimbursement. Please visit our website at www.firstenergycorp.com to learn more about all of our employee rewards programs. FirstEnergy proudly supports workforce diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, or status as a qualified individual with a disability. No recruiters or agencies without a previously signed contract. Unable to sponsor or transfer H-1B visas at this time.

Safety

Safety is a core value for FirstEnergy and is essential to all of our business activities. We ensure employees have the tools, information, and processes to perform their duties in a manner that assures safety for themselves, their co-workers, our customers and the public. Our goals are to provide a safe work environment, to maintain an accident-free, injury-free workplace, and to promote and maintain public safety. To meet these goals, we dedicate ourselves to achieving world-class safety standards.

title: Night Security
description:
Hours: 44 Hours – over four-night shift pattern
Work pattern: Continental Shift Pattern 4 on 4 off
Duration: Permanent Salaried
West Midlands Safari Park are currently recruiting for the position of Night Security Officer to deliver an overnight security service across the site.
This exciting role will deliver a security focused service ensuring a safe environment, patrolling throughout the night, monitoring and maintaining the protection of the premises, responding to any irregularities, communicating any key information to team leaders and management, monitoring and analysing CCTV footage and completion of nightly security logs. As part of your role, you will assist our Guest Service Host function with the delivery of an end-to-end accommodation support service for all of our onsite guests to achieve a consistent delivery of outstanding service at all times.

About you
The ideal candidate will be self-motivated and enthusiastic, possessing excellent concentration skills whilst remaining alert and aware of surroundings. You will maintain a professional attitude at all times positively building guest relationships through exception interaction and communication skills.
You will have previous experience working in a customer facing security position, ideally within the hospitality, events or leisure and tourism industry and will hold a current SIA Licence. This post is subject to a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check, this disclosure will need to be satisfactory to the Company for employment to commence.
Due to the role accessing all areas across the business, the successful candidate will need to hold a full, valid Driving Licence. You will hold a current First Aid at Work qualification or be willing to undertake a First Aid at Work qualification through the business.
You will need to be flexible in your approach to work outside of standard hours, adjustment to standard hours may be required to provide additional support to Safari events and business needs.

Benefits
As well as benefiting from working in a unique and beautiful setting, you’ll also receive a range of additional perks to employment including:

WMSP Annual Pass which gives you and your family and friends free admission and theme park wristbands, and free entry to our sister site Drayton Manor Park also Water World Stoke On Trent
20% Discount in our retail and catering outlets and off park special events.
24 Hour access to an online doctor and access to online prescriptions.
Counselling access.
Online retailer discount portal.

What we are
West Midlands Safari Park is an award-winning visitor attraction, located in Worcestershire in the heart of England. It is home to some of the world’s most beautiful and critically endangered species, with a four-mile safari drive-through, walk-through Discovery Trail, African Village and Lemur Woods, as well beautiful walking trails, allowing guests to experience up close encounters with hundreds of amazing animals. Guests can also choose from a wide range of catering and retail outlets, as well as enjoying a large amusement area with over 25 rides and attractions providing the ideal venue for family days out.
In 2021, the Park introduced Safari Lodges – luxury accommodation allowing guests to stay overnight for the first time. Guests can wake up to incredible sights of elephants, giraffes, rhinos, hippos and red pandas, or sleep just a ‘whisker’ away from lions, white lions, tigers and cheetahs.
In addition, the Park is home to three incredible venues – Spring Grove House, Treetops Pavillion and Cellarz, which play host to weddings, corporate events and social celebrations.

What we do
Our mission is to bring people together to create unique wildlife experiences that exhilarate, educate and leave memories to last a lifetime.
Our 200-acre site allows us to do just that, whether you’re a day guest, wedding guest or overnight guest! We create experiences unlike no other, attracting visitors from across the Midlands and beyond.
Our brand and our team members live by our core values. We’re passionate and work with a sense of togetherness, always striving to be progressive, with preservation at the heart of everything we do, all while creating unforgettable experiences.
Through these principles we aspire to achieve our vision: to be the number one UK wildlife attraction through the creation of immersive animal habitats and unique visitor experiences.

title: Senior Planning Manager
description:
Mace combines global delivery consultancy experience to unlock potential in every person or project and redefine the boundaries of ambition. Our values shape the way we consult and define the people we want to join us on our journey.

The project:

A large scale public infrastructure enhancement programme involving complex civil, structural and MEP works across multiple interconnected sites. The project encompassed significant station area upgrades, tunnel interface works, systems integration, and critical asset renewal to improve network capacity, safety performance and long term operational resilience within one of Hong Kong’s most heavily used transport corridors.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Lead a strong safety culture, ensuring projects meet exceptional standards in health, safety, quality, cost, programme, and sustainability.
  • Apply expert knowledge of local H&S regulations and promote an inclusive, people‑focused working environment.
  • Provide strategic direction across key assignments, driving effective planning performance and alignment with business objectives.
  • Oversee planning for projects and tenders, ensuring robust scheduling and progress monitoring.
  • Support contract development, due diligence, and long‑term functional strategy.
  • Foster collaboration, best‑practice sharing, and strong stakeholder relationships to enable successful delivery.

You’ll need to have:

  • Degree in construction or engineering, with broad multi‑sector project experience.
  • Strong planning expertise and proficiency in industry‑standard scheduling tools.
  • Skilled in stakeholder engagement, communication, and team development.
  • Delivers high‑quality outcomes through problem‑solving and service excellence.

Our values

Safety first - Going home safe and well: We champion a safe, diverse and inclusive working environment, understanding the importance of wellbeing in every team.

Client focus - Deliver on our promise: We own the quality of deliverables, strategic outcomes and build long term relationships with our clients.

Integrity - Always do the right thing: We influence positive outcomes within our industry, while always aligning with our compliance obligations.

Create opportunity - For our people to excel: We champion a continuous improvement culture throughout all activities, inspiring our people and teams to develop.

Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. Even if you feel you do not fulfil all the criteria, please apply as you may still be the best candidate for this role or another role within our organisation.

We are also open to discussing part time, flexible, and hybrid working options if suitable within the role.

title: Investor Oversight Services Analyst
description:
The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.

Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.

That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.

Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry-changing realities.

For our business, for clients, and for you

Investor Oversight Services Analyst


Job Summary

This role involves monitoring the day-to-day fund operations for a number of Irish domiciled collective investment schemes, including daily oversight of the third party fund administrators, depositaries and investment managers contracted by those funds.


Core Expectations & Contributions at this Level

Client Delivery

  • Oversee the delegated Transfer Agents to deliver top class service levels via supervision of service delivery through the ongoing compliance with SLAs, timely and accurate reporting including appropriate KPIs and periodic service review calls and onsite review meetings.
  • Day to day oversight of the Administrator’s activities in processing investor dealings and resolving investor enquiries.
  • Assist in the reviewing the Administrator’s calculations of all investor dealing related fees including; entry and exit costs.
  • Assisting in the oversight of the preparation and issuance of all investor related communications including, KI(I)Ds, and fund supplements.
  • Managing 3rd party service providers such as KI(I)D providers and data vendors.
  • Assist with the completion and distribution of scheduled third party static data files.
  • Assist clients with new fund/class launches, applying for security ID’s.
  • Prepare and deliver monthly management reporting, including Management Company and Board reports.
  • Prepare and perform monthly oversight and regulatory checks, including Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO), Ongoing charges and SRRI/SRI reviews.
  • Assisting the business development team on ad hoc projects related to transfer agency issues.
  • Demonstrate ownership, understanding, ongoing management and a client service excellence mentality in all that you do.

Compliance, Risk, Legal, AML, Audit & Regulatory

  • At all times ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and with relevant short, medium and long term objectives and values of the organisation.
  • Promote risk awareness, assessment and control within the organisation.
  • Assist with the development, implementation and maintenance of appropriate policy, procedures, process flows and job aids to meet internal control and external compliance/regulatory requirements.

Communication / Change Management

  • Effectively contribute in all relevant communication forums through being suitably prepared and performing the delivery of verbal and written submissions / conclusions as appropriate.
  • Contribute to and support the effective delivery of the Pathways Framework objectives and ongoing Communication / Engagement plan.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience Required

  • Excellent administrative, organisational and business support skills.
  • Strong communication skills with experience in managing multiple internal and external relationships.
  • Ability to work accurately to tight deadlines.
  • Proactive and able to work independently, but also with your team.
  • Working knowledge of MS Office suite including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Sound procedural, technical and product knowledge of your specific functional responsibility and the entire business /Funds Industry is preferred.
  • 1 + years financial service experience preferably with exposure to the fund industry.

Core Competencies

  • Client focused
  • Team Orientated
  • Excellent Communication Skills
  • Organised
  • Personable
  • Flexible
  • Self-Reliant
  • Enthusiastic
  • Timely, Accurate & Precise

Disclaimer: Unsolicited CVs sent to Apex (Talent Acquisition Team or Hiring Managers) by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this position. Apex operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our exclusive recruitment partners.

title: Cloud Engineer (6851)
description:
As a Cloud Engineer, you will support the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of secure AWS cloud environments supporting critical government missions.

We know that you can’t have great technology services without amazing people. At MetroStar, we are obsessed with our people and have led a two-decade legacy of building the best and brightest teams. Because we know our future relies on our deep understanding and relentless focus on our people, we live by our mission: A passion for our people. Value for our customers.

What you’ll do:

  • Build, configure, operate, and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure, including environments in AWS GovCloud, using services such as EC2, EBS, S3, VPC, IAM, and AWS Organizations.
  • Proactively pick up and manage support tickets, collaborating with teammates to troubleshoot infrastructure, access, and networking issues, implement solutions, and follow through to resolution.
  • Communicate ticket status, technical issues, and resolutions clearly to teammates and stakeholders.
  • Continue deepening AWS knowledge and technical skills, and contribute to improvements in team processes and documentation.

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Active TS/SCI with CI Poly security clearance.
  • 2+ years of experience building, supporting, or troubleshooting cloud infrastructure; plus prior experience supporting infrastructure in AWS GovCloud.
  • Experience with AWS services including EC2, EBS, S3, VPC, IAM (users, roles, policies), and AWS Organizations.
  • Experience working in a ticket-driven support environment, with a willingness to proactively pick up, troubleshoot, and resolve tickets.
  • Foundational understanding of cloud architecture principles and the AWS Well-Architected Framework, along with a conceptual understanding of cloud networking (e.g., VPCs and security groups).
  • Willingness to learn, deepen technical skills, and collaborate with teammates to troubleshoot issues and support cloud infrastructure.

Leveling and Salary:

This position may be filled at the Cloud Engineer I, II, or III level. The level offered will be determined based on the candidate’s relevant experience, technical depth, level of independence, architecture experience, and overall qualifications.

  • Cloud Engineer I: 4–7 years of relevant experience | $150,000–$185,000
  • Cloud Engineer II: 8–9 years of relevant experience | $190,000–$210,000
  • Cloud Engineer III: 10+ years of relevant experience | $200,000–$235,000

Application Deadline: Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis until the position is filled; candidates are encouraged to apply as early as possible for full consideration.

Additional Compensation: This role may also be eligible for bonuses and/or additional incentives based on individual and company performance.

Benefits: All full-time employees are eligible to participate in our benefits programs:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Paid time off (PTO) and holidays
  • Parental Leave and dependent care
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Employee assistance and wellness programs

Like we said, we are big fans of our people. That’s why we offer a generous benefits package, professional growth, and valuable time to recharge. Learn more about our company culture code and benefits. Plus, check out our accolades.

Commitment to Non-Discrimination
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit and without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

title: Advanced Software Engr
description:
As a Technical Product Owner here at Honeywell, you will be responsible for providing guidance through the product lifecycle, ensuring technical solutions are developed and delivered on schedule. You will collaborate with product management to align solutions with market and customer demand. You will be responsible for mitigating technical risks associated with new product development and providing rapid issue resolutions to minimize disruption. Through effective team leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and proactive risk management, you will contribute to the organization's competitiveness by delivering high-quality, market-relevant products.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Consult product stakeholders to understand business drivers and translate them into functional and non-functional requirements
  • You will work with Product Managers to evaluate the product Roadmap to identify features for development and identify "definition of done" for each feature
  • Engage with customers/prospects with unique ability to create partnerships over contractual relationships
  • Manage different stakeholders from across businesses and arrive at win-win solutions. Collaborate with stakeholders to define and prioritize technical requirements.
  • Lead robust, fast (through) inceptions (identify scope, value, solution and release plan) and Own prioritized actionable backlogs
  • Manage scope and drive trade-off decisions in conjunction with external stakeholders while balancing business requirements with technical requirements
  • Elicit, capture, analyze, refine and document business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and other technical documentation
  • Drive the development of technical specifications and ensure alignment with overall product strategy
  • Provide technical guidance to the development team throughout the product lifecycle
  • Research and analyze industry trends and benchmarking information as they apply to the HCI (Honeywell Connected Industrial) business model and domain area needs
  • Dissect high-level information into details and communicate details in a manner understood by relevant audiences
  • Attend standups, grooming meetings, estimation meetings, retrospectives and other key meetings for the scrum team
  • Co-own Release Plans and communicate changes to stakeholders regularly
  • Define Product roadmap based on various requirements gathered from consumers.
  • Follow complete lifecycle of project benefit, including reporting back on adoption, business value and customer satisfaction post go-live
  • Identify blockers that will impact timeline, scope, cost or other product variables and escalate to the appropriate stakeholders
  • Build and maintain strong collaborative relationships

YOU MUST HAVE

  • BTech/BE or higher in Instrumentation / Chemical / Computer Science or another related field
  • Business analysis in a complex and Cross-Functional Stakeholder environment
  • 3+ Years of experience in working with Industrial Automation Domain. Prior experience with DCS/PLC/Operator Training Simulator systems would be added advantage
  • Candidates with prior experience in Process Industry would be preferred.
  • 2+ years’ experience in Agile development environments as a Product Owner/Business Analyst
  • Proficient in multiple Agile frameworks such as Scrum, Kanban, design thinking, UX, and other frameworks. Must have good hands on with JIRA and Confluence tools usage.
  • Strong understanding of software development methodologies and processes
  • Proven ability to apply analytical and critical thinking skills to solve, or lead the solving of, strategic problems of high complexity on a large scale

WE VALUE

  • Certifications in product management or agile methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner).
  • Expert stakeholder management and commercial acumen to link both business and technical functions across a broad portfolio / large stakeholder group
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  • Attention to detail and excellent problem-solving capability.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
About iCOUNTER

iCOUNTER is redefining how enterprises defend against cyber threats originating across their extended business ecosystems.

Our AI-native Counter Threat Operating System (CTOS™) combines threat intelligence, risk determination, and operational response to help organizations identify and act on threats involving third parties, subsidiaries, portfolio companies, and interconnected business relationships.

We believe enterprises need to move beyond traditional risk assessments and static security scores toward intelligence-led, proactive defense.

We’re building a new category of cybersecurity, and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us bring it to market.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a DevOps Engineer, you’ll be a hands-on owner of the infrastructure and delivery systems behind our platform. That means architecting scalable, secure cloud environments, primarily on AWS; maintaining network designs that balance performance and security; leading the evolution of our CI/CD pipelines; and building the automation and observability that keep production healthy. You’ll also set the standard for security in the infrastructure you build, and partner closely with developers, QA, and IT operations to make shipping safe, routine, and fast.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Design and build scalable, secure infrastructure on AWS, with working knowledge of Azure and GCP

  • Design and maintain network architecture (VPCs, Transit Gateways, VPNs, IPsec tunnels, DNS) for performance and security

  • Own and evolve CI/CD pipelines so software releases are automated, repeatable, and low-risk

  • Build automation for deployment, monitoring, and operations to reduce manual work and human error

  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot complex issues, and tune resource allocation for high availability

  • Build security into infrastructure: least privilege, secrets management, hardening, and vulnerability remediation

  • Create and maintain architecture diagrams, runbooks, and process documentation

  • Work with developers, QA, and IT operations to remove friction and improve delivery and reliability

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 7+ years in DevOps, SRE, or a similar role, or equivalent practical experience, with hands-on depth in AWS

  • Strong Linux systems administration

  • Scripting proficiency in Python and/or Bash

  • Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform

  • Configuration management experience with Ansible or Puppet

  • Containerization experience with Docker and Kubernetes

  • Working knowledge of networking: TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, Transit Gateways, and IPsec tunnels

  • CI/CD experience with tools such as Jenkins or GitLab CI/CD

  • Proficiency with Git for version control and collaboration

  • Strong analytical skills and a methodical approach to troubleshooting complex systems

PREFERRED SKILLS

  • Hands-on experience with Azure or GCP

  • Experience supporting AI/ML workflows in AWS

  • A DevSecOps background or experience in a security-focused or regulated environment

  • Experience with observability tooling (for example, Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog)

  • Experience keeping high-availability production SaaS platforms running

Benefits & Perks:

  • Full Health, Dental, & Vision Coverage, with 100% employee premiums covered and 90% dependent premiums covered on base plans

  • 401(k), HSA, & FSA Plans

  • Flexible PTO

  • Meaningful equity ownership

  • Company Holidays & Paid Sick Days

  • Monthly home-office stipend for internet, equipment, or other technology needs

iCOUNTER is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. iCOUNTER provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.

Accommodation: If you need accommodations, reach out to accommodations@icounter.com.

Completion of a Background Check is required for employment at iCOUNTER
