We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced Global Trade Licensing & Compliance Lead to join our worldwide Global Trade organization. This is a highly strategic role for a recognized subject matter expert who thrives in complex international environments and can navigate evolving regulatory landscapes while enabling business growth.

The successful candidate will lead the development and management of a global licensing program, partnering with stakeholders across Legal, Supply Chain, Logistics, Sales, and Business Units to ensure compliance with export controls, sanctions, and international trade regulations. This individual will also play a critical role in assessing regulatory risk, evaluating business impacts, and shaping licensing strategies that support worldwide operations.

This position requires a deep understanding of global trade compliance, export licensing, international regulations, and the ability to translate complex legal requirements into practical business solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Global Licensing Strategy & Execution

  • Build, manage, and continuously improve a comprehensive global licensing program supporting international business operations.
  • Develop licensing strategies and secure required authorizations from government agencies and regulatory authorities worldwide.
  • Manage licenses throughout their complete lifecycle, including applications, amendments, renewals, reporting obligations, audits, and recordkeeping.
  • Drive the establishment of scalable global licensing frameworks that support business growth while maintaining compliance.

Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

  • Monitor and interpret changes in global trade regulations, export controls, sanctions programs, and other legal requirements.
  • Assess operational, commercial, financial, and compliance impacts of regulatory developments on worldwide business activities.
  • Conduct risk assessments for complex cross-border transactions, supply chain changes, market entry initiatives, and strategic business programs.
  • Develop mitigation strategies and compliance solutions that balance regulatory requirements with business objectives.

Strategic Business Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on global trade risks, licensing requirements, and regulatory developments.
  • Partner with Legal, Supply Chain, Logistics, Sales, Procurement, Business Units, and Compliance teams to support complex international transactions.
  • Provide expert guidance on trade compliance matters related to emerging markets, controlled destinations, and sanctioned jurisdictions.
  • Build and maintain productive relationships with government authorities, licensing agencies, and regulatory bodies.

Process Excellence & Leadership

  • Identify opportunities to improve compliance processes, operational efficiency, and regulatory responsiveness.
  • Lead cross-functional and cross-geography projects involving multiple stakeholders and business functions.
  • Mentor and guide colleagues on licensing, export controls, and global trade compliance matters.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen compliance programs and governance frameworks.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required.
  • Master's degree, Law degree, or other advanced qualification preferred.

Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in Global Trade, Export Controls, Trade Compliance, Licensing, or a related field.
  • Significant experience managing complex export licenses and government authorizations within multinational organizations.
  • Demonstrated expertise supporting global operations across multiple jurisdictions and regulatory environments.
  • Proven experience developing and implementing trade compliance programs, policies, and controls.
  • Experience engaging directly with regulatory agencies, licensing authorities, and government stakeholders.
  • Strong track record assessing regulatory risk and translating legal requirements into practical business solutions.
  • Experience supporting executive-level decision making regarding regulatory changes, geopolitical developments, sanctions, and market expansion.

Knowledge & Skills

The ideal candidate will possess:

  • Expert knowledge of global export controls, sanctions regulations, licensing frameworks, and international trade compliance requirements.
  • Deep understanding of U.S., EU, and international trade regulations and their application within complex global supply chains.
  • Strong knowledge of export licensing requirements, jurisdictional regulations, classification methodologies, and authorization frameworks.
  • Ability to assess the business impact of new laws, regulations, sanctions, and geopolitical developments.
  • Advanced risk assessment and mitigation capabilities.
  • Exceptional analytical skills and sound judgment in highly regulated environments.
  • Strong project and program management experience leading global initiatives.
  • Outstanding communication and influencing skills with executive leaders, regulators, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to build consensus and drive change across a multinational organization.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to balance commercial objectives, operational realities, and compliance obligations.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will:

  • Enable business growth through compliant global trade operations.
  • Establish robust licensing processes that support worldwide expansion.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate regulatory risks before they impact the business.
  • Influence strategic decisions through expert analysis of regulatory developments and their business implications.
  • Be recognized as the organization's leading authority on global licensing and trade compliance matters.

title: Senior Associate/Pricing & Market Access (m/w/d)
description:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provides clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.

Position Overview

CRA’s Life Sciences practice helps pharmaceutical, biotechnology, diagnostics and medical device companies achieve optimum performance across key aspects of their business, including innovation, commercial success, organization, and reputation, all for the long-term benefit of patients, clinicians, employees, and shareholders. We work with life sciences businesses directly as well as with their legal counsel, industry associations, government organizations, and advocacy groups from the earliest stages of research into new therapy areas, through product development, to the delivery of products that will achieve commercial success and fulfill the expectations of our clients and their key stakeholders.

Senior Associates at CRA work on project teams with senior and junior consultants on a variety of client engagements across industries. Senior Associates conduct advanced strategic analysis and assist in the management of consulting projects. They serve as a project manager, direct the work of others, oversee analysis, manage mid-level client relationships, and/or communicate project results. Staff at this level are expected to work independently with minimal supervision.

To be successful in this role, you must be able to effectively plan and manage the execution of smaller projects or significant sub-tasks on larger, more complex projects, conceptualize and analyse issues, and perform or direct a wide variety of analytical tasks. We also highly value a strong work ethic, creativity, a positive attitude, and a high level of energy. At this time, we are specifically seeking consultants with strong knowledge of pricing and access systems in Europe and globally. Typical Senior Associate responsibilities include:

  • Independently identify/design analytic tasks and contribute to the development of overall analytic framework for consulting projects;
  • Interface with client representatives to communicate developments and present results;
  • Draft reports or presentations, or sections of reports or presentations;
  • Contribute to project planning and budget management efforts;
  • Provide training and technical supervision to less-experienced staff, including reviewing their analyses and providing coaching/direction;
  • Contribute to business development efforts and draft client proposals.

Desired Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in life sciences (e.g., biology, biotechnology, biochemistry, pharmacology, chemistry etc.) or a relevant analytical degree, with significant work experience;
  • 3-6 years previous consulting experience;
  • Strong skills in quantitative and qualitative analysis methods and techniques;
  • Proven staff and project management skills;
  • Client interaction, facilitation, presentation, budgeting, and project planning skills;
  • Strong knowledge of pricing and market access issues in the European markets (and globally);
  • Occasional travel required.

To Apply

To be considered for this position, we require the following:

  • Resume – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;
  • Cover letter – please describe your interest in CRA and how this role matches your goals.

Career Growth and Benefits

  • CRA’s robust skills development programs, including a commitment to offering training annually through formal and informal programs, encouraging you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with skill building, training continues with technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.
  • We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.

Our Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Über Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates ist eine führende globale Beratungsfirma, die wirtschaftliche, finanzielle und betriebswirtschaftliche Expertise für große Anwaltskanzleien, Unternehmen und Regierungen weltweit bietet. CRA berät Kunden in wirtschaftlichen und finanziellen Angelegenheiten im Zusammenhang mit Rechtsstreitigkeiten und behördlichen Verfahren und unterstützt Unternehmen bei kritischen Geschäftsstrategien und leistungsbezogenen Fragen. Seit 1965 engagieren Kunden CRA aufgrund der Kombination aus Branchenerfahrung und rigoroser, faktenbasierter Analyse, die klare, umsetzbare Lösungen für komplexe Geschäftsprobleme bietet.

Stellenübersicht

Die Life Sciences Practice von CRA hilft Pharma-, Biotechnologie-, Medtech- und Digital-Health-Unternehmen, optimale Leistungen in wichtigen Geschäftsbereichen wie kommerzielle Strategie, Preisgestaltung und Zugang, Innovation, Organisationsstruktur, Politikanalyse, medizinische Angelegenheiten, Stakeholder-Management und Marketing zu erzielen – alles zum langfristigen Nutzen von Patienten, Ärzten, Mitarbeitern und Aktionären. Wir arbeiten direkt mit Life-Sciences-Unternehmen sowie mit deren Rechtsberatern, Industrieverbänden, Regierungsorganisationen und Interessengruppen zusammen.

Senior Associates bei CRA arbeiten gemeinsam mit erfahrenen und jüngeren Consultants in Projektteams an einer Vielzahl von Kundenprojekten in unterschiedlichen Branchen. Sie führen anspruchsvolle strategische Analysen durch und unterstützen bei der Steuerung von Beratungsprojekten. Dabei übernehmen sie die Projektleitung, koordinieren die Arbeit anderer Teammitglieder, verantworten Analysen, betreuen Kundenbeziehungen auf mittlerer Ebene und/oder kommunizieren Projektergebnisse. In dieser Position arbeiten Sie weitgehend selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich.

Für eine erfolgreiche Tätigkeit in dieser Position sollten Sie in der Lage sein, kleinere Projekte oder wesentliche Teilaufgaben größerer und komplexerer Projekte effektiv zu planen und zu steuern, Fragestellungen zu strukturieren und zu analysieren sowie ein breites Spektrum analytischer Aufgaben selbst durchzuführen oder anzuleiten. Darüber hinaus legen wir großen Wert auf eine ausgeprägte Arbeitsethik, Kreativität, eine positive Einstellung und ein hohes Maß an Engagement.

Aktuell suchen wir insbesondere Consultants mit fundierten Kenntnissen der Pricing- und Market-Access-Systeme in Europa und weltweit.

Aufgaben

  • Sie identifizieren und konzipieren eigenständig die erforderlichen Analysen und wirken an der Entwicklung des übergreifenden analytischen Ansatzes für Beratungsprojekte mit.
  • Sie stehen im direkten Austausch mit unseren Kunden, informieren sie über den Projektfortschritt und präsentieren Ergebnisse.
  • Sie erstellen Berichte und Präsentationen oder übernehmen die Ausarbeitung einzelner Abschnitte.
  • Sie wirken bei der Projektplanung und der Steuerung von Projektbudgets mit.
  • Sie unterstützen weniger erfahrene Teammitglieder bei ihrer fachlichen Weiterentwicklung, prüfen deren Analysen und geben ihnen fachliche Anleitung und Feedback.
  • Sie bringen sich in die Geschäftsentwicklung ein und wirken bei der Erstellung von Angeboten für Kunden mit.

Gewünschte Qualifikationen

  • Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss im Bereich Life Sciences, z. B. in Biologie, Biotechnologie, Biochemie, Pharmakologie oder Chemie, oder in einem relevanten Studiengang mit analytischem Schwerpunkt sowie einschlägige Berufserfahrung
  • 3 bis 6 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Beratung
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse und Erfahrung in der Anwendung quantitativer und qualitativer Analysemethoden
  • Nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Mitarbeiterführung und im Projektmanagement
  • Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt, in der Moderation und Präsentation sowie in der Budget- und Projektplanung
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse zu Pricing und Market Access in europäischen und internationalen Märkten
  • Deutschkenntnisse von Vorteil
  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen

Bewerbung

Um für diese Position berücksichtigt zu werden, reichen Sie bitte die folgenden Unterlagen ein:

  • Lebenslauf – bitte geben Sie Ihre aktuelle Adresse, eprsönliche E-Mail-Adresse und Telefonnummer an;
  • Anschreiben – Bitte beschreiben Sie Ihr Interesse an CRA und wie diese Rolle zu Ihren Zielen passt.

Karriereentwicklung und Benefits

  • CRA bietet Ihnen vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung. Dazu gehören jährliche formelle und informelle Weiterbildungsangebote, die Ihre individuelle Entwicklung ebenso fördern wie Ihre Zusammenarbeit im Team. Das Angebot reicht von Trainings zur Weiterentwicklung Ihrer fachlichen und persönlichen Kompetenzen über Präsentationstrainings und interne Seminare bis hin zu individuellem Karriere-Mentoring und Performance-Coaching durch eine erfahrene Kollegin oder einen erfahrenen Kollegen. Darüber hinaus bieten interne Initiativen die Möglichkeit, zusätzliche Führungsverantwortung zu übernehmen und sich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung von CRA einzubringen.
  • Wir bieten Ihnen ein umfassendes Vergütungs- und Leistungspaket mit attraktiven Zusatzleistungen. Dazu gehören Angebote zur Förderung Ihres körperlichen, mentalen, emotionalen und finanziellen Wohlbefindens sowie interne Unterstützung bei Einwanderungs- und Visaangelegenheiten für internationale Mitarbeitende und Geschäftsreisende.

Flexibilität am Arbeitsplatz

CRA schafft ein Arbeitsumfeld, das es unseren Kollegen ermöglicht, von der Zusammenarbeit im Büro zu profitieren, um unser Versprechen von beruflichem Wachstum, Mentoring und Inklusivität bestmöglich zu erfüllen. Gleichzeitig erkennen wir an, dass Einzelpersonen eine Reihe von Vorteilen genießen, wenn sie periodisch von zu Hause aus arbeiten. Derzeit bitten wir Mitarbeiter, im Durchschnitt 3 bis 4 Tage die Woche im Büro zu arbeiten (was Reisen zu einem anderen CRA-Büro oder zum Standort eines Kunden einschließen kann). Zu bestimmten Zeiten des Jahres (z.B. Feiertagsperioden) werden zusätzliche Remote-Arbeitsoptionen für diejenigen angeboten, deren Arbeitsverpflichtungen dies zulassen, obwohl unsere Büros für diejenigen, die dort sein möchten oder müssen, geöffnet bleiben.

Verantwortungsvoller Einsatz von KI im Recruiting

Bei CRA verstehen wir Recruiting als eine Tätigkeit, bei der Menschen eine zentrale Rolle spielen. KI und andere digitale Tools unterstützen uns zwar dabei, effizienter zu arbeiten, ersetzen jedoch nicht den persönlichen Austausch mit unseren Bewerberinnen und Bewerbern. Entsprechend erwarten wir auch von Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten, dass sie sich persönlich mit CRA und ihrer Bewerbung auseinandersetzen und sich auf die Gespräche mit uns vorbereiten. Weitere Informationen zum angemessenen Einsatz von KI im Recruiting bei CRA finden Sie auf unserer Website.

Unser Engagement für Vielfalt

Charles River Associates ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit bietet. Im Rahmen unseres Fokus auf Gerechtigkeit und Inklusion arbeiten wir daran, einen fairen und konsistenten Einstellungsprozess sicherzustellen. Wir feiern Vielfalt und sind für ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld engagiert.

title: Applied AI Architect ( Global Customers)
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic India, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises across India and the Asia-Pacific region understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.

Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation

  • Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success

  • Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work

  • Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives

  • Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack

  • Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases

  • Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams

  • Travel occasionally within India and the APAC region to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building

  • Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns

  • Collaborate across time zones with global teams while serving as the technical expert for the India market

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager

  • Experience working with enterprise customers in India or the APAC region, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders

  • Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more

  • Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders

  • Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems

  • Comfortable with Python

  • Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science

  • Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities

  • A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities

  • Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems

  • Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: AML/KYC Due Diligence Specialist
description:

title: Housing Assistant (Homelessness Prevention and Housing Options Team) - Various Locations
description:
Housing Assistant - Homelessness Prevention & Housing Options Team (HP&HOT)
Various Locations

Salary: £27,257 - £29,850
Hours: 36 per week, 52 weeks

1 x Fixed-term post until the 11th of December 2027

The City of Edinburgh Council’s Homelessness Prevention and Housing Options Team is at the frontline for tackling and preventing homelessness in Edinburgh.

An exciting opportunity has arisen for full-time HP&HOT Housing Assistants to support Homeless Housing Officers with the prevention and statutory duty requirements for households who are homeless or threatened with homelessness in Edinburgh.

All posts will be based in any of the following locations at any given time:
249 High Street, Edinburgh
North West Office – 8 West Pilton Gardens, Edinburgh
North East Office – 101 Niddrie Mains Road, Edinburgh
South East Office – 40 Captains Road, Edinburgh
South West Office – 10 Westside Plaza, Edinburgh
Working from home

Please note that at any point in your employment with the Council, you may be required to work in any location across Edinburgh, and therefore the above locations may change at short notice.

The HP&HOT Housing Assistant will work in a statutory service supporting Housing Officers to provide advice and support to customers to prevent and resolve homelessness by helping them remain in their home or, where this is not possible, secure a home.

They will assist with ongoing case management, ensuring homeless applicants access appropriate support, consider their full housing options, and bid appropriately to secure permanent accommodation.

The role will be administrative with ongoing customer contact, maintaining records and closing cases timeously. This will enable Housing Officers to focus on providing high-quality, person-centred casework to help households resolve their homelessness.

The HP&HOT Housing Assistant will fulfil the Council’s duties by working to legislative and good-practice requirements and in collaboration with other statutory services and partner organisations.

Successful candidates need resilience and excellent organisational skills, as they will work in a busy service area with competing demands. They must be able to take ownership and responsibility for their tasks and have a proven track record of working within a challenging frontline service.

title: Field Service Supervisor-Low Current System (Saudi National Only)
description:

Responsibilities include leading resource planning, performance management, talent development, and continuous improvement initiatives while leveraging Honeywell Building Solutions (HBS) tools, processes, and best practices. The position is responsible for delivering service and project execution in alignment with business objectives, contractual commitments, productivity targets, safety standards, and profitability goals. As a hands-on leader, the role also contributes directly to service delivery while maintaining overall accountability for team performance, customer engagement, and operational outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the delivery of service operations across assigned Facilities Management contracts and customer sites, ensuring contractual commitments are achieved and customer satisfaction consistently exceeds expectations.
  • Establish and maintain strong customer relationships, proactively addressing concerns, driving service excellence, and ensuring effective resolution of operational and customer satisfaction issues.
  • Review Voice of Customer (VOC) feedback, analyze trends, and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance customer experience and operational performance.
  • Drive business growth by identifying service enhancement opportunities, system upgrades, maintenance contract expansions, and additional revenue streams in collaboration with customers, sales teams, and service personnel.
  • Assume full accountability for the financial performance of the service portfolio, including revenue, profitability, productivity, resource utilization, forecasting, cost control, and achievement of operational KPIs.
  • Lead workforce planning and resource allocation to ensure the effective deployment of personnel, tools, equipment, materials, and subcontractors while optimizing operational efficiency and inventory management.
  • Drive the implementation of productivity improvement initiatives, digital tools, operational excellence programs, and best practices to improve service delivery, profitability, and customer outcomes.
  • Ensure compliance with Honeywell Building Solutions (HBS) global policies, procedures, service standards, safety requirements, and quality management systems across all areas of responsibility.
  • Develop, coach, and mentor service team members and supervisors, fostering a high-performance culture focused on accountability, customer centricity, technical excellence, and continuous professional development.
  • Establish performance expectations, monitor operational metrics, and implement corrective actions to ensure service quality, productivity, and financial targets are consistently achieved.
  • Maximize contract renewal, escalation, and growth opportunities while maintaining customer retention and minimizing contract cancellations.
  • Provide operational oversight of project estimates, resource plans, and service delivery strategies to ensure technical feasibility, commercial viability, and successful project execution.
  • Ensure service contracts, additional works, shutdown activities, and small to medium service projects are appropriately staffed, planned, and executed within budget and schedule requirements.
  • Direct the selection, performance management, and governance of subcontractors and external service providers in coordination with procurement and supply chain teams.

YOU MUST HAVE

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5-8 years of experience in field service, facilities management, building automation, or a related industry.
  • 3-5 years of experience managing or leading service teams with demonstrated success in achieving operational and customer satisfaction objectives.
  • Proven experience managing service contracts, resource planning, and service delivery performance.
  • Strong understanding of service operations, maintenance practices, and contract execution.
  • Knowledge of budgeting, cost control, and contract-level financial management.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build strong customer relationships.

Core Competencies

  • Leadership & Team Management - Ability to lead, coach, and develop service technicians and supervisors while fostering a culture of accountability, safety, and high performance.
  • Financial Acumen - Ability to understand contract-level financial performance, monitor costs, manage budgets, and implement actions to achieve revenue, margin, and productivity targets.
  • Operational Analysis - Ability to evaluate operational data, identify trends and performance gaps, and implement effective corrective actions to improve service delivery.
  • Customer Relationship Management - Ability to establish and maintain strong customer relationships, manage escalations, and ensure customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Planning & Resource Management - Ability to effectively allocate personnel, materials, tools, and subcontractor resources to meet operational and contractual requirements.
  • Continuous Improvement - Ability to drive process improvements, enhance operational efficiency, and promote best practices across service operations.
  • Results Orientation - Demonstrated ability to achieve business objectives by overcoming obstacles, making sound decisions, and delivering consistent operational results.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Senior Data Scientist

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.


As a values-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.


Senior Data Scientist

Ireland, Dublin - 3 days office


We are currently seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Senior Data Scientist at ICON, you will play a key role in designing, building and deploying advanced machine learning and generative AI solutions that move from proof of concept through to production.


You will take ownership of complex analytical challenges from end to end, partnering with business stakeholders, data engineers and product teams to deliver innovative solutions across clinical operations, feasibility and scientific intelligence.



What You Will Be Doing:

  • Leading the design, development and validation of machine learning, NLP and large language model (LLM) solutions that address priority business challenges across clinical operations, feasibility and scientific intelligence.
  • Translating complex or ambiguous business questions into well-defined analytical approaches with clear success measures and delivery milestones.
  • Designing and developing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), information extraction and agentic AI workflows using structured and unstructured clinical and operational data.
  • Applying robust statistical, experimental and causal inference methods to quantify impact and support evidence-based decision-making.
  • Partnering with Data and ML Engineering teams to take solutions from proof of concept into robust, monitored production services using Azure and Microsoft Fabric.
  • Implementing MLOps and LLMOps practices, including model versioning, reproducible pipelines, automated evaluation, and performance and drift monitoring.
  • Developing evaluation frameworks for generative AI solutions, considering areas such as accuracy, groundedness, bias, safety and cost.
  • Ensuring solutions comply with ICON's regulatory and quality requirements, including GxP/GCP, 21 CFR Part 11, GDPR and HIPAA.
  • Contributing to responsible AI practices, including model documentation, validation evidence and assessment of third-party and vendor technologies.
  • Acting as a trusted technical advisor to stakeholders and communicating complex technical findings in clear, accessible language.
  • Mentoring junior and mid-level Data Scientists through code reviews, pairing and knowledge sharing.
  • Contributing to the team's technical roadmap, reusable components and engineering standards.

Your Profile:

  • MSc or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Life Sciences or another relevant quantitative discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience delivering Data Science or Machine Learning solutions, including experience taking at least one solution into production.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience using libraries and frameworks such as pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch or Hugging Face.
  • Practical experience working with large language models, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search and RAG architectures.
  • Strong grounding in statistics, experimental design and model evaluation.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure, and modern MLOps technologies such as MLflow, Docker, CI/CD and orchestration tools including Airflow.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience within pharma, CRO, healthcare or another regulated industry would be advantageous.
  • Familiarity with clinical trial data and standards, such as CDISC, clinical study protocols, site data and investigator data, would be beneficial.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure OpenAI/AI Foundry, AKS or knowledge graph technologies would be advantageous.
  • Knowledge of causal inference, network analysis or optimisation methods would be beneficial.
  • A track record of publications, open-source contributions or patents would be an advantage.

title: VP, Customer Engineering & Success
description:
About the Team

Customer Engineering & Success is where CircleCI’s customer relationships are won, deepened, and renewed. The organization brings together the technical teams that help customers succeed with CircleCI at every stage, from the first proof-of-concept through enterprise-wide adoption and long-term partnership. It includes four groups:

  • Field Engineering, which partners with Sales on technical discovery, solution design, and proofs-of-concept, and advises high-touch accounts after the sale.
  • Technical Success Management, which guides strategic, enterprise, and commercial customers to adoption, value, and expansion.
  • Digital Customer Success, which serves SMB customers through a scaled, data-driven engagement model.
  • Support Engineering, which resolves complex technical issues for customers around the world, around the clock.

The team works across North America, Europe, and Japan and serves engineering organizations at companies of every size. CircleCI processes more than a million builds a day, so this team sees how the world’s best engineering teams ship software. It turns that insight into better outcomes for customers and a stronger product. Its work drives retention, expansion, and revenue directly.

About the Role

Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, the VP of Customer Engineering & Success leads CircleCI’s full technical customer journey, from pre-sales technical wins through adoption, support, renewal, and expansion. You’ll unite field engineering, technical success, digital success, and support engineering into one connected motion, so customers get a consistent and expert experience no matter how they engage with us.

Success in this role means higher net revenue retention, lower churn, faster time-to-value, and stronger technical win rates. It also means an organization that scales efficiently through the right mix of high-touch, pooled, and digital engagement. You’ll be the voice of the customer at the executive table and shape product priorities, go-to-market strategy, and the annual plan with insight drawn directly from how customers use CircleCI.

What You’ll Do:

  • Set the vision, strategy, and operating model for a global organization spanning Field Engineering, Technical Success Management, Digital Customer Success, and Support Engineering, and integrate pre-sales and post-sales technical engagement into one seamless customer journey.
  • Own retention and expansion outcomes, including gross and net revenue retention, churn reduction, and adoption, and partner with Sales leadership to drive technical wins and land-and-expand growth.
  • Build a coverage model that matches customer segment to engagement type (high-touch, pooled, and digital/scaled), and use data and automation to scale efficiently as the customer base grows.
  • Lead, develop, and retain a high-performing team of senior leaders and individual contributors across North America, EMEA, and APAC, and build strong succession and career paths.
  • Establish the metrics, health scoring, forecasting, and operating rhythms that give the business clear visibility into customer health, support performance, and team productivity.
  • Serve as the executive voice of the customer, working closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to influence the roadmap, improve the product experience, and align company priorities with customer needs.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 15+ years of experience in customer success, solutions or field engineering, technical support, or other technical customer-facing leadership roles, primarily at B2B SaaS companies
  • 10+ years leading leaders, including multi-function organizations that combine both pre-sales and post-sales technical teams
  • Proven track record owning and improving gross and net revenue retention, churn, and expansion metrics at scale
  • Experience building and scaling global teams across multiple regions and time zones, including follow-the-sun support operations
  • Hands-on experience designing segmented customer engagement models (high-touch, pooled, and digital/scaled) and the tooling and data infrastructure behind them
  • Strong technical foundation in software development, DevOps practices, CI/CD, and cloud technologies, credible enough to engage directly with customer engineering leaders
  • 10+ years developing go-to-market strategies tied to annual planning and quarterly execution, including headcount and budget ownership
  • Experience working at the executive level in a matrixed environment to influence Product, Engineering, and Sales priorities

Bonus Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in DevOps, CI/CD, developer tools, or platform engineering companies
  • Background leading organizations through a merger of functions (for example, combining pre-sales engineering and post-sales success teams under one leader)
  • Experience with consumption- or usage-based pricing models and the adoption and expansion motions that go with them
  • Experience building or scaling a professional services or paid technical advisory offering
  • Experience using AI and automation to scale customer engagement, support deflection, or health monitoring
  • Customer success leadership in a high-growth or post-restructure environment where you built new motions from the ground up

Expected salary range for San Francisco and the surrounding area.

$261,500—$327,000 USD

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

About CircleCI

CircleCI is the world’s largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most-used DevOps tools - processing more than 3 million jobs a day - CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster.


Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, Threshold
Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital.

CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring

At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. We use technology to support our recruiting team so they can spend more time on what matters most: getting to know you.

Where we may use AI

  • Job descriptions and messaging: AI may help draft job descriptions and role-specific messaging so they are clear and accurate.
  • Application review: For some roles, we use an AI tool to review applications, including resumes and application responses, against criteria our hiring team sets for the role. The tool generates a fit score and summary to help recruiters organize and prioritize applications.
  • Interview notes: With advance notice, an AI note-taking tool may join interviews to record, transcribe, and summarize the conversation. This lets interviewers focus on talking with you. You will be told before each interview, and you may opt out at any stage by letting your recruiter know. If you opt out, the tool will not join, and your candidacy is not affected.
  • Outreach: AI may help draft candidate outreach and scheduling messages, which our team reviews before sending.

Our commitment

AI does not make hiring decisions at CircleCI. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. No candidate is rejected based solely on an AI score. We have tools and processes in place to test for bias and to review how these tools perform, and we adjust our approach as AI technology and the laws that govern it change.

Your choices

You can ask for human-only review of your application, opt out of AI interview note-taking, request an accommodation, or ask questions about how we use AI. Contact recruiting@circleci.com. For how we handle your data, including retention, see our Privacy Policy.

Birmingham City Council Rent Service has an exciting permanent opportunity

The Rent Service is part of the Finance Directorate of Birmingham City Council and has significant responsibilities for income collection to the Housing Revenue Account (HRA). We are responsible for the annual collection of £300 million housing rents and also have responsibility for the recovery of former tenancy debt and Housing Benefit Overpayments from Local Authority tenants.

Our purpose is to maximise the collection of rent by providing our tenants with advice and support in order to prevent rent debt. We aim to promote self-sufficiency and identify vulnerable tenants at an early stage, whilst promoting and maintaining a strong payment culture and maximise income through receipt of relevant welfare benefits.

We are looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic Income Services Officer; ideally you will have experience of income collection and communicating with customers in a target driven environment.

Knowledge of county court processes and systems would be desirable

• Contacting Birmingham City Council customers by correspondence to advise them of the current situation with their rent account and to prompt contact where customers have fallen into debt so that corrective action may be taken

• Managing cases end to end, reviewing and assessing customer’s circumstances and making appropriate decisions whilst providing advice and guidance to customers in line with current policies and procedures.

• Accessing, filing and updating of information on computer systems using clear and concise language in order to summarise the content of any contact with customers and actions taken.

title: Manager, 3D Character Art - Unpublished R&D Product
description:
As a Manager, 3D Character Art in the Singapore Studio for Riot’s Unpublished R&D Product, you will channel your knowledge of color and light to explore and produce the best player value for players.

You’ll guide the exploration and execution of the 3D character content. Through your expertise, you’ll mentor and level-up the craft and game developer skills of your 3D team. You will work with the Associate Art Director to implement a 3D style that fits within the art pillars and punctuates the game design.

You’ll expand and support a high-performing external team and give them guidance and knowledge. You will set high expectations, push for growth for both each individual artist and the entire team, and streamline the production efficiency. You will use your broad knowledge of art, craft, technique, and people management, to set clear goals for your team and make sure the process of delivering those goals is as smooth as possible for your team and their stakeholders. You will ensure your team stays motivated and empowered to take ownership of creativity, you will coach your team to be a triple A team.

You will work closely with Product Leads, Delivery Leads, Stakeholders, and the Associate Art Director to stay aligned on vision and priorities. Quickly mediate and resolve craft disagreements and misalignments. Prioritize the craft’s health and support, above personally contributing to art production. Run and manage healthy and productive craft review sessions. Work closely with the other craft leads on your team to cultivate a great cohesive culture and ensure a consistent quality and style.

Responsibilities:

  • As a Manager, 3D Character Art on the team, you will oversee and be accountable for the quality of the work the team delivers and set the bar for excellence.
  • Provide craft direction for your team.
  • Provide as-needed support of all aspects of 3D production process; from set-up through production and troubleshooting
  • You will balance visual satisfaction and gameplay clarity.
  • Provide hands on craft support to the product where needed
  • Support the Associate Art Director on emergent tasks where needed.
  • Own the full lifecycle management of your team members - from selection and onboarding through performance development, feedback, and exits where necessary - ensuring the right people and skills are in place to deliver at Riot’s quality bar.
  • You will establish and maintain a highly engaged, creative, and motivated culture to unleash artists’ potential.

  • Collaborate with the Associate Art Director, art discipline leads, and Production teams in Singapore and Los Angeles to maintain consistency in workflow, and quality expectations.
  • You will be vigilantly finding creative and effective solutions to eliminate complex problems.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in 3D Character art for games, including creating high-quality stylized characters, cosmetics, or other 3D assets.
  • 2+ years in a lead or management role, providing artistic direction, feedback, mentorship, and guidance to individual artists or teams.

  • Proficiency with industry-standard 3D art tools such as Maya, 3ds Max, ZBrush, Substance Painter, and Photoshop.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience working across art disciplines such as concept art, animation, technical art, and production.

Desired Qualifications:

  • AAA game development experience, particularly creating stylized characters, skins, or cosmetic content.
  • Experience working with distributed teams or external co-development partners across regions.
  • Multilingual ability (Mandarin or other regional languages) to communicate effectively with partner studios.

  • Open paid time off
  • Retirement benefits with company matching

title: Junior DevOps Engineer
description:
At Franklin Templeton, we believe success is built through powerful partnerships. As a forward thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique.


From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success.

About the department


Our direct team is based in the USA. The team supports batch systems for FADB, our funds accounting database, and for GPW, the downstream system that reports product performance. The immediate team is currently three full-time employees.

A Junior DevOps Engineer helps build and run the pipelines, environments and monitoring that let Franklin Templeton's engineering teams ship software safely and often. This is an early-career role with strong support for learning and growth.

You will work alongside experienced engineers to automate builds and deployments, support containerized applications and Linux EC2 workloads on AWS, and keep services healthy. Your work gives development teams repeatable, reliable releases.


How you will add value


Core Responsibilities


  • You will maintain and improve GitLab CI/CD pipelines so changes are built, tested and deployed consistently.
  • You will help to support containerized applications on ECS Fargate, Linux EC2 workloads, and AWS Lambda and S3-based workflows, and help diagnose environment-specific issues.
  • You will set up and maintain monitoring, logging and alerts, and assist with incident investigation.

Strategic Responsibilities


  • You will write scripts and automation that remove repetitive manual work.
  • You will apply secure practices for secrets, access and configuration across development, testing and production.

Team & Collaboration


  • You will partner with developers to make releases smoother and repeatable.
  • You will document processes, configurations and fixes, and participate in cutover and implementation activities.

What will help you be successful in this role


1-4 years of Experience, Education & Certifications


  • Uses AI assistants as a natural part of their development workflow: for writing code, debugging, writing tests, generating documentation, and exploring unfamiliar domains.
  • Decomposes a task into parts, translates those parts into effective prompts, and iterates on those prompts until the task is complete.
  • Treats AI-generated outputs as drafts, not final, and refines them before incorporating.
  • Actively explores new AI tools, techniques, and capabilities.

Technical Environment


  • Core stack: GitLab CI/CD, AWS (Lambda, S3, EC2 and ECS Fargate), Linux, containers, and Python scripting.
  • Operating environment: AWS cloud, with some workloads on Linux EC2 and some container-based (ECS Fargate).
  • Workflow: GitLab CI/CD pipelines, Git version control, AWS Lambda workflows, [ticketing and SDLC to add].
  • Quality and reliability: monitoring, logging and alerting, and incident support.

Technical and Soft Skills


  • Foundational knowledge of CI/CD concepts and a version control workflow such as Git, ideally with GitLab.
  • Basic familiarity with containers and a cloud platform, ideally AWS, through coursework, projects or work experience.
  • Scripting skills in Python, and comfort working on the Linux command line.
  • Understanding of core operating system, networking and web application concepts.
  • Methodical troubleshooting: you form a hypothesis, test it, and confirm the cause before making changes.
  • Clear communication, effective teamwork, and a willingness to learn from feedback.
  • Exposure to infrastructure as code or configuration management tools would be a plus.
  • Familiarity with basic service health metrics such as latency, error rate and availability would be a plus.
  • Hands-on projects, internships or certifications in DevOps, cloud (especially AWS) or systems administration would be a plus.
  • Interest in applying AI to operations work would be a plus.

title: Global Trade Control Specialist
description:
Farnell

Farnell, an Avnet company, is a global high-service distributor of technology products, services and solutions for electronic system design, maintenance and repair.

In this role, you will be the go-to expert for export controls and trade compliance, partnering with teams across the business to ensure adherence to ITAR, EAR, and other global regulatory requirements while supporting secure and compliant business growth.


What's in it for you:


  • Private medical insurance
  • Meal allowance
  • Holiday allowance
  • 26 days of annual leave

Responsabilities:


  • Ensure compliance with international export control regulations, including ITAR, EAR, ECCN requirements, and other applicable trade regulations.
  • Monitor domestic and international shipments to support compliant movement of goods across global supply chains.
  • Review transactions, customers, products, and destinations to identify export control requirements and potential compliance risks.
  • Conduct customer, supplier, and business partner screening activities, including Denied Party Screening (DPS) and restricted party reviews.
  • Support export licensing activities, including license determinations, exemptions, exceptions, and documentation requirements.
  • Maintain accurate export control records, classifications, and compliance documentation in SAP and related systems.

  • Review and assist with the release of blocked orders and shipments while ensuring compliance with applicable regulations.
  • Monitor regulatory developments, embargoes, sanctions, restricted party lists, and export control updates, communicating relevant changes to the business.
  • Prepare compliance reports and analyze trade compliance data to support operational and strategic business decisions.
  • Partner with Logistics, Supply Chain, Operations, Sales, and Customer Service teams to ensure efficient and compliant business processes.
  • Deliver guidance and training on export controls, global trade requirements, and compliance best practices.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance trade compliance processes, controls, and operational efficiency.

What do we look for:


  • Previous experience in anti-money laundering or compliance department
  • To be familiar with military export control or logistics and/or export control of electronics
  • Previous experience in multinational enviroment
  • Fluency in English
  • Ability to build relationships among different departments
  • Ability to set standards for policies and procedures, for future team members

title: (114) Industrial Landscape and Spray Technician
description:
SUMMARY
The Field Service Technician I is responsible for performing comprehensive maintenance services on stormwater facilities and devices, and vegetation management services across a wide range of customer sites. The position requires hands-on fieldwork, attention to safety, and the ability to operate effectively in diverse outdoor environments.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
• High school diploma or equivalent
• Ability to travel 50 – 75% by vehicle, with overnight travel throughout territory
• Willingness to work in a team environment
• Clear vision, with or without corrective lenses, including close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus
• Proficient in using various forms of technology to complete tasks effectively and efficiently

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience of previous work-related skills, knowledge, or experience
• A valid driver’s license, good driving record, and the ability to drive company vehicles (DOT commercial motor vehicles)
• Ability to obtain and maintain a DOT medical card
• Valid state required herbicide license
• Ability to acquire a TWIC card within 120 days of hire

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
• Must have the ability to sit, kneel, bend, stand, or walk for 8-11 hours a day
• Must have the ability to routinely lift, push, pull, or move equipment of 50 pounds or more
• Must have the ability to withstand exposure to various weather conditions while completing work assignments (rain, heat, humidity, sun, etc.)
• Must have the ability to work around water and walk, stand, and move through diverse types of terrain such as uneven ground and sloped embankments
• Must have the ability to work within confined spaces
• Must be willing to be in close proximity to wildlife such as snakes, stinging insects, spiders, and other species
• Must be able to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) as necessary

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Demonstrate our five core values (Safety, Others, Integrity, Initiative, and Passion)
  • Prepare herbicides or materials for work application
  • Communicate with customers about the scope of work, timelines, and updates
  • Visually inspect all aspects of stormwater conveyance systems and document any problems found that affect functionality of the systems
  • Dispose of trash or waste materials properly in and around stormwater conveyance systems
  • Use a variety of equipment for chemical applications to manage unwanted vegetation
  • Identify designated areas for treatment to determine appropriate course of action
  • Apply knowledge of research findings to address environmental problems
  • Verify that hazardous chemicals are handled, stored, and disposed of according to IAW regulations
  • Keep record of usage and disposal of hazardous chemicals
  • Gain knowledge on immediate response expected for chemical spills and neutralize, when necessary, which includes application of bleach, setup of sock perimeter, and application of Oil-Dry as is dictated by the label and training
  • Dispose of trash or waste materials properly by following the instructions on the label under the Storage and Disposal section (unless preapproved to leave waste onsite)
  • Use technology to complete a tailgate brief and app reports throughout the day as necessary
  • Safely operate power equipment such as slope mowers, tractors, UTVs, marsh masters, and zero turn mowers
  • Safely operate handheld power equipment such as string trimmers, leaf blowers, chainsaws, hedge or brush trimmers, and saws
  • Safely use hand tools such as shovels, rakes, or axes
  • Maintain and safely operate spray equipment (ATV, UTV, Roxor, etc.)
  • Load and unload containers of materials, manually or using conveyors, hand-trucks, forklifts, or transfer augers per safety training
  • Lift, push, and pull hoses or equipment into place for application
  • Drive trucks or other vehicles to or at work sites, with or without trailers to haul supplies and tools
  • Identify and report any hazardous conditions or behaviors and defective equipment
  • Adjust, repair and service machinery and notify supervisors when machinery malfunctions
  • Manipulate controls to set, activate, and adjust mechanisms on machinery on spray application equipment
  • Direct vehicle traffic including flagging motorists and setting out signs and cones
  • Perform preventative, routine maintenance on vehicles, heavy equipment, and spray equipment
  • Clean or service machinery to ensure operating efficiency
  • Comply with all applicable traffic laws and regulations while operating a vehicle
  • Adhere to safety procedures including conforming to all OSHA standards and properly using personal protective equipment (PPE)
  • Develop skills and knowledge to obtain core herbicide applicator licenses
  • Develop skills and knowledge on the proper application of growth regulators
  • Adhere to company policies and procedures
  • Confer with supervisors to make operational decisions
  • Participate in company meetings, trainings and state licensure programs
  • Prioritize building strong relationships by effectively communicating with our customers, their needs, and expectations, to deliver exceptional customer service and a positive experience
  • Perform other duties as assigned

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
iFAST is a fintech wealth management platform headquartered in Singapore, providing a comprehensive range of investment products and services to financial advisory firms, financial institutions, banks, internet companies, multinational companies, as well as retail and high net worth investors in Asia.


Job Summary

We are looking for an application security professional to find vulnerabilities and business logic weaknesses in our business applications. You will work with developers and DevSecOps to get them fixed.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform security assessments of web, mobile and API applications using threat modelling, code scanning and penetration testing.

  • Plan and run red team exercises against applications and supporting infrastructure within agreed rules of engagement.

  • Provide security consulting to development teams on secure design, architecture reviews and threat modelling.

  • Work with developers to remediate findings, remove false positives from scan reports and retest fixes.

  • Work with DevOps to build tools and automation that improve security in the CI/CD pipeline.

  • Develop secure coding standards and train development teams on web and mobile secure coding.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, cybersecurity or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 2 to 4 years of experience in penetration testing, application security or red teaming.

  • Hands-on with Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap and similar tools; strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10 and API security.

  • Good understanding of Linux, Windows, Active Directory, TCP/IP, cloud and container infrastructure.

  • Proficient in at least one scripting or programming language (e.g. Python, Java).

  • Relevant certifications (OSCP, OSEP or similar) are a plus.

  • Ability to think outside the box and find creative ways to bypass security controls and defenses.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.


Why Join Us?

  • Work on modern AppSec practices instead of traditional “checklist security”

  • Gain hands-on exposure to AI-assisted security tooling and threat intelligence

  • Collaborate directly with engineering teams on real-world systems

  • Build highly transferable skills across security, cloud, DevOps, and AI-era engineering

  • Grow your career in one of the fastest-evolving domains in tech


Perks and Benefits:

  • Employee Share Options / Performance Shares : The company introduced the Share Options / Performance Shares Plan to recognize employees' contributions and achievements in the growth of the company.

  • Yearly Activities : Participation in outdoor activities, celebrations during festive seasons, and more exciting events!

  • Remuneration Package : Competitive salary packages that are well above market rates for those with the right potential.

  • Annual Salary Review and Yearly Bonus : Both processes will be conducted depending on the company's performance and individual work performance.

  • Coverage : Comprehensive insurance along with Medical, Dental & Optical coverage.

  • Allowances : Monthly sports allowance, Enjoy yearly department gatherings, and welcome lunches for new staffs.

  • Training : Benefit from free external and internal training providers, ensuring continuous learning and development.

  • Annual Leave : Entitlement to 21 days of annual leave.

These benefits are designed to enhance your overall well-being and ensure a rewarding working experience with us.

title: Director, Biotech Strategy Lead
description:
Director, Biotech Strategy Lead- China- Office or Home

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.


As a values-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.


Director, Biotech Strategy Lead

As a Director, Biotech Strategy Lead, you will play a key role in shaping innovative clinical development strategies and solutions for biotechnology clients globally. Acting as a strategic advisor, therapeutic area expert, and thought leader, you will bring deep understanding of drug development, clinical operations, and the biotech environment to create differentiated solutions that address client needs and support business growth.

You will partner across Business Development, Operations, Medical, Scientific, Finance, and senior leadership teams to shape opportunity strategy, engage clients, support proposals and bid defenses, and translate strategic solutions into successful operational delivery. This is a highly influential individual contributor role requiring the ability to lead through expertise, collaboration, and influence within a complex global matrix.

What you do

  • Shape differentiated clinical development and operational strategies for biotechnology opportunities, translating client objectives and scientific requirements into innovative, practical, and commercially competitive solutions.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to clients and internal stakeholders, supporting opportunity assessments, capability presentations, proposal strategy, bid defenses, and senior-level client engagements.
  • Lead the strategic development of proposals and solutions, partnering across Business Development, Operations, Finance, Medical, Scientific, and therapeutic area teams to develop compelling responses to RFIs, RFPs, budgets, and other client requirements.
  • Build trusted relationships with biotechnology clients, understanding their development priorities, advocating for their needs internally, and identifying opportunities to expand partnerships and portfolios.
  • Provide strategic oversight from solution development through execution, evaluating operational feasibility, financial assumptions, risks, KPIs, KRIs, quality indicators, and performance data to help ensure proposed strategies translate effectively into delivery.
  • Bring therapeutic area and drug development expertise to business strategy, providing insight into emerging scientific, clinical, operational, and market trends and helping teams translate these into differentiated client solutions.
  • Strengthen ICON's market positioning and capabilities through cross-functional collaboration, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and participation in client meetings, conferences, webinars, scientific forums, and other thought leadership activities.

Your profile

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Business Administration, or a related discipline; a scientific or biological sciences background is highly valued.
  • Approximately 9 or more years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, clinical research, or drug development environment, with strong knowledge of clinical development and trial operations.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting business development activities, including proposal strategy, opportunity assessment, client presentations, bid defenses, and development of client-focused solutions.
  • Strong understanding of the biotechnology drug development environment, with therapeutic area expertise and hands-on clinical or operational study execution experience highly valued.
  • Proven ability to develop strategic, operational, and commercially viable solutions, including assessment of financial assumptions, delivery models, business risks, performance metrics, and operational feasibility.
  • Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders within a global, matrixed organization without relying on direct reporting-line authority.
  • Executive-level communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills, with the ability to engage senior client and internal stakeholders and gain alignment around complex recommendations.
  • Strong business acumen, analytical thinking, sound judgment, and ability to translate scientific, clinical, operational, and commercial considerations into practical strategies and solutions.
  • Live in Beijing and able to travel approximately 25% based on business and client needs.


Employment with ICON is contingent upon having the legal right to work in the country where the role is based.


Rewards & Benefits

ICON offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and career development.


Benefits may include:

  • Competitive base salary and performance related incentives
  • Health and wellbeing programmes including medical, dental, and vision coverage where applicable
  • Retirement and pension plans
  • Life assurance and disability coverage
  • Employee assistance programmes and wellbeing resources
  • Learning and development opportunities through structured training and career pathways

Benefits may vary depending on role and location.

Inclusion and Accessibility

title: Nyhedsjournalist med skarpt blik for video
description:
Vil du være med til at lave fængende videoer og hurtige nyheder fra Faaborg-Midtfyn til ?

Så kan det være dig, vi søger til at styrke vores visuelle journalistik i Fyns største kommune.

Du bliver en del af et hold på 7 journalistiske medarbejdere med fokus på de emner og sager, som flest interesserer sig for.

Vi laver journalistik med udgangspunkt i brugerbehov og altid med hovedfokus på nyheder og de mennesker, der er en del af historien.

Rollen som lokal videojournalist er ny og skal først og fremmest hjælpe med at gøre vores journalistik mere relevant og fange opmærksomheden hos særligt de 30-50-årige.

Det er et must, at du er vild med video som fortælleform og fuld af lyst og gåpåmod til både at optræde foran kameraet som fortæller og bag kameraet som interviewer.

Selv om video kommer til at fylde meget i den nye rolle, kommer du også til at bruge meget tid på skreven journalistik.

Derfor forventer vi, at du kan finde og udvikle dine egne skrevne historier, at du kan vinkle hårdt på en nyhed, og at du kan lave en skarp digital rubrik, der giver brugeren lyst til at betale for journalistikken - måned efter måned.


Faaborg-Midtfyn-redaktionen har base i Ringe og udkommer på , på vores nye nærlokale site samt i vores trykte aviser.

Jobbet er på fuld tid og med start hurtigst muligt.

Send en kort ansøgning og cv via "Ansøg" senest den 12. november.
Vi holder samtaler løbende i uge 47 og 48.

Vil du høre nærmere om jobbet, Faaborg-Midtfyn-redaktionen og , så kontakt lokalredaktør
Torsten Cilleborg, telefon 63 45 22 19 eller redaktionschef Tim Visti på telefon 65 45 51 50.


Vi har fokus på mangfoldighed!

I JFM ser vi mangfoldighed som en styrke, og vi opfordrer alle kvalificerede ansøgere, uanset personlig baggrund, til at søge job hos os. Vi ønsker at afspejle samfundet i vores medarbejderstab, og vi arbejder aktivt med at øge diversiteten i vores virksomhed.

Skab din fremtid hos JFM

Vil du arbejde et sted, hvor du virkelig kan gøre en forskel?

Hos JFM får du chancen for at blive en del af Danmarks næststørste privatejede mediekoncern, hvor dine ideer og dit engagement er med til at styrke og skabe lokale fællesskaber.

Vores mission forandrer sig aldrig – vi støtter demokrati og sammenhængskraft med rod i det lokale. Vi arbejder med udgangspunkt i vores kerneværdier: Tillid, Ansvar og Mod.

Værdierne gennemsyrer alt, hvad vi gør, og skaber et arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi tager ansvar, stoler på hinanden og udfordrer status quo.

Med mere end 1300 kolleger fordelt på over 50 lokationer i hele landet tilbyder vi et arbejdsmiljø med højt til loftet, plads til udvikling og frihed under ansvar.
Hos os arbejder journalister, medierådgivere, specialister, konsulenter, ledere og mange andre faggrupper side om side - alle med et fælles ønske om at skabe kvalitetsindhold og kommunikere med vores store publikum.

Bliv en del af JFM, hvor vi værdsætter din nysgerrighed, kreativitet og lyst til at tage ansvar.
Her får du mulighed for at være med til at sætte dit præg på vores udvikling og bidrage til en tidssvarende, bæredygtig forretning.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Engineer/Cloud Architect.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver
