title: Extruder Operator - Kirton
description:
Contract Type: Permanent

We are looking for an enthusiastic Extruder Operator to join our Kirton Team.
About the role
The Extruder Operator is responsible for the supply of stains, removing waste and generally assisting the extrusion and setting team where required.
Key Responsibilities

Assist the I/C Extrusion in the task of setting the columns up.
Check that the correct stain jets are inserted as required make sheet and specification book
Ensure stain tubs and stain hoppers contain sufficient stain.
Remove any waste slugs until the I/C Extrusion declares the column presentable, ensuring best practices for manual handling are followed.
Ensure sand/stain chute does not run empty.
Check sand/stain tubs and if a tub is empty, replace it using overhead gantry crane.
Make up cutter wires for the Freymatic cutting table and maintain a suitable stock, ensuring eye protection is worn at all times during this operation.
Towards the end of the shift empty all waste tubs
On collection of Vehicle, carry out pre-start checks as per the manufacturers' recommendations and fill out daily logbook, reporting any defects to production foreman.
Ensure they are aware of all emergency procedures.
Drive Vehicle using best practice in accordance with the CTA or other recognised certificate/ qualification.
At all times, be aware of pedestrians and other traffic.
Stop the process at any time upon spotting malfunction, call for assistance if required in order to rectify
Report all health and safety concerns to shift supervisor, BST safety leader or management, depending on severity.

About you
Despite no formal academic qualifications or education being required, the individual requires a minimum of 3 months training period, in which they will be assessed and supervised by a competent operator and examined against a competency check sheet.
Training requirements for job role;

Company induction
Manual handling training
FLT (counterbalance) licence
COSHH Awareness training
Working at height awareness training
Gantry crane and slinging training
Fire awareness training
Dusk mask face fit training
Isolation/ lock off procedure training
Waste management awareness
Silica awareness training
Spill containment training
Control of vehicular movement training
Asbestos awareness training
IOSH Working
Mobile Phone Awareness

We don’t expect you to tick every box. If you bring the mindset, curiosity and drive to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Public Safety Ambassador
description:
This position is located on the Cornell University Campus in Ithaca, New York.

No Visa sponsorship or relocation is available for this position.


The Opportunity:

The Division of Public Safety (DPS) is a team of public safety professionals that work collaboratively with our community to keep Cornell a safe and healthy campus to learn and live. The Public Safety Division is comprised of the Public Safety Communications Center, University Police Department, Emergency Management, Clery Compliance, Access Control, Community Response Team, and Public Safety Ambassadors.

Housed within the Division of Public Safety, Cornell University’s Public Safety Ambassadors (PSA) are unarmed safety and security professionals who in collaboration with Public Safety Division Partners play a central role in ensuring a respectful safe environment to all those on Cornell campus.

In this role you will:

  • Patrol designated areas of campus to help maintain a safe, respectful environment for all those on Cornell’s campus.
  • Identify and report suspicious or hazardous situations.
  • Conduct checks of essential university facilities and equipment.
  • Ensure welcoming and safe environment through vigilance, adherence to safety protocols, and professional interactions with staff, visitors, and the public.
  • Provide static security for high-profile events, including sporting events, student events, and invited speakers.
  • Participate in planning for critical incidents and campus-wide emergencies.
  • Support emergency response efforts by working alongside Public Safety Division partners to help ensure scene safety and provide traffic control.
  • Work in integrated response teams that may include members of Cornell University EMS, Environment Health & Safety, Student and Campus Life, Community Response Team, Cornell University Police Department, and regional agencies.
  • Be available for work assignments outside regularly scheduled shifts, including security for special events, athletic contests, staffing shortages, and weather or disaster emergencies.
  • Ability to work varying schedules and hours as needed to support operational and business needs, which may include evenings, weekends, holiday, and special events.

While position responsibilities vary, every member of our community is expected to foster a culture of belonging and a healthy work environment by communicating across differences; being cooperative, collaborative, open, and welcoming; showing respect, compassion, and empathy; engaging and supporting others regardless of background or perspective; speaking up when others are being excluded or treated inappropriately; and supporting work/life integration of oneself and others.

This is a unionized position within the Cornell Police Union. The current rate of pay is $23.79 per hour.

Application Requirements:

A cover letter and resume are required for further consideration for this position. When applying through our system, please attach both your resume and cover letter in either Microsoft Word or PDF format.

Required Qualifications:

  • High School diploma or GED and 1-2 years of relevant customer or public service experience.
  • Must have the ability to work nights and weekends for additional work assignments outside regularly scheduled shifts, which may include security for special events, athletic events, staffing shortages and weather/disaster emergencies. Shift assignments may change to meet needs of the department.
  • Must possess and maintain a valid NYS Driver’s License with a good driving record. Out-of-state employees must obtain and show proof of a NYS license within 30 days of starting employment.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain background checks and meet physical requirements.
  • Must be able to pass a psychological examination.
  • Must have or be able to obtain NYS Security Guard License.
  • Demonstrated history of ethical and professional behavior.
  • Must have demonstrated interpersonal skills, customer service orientation, flexibility, and effectively communicate, both verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to effectively manage emergency situations in a calm, logical manner and make quick decisions.
  • Ability to understand, follow, and enforce safety codes, regulations, and procedures.
  • Ability to conduct security patrols without direct supervision.
  • Whether dealing with a routine call for service or an emergency, utilize a solid understanding of campus operations, while employing sound judgment, critical problem-solving skills, and empathy to resolve the situation at hand.
  • Maintain certification in Responding to Emergencies and automated external defibrillator (AED/CPR/First Aid).
  • Ability to perform the requirements as a Campus Security Authority pursuant to the Jeanne Clery Disclosure of Campus Security Policy and Crime Statistics Act (20 U.S.C. §1092 (f) (Clery Act).
  • Ability to cultivate and develop inclusive and equitable working relationships with students, faculty, staff, and community members.
  • undefined

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2 or more years of relevant security experience or public safety experience.
  • Current NYS Security Guard certification.
  • Familiarity with the university context.
  • Knowledge of public security codes, policies, and regulations.

Benefits and Perks:

title: Staff Product Manager (Runtime Team)
description:
PolyAI is the Agentic Dialog Platform for building the conversational enterprise, used to build, run, govern, and improve dialog agents at scale. Powered by Raven, a proprietary dialog model trained on more than a billion enterprise conversations, PolyAI agents are built for complexity, open at every layer, and sovereign by design. PolyAI serves hundreds of enterprises across 75 languages and 25 countries, including Metro Bank, Marriott, PG&E, and UniCredit.

PolyAI automates customer service through lifelike voice assistants that let customers lead a conversation. Our voice assistants make it possible for businesses to deliver outstanding customer service that rivals their human agents.

Our customers, which include the world’s leading logos, are expanding how they use our platform, driving automation of critical customer service operations and integrating PolyAI into their daily customer service workflows.

We’re looking for a highly technical, senior product leader to own the platform underneath everything our agents do: the runtime that serves conversations in production, the inference layer that powers our models, and the data infrastructure that feeds both. This is a deep infrastructure role with direct exposure to latency, cost, and reliability tradeoffs at scale, not a roadmap-and-backlog role. You’ll set strategy for areas other teams build on top of, working closely with engineering leadership rather than through them

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the product strategy for runtime (how conversations get served in production), inference (how our models are hosted and served, including self-hosted and third-party paths), and the data platform (how conversation and model data moves, is stored, and is queried across the business)
  • Set direction on build-vs-buy and self-host-vs-managed tradeoffs for model serving, including evaluating cost, latency, and scaling implications of infrastructure decisions before they’re made, not after
  • Build and own the evaluation framework for how we measure runtime and inference performance in production (latency, throughput, cost per minute/token, failure rates), and drive continuous improvement off that data
  • Partner directly with infrastructure and platform engineering leadership to sequence a technical roadmap that often has no visible customer-facing surface, and defend its priority against features that do
  • Own how conversation data flows into and out of the platform, including data residency, retention, and access-control tradeoffs that affect what the business can build or sell
  • Translate ambiguous technical constraints (capacity limits, model failure modes, data gaps) into decisions the rest of the business can plan around
  • Lead and influence a cross-functional group of engineers, data scientists, and infrastructure specialists without formal authority over them
  • Represent this area in exec-level conversations on cost, capacity planning, and platform risk

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 6+ years of product management or related technical experience, including a strong track record owning infrastructure, ML/data platform, or runtime-adjacent products, not just user-facing features
  • Bachelor’s degree (or foreign equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field involving AI/ML or distributed systems, or equivalent industry experience
  • Strong working knowledge of how inference and model-serving infrastructure actually works: latency budgets, GPU/node economics, self-hosted vs. managed serving tradeoffs
  • Comfortable owning a roadmap with no end-user-visible surface, and able to make the business case for infrastructure investment on its own terms
  • Experience with data platform decisions: pipelines, residency/compliance constraints, and tradeoffs between centralizing vs. fragmenting data by region or product line
  • Demonstrated ability to operate at a senior level: setting direction, not just executing against someone else’s plan, and mentoring more junior PMs
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration in a high-growth environment
  • Exceptional cross-functional communication skills, particularly translating infrastructure tradeoffs for non-technical stakeholders

Compensation

We offer a competitive base salary, shaped by your experience and location, plus equity — so you share in the value you help create.

Benefits

💰 Participation in the company’s employee share options plan

🏝 Tenure-Based PTO: You will receive 25 holidays when you join and will gain an additional 1 day after 2 years of service, then 1 day each year until capped at 32 holidays

🏡 Flexible working from home policy

🌎 Work from outside of the UK for up to 6 months each year

🫂TELUS Health EAP 24/7 - offers you and your chosen family confidential, judgment-free support for any work, health, or life challenge

🧡 Enhanced parental leave

🚲 Bike2Work scheme

📚 Annual learning and development allowance

🏡 We’re all about making WFH work for you - that’s why we offer a one-off WFH allowance when you join. Offering perks like noise-cancelling headphones or a comfortable desk chair to boost your comfort and focus!

👨‍👩‍👧 Company-funded fertility and family-forming programmes

🌸 Menopause care programme with Maven

🏥 Private healthcare and dental cover, discounts on gym members and relaxation apps, and access to a range of mental health programs

🌎 Sabbatical Program: 5-week paid sabbatical available after 5 years of employment

At PolyAI, we take great pride in our values - they guide everything we do. We believe that a strong culture leads to meaningful work and lasting impact.

Only the best
We expect the best from our people, we hire people that expect the best from themselves, and we nurture this drive for excellence.


Ownership
We care deeply about what we do. We take ownership of our initiatives, decisions and outcomes.


Relentlessly improve

Disagree and commit

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
About

is the enterprise orchestration platform for data and AI. We unify AI agent building (Merlin Agent Builder), MCP governance (Agent Gateway), integration across 700+ apps, and automation on a single platform, so enterprises can stop wrangling AI and start orchestrating it.

Our platform also includes Helix, the governed runtime for AI-built apps. Business teams build real, working apps fast with AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. Helix takes them from prototype to production with a single command, running on Tray's managed runtime with enterprise SSO, managed authentication (no hardcoded secrets), a live registry of every app and its owner, and per-app cost and usage visibility. It's how teams build with AI at speed without IT losing control.

Companies like Cisco, Airbnb, FedEx, CrowdStrike, and Capital One trust to power their most critical processes. We've been named a Gartner Visionary for iPaaS three years running, a Pioneer in the 2026 Gartner Emerging Market Magic Quadrant for No-Code Agent Builders, and included in the Gartner 2026 Hype Cycle for Agentic AI.

The Role

As a Technical Support Engineer at , you're the person customers turn to when something isn't working, or when they're trying to build something they haven't built before. You'll troubleshoot issues across our orchestration and AI platform, from connectors and authentication to AI agents, MCP, and Helix-deployed apps, and get customers back to building.

This isn't a script-following, ticket-closing role. We need someone who digs into logs, reproduces problems, finds the root cause, and explains it clearly, whether to a customer on a live call or to an engineer in a bug ticket. As our platform evolves, that increasingly means understanding how customers build with AI and helping them do it well.

We're looking for someone a few years into a customer-facing technical career who's ready to take on harder problems. You've worked tickets under SLA, you're comfortable with APIs and authentication flows, and you're curious enough to keep learning as the platform moves fast. You'll have an experienced team behind you as you grow into the full scope of the role.

What You'll Do

  • Solve customer problems. Work a queue of technical tickets in Zendesk across a range of severities, responding within SLA. Jump on live Zoom calls to speed up investigations. Analyze logs, API requests, and HAR files to identify errors and their root cause, and guide customers to a fix or workaround.

  • Bridge support and engineering. Triage bug and task tickets raised by internal teams. Reproduce and validate reported issues, propose workarounds, and route them to the right engineering team with the evidence they need. Respond to internal questions and issues in Slack.

  • Help keep the platform running. Take part in incident response and keep the status page updated, progressing to Incident Commander once ramped up. Support scheduled platform maintenance alongside engineering, and join the weekend on-call rotation.

  • Build and share knowledge. Stay current on the Tray platform, including AI agents, MCP, and Helix. Write knowledge base articles for common issues so customers can help themselves.

  • Make support better. Pass customer needs and product feedback to Product and Engineering, and contribute to team projects and process improvements.

What We're Looking For

  • Pragmatic troubleshooter. You work methodically to find the root cause, but you know when to stop. You can tell when a ticket needs a workaround now and a deeper fix later, when to escalate, and how to keep a queue moving within SLA.

  • Clear communicator. You explain technical problems in plain language, adjust to who you're talking to, and keep customers informed without being chased.

  • AI-curious. You use AI tools yourself and want to understand how agents, LLMs, and MCP work in practice, because our customers are building with them.

  • Ownership. You follow issues through to resolution, keep your commitments, and flag problems early.

Supporting strengths

  • Working knowledge of APIs (HTTP, REST, GraphQL), JSON, and authentication concepts (OAuth, SAML), and comfortable debugging API calls and network traffic.

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), databases, and data integration concepts.

  • Calm under pressure, able to juggle multiple issues of varying severity in a fast-paced environment.

Experience

  • A typical fit has 2+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as technical support, support engineering, or implementation. You'll have a degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Experience with iPaaS, integration, or automation platforms is a strong plus, as is a background in software development or cloud certifications.

Salary

If hired on the US West Coast, the total compensation for this role is $90,000–$110,000 annually. Our salary range is based on paying competitively for our size, industry, and the location of the role, and is one part of a wider package of compensation, benefits, and rewards we provide, including stock options. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skill set, and internal equity relative to peers at the company. The range above is a good-faith estimate based on the expectations laid out in this job description. However, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles and recognize that the person we hire may be more or less experienced than this job description suggests. For this reason, the actual salary may vary from the estimate provided above.

Location

is a remote-first organization. This role is remote and open to candidates based on the US West Coast. It will support US customers, with working hours aligned to US Pacific time.

Your team will fully support you to do your best work.

Our team is humble but fiercely ambitious people, who take immense pride in what they do. We work in a culture built on friendship, transparency, and above all, looking out for one another. The heart of is made of generosity and trust. It is a community built on individual interactions between people who think differently; who are always available to help, to answer questions, and to empower. You'll have endless opportunities to learn and grow in a fun, fast-paced, and open environment. We love to achieve things that haven’t been done before.

We believe in diversity and equal opportunity

We believe that in building diversity we build strength. We encourage all to apply, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

title: CX Apprentice - Service Optimisation Specialist
description:
About THG Ingenuity

THG Ingenuity is a proprietary Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) technology, robotics, and operations platform built for global ecommerce. Developed through more than two decades of operating ecommerce and retail services at scale, its software and automation capabilities have been engineered, tested, and refined through the real-world demands of managing complex commerce operations. Today, THG Ingenuity provides an integrating operating environment that enables brands to intelligently optimise the entire commerce lifecycle from browsing and checkout to AI inventory management and forecasting, automated fulfilment, carrier control, and customer experience. The platform comprises:

  • THG Fulfil: The fulfilment operating system for global ecommerce. Delivered via a proprietary SaaS and Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model, THG Fulfil orchestrates every stage of checkout, fulfilment, delivery, and customer experience through an integrated system.
  • THG Studios: The UK's most innovative creative hub, helping brands create content that connects, experiences that engage, and IP that scales, all from its end-to-end, in-house facilities.
  • THG Commerce: A cloud-native technology stack enabling retailers and brands to create intelligent, AI-powered, digital shopping experiences, while integrated marketplace and social commerce functionality allows brands to reach customers across every sales channel

With its expertise in building and scaling brands, THG Ingenuity is uniquely positioned to bring pertinent, pragmatic, and global know-how across all aspects of commerce.

What’s the role?

Job Title: CX Apprentice - Service Optimisation Specialist

Reports to: Head of Service Optimisation

Apprenticeship: Customer Service Specialist - Level 3

Duration: 12-18 months, subject to learner progress + End Point Assessment

Perfect opportunity for a recent school/college leaver.

Applicants should have a personal interest in technology, applications and data.

To support the Service Optimisation function within Customer Experience, helping resolve and prevent order issues, manage customer and client requests, and continually improve service processes and the customer journey.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support resolution of stuck or at-risk orders, including orders held in reserve pending, stuck order/stock tickets, and split shipment issues.
  • Help manage warehouse next-day/same-day delivery (NDD/SDD) failures and review outstanding warehouse shipments.
  • Process manual order uploads and support management of outstanding client orders.
  • Carry out bulk customer actions, including bulk communications and bulk account credits.
  • Support client delivery configuration changes, including pricing rules, delivery rules, checkout text, and destination/site locale settings.
  • Assist with new account setup in Delivery Manager and help maintain late communication logic and triggers.
  • Review current processes and workflows, helping identify and implement amendments that improve the customer journey.
  • Complete all daily tasks within agreed timescales to help ensure a consistently excellent standard of service.

What We Need From You

  • A proactive, detail-focused approach, dedicated to resolving and preventing problems
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to spot trends and patterns
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Good Excel skills and confidence learning bespoke internal IT applications
  • GCSEs (or equivalent) at Grade 4 or above in English and Maths, or working towards Functional Skills Level 2
  • Proactively manage your own learning, working closely with your training provider to meet course deadlines and complete tasks on time

What You'll Get In Return

  • A fully funded Customer Service Specialist (Level 3) apprenticeship qualification
  • A competitive apprentice salary
  • 20% of your working week protected for off-the-job (OTJ) training, on top of your day-to-day role
  • Learning directly from industry experts and professionals throughout your apprenticeship
  • Free lunches on site
  • GP access & Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)
  • Additional wellbeing support, including on-site physio and dentist

title: Commercial Insights Analyst
description:
Commercial Insights Analyst
India or Philippines | Hybrid | Moving Services

One Team. One Purpose. One Global Impact.
Every relocation begins with people. Every move creates opportunity. At Sirva, we're united by one shared purpose: helping people and organisations move forward. Join us and you'll build a career where your work makes a difference every day.

MOVE WITH PURPOSE
Your Impact Starts Here
The Commercial Insights Analyst plays a critical role in transforming data into actionable business insights that drive revenue growth, profitability, pricing optimisation, sales effectiveness and operational performance. This role will closely support the Consumer Sales leader to identify trends, evaluate performance, support commercial decision-making and improve business outcomes. The successful candidate will combine strong analytical capabilities with commercial acumen to help the business understand what is happening, why it is happening, and what actions should be taken.
The role will also support the translation of commercial strategy and insights into customer-facing sales tools, proposals, templates and communications, helping ensure the Consumer Sales organisation presents a consistent, compelling and commercially disciplined proposition to customers.
In this role, you will:
Commercial Performance Analysis

Analyse sales, revenue, profitability and client performance data to identify trends, opportunities and risks.
Develop recurring and ad-hoc reporting that supports commercial decision-making.
Monitor key performance indicators and provide insights to leadership teams.
Conduct root-cause analysis on business performance issues and recommend actions.
Translate performance insights into practical recommendations that improve sales effectiveness, conversion, revenue and profitability.

Revenue and Growth Insights

Support forecasting, pipeline reporting and revenue analysis activities.
Identify drivers of client segment growth, retention, and profitability.
Analyse win/loss data and sales effectiveness metrics.
Support evaluation of sales initiatives and changes to determine their impact on revenue, conversion and profitability.

Pricing and Commercial Strategy

Support the development and execution of pricing strategies across products and services.
Analyse pricing performance, margin trends, discounting practices and deal profitability.
Evaluate pricing proposals and commercial terms to ensure alignment with revenue and profitability objectives.
Conduct pricing elasticity, competitive benchmarking and market positioning analysis.
Identify opportunities to improve pricing consistency, governance and commercial discipline.
Develop models and scenarios to assess the commercial impact of pricing changes.
Monitor profitability and recommend pricing improvements to improve margin performance.
Support the translation of pricing strategy and methodology into practical tools, templates and guidance for Sales teams.

Client and Market Intelligence

Monitor market trends, competitor activity and industry developments.
Produce client segment analysis to identify cross-sell, upsell and retention opportunities.
Support strategic planning through market and competitive intelligence.
Identify opportunities to strengthen the customer value proposition based on market intelligence, competitive positioning and sales performance.

Sales Commercial Content, Templates and Proposals

Own and maintain customer-facing sales templates, proposal formats and commercial presentation materials to ensure they are consistent, current and commercially effective.
Develop and continuously improve proposal templates, quotation support materials and sales collateral that enable Sales teams to communicate the customer value proposition clearly and consistently.
Partner with Sales, Marketing and other business functions to ensure outward-facing sales communications align with brand standards, commercial strategy, pricing methodology and the customer proposition.
Establish appropriate governance for sales templates, proposals and customer-facing commercial materials, including version control, ownership and regular review.
Use customer, sales and performance insights to identify opportunities to improve the effectiveness of sales communications, proposals and supporting materials.
Support the rollout and adoption of new sales materials, commercial tools and templates across the Consumer Sales organisation.
Ensure changes to pricing, products, commercial policy or customer propositions are accurately reflected in relevant Sales materials and templates.

Executive Reporting and Dashboard Development

Create dashboards, scorecards and visualisations that communicate complex data clearly.
Prepare executive presentations and board-level reporting materials.
Translate analysis into practical recommendations for business leaders.
Develop reporting that connects sales activity and funnel performance with revenue, margin and commercial outcomes.

Business Partnering

Collaborate with Sales, Finance, Marketing and Operations leaders to understand business challenges.
Support commercial initiatives with financial and operational analysis.
Act as a trusted advisor by providing fact-based recommendations.

Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, data quality and analytical capabilities.
Support the implementation of data governance and reporting standards.
Help drive a culture of data-led decision-making across the organisation.
Support continuous improvement of the tools, information and commercial frameworks used by Consumer Sales.

GROW WITH INTENTION
What You’ll Bring

Bachelor’s degree in business, Economics, Statistics, Finance, Marketing, Data Analytics, or a related field.
2-5 years of experience in commercial analysis, business intelligence, sales analytics, market research, or data analytics.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and provide actionable insights.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query, formulas).
Experience with Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or other data visualization and reporting tools.
Knowledge of sales performance metrics, revenue analysis, forecasting, pricing, and market trends.
Experience working with CRM systems such as Salesforce or similar platforms.
Strong communication and presentation skills to translate data into business recommendations.
High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Experience partnering with commercial, sales, marketing, and leadership teams.

Belong at Sirva
At Sirva, we are committed to creating an environment where employees can thrive professionally and personally. We encourage innovation, value diverse perspectives, and empower our people to make a meaningful difference every day.
Whether you're collaborating across borders, learning from experienced colleagues or celebrating shared achievements, you'll be part of a culture built on trust, respect and inclusion.

Being part of a truly global organisation means your opportunities can grow as far as your ambitions. From flexible ways of working and wellbeing initiatives to learning, development and financial rewards, we're committed to helping you thrive—both professionally and personally.

Hybrid working Core Flex Hours

Ready to Move Forward?

description:

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Business Group: Personal Workspace Solutions (PWS)


The Role and the Team
At Logitech, we don’t just build tools—we bridge the gap between people and the digital world. As AI transforms that relationship, the PWS New Ventures team is defining what the personal workspace becomes next, beyond our existing categories.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the New Ventures team in Lausanne. You’ll drive new product concepts from first user insight to launch, across hardware, software and AI. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit, a deep appreciation for human-centred experiences and the technical grounding to bridge high-level experience design with low-level engineering, this role is for you.

The role is based on site in Lausanne three days a week, with up to 20% travel.

Your Impact
In this role, you will shape new experiences that help millions of people work, create and connect in new ways. You will:

  • Identify, explore and validate white-space opportunities for the personal workspace at the intersection of AI, hardware, software and human-computer interaction.
  • Lead AI-enabled products from concept to launch, acting as the bridge between Design, R&D and business teams.
  • Balance desirability, feasibility and viability, combining a strong understanding of user experience with sound technical architecture and sustainable business models.
  • Stay close to users at every stage, turning research, prototypes and real-world feedback into insights that drive product decisions.
  • Build a clear point of view on AI and emerging interaction technologies, and on what they mean for Logitech and the future of the personal workspace.
  • Partner with business leads to build the case for new opportunities where historical data doesn’t yet exist, and decide with evidence when to scale, pivot or stop.
  • Turn early-stage innovations into lasting businesses that reach new users, new markets and new revenue streams.

Key Qualifications
 You will bring the following skills and behaviors to our team:

  • 7+ years in product development, including successful launches of combined hardware and software products.
  • A proven 0-to-1 track record: building products from scratch with high autonomy, strong ownership and the resilience to push through ambiguity.
  • A strong grasp of AI, from on-device intelligence to AI-powered software and agentic workflows, and a clear sense of where it creates real value both for your own ways of working and for end-users.
  • A human-centred approach to product development, grounded in deep user understanding, rapid prototyping with latest AI tools, and design thinking, and the sound judgment to stop or pivot concepts when user evidence doesn’t hold up.
  • Confidence in navigating technical deep-dives, moving from high-level user experience discussions down to mechanical design, firmware, software and AI architecture.
  • Strong business acumen to partner effectively with business and commercial teams.
  • The leadership and communication skills to align and motivate cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders at all levels in the organization.
  • Consumer electronics experience, ideally across both B2C and B2B
  • Experience from a high-growth startup or corporate venture team is a plus.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Education

  • Degree in engineering, design, business, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience. An MBA is a plus.

Logitech is the sweet spot for people who are passionate about products, making a mark, and having fun doing it. You will play a key role in the functional verification of designs, from developing block-level and system-level verification plans to writing test sequences, executing tests, and collecting and closing coverage.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute block-level and system-level verification plans.
  • Write and execute test sequences and collect and close coverage.
  • Collaborate with RTL designers to debug failures and refine verification processes.
  • Utilize coding and protocol expertise to contribute to functional verification.
  • Develop user-controlled random constraints in transaction-based verification methodologies.
  • Write assertions, cover properties, and analyze coverage data.
  • Create VIP abstraction layers for sequences to simplify and scale verification deployments.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 6 years’ experience in supporting or developing complex SoC/silicon products for server, storage, and/or networking applications.
  • Strong academic and technical background in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering (bachelor’s degree required, master’s preferred).
  • Professional attitude with the ability to prioritize tasks, prepare for customer meetings, and work independently with minimal guidance.
  • Knowledge of industry-standard simulators, revision control systems, and regression systems.
  • Entrepreneurial, open-minded behavior and a can-do attitude, with a focus on customer satisfaction.

Required Experience:

  • Interpreting PCIe/CXL standard protocol specifications to develop and execute verification plans in simulation environments.
  • Experience using Verification IPs from third-party vendors for PCIe/CXL, focusing on Gen3 or above.
  • Ability to independently develop test plans and sequences in UVM to generate stimuli.
  • Experience writing assertions, cover properties, and analyzing coverage data.
  • Developing VIP abstraction layers for sequences to simplify and scale verification deployments.

Preferred Experience:

  • Expertise in verifying Physical Layer, Link Layer, and Transaction Layer of PCIe/CXL protocols, including compliance on PCIe/CXL EP/RC.
  • Experience with buffering and queuing with QoS on complex NOC-based SoCs.
  • Analyzing performance at the system level on switching fabrics.

We know that creativity and innovation happen more often when teams include diverse ideas, backgrounds, and experiences, and we actively encourage everyone with relevant experience to apply, including people of color, LGBTQ+ and non-binary people, veterans, parents, and individuals with disabilities.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Williams International is a privately-owned company that develops and manufactures jet engines for both military and commercial aircraft applications. We are a company of creators who deliver pioneering ideas and technologies that lead the aerospace industry. Our culture fosters creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning to position our team members to inspire each other and provide quality products and supporting services that exceed the expectations of our customers.

The Opportunity

Williams International has an exciting opportunity for a Data Engineer to join our team. The Data Engineer will be responsible for developing and supporting data engineering projects by providing technical expertise and/or guidance to all levels of the organization as needed and will work within assigned departments to provide specialized technical input to department function.

This position is 100% on-site. U.S. Citizenship is required.

The Data Engineer's responsibilities will include:

  • Build and maintain enterprise ontologies, data catalogs, and metadata systems
  • Design and implement scalable batch and streaming ingestion pipelines
  • Develop and optimize data lake, warehouse, and lakehouse environments
  • Create robust data models and curated, high-quality datasets
  • Establish and maintain data quality, validation, lineage, and governance standards
  • Implement security, compliance, and policy controls for all data assets in alignment with cybersecurity requirements
  • Optimize pipeline performance, reliability, cost, and observability
  • Manage data platform tooling, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD for pipelines
  • Work with DBAs to design and optimize database schemas, configure database settings, and ensure data availability and reliability
  • Assist with query optimization and data systems related troubleshooting
  • Collaborate closely with software, engineering, analytics, business, and IT teams

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or related field is required.

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience working with enterprise data systems, including:
    • Designing and maintaining data ingestion pipelines (batch and/or streaming)
    • Building and optimizing ETL/ELT workflows
    • Working with multiple data storage solutions from relational and nonrelational databases to data lakes, warehouses, and lakehouse architectures
    • Writing performant SQL and developing data models
    • Managing data quality, validation, lineage, and governance processes
    • Developing and maintaining ontologies, taxonomies, and semantic data models to support enterprise data consistency and discoverability
  • Proficiency in Python, C#, and SQL, including experience writing production-grade data processing code.
  • Experience with cloud data environments (Azure, AWS, GCP) including storage, compute, networking, and orchestration services used for data pipelines.
  • Familiarity with enterprise systems and integration tools, such as ERP, MES, PLM, or API-based data exchange.
  • Experience with version control systems (Git, Bitbucket) and agile development practices.
  • Experience with working with containerization or orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) to operationalize or scale data workloads.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to work independently to identify and solve complex problems.
  • U.S. citizenship is required
  • Position requires the ability to obtain a U.S. Government Security Clearance, if needed. Candidates selected may be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Additional Information

Williams International is a Drug Free Workplace where all new team members and contractors are subject to pre-employment drug testing for the following controlled substances: marijuana, cocaine, PCP, amphetamines, opioids and alcohol as policy dictates.

title: EHCP Coordinator
description:
Welcome to Aurora Foxes, a specialist college and training hotel for young people with learning disabilities, situated in the friendly seaside town of Minehead. Foxes is a very special place.

This is a unique opportunity to make a real difference to the lives of our young people in an operational hotel environment that supports our students to learn the skills, knowledge, and confidence they need to successfully shape their own future. Our aim is to equip our young adults with the life and hospitality skills to become work ready, life ready.

Your Role:

As our EHCP Coordinator, you will be primarily responsible for the administration, coordination, and facilitation of the college's Annual Review of Education Health & Care Plan process. In addition, you will acts as the first contact to customers by responding to external and internal written and telephone queries relating to EHCP processes.

The EHCP co-ordinator will ensure that the EHCP process is conducted accurately, timely and effectively across all provisions, in line with statutory and local requirements for reporting. This will include supporting in the co-ordination and attendance at EHCP review meetings. Throughout the process the EHCP Co-ordinator will be a point of contact for external agencies, staff, parents and carers who have EHCP process queries.

Key Duties:

  • Coordinate the EHCP process, from initial report gathering through to submission of paperwork to local authorities.
  • Arrange, facilitate, and administrate timely Annual Review meetings, including inviting attendees and distributing reports in accordance with statutory timescales, using the relevant paperwork.
  • Ensure that the Annual Review meeting chair takes ownership of the Annual Review meeting and sets appropriate targets/amends EHCP outcomes as appropriate.
  • Submit the Annual Review paperwork to the local authority, ensuring that the college's recommendations are supported by professional reports and that students/parents/carers are provided with advice and guidance, and are signposted to the relevant resources/services if a change of educational placement/provision is expected.
  • Maintain an administrative overview of Annual Reviews on the relevant college system.
  • Ensure that the relevant professional is invited to the meeting, in cases where the student is expected to progress into a new area, e.g., Apprenticeship, Supported Internships, Traineeships, Higher Education, Employment, Adult Social Care etc.
  • Deliver/assist in the delivery of staff training relating to statutory processes linked with Education Health and care plans.

Successful candidate qualities:

  • Educated to level 2 GCSE standards and/or relevant experience
  • Grade 4/C GCSE English and Maths
  • Experience in using IT
  • Experience in reporting writing
  • Experience in dealing in a professional capacity with a broad range of people
  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely at all levels
  • Ability to be self-motivated, to reflect on own performance within a role and to identify areas of learning/improvement
  • Ability to multi task whilst having exceptional attention to detaill
  • Flexible approach to work and work area, working outside normal hours when reasonably required to do so
  • Understanding of safeguarding
  • Understanding of the benefits of equality, diversity and inclusion within society
  • Understanding of the principles of Data Protection
  • General Awareness of the Special Educational Needs and Disability Code of Practice 2015
  • Knowledge of EHCP processes and procedures
  • Accurate typing and minute taking skills
  • Organisation skills and good time management
  • Ability to manage own time to deal with multiple tasks.
  • Able and willing to work as part of a team.

How to apply?

For candidates that haven't worked in this sector before please be aware that for regulatory reasons the application process is far more detailed and thorough compared to other sectors.

Please complete the online application form in full, including all employment and education details, and provide a personal statement that makes us keen to speak to you.

If you need any assistance or would like any more information, please contact Emma in the Aurora Group Recruitment Team at Emma.McKay@theauroragroup.co.uk

Successful applicants will be subject to pre-employment safeguarding checks including an enhanced disclosure and barring service (DBS) check.

The post is exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 and the Aurora Group is therefore permitted to ask job applicants to declare all convictions and cautions (including those which are "spent" unless they are "protected" under the DBS filtering rules) in order to assess their suitability to work with children.

The Aurora Group is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of the children and young adults in our care and is a disability confident and equal opportunities employer.

This advert could be taken down at any point in time without prior notice if the position is filled.

Please note that candidates that are shortlisted might be subject to an online search.

title: Senior Manager, Analytics
description:
About Arena Club

Arena Club is building the number one digital marketplace for collectibles. We started by reinventing the hobby with the first-ever digital card show, and we are expanding into new categories so collectors can buy, sell, grade, and showcase everything they care about in one place. Our 'Slab Pack' product brought the mystery and chase of opening physical packs of cards to a digital format, and has led to Arena Club being one of the fastest-growing (and highly profitable) companies in Los Angeles. Our business was founded by 5x World Series Champion Derek Jeter and serial entrepreneur Brian Lee, who previously founded LegalZoom and The Honest Company.

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Senior Manager to anchor, scale, and lead our data analytics function. As our first dedicated analytics leader, you will serve as the principal data partner to Marketing, Finance, Product, and Operations. You will also balance strategic leadership (defining core KPIs, managing stakeholder intake, and mentoring a growing team) with high-impact execution, presenting insights directly to executive leadership. This role is ideal for a builder who thrives in high-growth environments and wants to shape the data culture of a scaling marketplace.

What You Will Do

  • Team Leadership & Scaling: Manage and mentor our founding analyst and senior analytics engineer, establishing best practices for code review, documentation, and career growth
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Act as the primary analytics partner for Product, Marketing, Finance, and Operations, translating complex business problems into structured data initiatives
  • Data Strategy & Governance: Establish a centralized intake and prioritization framework to align analytics resources with high-impact business goals; define and own core company KPIs to ensure a single source of truth
  • Advanced Analytics & Modeling: Remain hands-on in the data; design and deploy predictive models (e.g., LTV, churn, propensity, and demand forecasting) to optimize marketplace mechanics
  • Experimentation & Attribution: Design, execute, and analyze A/B tests and incrementality frameworks, including holdout designs for marketing promotions and customer loyalty initiatives
  • Insights & Executive Communication: Proactively surface growth opportunities and deliver narrative-driven, actionable recommendations to leadership to guide strategic decision-making
  • Data Architecture Collaboration: Partner closely with Data Engineering to define requirements for core data models, ensuring downstream data structures support robust business analysis

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field)
  • 6+ years of progressive experience in product, business, or marketplace analytics; 2+ years of experience managing, mentoring, or leading technical reports
  • Proficiency in SQL (advanced CTEs, window functions, query optimization) and hands-on experience building predictive models using Python or R
  • Strong command of analytics frameworks such as cohort retention, multi-touch attribution, funnel analysis, and user-journey mapping
  • Comfortable operating within a modern data ecosystem (e.g., Snowflake, dbt, BI tools like Omni/Looker/Tableau)
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, LLMs, AI coding assistants) to accelerate analytics workflows and code production
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to distill complex quantitative findings into clear business strategies for executive and non-technical audiences

The base salary range listed is a guideline. Actual compensation is determined based on skills, experience, and the impact you bring. Total compensation includes base salary, bonus, and equity.

Salary Range
$140,000—$200,000 USD

title: Member Service Representative 1 - Union
description:
**Posting Deadline: Please submit your application by 11:59 PM PST, November 18, 2026**

Position Type: Permanent

Together, Let’s Do Great Things!

We're a financial services co-operative with an expansive reach on Vancouver Island, the Gulf and Discovery islands and North Central BC. Joining us is your chance to work, and do good, locally. We are looking for a Member Service Representative, so if you’re passionate about improving people’s financial health and have experience with sales and service, we’d like to hear from you.

What’s the role?

As a Member Service Representative, under direct supervision you will process a variety of financial and non-financial transactions for members within the guidelines established. Coastal Community Credit Union strives "to be the leaders in building relationships that improve financial health, enrich people’s lives and build healthier communities" and it is your responsibility as a Member Service Representative to be the primary point of contact for members and carry the vision statement forward in order to build, maintain, attract and expand the member’s relationship with the credit union.

Your duties will include:

  1. Accurately processes a variety of transactions to meet the needs of our members.
  2. Providing sales and service expertise to inform members of new products/services and changes to existing products/services.
  3. Answering telephone inquiries.
  4. Providing members access into safety deposit boxes.
  5. End of day processing and balancing to be completed in a timely manner as per established procedures.
  6. Performing other related duties as assigned.

What are we looking for?

  • A secondary school diploma with academic emphasis
  • 1 year post-secondary education
  • Up to 1 year of work experience in a sales and service position

Ideally, you are a flexible, collaborative team player with:

  • Keyboarding skills of 40 wpm and computer terminology are required, in addition to proficiency with Windows products such as Outlook, Word, and Excel applications.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to articulate in a clear, concise manner is required to transfer information and understanding to members.
  • Effective listening skills to engage members in conversation to understand and identify their immediate financial needs, and provide resolution through sourcing information, matching an appropriate product/service and/or referring members to the appropriate individual to complete their request.
  • The ability to multitask with keyboarding and internet/computer navigation skills for searching on-line client data and product information while simultaneously conversing with the member is essential to ensure that members receive excellent member service.
  • Interviewing skills and the ability to ask probing questions are required, as well as having the flexibility to adapt to each request and move between a variety of member concerns/questions/requests.

If you’re an approachable problem solver who embraces self-development and life-long learning, you’ll be a great fit with us.

Who are we?

Established in 1946, Coastal Community Credit Union puts people's needs first and invests in communities across Vancouver Island, the Discovery and Gulf Islands, and in North Central BC. We’re proud of the legacy we’ve built and the things that make us who we are:

  • We’re 100% member-owned, with all decisions made locally—right here in BC.
  • We’re a growing organization with $5.6 billion in assets under management.
  • Coastal Community helps improve the financial health of over 110,000 members as well as insurance and wealth clients through our 32 branches, 19 insurance offices, our business centres, plus our wide range of online and digital services.
  • We believe in making meaningful contributions to the communities we call home through grants, education awards, sponsorships, and fundraising.

At Coastal Community we are dedicated to serving our local community by prioritizing diversity, equality, inclusion, and supporting a sense of belonging for all. We value every individual’s unique experience and perspective. As a result, we empower individuals to achieve their financial goals, enrich lives, and build healthier communities.

Embarking on a journey with Coastal Community means joining an exceptional team, engaging in meaningful work, and enjoying fulfilling experiences along the way. We take pride in offering a comprehensive total rewards package and a workplace culture that’s second to none. This includes a commitment to work/life balance, a substantial extended benefits package, an impressive 11.75% employer-paid RRSP contribution, investments in your education and training, banking perks, and so much more! Join us and be part of a community that values your growth and success!

Full Time Role Range (Annual Salary) - $44,187.96 to $52,236.84

We welcome existing MSR2 employees to apply internally for this role and your current wage range would be applicable.

The wage ranges provided are based on the Union collective agreement.

If this role resonates with your passion and skills, we would love to hear from you.

title: Rigger Technician
description:

We are seeking a full time Rigger Technician to join our team in Long Sault, ON.

As a Rigger Technician, you’ll fabricate, set up, and repair rigging, supporting structures, hoists, and pulling gear, using hand and power tools according to customer requirements. All training is provided.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Enjoys hands-on, physical work
  • Has a strong mechanical aptitude
  • Prioritizes safety in everything they do
  • Can read a tape measure and follow instructions accurately
  • Is willing to learn a specialized trade

Experience in rigging, fabrication, warehouse, construction, manufacturing, or other physical work environments is an asset, but the right attitude and willingness to learn are just as important.

What we offer:

  • Competitive wage ranging from $20 to $22 per hour depending on experience
  • Generous RRSP matching program 5% (after one year)
  • Full health and dental benefits (shared costs)
  • Great schedule-Monday to Friday 8 - 4:30
  • Ongoing training and professional development
  • A supportive, safety-first team environment
  • Opportunities to build a long-term career

What You’ll Do:

  • Ensure a quality product is produced, as per the company quality standards
  • Organize, clean, and ensure overall maintenance of the rigging workspace

  • Previous experience working with wire rope is considered a strong asset

Please note: Successful candidates will be required to pass a criminal background check; drivers abstract and reference checks as a condition of employment.

Why build your career with HGC?
- Canadian owned. National opportunities: We're proudly Canadian owned and operated, with teams serving customers and industries across Canada.
- A diverse group of businesses: Our operations span lifting and rigging, crane services, inspections, industrial supply, NDT, machining, fabrication, training and more — creating exposure to different skills, industries and career paths.
- We invest in our people: We provide ongoing training and development beyond your initial onboarding so you can continue building your technical knowledge and capabilities.
- Room to grow: We believe in developing our people and promoting from within wherever possible. As Hercules grows, employees can pursue opportunities within their branch, another location, or across our broader group of companies.
- Work that matters: Our teams help keep Canadian industry operating safely and productively. The work you do here has a purpose.

title: Global ITP Implementation Analyst
description:
AFL manufactures industry-leading fiber optic cable, connectivity and accessories and provides engineering and installation services for some of the largest telecom customers in the world. Our company was founded in 1984 with a single fiber optic cable and today, we manufacture thousands of products, generate an excess of $4B in revenue, and employ approximately 12,000 associates worldwide. At AFL, we recognize that our employees are our greatest asset. We hire and train each individual, investing in them to ensure success in their careers. With a commitment to professional development and growth, let us connect you to your next career opportunity.

What We Offer:

  • A hybrid in office schedule for qualifying employees
  • Flexible time off policy
  • 401K Company match (up to 4% - dollar for dollar)
  • Professional development, training, and tuition reimbursement programs
  • Excellent medical, dental, vision, and life insurance policy options
  • Opportunities for career advancement with an industry leading company!

We are seeking a Global ITP Implementation Analyst to join our Integrated Tactical Planning team at our corporate office in Duncan, SC. This role will work closely with cross-functional teams, including Commercial, Client Success, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Scheduling, Purchasing, Operations, Finance, Data Governance, IT, and BI. The analyst must also be able to work independently, act as a change agent, and challenge manual ways of working by demonstrating better approaches and helping teams adopt AI-enabled processes. The analyst will lead smaller improvement initiatives, support larger global workstreams, and convert business needs into practical solutions that reduce preparation effort, accelerate root-cause analysis, and improve the team’s ability to make and keep promise dates.

Key Outcomes

  • AI and low-code automation solutions are identified, implemented, adopted, and sustained.
  • Manual meeting preparation, follow-up, and recurring reporting effort are reduced.
  • ITP exceptions, likely root causes, and potential solutions are identified faster.
  • ITP processes, standard work, action tracking, and escalation routines are implemented and consistently used.
  • Teams improve their ability to make and keep customer promise dates.
  • Power BI requirements and simple reports provide clear, actionable information for ITP decisions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to lead assigned ITP implementation and improvement projects, translating decisions into clear plans, owners, milestones, risks, and actions.
  • Identify practical AI and automation use cases, prioritize opportunities, build low-code solutions where appropriate, and coordinate specialists for more complex development.
  • Use AI to streamline meeting preparation and follow-up, summarize exceptions, support root-cause analysis, draft status updates and standard work, and surface potential solutions for human review.
  • Challenge manual ways of working, demonstrate improved approaches, and help teams adopt AI-enabled processes.
  • Define Power BI reporting requirements and work with BI specialists on complex solutions; build simple reports using existing datasets, Power Query, and basic DAX when appropriate.
  • Interpret Power BI and other planning outputs, using AI-assisted analysis where appropriate to identify trends, exceptions, root causes, and decision needs.
  • Create and maintain concise project plans, process maps, standard work, decision logs, action trackers, risk logs, and implementation updates.
  • Support priority ITP meetings through preparation, facilitation, decision capture, action follow-up, and escalation of missed commitments.
  • Work closely with Data Governance and assigned data owners to clarify business impact and route data concerns; this role does not own data validation or remediation.
  • Apply responsible AI practices, including appropriate data handling, information security, human review, transparency, and compliance with company standards.
  • Coordinate readiness, testing, training, deployment, adoption, and sustainment for assigned process and automation changes.

Decision Rights and Boundaries

  • Determines the project, facilitation, documentation, and follow-up approach for assigned work within approved standards.
  • Recommends AI, automation, reporting, process-improvement, and meeting-effectiveness priorities.
  • Leads smaller use cases and pilots; coordinates technical, functional, BI, Data Governance, and information-security resources as needed.
  • Does not own forecasts, supply plans, schedules, purchase decisions, customer commitments, data validation, or final technology and policy approvals.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, Project Management, or a related field. Candidates with nontraditional backgrounds may be considered when project experience demonstrates the required capabilities.
  • Demonstrated practical use of AI in projects, with the ability to learn new AI capabilities and apply them to real business problems.
  • Relevant experience demonstrated through professional work, internships, project portfolios, or applied coursework.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across Commercial, Scheduling, Purchasing, Operations, Data Governance, IT, BI, and other functions while independently organizing work, removing barriers, escalating risks, and driving deliverables to closure.
  • Experience identifying business use cases and implementing process improvements, automation, or low-code solutions.
  • Strong Excel skills and the ability to define reporting needs, interpret results, and communicate business insights.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, facilitation, collaboration, and change-leadership skills.
  • Commitment to responsible AI use, data privacy, information security, and human oversight.

Strongly Preferred Qualifications

  • Power BI experience, including simple report creation, Power Query, and basic DAX; advanced semantic-model development is not required.
  • Experience with Power Automate or similar low-code workflow tools.
  • Exposure to supply chain, manufacturing, planning, ITP, IBP, ERP/MRP, or enterprise process implementation.
  • Experience with Oracle or Kinaxis.

Key Interfaces

Global ITP Implementation Leader and design team; business-unit ITP leaders and participants; Commercial, Client Success, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Scheduling, Purchasing, Operations, Finance, Quality, Data Governance, IT, BI, AI and automation, ERP, and information-security teams.

Working Conditions and Travel

This position is based in Duncan, South Carolina, and follows a hybrid work schedule, with an expectation of working onsite three days per week. The role supports global teams and may require travel and meetings across time zones. Onsite expectations may vary based on business needs, project activities, workshops, and team collaboration requirements.

title: Software Engr II
description:

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· Develop UI SPA applications using React JS, SCSS CSS3.

· Develop backend systems using C# .Net & Node Js frameworks.

· Apply Test Driven Development using Jest in React & Node JS, XUnit / NUnit in C# programming.

· Apply Object-Oriented Programming (OOP).

· Work with System Technical Leads to understand the design & deliver the required Spike, PoC, Prototypes in design & exploration phases.

· Apply GoF Design Pattern, SOLID & KISS principles in development.

· Nice to have knowledge of PSIM domain solutions and their integration with building automation systems.

YOU MUST HAVE

· 3+ years of experience in software development, specifically in full stack development using Javascript / C# .Net programming.

· Experience with cloud technologies and IoT platforms, particularly in the context of smart buildings.

· Experience with enterprise level large scale application development.

· Test Driven Development practices in development.

· Hands on with React JS & Some RPC like WebAPI, gRPC, GraphQL.

WE VALUE

· Advanced degrees in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.

title: IT Analyst (Retail Data & Systems)
description:
Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced and analytical IT Analyst to join our retail headquarters IT team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between retail operations, distribution center logistics, and advanced data analytics. You will manage, optimize, and query our relational databases (MySQL) while scaling our enterprise data capabilities using Google Cloud BigQuery.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in the retail sector—familiar with point-of-sale (POS), inventory management, supply chain, and ERP data flows—and possesses advanced SQL coding skills to transform raw transactional data into actionable business intelligence.

Key Responsibilities

1. Database Management & MySQL Coding

  • Design, write, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, stored procedures, triggers, and views in MySQL to support enterprise retail systems, ERPs, and warehouse management systems (WMS).

  • Monitor database performance, troubleshoot query bottlenecks, and ensure data integrity across multi-location retail and distribution center databases.

  • Automate routine data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) tasks to streamline daily inventory reconciliation and financial closing workflows.

2. BigQuery & Data Analytics Integration

  • Architect, manage, and scale data pipelines and data warehouse environments using Google BigQuery.

  • Write highly optimized standard SQL queries for BigQuery to analyze large-scale retail datasets, customer behavior trends, and supply chain metrics.

  • Integrate multi-source retail data (POS logs, e-commerce transactions, ERP records) into BigQuery for centralized reporting and dashboarding.

3. Retail Systems Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with retail operations, finance, and logistics teams to translate business requirements into technical data solutions and automated reports.

  • Support system integrations, ensuring seamless Unit of Measure (UOM) synchronization and data consistency between retail headquarters and distribution hubs.

  • Document system architectures, query logic, data dictionaries, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for team knowledge sharing.

Key Qualifications & Requirements

1. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data

Analytics, or a related field.

2. Experience: Approximately 3-5 years of hands-on IT working experience, preferably

within a retail, wholesale, or fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) environment.

3. Technical Skills:

  • Advanced SQL Proficiency: Deep expertise in writing and optimizing complex queries, joins, subqueries, and performance tuning in MySQL.

  • Cloud Data Warehousing: Proven experience utilizing Google Cloud BigQuery for querying large datasets and managing cloud-based analytics.

  • Retail Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with retail management systems, ERPs,

  • point-of-sale data structures, inventory control, and supply chain/warehouse data flows.

  • Data Tooling: Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI) and basic scripting (Python or Bash) is a strong advantage.

4. Soft Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with high attention to detail.

  • Effective communication skills to collaborate with technical peers and non-technical retail stakeholders.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced retail headquarters environment.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer - AI and Optimization
description:

This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

As a Senior Software Development Engineer within HPE's Product Security Office, you will design, build, and scale AI-enabled security applications that improve engineering productivity, security analysis, automation, and decision-making across the enterprise. You will combine software engineering, AI/ML, large language models, agentic workflows, data engineering, and secure development practices to create capabilities that accelerate how Product Security teams identify risk, generate insight, and drive remediation.

This role requires strong technical depth, systems thinking, and a builder mindset. You will work across Product Security, engineering, data, and platform teams to transform complex security challenges into scalable software solutions that deliver measurable impact.


About You

You are an experienced software engineer who enjoys building new capabilities from ambiguous problems. You combine strong software engineering fundamentals with curiosity about AI technologies and their practical application to cybersecurity challenges.

You can move comfortably between architecture discussions, hands-on development, AI experimentation, and production deployment. You focus on delivering solutions that are maintainable, scalable, and measurable, and you look for opportunities to create capabilities that continue delivering value long after the initial implementation is complete.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead the design, development, and delivery of complex software applications and platforms, providing technical leadership across solution design, analysis, coding, testing, integration, and deployment activities.
  • Drive end-to-end execution of software engineering initiatives, ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable, secure, and aligned with business and technical objectives.
  • Review and evaluate software designs, architecture decisions, and development activities to ensure alignment with engineering standards, improve solution quality, and reduce operational and delivery risk.
  • Provide technical expertise and engineering leadership for cross-functional projects, influencing technical direction, resolving complex challenges, and enabling successful delivery across organizational boundaries.
  • Champion the evaluation, adoption, and integration of emerging technologies, tools, and engineering practices that improve product capabilities, developer productivity, and overall solution effectiveness.
  • Contribute to the definition and evolution of software engineering standards, development methodologies, and best practices that support consistent and high-quality delivery.
  • Mentor and coach engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, knowledge sharing, and hands-on collaboration, helping to strengthen engineering capability across the team.

What you need to bring:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Typically 6-10 years of software engineering experience designing and delivering enterprise applications and platforms.
  • Experience developing applications using the MERN stack and Python.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitOps, Docker, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with software systems architecture, including designing and integrating solutions across multiple platform types.
  • Experience evaluating software testing methodologies, developing test plans, debugging complex issues, and creating testing tools and automation.
  • Experience working with AI/ML, cloud technologies, MLOps, large language models, and agentic AI concepts.

Experience and Expertise

  • Understanding of AI security, responsible AI principles, and governance frameworks.
  • Understanding of OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities and secure coding practices.
  • Experience with a variety of software design tools, frameworks, and programming languages.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

title: Supervisor Regional Operations Line and Substation - PA Operations - Butler Service Center
description:

This is an open position with the FirstEnergy Pennsylvania Electric Company, a subsidiary of FirstEnergy Corp.

This position is a Line Supervisor, based out of the Butler Service Center.

This position supervises employees engaged in complex construction, maintenance, repair, testing, and operation of the electric transmission and distribution system.

Responsibilities include:

  • Demonstrating and directing a solid commitment to all aspects of safety
  • Directing and supervising employees engaged in electric transmission and distribution line work
  • Directing line workers in the installation of energized lines, transferring circuit loads, directing cutovers from poles and equipment to new or temporary installations, and locating faults on distribution voltages and street light circuits
  • Responding and supervising resources during emergency conditions to support public safety and system reliability, as well as supervising and dispatching service restoration crews during major storms

  • Implementing instruction and training of line employees in the established work practices and methods utilized throughout the department
  • Administering Company and Regional Absenteeism Management Program and Regional Safety Plan
  • Other duties as assigned

  • High school diploma or equivalent and 5-7 years’ related work experience in an electrical field is required. Related work experience includes hazard responding, knowledge of construction and maintenance practices, procedures, work methods, materials, equipment, and tools which would be used to determine the resources necessary to perform construction and maintenance work activities
  • An advanced level of knowledge and experience in operations, repair, and construction of assigned Transmission and Distribution area
  • Some supervisory experience is preferred

  • Able to learn various computer applications (CREWS, SAP, GIS, Flex OMS, Empower) and Microsoft Office
