title: Senior Technical Producer, Tech Strategy | Central Technology
description:
Job Title:

Senior Technical Producer, Tech Strategy | Central Technology

Requisition ID:

R028329

Job Description:

Your Mission

Activision Central Tech is seeking a highly skilled and motivated senior producer to drive the success of our AI initiatives. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing the entire product development lifecycle, aligning technical requirements across stakeholders, and collaborating with various teams to achieve shared technology goals.


What you bring to the table

Priorities can often change in a fast-paced environment like ours, so this role includes, but is not limited to, the following responsibilities:


  • Product Development Lifecycle: Lead the full product development lifecycle, from gathering requirements to prioritizing features, assisting in writing specifications, and ensuring alignment with strategic technology development goals.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Work closely with stakeholders across all the Call of Duty studios to align technical requirements and foster collaboration among teams.
  • Project Planning: Develop project schedules, implementation plans, status reports, burndown charts, and shared technical roadmaps across studios.
  • Resource Management: Balance resources across multiple projects, ensuring efficient allocation and staffing to meet technology roadmaps. Work closely with studio Producers to ensure resources are properly allocated amongst project initiatives.
  • Project Oversight: Manage project backlogs, track progress, identify critical issues, and escalate blockers. Monitor project velocity and highlight risks. Drive recurring project updates (E.g., Team meetings / stand-ups, Post-mortems, Sprint Kick-offs)
  • Reporting: Provide regular, timely, and accurate reporting to stakeholders and leadership, including KPIs to track project timeliness and quality.
  • Process Enhancement: Collaborate with internal resourcing teams with PMG and studios to optimize development efficiency and enhance the structure and communication within Core Development teams.
  • Documentation: Create wireframes, process flow diagrams, UI mock-ups, and other documentation to support project requirements.
  • Leadership Goals: Deliver set goals as determined by leadership partners across different studios, driving the development of shared technology capabilities.
  • Communication: Excellent communicator with the ability to lead multiple teams with sometimes divergent requirements along different timelines. Comfortable with building trust in a large organization with many independent operating functional units.

Minimum Requirements


Production & Project Management:

  • 5+ years of production or other project management background, preferably in the games space or other software-forward environment on either client or backend.
  • Skilled with project management tools such as JIRA, Confluence, and communication infrastructure such as Slack and Miro.
  • A track record of helping ship software products in a timely manner or in rapid development cycles.
  • Successful project planning, leading completion, and the timely delivery of quality projects.
  • Deep experience with each stage of software development lifecycle, from inception, design and implementation, through to QA and deployment.

Nice to have:

  • Experience working on AAA and/or first-person shooter games.
  • Experience with AI/ML, LLM
  • While not required, a technical degree such as a computer engineer or similar experience is a plus.
  • Familiarity with data protection laws and regulatory requirements a plus.


Central Tech


Activision Central Tech works to support our development studios and their titles. Comprised of seven main teams, we have many specialties including big data, privacy and security, motion capture and animation pipeline technologies, graphics, build and infrastructure for studio development and data centers, optimization, systems programming and online services including matchmaking and networking. Central Tech is distributed globally with offices across the U.S., and in Canada, England, Ireland and Japan.


Most of our teams are comprised of both engineering and research talent, allowing us to always have an eye on the future. Our talented engineers help with title development and provide valuable knowledge sharing between studios while our researchers are action-oriented and keep a strong connection with the needs of the game studios.


Central Tech is part of Activision. To learn more about us and our research, please visit us at https://research.activision.com/.


Our World

At Activision, we strive to create the most iconic brands in gaming and entertainment. We’re driven by our mission to deliver unrivaled gaming experiences for the world to enjoy, together. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, Crash Bandicoot™, Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™, and Guitar Hero®. As a leading worldwide developer, publisher and distributor of interactive entertainment and products, our “press start” is simple: delight hundreds of millions of players around the world with innovative, fun, thrilling, and engaging entertainment experiences.


We’re not just looking back at our decades-long legacy; we’re forging ahead to keep advancing gameplay with some of the most popular titles and sophisticated technology in the world. We have bold ambitions to create the most inclusive company as we know our success comes from the passionate, creative, and diverse teams within our organization.


We’re in the business of delivering fun and unforgettable entertainment for our player community to enjoy. And our future opportunities have never been greater — this could be your opportunity to level up.


Ready to Activate Your Future?

We love hearing from anyone who is enthusiastic about changing the games industry. Not sure you meet all qualifications? Let us decide! Research shows that women and members of other under-represented groups tend to not apply to jobs when they think they may not meet every qualification, when, in fact, they often do! We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and strongly encourage you to apply.


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, among other characteristics.


We are committed to working with and providing reasonable assistance to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are a disabled individual requiring an accommodation to apply for an open position, please email your request to candidate-accommodations@activisionblizzard.com. General employment questions cannot be accepted or processed here. Thank you for your interest.

Rewards

We provide a suite of benefits that promote physical, emotional and financial well-being for ‘Every World’ - we’ve got our employees covered! Subject to eligibility requirements, the Company offers comprehensive benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, vision, health savings account or health reimbursement account, healthcare spending accounts, dependent care spending accounts, life and AD&D insurance, disability insurance;
  • 401(k) with Company match, tuition reimbursement, charitable donation matching;
  • Paid holidays and vacation, paid sick time, floating holidays, compassion and bereavement leaves, parental leave;
  • Mental health & wellbeing programs, fitness programs, free and discounted games, and a variety of other voluntary benefit programs like supplemental life & disability, legal service, ID protection, rental insurance, and others;
  • If the Company requires that you move geographic locations for the job, then you may also be eligible for relocation assistance.

Eligibility to participate in these benefits may vary for part time and temporary full-time employees and interns with the Company. You can learn more by visiting .

In the U.S., the standard base pay range for this role is $94,580.00 - $174,988.00 Annual. These values reflect the expected base pay range of new hires across all U.S. locations. Ultimately, your specific range and offer will be based on several factors, including relevant experience, performance, and work location. Your Talent Professional can share this role’s range details for your local geography during the hiring process. In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role may be eligible for incentive compensation. Incentive compensation is not guaranteed. While we strive to provide competitive offers to successful candidates, new hire compensation is negotiable.

title: Olfactive Scientist - Asia, Fabric & Home Care
description:
Job Location

SINGAPORE TC-BIOPOLIS

Job Description

Overview of role

Perfume is a critical driver of consumer delight and business growth in nearly every category in P&G. The Olfactive Scientist is responsible for development of successful freshness system in Fabric and Home Care with a combination of strong scientific and creative skills, understanding of our brand equities and consumer needs, as well as mechanistic understanding of product chassis and perfume delivery technologies.


Your team

You will work in the Fabric & Home Care (F&HC) team of the Fragrance & Flavor (F&F) discipline. You will be part of a passionate team of perfumers and technical experts in leading projects in the region and globe.


Key Responsibilities

The job is a multi-faceted role focused on leading the evaluation, design and execution of Irresistibly Superior fragrances for our Asia F&HC brands. The ideal candidate must demonstrate a bias for action and innovation as they will be in fast-moving projects.


The key responsibilities include:


  • Developing key fragrance-related consumer insights and translating those into directions that guide the creation of superior fragrances for our brands
  • Inspiring, motivating and providing critical, consumer-driven evaluation feedback to P&G and Perfume House perfumers to help guide them in the development of Irresistibly Superior perfumes
  • Providing fragrance project leadership, working with category PR customers, internal, and external perfume resources
  • Develop new methodologies that improve Perfume's capability to create and identify superior fragrances that help drive purchase intent and build brand equity
  • Leverage the effective use of external perfume resources to complement our internal perfume capability to meet project objectives

Job Qualifications


  • Bachelors/ Masters / PhD degree in Science or Engineering fields. A ISIPCA degree is highly preferred.
  • Experience in a Fragrance design type role either in fragrance or in category related work that involved fragrance design. The role will require a skill set that enables immediate impact on projects across multiple fronts.
  • Olfactive Acuity – Potential candidate must pass an odor acuity test and overall have an excellent sense of smell.
  • Creativity & Innovation – Demonstrate a strong creative talent and a passion to use this creativity on the job.

The candidate should use scent regularly in their day-to-day life and be able to clearly articulate the role scent plays in their personal product usage experiences.
  • Agility – Able to manage multiple projects simultaneously and be able to effectively organize and prioritize their work. The current category work is very dynamic and there are several active projects currently in development. Attention to detail and discipline in follow through will be critical for success in this role.

The candidate will be interacting daily with multiple project teams, perfumers, perfume houses and product supply, and must be able to effectively communicate the program needs.

The candidate will be asked to guide perfume learning plans for the programs they manage, so knowledge of PR tools is beneficial.
  • Technical Mastery – Basic knowledge of chemistry to understand perfume raw materials and how they interact with product applications and be willing to go into more depth as needed to understand interactions between perfumes, chassis and perfume delivery technologies.
  • Collaboration – Able to collaborate with multiple functions within P&G, including R&D, Regulatory, Purchases, and Product Supply. Externally, P&G Perfumers collaborate with Perfumers across the industry, technology suppliers, and academic partners. The successful candidate will have a strong track record of collaborating internally and externally to bring out the best skills and capabilities in pursuit of winning perfumes.

title: Hardware Electrical Component Engineer I
description:
Hardware Electrical Component Engineer I

This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

Job Family Definition:

Designs, analyzes, develops, modifies and evaluates electrical/electronic parts, components, sub-systems, algorithms, or integrated circuitry for electrical/electronic equipment and other hardware systems. Conducts feasibility studies, design margin and validation analyses and empirical testing on new and modified designs. Assists in architecture development and assessment. Evaluates reliability of materials, properties, designs, and techniques used in production. May direct support personnel in the preparation of detailed design, design testing and prototype fabrication.

Management Level Definition:

Contributes to assignments of limited scope by applying technical concepts and theoretical knowledge acquired through specialized training, education, or previous experience. Acts as team member by providing information, analysis and recommendations in support of team efforts. Exercises independent judgment within defined parameters.

Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for new part introduction and alternative sourcing for passive, discrete, and other common electronic components.

  • Support new part number creation, datasheet review and approval, second-source qualification for cost reduction, and component EOL management.

  • Focus on multi-source development and component lifecycle management.

  • Support component management activities, including multi-source compliance, BOM review, component cost optimization, and lifecycle management.

  • Collaborate and communicate with management, hardware design engineers, and outsourced development partners.

  • Designs portions of engineering solutions for electrical and electronic parts, subsystems, integrated circuitry, and algorithms based on established engineering principles and in accordance with provided specifications and requirements.

  • Develops understanding of and relationship with internal and outsourced development partners on electrical hardware design and development.

  • Participates in cross-functional project teams with hardware engineers, sourcing teams, suppliers, and ODM partners to deliver reliable and cost-effective solutions.

Education and Experience Required:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering. Typically 0-2 years experience.

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience or understanding of electrical design tools and software packages.

  • Good analytical and problem solving skills.

  • Understanding of electronic components, including passive, discrete, connector, and semiconductor devices, and their electrical and mechanical specifications.

  • Understanding of component lifecycle management, qualification, reliability concepts, and supply chain considerations.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills; mastery in English and local language.

title: Standardized Patient
description:
As a part of a diverse community of faculty and staff who represent many faith systems and worldviews, the Hill-Rom Simulation Center at Marian University is welcoming application for part-time Standardized Patients (SP). A Standardized Patient is a person carefully recruited and trained to take on the characteristics of a real patient. Reporting to the Coordinator of Standardized Patients, the Standardized Patient will promote our Catholic Franciscan mission and identity by affording the student an opportunity to learn, practice skills, be evaluated and receive feedback in a simulated clinical environment. Works varied hours on an on-call basis, as needed.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Actively engage the Catholic Franciscan mission and identity of Marian University by modeling the Franciscan Sponsorship Values and honoring the legacy of the founding congregation through transformative education, unity in diversity, leadership through service, integrating faith and life, and institutional policies.
  • Memorizes a case script detailing specific emotions, behaviors, and disease signs/symptoms for
  • Presents case information in a standardized manner, as elicited by students during simulated interactive patient history and/or medical examinations.
  • Remains in a specific patient character as trained when responding to student questions.
  • Accurately remembers encounters with students for the purpose of scoring student behaviors.
  • Participates in group training and/or mentorship of entry-level standardized patients.
  • Maintains confidentiality of information related to cases, student behaviors and feedback evaluations.
  • Provides educationally constructive verbal feedback within a structured format, as appropriate to the position.
  • Performs miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.
Required Qualifications:
  • Ability to accurately and convincingly maintain a specified character as trained.
  • Ability to work flexible hours on a scheduled on-call basis.
  • Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing.
  • Ability to recall case information, as cued by students in a role-play situation.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality of case and student information.
  • Ability to understand and follow directions and incorporate trainer feedback.
  • Ability to recall and accurately score student behaviors.
Working Conditions and Physical Effort
  • Must be able to: move all extremities without difficulty, step up and down from an exam table, and quickly change from a gown to clothing.
  • Work is performed in an interior medical/clinical environment.
  • No or very limited physical effort required.
  • No or very limited exposure to physical risk.

Review of applications will begin immediately and continue until the position is filled.

  1. Cover Letter

  3. Contact information of three professional references. The reference contact information must be entered after the application is submitted in the "My Presence" section of the applicant profile.

title: Team Leader Controlling Operations
description:
At Swarovski, you don’t just join a brand - you help reinvent one of the most iconic names in fashion and design. Here, bold ideas matter, creativity drives change, collaboration is valued, and your work shapes how the world experiences brilliance. If you’re ready to push boundaries, grow your skills, and leave your mark where innovation meets timeless elegance, we’re ready for you.

Our Global Business Services offices based in Poland, Costa Rica and Penang Malaysia, are vibrant workplaces where your expertise makes a global impact. You’ll collaborate across borders, deliver high-quality services, and help shape a people-centered organization.

We are looking for a Team Leader Controlling Operations who combines strong leadership, finance controlling expertise, and a continuous improvement mindset to deliver high-quality operational outcomes, foster stakeholder partnerships, and drive transformation initiatives.

About the job

Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • People Leadership: Lead, coach and develop the Controlling Operations Team (approximately 6+ people), building strong capabilities, accountability, and engagement. Manage performance, workload allocation, and team capacity to ensure effective delivery.
  • Operational Delivery: Ensure timely and high-quality execution of recurring controlling, reporting and closing-related activities. Proactively manage priorities, resolve operational issues, and ensure continuity of service.
  • Reporting & Analytics: Ensure accuracy, consistency and quality of management reporting and analytical deliverables. Oversee recurring reporting and analysis, ensuring outputs meet the requirements of Controlling and Finance stakeholders.
  • Business Partnering: Act as the key operational interface with Controlling Managers and relevant cluster and global Finance & Controlling Stakeholders. Maintain transparent communication on priorities, deliverables, service quality, and operational challenges.
  • Process Excellence: Drive standardization, simplification and harmonization of controlling processes and ways of working. Identify and implement automation and productivity opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve efficiency.
  • Controls & Governance: Ensure appropriate controls, review mechanisms and process documentation are in place. Maintain compliance with Group policies, standards, and governance requirements.
  • Transformation: Support transitions, implementation of new scope and broader Finance & Controlling transformation initiatives. Drive adoption of new processes, tools and ways of working and ensure sustainable implementation within the team.

About you

We are looking for a unique and amazing talent, who brings along the following:

  • 5+ years of leadership experience in Finance, Controlling, FP&A, Management Accounting, Budgeting, or Reporting.
  • Strong knowledge of FP&A, management accounting, controlling, budgeting, and reporting, with hands-on experience in SAP FI/CO.
  • Experience with Power BI, Power Query, Power Pivot, SAP BW, or similar BI and reporting tools. Tableau experience is an advantage.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, data analysis, and VBA.
  • Proven track record in driving process improvements, automation, and LEAN initiatives.
  • Strong leadership, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Experience leading and developing teams, including working with remote or global stakeholders.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

What we offer

You can expect a range of benefits, including:

  • Learning and career development programs to help you grow
  • A global employee assistance program offering support in the areas of mental, physical, and emotional health, managerial support as well as financial and legal matters
  • Hybrid and flexible work options to support your work-life balance
  • Paid volunteering leave to support causes that matter to you
  • Exclusive employee discounts on Swarovski products

About Swarovski

Swarovski creates crystal-based products of unique quality and craftsmanship that bring joy and celebrate individuality. Founded in Austria in 1895, we design, manufacture, and sell the world’s finest crystals, gemstones, Swarovski Created Diamonds, zirconia, jewelry, accessories, and home décor.

Sustainability and responsibility are at the heart of our brand, from circular innovation to diversity, inclusion, and the philanthropic work of the Swarovski Foundation. We empower people to express their individuality with confidence and respect, and we believe that different perspectives make us stronger.

Swarovski is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fair, inclusive recruitment and to building a workplace where everyone feels they truly belong.

description:

This ambition is supported by leadership grounded in courage and clarity—ensuring alignment, accountability, and purpose in everything we do. We are seeking a highly experienced BSS Transformation Program Director to lead a multi-year, large-scale transformation program for Banglalink. The role will own end-to-end program leadership across integration, migration, cutover and business readiness for various BSS components - CRM, Revenue Management, Product Catalogue, Mediation, Case management, API Gateway, Order Management. The ideal candidate will combine telecom BSS domain high level knowledge, executive stakeholder management, delivery governance, multi-vendor leadership, commercial discipline and hands-on experience delivering complex transformation programs in tier-1 or large telecom environments.

  • Internal Candidates: A two-year assignment, after which the selected employee will return to their original domain.

title: Quantitative Developer, Risk Technology
description:
JOB TITLE

Quantitative Developer, Risk Technology

A CAREER WITH POINT72’S TECHNOLOGY TEAM


As Point72 reimagines the future of investing, our Technology team is constantly evolving our firm’s IT infrastructure and engineering capabilities, positioning us at the forefront of a rapidly evolving technology landscape. Point72 is a leading global alternative investment firm led by Steven A. Cohen. We aim to attract and retain the industry's brightest talent by cultivating an investor-led culture and committing to our people's long-term growth. For more information, visit https://point72.com/.

title: Instrument Engineering Specialist

- Provide instrumentation and F&G engineering support, including design reviews, SIL workshops, assessments, verification, HAZOP, commissioning and start-up activities.
- Support failure analysis, troubleshooting and resolution of complex instrumentation and F&G system issues.
- Develop and implement surveillance and maintenance programmes for critical instrumentation and Fire & Gas systems.
- Ensure high standards of system reliability, availability and cybersecurity.
- Identify engineering best practices and recommend performance improvement initiatives.
- Develop work plans and schedules to ensure timely completion of engineering activities and project milestones.
- Provide technical support and coordinate with other engineering disciplines and project teams.
- Supervise and coordinate the activities of contractors, consultants and service providers.
- Provide technical guidance to junior engineers on system integrity and reliability requirements.
- Coordinate and support project tie-in activities for instrumentation and F&G systems.

- Support high-risk commissioning activities through system monitoring, testing, optimization and technical guidance to Operations and Maintenance teams.

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or an equivalent qualification.
- Minimum 8 years of experience in the Oil & Gas industry.

- Distributed Control Systems (DCS).
- Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs).
- Emergency Shutdown (ESD) and Fire & Gas (F&G) Systems.
- Anti-Surge Control Systems.
- Metering Systems.
- Turbine and Compressor Control Systems.
- Strong understanding of Safety Integrity Level (SIL) requirements, including assessment and verification.

Technical & Professional Skills
- Strong technical knowledge of instrumentation and Fire & Gas systems.
- Ability to work and make decisions under high-pressure conditions.
- Excellent written and spoken English.
- Strong leadership, communication and interpersonal skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, SAP, CONVAL and InstruCal.

The primary responsibilities of this position are managing the day-to-day operations of the Campus Pantry and Teaching Kitchen, supporting the Sustainability Manager in running the Campus Farmers Market, and working on other educational outreach and expansion opportunities. This position supervises and mentors the Campus Pantry student employees, working closely with the student management team to ensure the smooth operation of the Campus Pantry. This position will work with the Sustainability Manager to collect, analyze, and report relevant data both internally and to external rating organizations. title: Spring Internship Program - Field Quality Analyst (Artificial Intelligence and System Integration)
description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

The role and team:

We are seeking a forward-thinking Field Quality Analyst (Artificial Intelligence and Systems Integration) intern to bridge the gap between Quality Assurance and Advanced Analytics.


In this role, you will spearhead the digital transformation of our Quality Issue Management System (QIMS), migrating our robust CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) frameworks from Oracle PLM Quality Cloud to Jira. Beyond the migration, you will be instrumental in implementing AI-driven applications to analyze quality data, identifying patterns that allow us to move from reactive fixes to predictive preventive measures.


The position is part of Logitech’s Consumer Quality within Global Quality Organization. The team focuses on Quality issue management and use of Quality tools in identifying problem causes and the subsequent actions and learnings


This role will collaborate with global teams including data, IT, AI Quality and Doc Sys to improve the quality issue management tools and data analysis.


Your Contribution:

Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:


  • Design and manage the development of an AI-powered Quality Issue Management Systems platform that centralizes company-wide Quality issues.
  • Collect and analyze relevant QI data across many sources to identify and integrate high-value features that enhance platform functionality.
  • Partner with cross-functional leadership to capture business intelligence needs and translate them into detailed technical specifications.
  • Lead the platform transition by collaborating with IT to build, configure, and optimize the QIMS environment within Jira Cloud, ensuring alignment with global quality standards.
  • Execute rigorous testing and UAT (User Acceptance Testing) protocols to qualify the Jira project, working directly with IT developers to resolve technical bottlenecks.
  • Implement AI/Machine Learning integrations to mine historical QIMS data, enabling rapid, automated "Lessons Learned" retrieval to prevent the recurrence of known issues.
  • Build a CQ library platform to house CQ Issues, CAPA, CIP projects and leveraging AI in notebookLM.

This role will also entail:

  • Regular collaboration with a dedicated mentor to refine strategies and assess performance
  • Working closely with data, IT, and AI teams to develop scalable analytical solutions
  • Communication in English with global teams across different time zones
  • Being on‑site at the Logitech Hsinchu office

For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team:

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s degree in any Engineering major
  • Strong interest and knowledge in AI applications & tools, data analytics, dashboards and and data visualization
  • Knowledge of machine learning concepts, large language models and automation tools
  • An analytical mindset and ability to think critically about data and insights
  • Self‑motivated with the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a global team
  • Strong communication skills in English
  • Highly organized, commitment to meeting deadlines, able to prioritize effectively with strong time management skills and continuously learning new skills

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Interest in consumer analytics, product quality, or customer experience improvement

  • Willingness to extend the internship for up to 6 months when required by the department
  • Duration: March 1, 2027 – June 30, 2027

#LI-SL1/104

title: Applied AI Architect, Partnerships
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Partners Solutions Architect on the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on cultivating technical relationships with our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs), and our cloud partners . You will strengthen our relationships with key partners to accelerate indirect revenue, enable their AI practices, and execute on long-term GTM strategy.

Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Technical Partnership: Be a technical thought partner to the Anthropic GTM partnerships team, providing technical expertise to better understand the partner landscape, driving key strategic programs, and identifying opportunities to deepen partner technical capabilities. Embed with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, support troubleshooting, evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities, and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.

  • Joint Solution Development: Collaborate with partners to identify high value industry-specific GenAI applications, develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures / best practices to accelerate time to deployment

  • Customer Deal Support: Intervene directly to unblock strategic customer deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep technical expertise and solution architecture guidance.

  • Partner Ecosystem & Events: Represent Anthropic at partner events such as GSI customer workshops, summits, and industry conferences. Lead or support partner-specific developer events, hackathons, and technical enablement sessions, especially for technically native communities.

  • Product Feedback: Validate and gather feedback on Anthropic's products and offerings, especially as they relate to partner use cases and deployment patterns, and deliver this feedback to relevant Anthropic teams to inform product roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing/partner-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Sales Engineer

  • Track record of successfully partnering with GSIs and/or cloud providers to solve complex technical challenges, from initial solution design through customer delivery

  • Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more

  • Strong presentation & technical communication skills with the ability to translate requirements between technical and business stakeholders

  • Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems

  • Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science

  • Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities

  • A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed

  • Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Research Specialist, Laboratory Animal - SOM Radiation Oncology Rsrch DTRS
description:
University of Maryland, Baltimore (UMB) is currently seeking a Laboratory Animal Research Specialist to join the School of Medicine, Department of Radiation Oncology Research. The Laboratory Research Specialist Animal is responsible for performing research activities at the University of Maryland, Baltimore. Functions as a single specialist in a laboratory setting, is responsible for providing the advanced technical expertise to research project(s) and must follow and complete advanced pathways to provide an animal `whole body care' as it applies to the area of specialty to achieve this job title. The position will work in a highly collaborative environment to achieve research project goals by designing studies, performing laboratory experiments, analyzing data, writing reports, presenting results, and training staff and students. Work is performed in accordance with animal welfare regulations, USDA, the Guide for the Care and Use of Laboratory Animals, Public Health Services (PHS), Office of Laboratory Animal Welfare (OLAW), Association for assessment and Accreditation of Laboratory Animal Care (AAALAC), Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC) guidelines, and/or United States Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) 21CFR58 Good Laboratory Practices Regulations.

  • Perform independent project(s) and participate in the design of research studies. Perform procedures utilizing specific skillsets or advanced treatments as dictated by the veterinarian in charge. Compile, analyze, and interpret research data using various relevant computer software applications.
  • Independently perform day to day laboratory research activities such as: general housekeeping, daily observations of animal health; collection of cultures and biological specimens for diagnostic testing and monitoring of animal health; diagnostic molecular (ELISA), bacteriological, or biological assays; breeding colonization processes; irradiation of blood products; and executing biochemical or hematopoietic procedures such as: bone marrow aspirations, complete blood count, white cell differential, electrophoresis, blotting, chromatography, PCR and DNA extractions, etc.; and may require performing psychological enrichment of certain species.
  • Performs laboratory animal support activities such as surgical, anesthesia, enrichment, diagnostics, good laboratory practice, internal-medical and biohazardous research and may contribute to the design of related activities.
  • Administer day-to-day laboratory operations including monitoring and advise on the budget, ensuring quality control and safety compliance, developing policies and procedures, and ordering supplies including the identification of supply sources. Maintain proper operation of research equipment, ensuring proper operation records, cleaning, ordering of required components and explaining/resolving technical issues.
  • Conduct library research and participates in editing and preparing manuscripts, scientific illustrations and computer graphics for publication. Contribute to the preparation of journal articles and grant proposals. Presents research findings.
  • Prepare materials for research studies, including sample collection kits and research documents.
  • Assist in the training of undergraduate and graduate students, post-doctoral, international fellows, and/or junior technical personnel in the performance of a variety of laboratory techniques.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in biology, agriculture, veterinary science, biochemistry, chemistry, or field of study related to the animal science.

Three (3) years of experience working with animals in a research laboratory setting or in an animal hospital is preferred, including two (2) years in the relevant research specialization in rodent/multi-species clinical.

Additional related experience and formal education in which one has gained the knowledge, skills, and abilities required for full performance of the work of the job may be substituted for the education or experience requirement.

title: Sr. Integrated and ABM Specialist
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.

By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.

Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

Job Description

About the Role

As an Integrated Campaign & ABM Specialist, you’ll help shape how Sprinklr engages priority audiences and enterprise accounts. You’ll turn audience insight, account intelligence, and business priorities into connected experiences that build engagement, support pipeline progression, and create opportunities for account growth. This is a hands-on role for a B2B marketer who can move confidently between strategy and execution, coordinate multiple stakeholders, and translate performance signals into clear action.


What Success Looks Like

Success means delivering campaigns that feel like one connected experience rather than a collection of channel activities. Your programs help account teams understand where engagement is building, which buying-group members matter, and what action to take next. You’ll be known for reliable execution, clear communication, strong partnership, and the ability to turn performance signals into better decisions.


What You’ll Do

  • Plan and execute integrated, multi-channel campaigns from brief and audience strategy through launch, optimization, and performance reporting.
  • Build campaign journeys across email, content, webinars, virtual events, paid media, social, web, executive engagement, and sales-assisted outreach.
  • Execute 1:1, 1: Few, ABM programs for priority accounts, industries, segments, and buying groups.
  • Develop campaign briefs, audience definitions, messaging frameworks, content requirements, channel plans, project timelines, and stakeholder updates.
  • Coordinate the creation of account- and persona-relevant assets, including landing pages, emails, sales plays, executive invitations, one-pagers, and digital experiences.
  • Manage campaign operations with strong attention to quality, governance, dependencies, budgets, agencies, and launch readiness.
  • Monitor engagement, buying-group coverage, conversion, pipeline progression, sourced and influenced pipeline, and account outcomes; translate findings into optimization actions.
  • Identify opportunities to challenge established campaign practices, test new engagement approaches, and convert successful experiments into repeatable programs.
  • Use AI thoughtfully to accelerate research, personalization, content workflows, and performance analysis while protecting quality, accuracy, customer trust, and brand standards.

What Makes You Qualified

  • 5–7 years of experience in B2B integrated marketing, demand generation, account-based marketing, campaign management, or a related discipline; enterprise SaaS experience is strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of 1:1, 1: Few ABM motions, buying groups, persona-led journeys, account research, and relevant account-specific experiences.
  • Experience partnering with Sales and cross-functional marketing teams in a matrixed, global environment.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple programs, stakeholders, deadlines, and dependencies.
  • Analytical fluency across engagement, conversion, funnel, pipeline, and account-level performance metrics.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, strong attention to detail, and the ability to turn complex inputs into actionable plans.
  • Hands-on experience with CRM, marketing automation, campaign analytics, paid media, webinar, and project-management platforms.
  • Familiarity with ABM and intent platforms such as 6sense, Demandbase, or Terminus is preferred; comparable account intelligence experience is welcome.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant work experience.

What You’ll Help Achieve

In your first year, you’ll help establish a dependable, insight-led campaign and ABM operating rhythm that improves account engagement, strengthens Sales partnership, and connects marketing activity to measurable business progress.

  • Consistently deliver integrated campaigns and ABM plays against agreed briefs, milestones, quality standards, and business priorities.
  • Improve engagement and buying-group coverage across priority audiences and accounts.
  • Create a dependable operating rhythm with Sales and partner teams, including clear targeting, activation, follow-up, and feedback loops.
  • Provide actionable reporting that connects campaign activity to funnel progression, pipeline, and account outcomes.
  • Build reusable playbooks, templates, and learnings that improve campaign quality and scale.

We focus on our mission: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

  • Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.

  • Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.

  • Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

We believe in our product: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

We invest in our people: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.

To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.

To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.

EEO - Our philosophy: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.

Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.

Warning about Recruiting Scams: Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.

title: Senior Software Engineer (GOlang, Engine)
description:
About Workato

Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit .

Why join us?

Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a flexible, trust-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles. We are driven by innovation and looking for team players who want to actively build our company.

But, we also believe in balancing productivity with self-care. That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives.

If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!

Also, feel free to check out why:

  • Business Insider named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”
  • Forbes’ Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world
  • Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America
  • Quartz ranked us the #1 best company for remote workers

Responsibilities

The Engine team develops and maintains core components of the Workato Recipe runtime. Scope includes recipe execution, DSL, event pulling, webhook processing, and job execution. The team owns trigger and event infrastructure that defines how integrations start and react to external events. Current focus: modernization of a high-throughput platform to improve reliability, scalability, and long-term evolvability. Work is platform-oriented and directly impacts runtime performance and system correctness.

In this role, you will also be responsible to:

  • Design and implement distributed backend systems in Go with deep consideration of performance and memory behavior.

  • Work on runtime-level components operating under high concurrency and throughput.

  • Apply in-depth knowledge of Go internals (scheduler, memory model, garbage collection behavior) to improve system efficiency.

  • Design and optimize concurrent workflows using goroutines, channels, synchronization primitives, and context propagation.

  • Analyze and optimize slice usage, memory allocations, and data structures for performance-critical paths.

  • Improve execution engine for custom third-party code (isolation, performance, feature extensions).

  • Modernize runtime components with focus on modularity, structured architecture, and observability.

  • Improve trigger configuration and execution across webhooks and polling mechanisms.

  • Integrate and optimize data storage solutions (Postgres, S3, DynamoDB, Kafka, ClickHouse).

  • Identify bottlenecks, race conditions, deadlocks, and performance degradation in distributed systems.

  • Own initiatives end-to-end, from design to rollout and production support.

  • Conduct code reviews with emphasis on correctness, concurrency safety, and performance characteristics.

Requirements

Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills

  • Strong experience in building scalable distributed backend applications (7+ years).

  • Great understanding of all building blocks of large web applications: databases, load balancers, application servers, message brokers, caching, monitoring, etc.

  • Good understanding of network protocols and stacks.

  • Good understanding of DB technologies: classic databases and modern no-SQL.

  • Knowledge of basic data structures and algorithms and how they are used is a must.

  • Multilingual programming experience: our code base is primarily in Ruby, with trend to migrate to GOlang and Rust.

  • Excellent debugging, analytical, problem solving, and social skills.

  • BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related subject, 7+ years of industry experience.

  • Readiness to work remotely with teams distributed across the world and timezones.

Nice to Haves

  • Background in network programming.

  • Background in application, data security.

  • Deep knowledge of physical DB design.

  • Experience of working with Docker and other isolation technologies.

  • Experience of working with public cloud infrastructure providers(AWS/Azure/Google Cloud).

  • Experience in related fields (DevOps, ML, DBA, Enterprise applications, etc).

  • Experience in building/deploying data processing pipelines is a plus.

  • Experience of working with third-party REST APIs at scale (request throttling, batch processing etc).

    Location: Remote — We are hiring candidates based in Germany, Armenia, Georgia, Portugal, Poland, the Netherlands, Serbia, Armenia, Georgia, Greece, and Spain.

title: Tupande Health, Safety, Security, and Transport (HSST) Coordinator
description:
About One Acre Fund

Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across nine countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services. On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions. To learn more, please see our Why Work Here blog post.

Our Kenya program, founded in 2006, operates under the local brand Tupande. Close to 500 staff in our Kakamega headquarters support 1,747 field staff and serve more than 1 million farmers. In Nairobi, around 50 staff support global functions like procurement, recruitment, government relations, and communications.

About the Role

Seeking a strategic leaders to lead Transport, OSH, and Security operations. You will manage a team, drive efficiency and compliance, and optimize budgets to ensure a safe, cost-effective environment for Tupande staff and partners.

Responsibilities

Manage the Transport workstream.

  • Oversee transport workstream daily operations to maintain high-quality standards and exceptional service provision.
  • Implement and audit transport workstream management systems to maintain expected performance standards.
  • Manage the transport workstream assets through their life cycle for adequate work resourcing.
  • Manage large and minor transport workstream projects, ensuring timely completion and customer satisfaction.
  • Act as the primary decision-maker for day-to-day transport operational roadblocks, resolving driver or vehicle issues that the supervisors cannot handle.
  • Enforce transport policies and maintenance schedules, ensuring the supervisors keep vehicles compliant, clean, and roadworthy.

Support the Occupational Safety and Health workstream

  • Engage with relevant internal and external stakeholders to plan, implement, and complete annual OSH audits and related training.
  • Organize all audit reports and training certificates for ease of sharing with relevant stakeholders
  • Support in overseeing the OSH compliance for all relevant Tupande locations across all our regions of operation.
  • Coordinate the implementation of all OSH audit recommendations to ensure 100% implementation rate across all audited locations.

Support Security Operations

  • Act as the primary daily contact for the Vendor Security Manager regarding routine deployment updates, ad-hoc requests, and immediate operational issues.
  • Validate the daily/weekly reports submitted by the security service provider against the internal observations to ensure "ghost guards" or missed shifts are flagged before invoicing.
  • Follow up with the vendor's technical team on maintenance and track their turnaround time to ensure they meet the maintenance Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  • Collaborate with the Security service provider during initial incident responses; ensure the vendor’s Incident Reports capture the full internal context and accuracy required.
  • Track recurring performance issues to provide data and talking points for the HSST lead during the monthly stakeholder sync-ups.
  • Coordinate with the security vendor to ensure access control protocols are being enforced on the ground as per Tupande’s policy across all locations.

Budget and Cost Management

  • Collate and track expenditure data for Transport, OSH, and Security to assist in budget analysis.
  • Analyse HSST workstream expenditure to develop strategies to manage or reduce recurring expenses while maintaining quality.
  • Support in preparation of monthly BvA reports for leadership review.
  • Monitor budget levels to curb overspends and achieve 10% budget savings annually.
  • Review vendor invoices against LPOs to ensure accurate vendor payments

People Management

  • Recruit the right team members to fill any personnel gaps.
  • Identify and facilitate opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • Develop and train the team on HSST workstream performance metrics so they know what success in their roles looks like.
  • Track, audit, and report on HSST workstream performance metrics to ensure the team achieves performance expectations.
  • Identify potential future leaders within the team and develop their skills to prepare them for leadership roles.
  • Foster a collaborative and inclusive workplace culture, implementing initiatives to boost team morale and motivation.

Career Growth and Development

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

Qualifications

Across all roles, these are the general qualifications we look for. For this role specifically, you will have:

Technical skills:

  • Google Suite applications, i.e., Google Sheets and Google Docs.
  • Proficiency in software and systems that manage and track transport operations.
  • Experience with tools used for raising PRs and managing vendor payments.

Knowledge:

  • Knowledge of fleet management and logistics principles, including route efficiency, scheduling maintenance, conducting safety checks, and ensuring proper vehicle performance.
  • Familiarity with safety regulations and compliance standards in the transport industry.
  • Knowledge of applicable safety regulations and transport industry-specific compliance requirements.
  • Knowledge of OSHA and safety regulations in Kenya.
  • Ability to conduct a Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment to assist the HSST Lead.
  • Knowledge of fire suppression systems and evacuation drill protocols.
  • Understanding of security and basic access controls, technology and regulation
  • SLA management and understanding of how to hold private security firms accountable to Guard Force Instructions (GFIs).

Preferred Start Date

As soon as possible

Job Location

Kakamega, Kenya

Benefits

Health insurance, paid time off

Eligibility

This role is only open to citizens or permanent residents of Kenya.

Application Deadline

28 January 2027. Please note that we hire on a rolling basis which means that applications are reviewed and processed on a continuous basis until a hire is made.

One Acre Fund never asks candidates to pay any money or pay for tests at any stage of the interview process. Official One Acre Fund emails will always arrive from an @ address. Please report any suspicious communication here (globalhotline@oneacrefund.org), but do not send applications or application materials to this email address.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion (DEI), and anti-racism are deeply connected to our organization’s mission and purpose. One Acre Fund aspires to build a culture where all staff feel consistently valued, represented, and connected – so that our team can thrive as professionals, and achieve exceptional impact for the farmers we serve.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

title: Project and Change Manager
description:
• Division: Business Services
  • Team: Operations – Change Management
  • Location: Leeds

About Alpha FMC

Alpha Financial Markets Consulting is a leading global consultancy to the financial services industry. Founded in 2003, we have worked for over 20 years to bring together specialist, sector-focused strategy, management consulting and technology expertise to support the entire client transformation lifecycle. Having partnered with more than 1,200 clients worldwide across the asset and wealth management, alternatives and insurance industries, Alpha is truly a trusted advisor for complex change programmes. We now have over 1,180 consultants working with clients across North America, the UK, Europe, Middle East and APAC. In 2024, in recognition of our successful track record and strong growth prospects, Alpha was acquired by Bridgepoint, one of the world’s leading quoted private asset growth investors. Our people are at the heart of everything we do. We are delighted that many of our team have built long and fulfilling careers with us, many staying over a decade. We believe this is because Alpha offers a genuinely rewarding place to work: a meritocratic environment where your career can flourish, and a welcoming culture where you can be yourself, connect with others and thrive. As we look to the future, we’re excited to be looking for new Alpha colleagues – individuals who are collaborative, innovative and ambitious. We hope you will join us and help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.

Why join Alpha Business Services?

  • Be part of something successful – We’re an established professional services firm with an ambitious growth trajectory. Your work directly supports and impacts our business success and makes a real contribution to the company’s success story.
  • Unlock your potential – You’ll grow through meaningful work, real exposure to new challenges and continuous learning. Stretch your skills, take ownership of key responsibilities and access progression opportunities as our company grows.
  • Belong to a great international team – Our culture is collaborative, supportive, and social. You’ll work with people who value teamwork, celebrate success and genuinely enjoy working together.
  • Thrive with us – Benefit from flexible working, market-aligned pay and benefits and a supportive environment that helps you do your best work.

Overview of Business Services

While consultants focus on delivery client value, our ‘Business Services’ function ensures that the company runs efficiently and appropriately across a number of operational areas: People, Operations, IT, Legal and Finance. Together, these teams ensure the consultants are fully supported – working from a strong operational base that’s efficient, innovative and compliant. Business Services doesn’t just enable delivery; it empowers Alpha’s long-term success.

Overview of Change (Operations)

The Change team is a key part of the Operations function and consists of two core pillars – the Change pillar works closely with senior leadership to implement key Group-wide change and transformation projects. These projects both support the Group’s growth ambitions as well as support the Group’s internal strategic evolution, for example from inorganic acquisitions, organic acquisitions or key technological and operational change. The Business Analysis & Support pillar performs key business analysis tasks ranging from requirements development to supporting change projects, as well as managing a number of key operational and business functions across the Group. Through both its Change and Business Analysis activities, the team is pivotal to ensuring and enabling Alpha’s long-term growth and competitiveness.

Role & Requirements

Role: We are looking to hire a Project and Change Manager into the Change team. The role requires ownership of change from a project management (PM), change management (CM) and business analysis (BA) perspective. This means demonstrating strong judgement in driving project delivery, proactively identifying risks and challenges, developing practical solutions and recommendations, and escalating issues with appropriate context and proposed options. Key responsibilities will include:

  • Leading and delivering a variety of change initiatives, projects and programmes. This will include acquisition integration projects, IT, business and operational change implementation projects
  • Taking responsibility for autonomously driving projects forwards, ensuring milestones and deliverables are on track
  • Developing and executing detailed project and integration plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables and key project management collateral
  • Establishing and maintaining appropriate project governance, working with project sponsors and stakeholders to clarify responsibilities, decision-making arrangements, approval requirements and escalation routes from project initiation through to delivery. Chairing governance when appropriate, including Steering Committee meetings – providing updates to key senior leaders within the business and leading subsequent discussions regarding project direction and/or developments
  • Partnering with business and operational stakeholders to assess and implement change, and acting as a trusted advisor to leaders and teams, building buy-in and reducing resistance
  • Translating complex project information into clear, concise and audience-appropriate communications, ensuring senior stakeholders have the relevant context, recommendations and information required to make informed decisions
  • Identifying and managing risks, challenges, and opportunities in change projects
  • Monitoring and measuring change progress, identifying barriers and driving corrective actions where needed
  • Serving as an ambassador for the internal change team, providing ad-hoc support to the business where needed
  • Supporting continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned and refining change approaches
  • Ensuring alignment of change activities with business objectives, culture, and values
  • Continuously building and leveraging a deeper and more thorough understanding of Alpha’s business model, strategy, employees, industry and clients to work on increasingly complex projects and deliver real impact for the Group

Qualifications:

Must have:

  • Minimum 5+ years’ experience in project management, change management, consulting and/or transformation, in particular in operational change
  • Extensive proven experience in leading and delivering operational change, including acquisition integration, IT implementations, Business Change and Operational implementation projects as a project or programme manager
  • Understanding and experience of the end-to-end project management and change management process, including working with key frameworks and collateral
  • Proven ability to lead and deliver complex projects whilst and working with cross-functional teams
  • Strong understanding of project management and change management frameworks as well as their practical applications
  • A self-starter who is proactive and shows initiative
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills. Experience in working with senior (up to C-suite) stakeholders
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and organisational skills
  • Ability to influence and build relationships at all levels of the organisation
  • Experience in developing and delivering change communications and training
  • Ability to multitask and work on multiple initiatives simultaneously
  • Good Microsoft Office and project planning skills, experience in other SaaS systems (e.g. Salesforce, Slack) is a plus

Good to have:

  • Professional certification in Change Management
  • Project management certification or experience working in structured project environments
  • Relevant Professional Services and/or Financial Services experience
  • Experience with digital transformation or large-scale systems implementations
  • Exposure to business process improvement methodologies

Location and working pattern:

Alpha is proud to offer a hybrid working arrangement wherein staff are able to combine office and home working. This would typically mean 2–3 days in the Leeds Alpha office; however the exact arrangements will be confirmed based upon the role and responsibilities. Occasional travel might be required, more likely at senior levels.

Benefits & Compensation

  • Competitive salary with annual profit-sharing opportunity
  • 25 days’ holiday additional to bank holidays
  • Private Medical Health Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • Mobile phone and Company laptop

Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Alpha, diversity, equity and inclusion are critical to our success. Our priorities show a focus on fostering an inclusive, equitable workplace where individuals are treated fairly regardless of gender or background. We welcome applications from disabled people and are committed to making our recruitment process and workplace accessible and inclusive for everyone.

Data Privacy Policy: Full details around what data we hold, why we hold it and for how long are available in our recruitment privacy statement (). If you have any questions, or would like us to delete your data, please contact us by email at privacy@alphafmc.com

title: Analytics Engineer, Data Management
description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the Role

We are seeking an Analytics Engineer to join our internal Data Management team. As an Analytics Engineer, you will be part of the team transforming and delivering data for our Data Science, Analytics, and Reporting team use. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining our data marts, pipelines, and data processes. This role requires a blend of strong technical skills, analytical thinking, and an ability to understand and communicate technical solutions with business partners.

Work model: full-remote from Romania

What You’ll Do

  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable data marts and ETL/ELT processes using SQL or Python
  • Transforming raw data from multiple sources into structured datasets for analysis and reporting
  • Collaborate with data analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand their data needs and turn those requirements into well-defined data models
  • Build and orchestrate pipelines using Azure Data Factory and Databricks (Python notebooks and Spark SQL)
  • Deliver and maintain recurring reporting datasets, including but not limited to Finance and Sales, such as quarterly business reviews and sales compensation
  • Implement data quality checks and reconciliations so reported numbers can be trusted and traced back to their source
  • Own operational health of the AE team’s pipelines: job scheduling and dependencies, monitoring, alerting on late or stale data, and root-cause analysis when something breaks
  • Work closely with our internal Data, Architecture, and DevOps teams on deployments, infrastructure, and platform standards
  • Document data flows, models, and processes clearly enough that a teammate can support them without you

What You’ll Bring

  • 3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI engineering
  • Advanced SQL, including window functions, CTEs, complex joins, and query performance tuning
  • Python for data pipeline work (PySpark or pandas)
  • Solid understanding of dimensional modeling and slowly changing dimensions (SCD Type 2)
  • Experience building data processes on a cloud platform (Azure preferred; AWS or GCP considered)
  • Experience running pipelines in production: scheduling, monitoring, and troubleshooting failures, not just building them
  • Experience delivering datasets for recurring business reporting where accuracy and deadlines matter
  • Ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders
  • Fluent English both spoken/written
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent work experience

What You’ll Get

  • 21 annual vacation days, additional days based on tenure, plus 4 extra global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
  • Private health, dental, and vision insurance for employees and dependents, including outpatient care, hospitalization, pregnancy monitoring, and psychology support
  • Monthly lifestyle and daily meal benefits: 40 RON/day via Edenred and 600 RON/month through a flexible cafeteria platform
  • Life insurance (2× annual gross salary), critical illness, and disability coverage, plus vision reimbursement
  • Free access to Bookster library platform for borrowing your favorite books for free
  • Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning
