About Us

Optima Health is the UK's largest provider of Occupational Health and wellbeing services, supporting organisations across both the public and private sectors. With a heritage dating back to 1947, we have been helping employers create healthier, high-performing workplaces for generations, and we continue to evolve with innovative, practical solutions that make a real difference.

At the heart of our story are our people. We bring together like-minded professionals who are passionate about improving workplace health and wellbeing and delivering meaningful support to the organisations we work with across the UK.

When you join Optima Health, you become part of something bigger. We invest in our people/you through structured induction, ongoing training and tailored career development, helping you build the skills and experience to grow your career.

Together, we live our values:

One Team – There are no barriers in our business. We trust each other and work together as one team to deliver what our clients need. We all have a part to play in our future, and everyone's contribution is important and valued.

Doing the Right Thing – We operate to the highest standards. Success is underpinned by honesty and integrity, and by doing what we say we will do. We care about the impact of our work on our people, our clients, their employees, society, and the world we live in. Caring for our colleagues' wellbeing and respecting their time, energy and balance is fundamental to this value.

Shaping Tomorrow – We are always looking for ways to improve and innovate. We train, support and empower future leaders, invest in market-leading propositions and use technology to advance service and clinical outcomes. We evolve how we work - embracing smater, more flexible approaches that help our people thrive both professionally and personally.

Never Too Big to Care – We always retain a client-first approach. Every client, and every one of their employees that we support, matters. We work in partnership to optimise workplace health and wellbeing, sharing in the benefits of growing together

Role Summary

The role will involve supporting a higher education client based in Newcastle upon Tyne. The role sits within an established occupational health service, supporting the health and wellbeing of staff across a university environment.

The working pattern is flexible, with opportunities for candidates seeking 3, 4 or 5 days per week. Those working 3 days per week will spend all three days onsite with the client. The core focus of the role is case management, handling a maximum of approximately 6 cases per day. The service also delivers immunisations, and training can be provided for candidates who do not currently have this competency.

Additional responsibilities include supporting flu immunisation clinics and contributing to wider health initiatives onsite. The onsite team includes an occupational health technician present four days per week, along with access to an external physiotherapy provider.

title: Corporate Responsibility Specialist
description:
AFL manufactures industry-leading fiber optic cable, connectivity and accessories and provides engineering and installation services for some of the largest telecom customers in the world. Our company was founded in 1984 with a single fiber optic cable and today, we manufacture thousands of products, generate an excess of $2B in revenue, and employ approximately 12,000 associates worldwide. At AFL, we recognize that our employees are our greatest asset. We hire and train each individual, investing in them to ensure success in their careers. With a commitment to professional development and growth, let us connect you to your next career opportunity.

What We Offer:
A hybrid in office schedule for qualifying employees
Flexible time off policy
401K Company match (up to 4% - dollar for dollar)
Professional development, training, and tuition reimbursement programs
Excellent medical, dental, vision, and life insurance policy options
Opportunities for career advancement with an industry leading company!

About the Role
The Corporate Responsibility Specialist supports the coordination, implementation, and continuous improvement of corporate responsibility programs, requirements, and related initiatives across AFL, with a primary focus on Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) program management. This role helps translate RBA, customer, regulatory, and stakeholder expectations into practical internal processes, governance structures, reporting, and cross-functional action.
Reporting to the Corporate Responsibility Manager, this position works across supply chain, commercial, legal, compliance, sustainability, operations, engineering, and business-unit teams. Success requires a highly organized, self-directed professional who can create structure, coordinate action, and communicate clearly across functions. The ideal candidate is experienced in independently building and maturing a cross-functional program with limited day-to-day direction.

What You'll Do
RBA Program Management & Requirements
• Lead coordination of AFL’s Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) membership, commitments, annual obligations, internal tracking, and related leadership updates.
• Help define and communicate internal expectations for alignment with the RBA Code of Conduct and related requirements across AFL operations and the supply chain.
• Monitor updates to the RBA Code of Conduct, RBA VAP standard, and related regulations and standards, and support business adoption of new or updated requirements.
• Schedule and support Validated Assessment Program (VAP) audits as required; coordinate internal preparation, gap assessments, corrective actions, and shared learnings across the business and supply chain.
• Maintain trackers, dashboards, review cadences, and concise leadership updates to support visibility into RBA commitments, risks, decisions, and resourcing needs.
Cross-Functional Implementation & Gap Closure
• Support business adoption of the RBA Code of Conduct across operations and supply chain by translating expectations into practical processes, timelines, ownership models, and escalation paths.
• Create structure where ownership, process, documentation, or accountability are unclear, and drive alignment on practical gap-closure plans.
• Develop and maintain procedures, work instructions, tools, and documentation that support consistent implementation across functions.
• Represent Corporate Responsibility on the Product Stewardship Task Force, with a focus on responsible sourcing, responsible minerals, supply chain due diligence, and related customer and regulatory requirements.
• Facilitate working groups and action-oriented meetings that move programs from concept to execution.
• Develop and support recurring training, guidance, and practical tools for cross-functional teams.
Customer, Commercial & Stakeholder Support
• Lead or coordinate responses to customer responsible sourcing, social responsibility, supplier due diligence, and sustainability-related requests that require cross-functional input.
• Support commercial and supply chain teams in understanding customer due diligence requirements, routing requests appropriately, and providing consistent responses.
Success Measures / KPIs
• RBA commitments, annual obligations, and internal reporting milestones are completed on time, with accurate tracking and clear visibility for leadership.
• VAP audit preparation, gap assessments, corrective actions, and shared learnings are coordinated effectively across applicable functions.
• Corporate responsibility requirements, risks, and customer requests are routed, documented, and escalated consistently through established ownership and decision-making processes.
• Procedures, work instructions, tools, and ownership models are maintained and used by cross-functional teams to support consistent implementation.
• Customer and internal stakeholder requests are responded to accurately, consistently, and within expected timelines.
• RBA and related corporate responsibility program maturity improves over time through stronger documentation, coordination, training, and stakeholder engagement.

What Sets You Up For Success
Required
• Bachelor’s degree in sustainability, business, supply chain, environmental studies, compliance, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
• 3–5 years of experience in corporate responsibility, sustainability, ESG, responsible sourcing, supply chain risk, procurement compliance, customer due diligence, or related program management.
• Proven experience coordinating cross-functional programs that require stakeholder alignment, process development, documentation, and sustained follow-through.
• Demonstrated ability to clarify ambiguous requirements, create structure, manage priorities, and drive work to completion with limited day-to-day direction.
• Strong written communication skills, attention to detail, and ability to simplify complex external requirements into practical internal guidance.
• Ability to facilitate cross-functional discussions, gather input from multiple stakeholders, and translate decisions into clear actions.
• Ability to prepare clear leadership updates, communicate risks and recommendations, and support cross-functional alignment on decisions, ownership, and next steps.
• Comfortable working in a developing program environment where processes may need to be built, improved, or standardized over time.
Preferred
• Responsible Business Alliance (RBA), supplier code of conduct, human rights due diligence, VAP audit support, or responsible sourcing program experience.
• Experience supporting customer sustainability, responsible sourcing, supply chain due diligence, or social responsibility requests and cross-functional evidence collection.
• Conflict minerals program experience, including familiarity with OECD-aligned due diligence expectations and ability to support business adoption of RBA responsible minerals requirements.
• Project management, continuous improvement, training development, or change-management experience in a manufacturing, technology, supply chain, or industrial environment.

What You Can Expect
• Normal office and manufacturing facility environment.
• Some travel may be required, but not frequent (<15%).
• When not traveling, the schedule is three days in the Duncan office and two days remote.

title: Data Scientist-Ai Engineer
description:

  • Conoscenza concreta delle architetture RAG, con esperienza nella progettazione e implementazione di pipeline per applicazioni LLM-based, vector store (FAISS, Chroma, Pinecone), embedding models e LangChain/LlamaIndex. Fortemente preferibile esperienza nel settore Financial Services / FSI, in particolare su casi d'uso quali document Q&A, contratti, normative o report finanziari.

But, we also believe in balancing productivity with self-care. That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives.

If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!

Also, feel free to check out why:

  • Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America
  • Quartz ranked us the #1 best company for remote workers

Responsibilities

The Engine team develops and maintains core components of the Workato Recipe runtime. Scope includes recipe execution, DSL, event pulling, webhook processing, and job execution. The team owns trigger and event infrastructure that defines how integrations start and react to external events. Current focus: modernization of a high-throughput platform to improve reliability, scalability, and long-term evolvability. Work is platform-oriented and directly impacts runtime performance and system correctness.

In this role, you will also be responsible to:

  • Design and implement distributed backend systems in Go with deep consideration of performance and memory behavior.

  • Work on runtime-level components operating under high concurrency and throughput.

  • Apply in-depth knowledge of Go internals (scheduler, memory model, garbage collection behavior) to improve system efficiency.
